	        If MsCuerpo = NullValue() Then Setlog(0,60,1,36,GetChannelId(),"28")        

        EndIf
        MsCuerpo =MsCuerpo + " "+MsNombre  


    
    MAIL!MAIL.COMPOSE()
    MAIL!MAIL.DESTINATION = MsDestino
    MAIL!MAIL.FROM = MsOrigen
    MAIL!MAIL.SUBJECT = MsSubject
    MAIL!MAIL.BODY = MsCuerpo

'SCO_DATE_NEW_HOUR
'Date - Hour  = date-New Hour
'ARG_DATE,ARG_HOUR

nYearD = 0 : nMonthD = 0 : nDayD = 0 : nHourD = 0 : nMinuteD = 0 : nSecondD = 0 
DateToAllNumbers(ARG_DATE,nYearD,nMonthD,nDayD,nHourD,nMinuteD,nSecondD)

nYearH = 0 : nMonthH = 0 : nDayH = 0 : nHourH = 0 : nMinuteH = 0 : nSecondH = 0 
DateToAllNumbers(ARG_HOUR,nYearH,nMonthH,nDayH,nHourH,nMinuteH,nSecondH)

dtResult = NumbersToDate(nYearD,nMonthD,nDayD,nHourH,nMinuteH,nSecondH)

Return(dtResult)

'SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR
'Date + hour = date and time
'ARG_DATE,ARG_HOUR

nYearD = 0 : nMonthD = 0 : nDayD = 0 : nHourD = 0 : nMinuteD = 0 : nSecondD = 0 
DateToAllNumbers(ARG_DATE,nYearD,nMonthD,nDayD,nHourD,nMinuteD,nSecondD)

nYearH = 0 : nMonthH = 0 : nDayH = 0 : nHourH = 0 : nMinuteH = 0 : nSecondH = 0 
DateToAllNumbers(ARG_HOUR,nYearH,nMonthH,nDayH,nHourH,nMinuteH,nSecondH)

dtResult = NumbersToDate(nYearD,nMonthD,nDayD,nHourD+nHourH,nMinuteD+nMinuteH,nSecondD+nSecondH)

Return(dtResult)

'SCO_DATE_TIME_PLUS_NUMBER
'Date and time + number of hours = date and time
'ARG_DATE,ARG_NUM_HOUR

nYearD = 0 : nMonthD = 0 : nDayD = 0 : nHourD = 0 : nMinuteD = 0 : nSecondD = 0 
DateToAllNumbers(ARG_DATE,nYearD,nMonthD,nDayD,nHourD,nMinuteD,nSecondD)

nMinuteH = ARG_NUM_HOUR * 60 

dtResult = NumbersToDate(nYearD,nMonthD,nDayD,nHourD,nMinuteD+nMinuteH,nSecondD)

Return(dtResult)

'SCO_DATE_TIME_TO_HOUR
'Convert Date and time in Hour (loosing date)
'ARG_DATE

nYearHr = 1970 : nMonthHr = 9 : nDayHr = 25
nYearD = 0 : nMonthD = 0 : nDayD = 0 : nHourD = 0 : nMinuteD = 0 : nSecondD = 0 
DateToAllNumbers(ARG_DATE,nYearD,nMonthD,nDayD,nHourD,nMinuteD,nSecondD)

hResult = NumbersToDate(nYearHr,nMonthHr,nDayHr,nHourD,nMinuteD,nSecondD)

Return(hResult)

'SCO_DIF_DATE_TIME_TO_NUMBER
'Diference between datetime in hours in number format

nDiffSeconds = DateDiff(ARG_HOUR_START,ARG_HOUR_END,M4_SECOND)

nDiff = nDiffSeconds/3600

Return(nDiff)

'SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER
'Diference between hours in hours in number format
'Examples 
'ARG_HOUR_END-ARG_HOUR_START=RESULT
'      9:00  -    7:30      = 1.50
'     18:00  -    9:00      = 9
'      9:00  -   18:00      = 15


nDiffHours = DateDiff(ARG_HOUR_START,ARG_HOUR_END,M4_HOUR)
dHour1_2 = DateAdd(ARG_HOUR_START,nDiffHours,M4_HOUR)
nDiffSeconds = DateDiff(dHour1_2,ARG_HOUR_END,M4_SECOND)
If nDiffHours < 0 Then nDiffHours = nDiffHours + 24

nDiff = nDiffHours + (nDiffSeconds/3600)

Return(nDiff)

'SCO_HOUR_TO_STRING
'Hour to string
' Example: 1970-09-25 19:04:00 => 19:04
' Example: 1970-09-25 19:54:08 => 19:54:08

nYear = 0 : nMonth = 0 : nDay = 0 : nHour = 0 : nMinute = 0 : nSecond = 0 
DateToAllNumbers(ARG_HOUR,nYear,nMonth,nDay,nHour,nMinute,nSecond)

If nHour < 10 Then
    sRet = "0" + ToString(nHour,0)
Else
    sRet = ToString(nHour,0)
EndIf

If nMinute < 10 Then
    sRet = sRet + ":0" + ToString(nMinute,0)
Else
    sRet = sRet + ":"  + ToString(nMinute,0)
EndIf

If nSecond <> 0 Then
    If nSecond < 10 Then
        sRet = sRet + ":0" + ToString(nSecond,0)
    Else
        sRet = sRet + ":"  + ToString(nSecond,0)
    EndIf       
EndIf

Return(sRet)

'SCO_NUM_HOUR_TO_STRING
'Hour (internally number) to string
' Example: 7,250000 => 7,25 o 07:15 depending on the application param

sRet = ""

'First, we transform to number, because sometimes can be a string (for example, from variant)
ARG_HOUR = ToDouble(ARG_HOUR)
If ARG_HOUR = nullvalue() Then ARG_HOUR = 0

If SCO_TIMESPAN_TYPE = nullvalue() Then
    'First, we take the parameter, if it is the first time
    DefineInstance("SAV_PARAMS","SAV_PARAMS",M4_AUTOLOAD_OFF,M4_INSTANCE_GLOBAL_SHARED)
    clcExecuteLn4Jit("SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE(ARG1,ARG2,ARG3)","ARG1","FORMS","ARG2","GENERAL","ARG3","TIMESPAN")
    If clcExecuteLn4Jit("Return(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.Count())") >0 Then
        nTimespan = clcExecuteLn4Jit("Return(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN[0].APP_VALUE)")
        SCO_TIMESPAN_TYPE = nTimespan
    EndIf
EndIf

If SCO_TIMESPAN_TYPE <> 1 Then
    'number mode
    sRet = ToString(ARG_HOUR,2)
Else
    'hours mode
    sRet = SCO_NUM_HOUR_TO_STRING_HHMM(ARG_HOUR)
EndIf
Return(sRet)

'SCO_NUM_HOUR_TO_STRING_HHMM
'Hour (internally number) to string hh:mm
' Example: 7,250000 => 7,25 
'For internal use.
'Always return the value in hh:mm, although the user wants to see the number

sRet = ""

'First, we transform to number, because sometimes can be a string (for example, from variant)
ARG_HOUR = ToDouble(ARG_HOUR)
If ARG_HOUR = nullvalue() Then ARG_HOUR = 0

'hours mode
nEnterPart = Truncate(ARG_HOUR,0)
nDecimalPart = ARG_HOUR - nEnterPart
If nDecimalPart < 0 Then nDecimalPart = -1 * nDecimalPart 

If ARG_HOUR < 0 Then 
    nEnterPart = -1 * nEnterPart 
    sRet = sRet + "-"
EndIf
If nEnterPart < 10 Then sRet = sRet + "0"
sRet = sRet + ToString(nEnterPart,0)

sRet = sRet + ":"

nNumMin = nDecimalPart * 60
If nNumMin < 10 Then sRet = sRet + "0"
sRet = sRet + ToString(nNumMin,0)

Return(sRet)

'Loads the entitlement summaries valid for the given date and incidence list.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
' - ARG_SCO_INCIDENCE_LIST
'Returns number of records loaded

DestroyBlock()

sFrom = "FROM &SCO_AB_H_HRP_ENT_SUMMARY A, SCO_X_AB_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE B"
sJoin = " WHERE A.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE = B.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE"
sWhere = " AND B.SCO_ID_INCIDENCE IN (" + ARG_SCO_INCIDENCE_LIST + ")"
sWhere = sWhere + " AND A.SCO_DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0)"

sAsAtDate = ToString(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)

SCO_SYS_SENTENCE = sFrom + sJoin + sWhere
SCO_SYS_PARAM = sAsAtDate + "|" + sAsAtDate

Load_BLK()

Return(Count())

'****************************************************************************************** 
' Metodo:  GET_TEXTO
' Fecha:   22/11/2000
' Version: 1.0
'******************************************************************************************
' Devuelve el valor del texto de un tipo de E-Mail
' Argumentos: PARAMETRO

MsParametro = PARAMETRO
MnTipo = TIPO
MsValor = ""
SSE_CUERPO_MAIL.Begin()
MnReg = SSE_CUERPO_MAIL.FindRegister("SSE_ID_MAIL",MsParametro,1)
If MnReg <> -1 Then
    SSE_CUERPO_MAIL.MoveTo(MnReg)
    MsValor = SSE_CUERPO_MAIL.SSE_N_TEXT
    MsSubject = SSE_CUERPO_MAIL.SSE_SUBJECT

Else

'Error. El parámetro buscado no se encuentra. Debe crearlo en tatatá...
    
EndIf
If MsValor = NullValue() Then MsValor = ""
If MnTipo = 1 Then

    Return(MsValor)
    
ElseIf MnTipo = 2 Then

    Return(MsSubject)
    
EndIf

'****************************************************************************
' Metodo:  GET_DATE
' Fecha:   30/11/2000
' Version: 1.0                                                 NO MODIFICABLE
'****************************************************************************
'Argumentos:2
'GET_DATE( String STRING_DATE, Int TIPO)
'El primer argumneto nos da el String que vamos a convertir a fecha
'El segundo no da un entero que nos dice como nos viene el string
'TIPO=1=>Formato Español dd-mm-yyyy
MsDate = STRING_DATE
MnTipo=TIPO
a=length(MsDate)

MvValue = STRING_DATE  
MsSeparador = "-"
' Calculo del formato utilizado por el usuario:
If MvValue = NullValue() or  MvValue  ="" Then  Return(AppEndDate())
MsFormat =    SGCO_DATE_FORMAT
If MsFormat =" " or MsFormat =NullValue() then 


DefineInstance("SAV_PARAMS","SAV_PARAMS", 1, 3)  
Code = "Return(SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.THINCLIENT_GET("+ CHR(34) +"FORMAT"+ CHR(34) +","+ CHR(34)+"DATE"+ CHR(34) +"))"
iRetCode   =(ClcExecuteLN4JIT(Code))

        If (iRetCode = 1) Then
            MDFormat = "Return(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE)"
MsFormat = (ClcExecuteLN4JIT(MDFormat ))

            'MsFormat = SAV_PARAM_GN_ROOT!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE
             SGCO_DATE_FORMAT =MsFormat 
        Else
            MsFormat = M4_ERROR
        EndIf
 Endif   
  
Code = "Return(SAV_PARAMS!UTILS.EXTRACT_DATE_SEPARATOR ("+ CHR(34) +MsFormat + CHR(34) +"))"

MsSeparadorUser =  (ClcExecuteLN4JIT(Code))
MsFormat = Replace(MsFormat ,MsSeparadorUser ,MsSeparador)
    
If MsFormat = M4_Error Then SetLog(0,61,1,1,MsFormat)

 If MsFormat = "dd-MM-yyyy" Then

        MsDias = Mid(MvValue,0,2)
        MsMes = Mid(MvValue,3,2)
        MsAno = Mid(MvValue,6,4)

    ElseIf MsFormat = "dd-yyyy-MM" Then
    
        MsDias = Mid(MvValue,0,2)
        MsAno = Mid(MvValue,3,4)
        MsMes = Mid(MvValue,8,2)

    ElseIf MsFormat = "MM-dd-yyyy" Then
    
        MsMes = Mid(MvValue,0,2)
        MsDias = Mid(MvValue,3,2)
        MsAno = Mid(MvValue,6,4)

    ElseIf MsFormat = "MM-yyyy-dd" Then
    
        MsMes = Mid(MvValue,0,2)
        MsAno = Mid(MvValue,3,4)
        MsDias = Mid(MvValue,8,2)

    ElseIf MsFormat = "yyyy-dd-MM" Then
    
        MsAno = Mid(MvValue,0,4)
        MsDias = Mid(MvValue,5,2)
        MsMes = Mid(MvValue,8,2)

    ElseIf MsFormat = "yyyy-MM-dd" Then
    
        MsAno = Mid(MvValue,0,4)
        MsMes = Mid(MvValue,5,2)
        MsDias = Mid(MvValue,8,2)

    Else
    
        ' Formato incorrecto
               
    EndIf
    

    MsValor = MsAno + MsSeparador + MsMes + MsSeparador + MsDias


    
    if MnTipo=2 then     Return(MsValor)

    MsValor = ToDate(MsValor)
    Return(MsValor)

'****************************************************************************
' Metodo:  GET_DATE
' Fecha:   30/11/2000
' Version: 1.0                                                 NO MODIFICABLE
'****************************************************************************
'Argumentos:2
'GET_DATE( String STRING_DATE, Int TIPO)
'El primer argumneto nos da el String que vamos a convertir a fecha
'El segundo no da un entero que nos dice como nos viene el string
'TIPO=1=>Formato Español dd-mm-yyyy
MsDate = STRING_DATE
MnTipo=TIPO
a=length(MsDate)
If MsDate=NullValue() or MsDate="" Then
    Return(AppEndDate())

elseif a>=10 Then
    If MnTipo=1 Then
        MsDias =Mid(MsDate,0,2)
        MsMes=Mid(MsDate,3,2)
        MsAno=Mid(MsDate,6,4)
        MsValor = MsAno + "-" + MsMes + "-" + MsDias
        Return(MsValor)
    else
    'error  de momento solo esta implementado el tipo 1
     Setlog(0,60,5,1,Mntipo,"GET_DATE")
    EndIf
else   
    'error
    Setlog(0,60,5,1,MsDate,"GET_DATE")
EndIf

'****************************************************************************
' Metodo:  NULL_DATE
' Fecha:   01/12/2000
' Version: 1.0                                                 NO MODIFICABLE
'****************************************************************************
'Argumentos:1
'NULL_DATE( DAte ARG_DATE)
'A esta función le pasamos una fecha:
'Si la fecha es distinta de +infinito(4000-01-01), no s devuleve la misma fecha y sino un nulo
MdFecha=ARG_DATE
If MdFecha=AppEndDate() then
    MdFecha= Nullvalue()
EndIf
Return(MdFecha)

'Método SRCO_DATE_SUSER
'Argumento  PAR_DATE- fecha
'Dada una fecha nos da  un string con la fecha en formato usuario


dDate = PAR_DATE



MsSeparador = "-"
' Calculo del formato utilizado por el usuario:
If dDate = NullValue() or  dDate ="" Then  Return("")
MsFormat =    SGCO_DATE_FORMAT

If MsFormat =" " or MsFormat =NullValue() then 
    DefineInstance("SAV_PARAMS","SAV_PARAMS", 1, 3)  
    Code = "Return(SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.THINCLIENT_GET("+ CHR(34) +"FORMAT"+ CHR(34) +","+ CHR(34)+"DATE"+ CHR(34) +"))"
    iRetCode   =(ClcExecuteLN4JIT(Code))
    If (iRetCode = 1) Then
        MDFormat = "Return(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE)"
        MsFormat = (ClcExecuteLN4JIT(MDFormat ))
        SGCO_DATE_FORMAT =MsFormat 
    Else
            MsFormat = M4_ERROR
    EndIf
 Endif   
  
Code = "Return(SAV_PARAMS!UTILS.EXTRACT_DATE_SEPARATOR ("+ CHR(34) +MsFormat + CHR(34) +"))"

MsSeparadorUser =  (ClcExecuteLN4JIT(Code))
MsFormat = Replace(MsFormat ,MsSeparadorUser ,MsSeparador)
sAno = ""
MsMes = ""
MsDias = ""
MnAno = 0
MnMes = 0
MnDia = 0

DateToNumbers(dDate ,MnAno,MnMes,MnDia)
MsAno = ToString(Format(MnAno,0))
MnMes = Format(MnMes,0)
If Length(MnMes) = 1 Then

    MsMes = "0" + ToString(MnMes)

Else

    MsMes = ToString(MnMes)

EndIf
MnDia = Format(MnDia,0)
If Length(MnDia) = 1 Then

    MsDias = "0" + ToString(MnDia)

Else

    MsDias = ToString(MnDia)

EndIf

If MsFormat = "dd-MM-yyyy" Then

    MsResultado = MsDias + MsSeparadorUser + MsMes + MsSeparadorUser + MsAno
    
ElseIf MsFormat = "dd-yyyy-MM" Then

    MsResultado = MsDias+ MsSeparadorUser + MsAno + MsSeparadorUser + MsMes
    
ElseIf MsFormat = "MM-dd-yyyy" Then

    MsResultado = MsMes + MsSeparadorUser + MsDias + MsSeparadorUser + MsAno

ElseIf MsFormat = "MM-yyyy-dd" Then

    MsResultado = MsMes + MsSeparadorUser + MsAno + MsSeparadorUser + MsDias
    
ElseIf MsFormat = "yyyy-dd-MM" Then

    MsResultado = MsAno + MsSeparadorUser + MsDias + MsSeparadorUser + MsMes
    
ElseIf MsFormat = "yyyy-MM-dd" Then

    MsResultado = MsAno + MsSeparadorUser + MsMes + MsSeparadorUser + MsDias        

Else

    ' Formato incorrecto
    
EndIf
Return(MsResultado)

M4RCH_RULES3/ID_TI/MAIL.SOURCE_CODE:
for I=1 to length(STRFILENAME)
    if MID(STRFILENAME,I,1)="*" then
       //Error: not allowed as file name. File will not be attached.
       return -1
    endif
next

if ATTACHMENTS = "" then 
    ATTACHMENTS = STRFILENAME
else
    ATTACHMENTS = ATTACHMENTS + "*" + STRFILENAME
endif

if count() > 0 THEN
    for I=0 to count()-1
        if BOXTYPE=2 then
            DestroyRegister()
        endif
    next
endif

addregister()

BOXTYPE=0 ' Messages to send
SUBJECT=""
ATTACHMENTS=""

moveto(count()-1)

' ************************************************************
' (c) Copyright 1991-2000, Meta Software M.S., S.A.
' All rights reserved.
'
' Module           : Mail
' Method           : DELETE_ATTACHMENTS
' Project          : 
' Author           : Meta Software M.S., S.A.
' Date             : 19/11/2015
' Language         : LN4
' Operating System : Microsoft Windows
' Design Document  : 
' Description      : Parsear cadena de ficheros adjuntos, separados por *
'                    y guardarlos en el nodo.
'
' ************************************************************
'
' Arguments:
'    AI_ATTACHMENTS: attachements.
' ************************************************************
'
' Return:
'
'     M4_ERROR
'     M4_SUCCESS
'
' ************************************************************

// Borrar directorio temporal donde se genera el fichero
// comprimido con los ficheros adjuntos, si ha sido necesario.
if (IsNull(TEMP_DIR) = M4_FALSE And TEMP_DIR <> "") then
    DLL_REMOVE_DIR(TEMP_DIR, 2)
endif
    
return M4_SUCCESS

// Verificar el número de argumentos.
// Servidor POP3/IMAP: tercer argumento. Oopcional.
// Puerto POP3/IMAP: cuarto argumento. Opcional. 

iArgNum = GetArgumentNumber()

// Leemos el servidor .
if iArgNum > 2 then
    sServer = GetArgument(4)
endif
// Leemos el puerto.
if (iArgNum > 3) Then
    iPort = GetArgument(5)
EndIf

If (MODEL =  0) Then
   'Si no nos pasan el server lo obtenemos del parámetro
   If (IsNull(sServer) = M4_TRUE OR sServer = "") Then
      SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("M4MAIL","SERVERS","POP3_SERVER")
      sServer = SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE  
   EndIf 
   'Si no nos pasan el puerto lo obtenemos del parámetro
   If (IsNull(iPort) = M4_TRUE OR iPort = "") Then
      SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("M4MAIL","PORTS","POP3_PORT")
      iPort = ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE)
   EndIf 
   
   return DELETE (sServer, USER, PASSWORD, MSG_NUM, iPort)

Else
    //Limpiamos el nodo de mensajes a borrar y añadimos el número de mensaje
    DELETE_MAILS.DESTROY_BLOCK()
    DELETE_MAILS.AddRegister()
    DELETE_MAILS.MESSAGE_NUMBER = MSG_NUM
    iRet = DELETEMSG_EX(USER,PASSWORD,sServer,iPort,NullValue())

EndIf

' Module           : Mail
' Method           : ReceiveAll_Ex
' Project          : 
' Author           : Meta Software M.S., S.A.
' Date             : 14/03/2017
' Language         : LN4
' Operating System : Microsoft Windows
' Design Document  : 
' Description      : Receive mail using Java mail component.
' ************************************************************
'
' Arguments:
'
'    USER: mail user.        If null will use the "M4MAIL/"AUTHENTICATION/IMAP_USER" param value
'    PASSWORD:               mail password. If null will use the "M4MAIL/AUTHENTICATION/IMAP_PWD" param value
'    SERVER:                 mail server. If null will use the "M4MAIL/SERVERS/IMAP_SERVER" param value
'    PORT:                   mail port. If null will use the "M4MAIL/SERVERS/IMAP_PORT" param value
'    FOLDER:                 folder to readc messages. If null folder will be 'Inbox' folder
'   
' ************************************************************
'
' Return:
'
'     M4_ERROR
'     M4_SUCCESS
'
' ************************************************************

'Usuario 
If (IsNull(USER )= True) Or (USER = "") then
      SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("M4MAIL","AUTHENTICATION","IMAP_USER")
      USER = SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE
EndIf

'Pwd
If (IsNull(PASSWORD)= True) Or (PASSWORD= "") then
      SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("M4MAIL","AUTHENTICATION","IMAP_PWD")
      PASSWORD= SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE
EndIf

'Servidor
If (IsNull(SERVER )= True) Or (SERVER = "") then
      SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("M4MAIL","SERVERS","IMAP_SERVER")
      SERVER = SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE
EndIf

'Puerto
If (IsNull(PORT)= True) then
      SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("M4MAIL","PORTS","IMAP_PORT")
      PORT= SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE
EndIf

'Carpeta
If (IsNull(FOLDER)= True) Or (FOLDER= "") then
      FOLDER= "inbox"
EndIf

'Leemos el valor del timeout
SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("M4MAIL","SERVERS","TIMEOUT")
iTimeOut = ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE)

'Leemos la seguridad de la configuración de IMAP_TRANSPORT
SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("M4MAIL","IMAP_TRANSPORT","SECURITY")
sSecurity = SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE

'Leemos si se quiere verificar certificado
SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("M4MAIL","IMAP_TRANSPORT","CA_VERIFICATION")
iCAVerification = ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE)

'Leemos si se quiere verificar el host
SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("M4MAIL","IMAP_TRANSPORT","HOST_VERIFICATION")
iHostVerification = ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE)

'Protocolo siempre IMAP
sProtocol ="IMAP"

//Pasamos los mensajes que queremos borrar al nodo del canal JAVA_MAIL
bIsNotEof = DELETE_MAILS.Begin()
While (bIsNotEof = M4_TRUE)   
    JAVA_MAIL!DELETE_MAILS.AddRegister()
    JAVA_MAIL!DELETE_MAILS.MESSAGE_NUMBER = DELETE_MAILS.MESSAGE_NUMBER
    bIsNotEof = DELETE_MAILS.GO_NEXT()
Wend

//Una vez procesado limpiamos el nodo
DELETE_MAILS.DESTROY_BLOCK()

iRet = JAVA_MAIL!JAVA_MAIL.DELETE_MESSAGES(SERVER, USER, PASSWORD, PORT, iTimeOut, sProtocol, FOLDER, sSecurity, iCAVerification, iHostVerification)

'Si hay error al recibir salimos
 if (iRet <> 0) then
        return iRet
 endif
 
 return M4_SUCCESS

'***********************************************************************************
'Description: 
' 1. Comprobamos si el tamaño del fichero adjunto es mayor que el parametrizado en un parámetro de aplicación
' 2. Si es mayor lo comprimimos en el directorio temporal 
' 3. Comprobamos si el tamaños del fichero comprimido  no supera el máximo para enviar, en otro caso
'    no anadimos fichero adjunto
' PARAMS:
' [AI_FILE] Fichero inicial adjunto
' [AO_FILE] Fichero que se adjuntará
'***********************************************************************************


sSepL = "\"
sSepR = "/"
sExt = "."
sExtZip = ".zip"


// FICHEROS ADJUNTOS LEEMOS EL  PARAMETRO Y EL TAMAÑO DE LOS FICHEROS ADJUNTOS
'Leemos el tamaño a partir del cual se comprimen los ficheros
SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("M4MAIL","FILE","SIZE_FILE_COMPRESS")
iSizeFileCompress = ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE)

'Comprobamos el tamaño de los archivos adjuntos
iSizeAllFiles = 0 
iSizeFile = 0
iPosInit =0
'Nombre del primer archivo  para el nombre zipeado
sFirstInit = ""

sFileInit = AI_FILE
iPosNameFile = StrIn (sFileInit , "*")


While (iPosNameFile <> -1) And (iSizeFileCompress > iSizeAllFiles ) 
    sFile = Mid ( sFileInit , 0 , iPosNameFile )
    If sFirstInit = "" then
        sFirstInit = sFile 
    EndIf
    GET_FILE_SIZE (sFile  , iSizeFile)
    'Lo convertimos a MB
    iSizeFile=  iSizeFile / (1024 *1024)
    iSizeAllFiles = iSizeAllFiles  + iSizeFile
    'Buscamos nuevamente el valor del "*"
    sFileInit  =  Mid ( sFileInit ,iPosNameFile + 1 , Length(sFileInit)- Length(sFile))
    iPosNameFile = StrIn (sFileInit,"*")    
WEnd

'Leemos el tamaño del último
sFile = Mid ( sFileInit , 0 ,  Length(sFileInit))
If sFirstInit = "" then
    sFirstInit = sFile 
EndIf

GET_FILE_SIZE (sFile  , iSizeFile)

'Lo convertimos a MB
iSizeFile=  iSizeFile / (1024 *1024)
iSizeAllFiles = iSizeAllFiles  + iSizeFile
 
If (iSizeFileCompress <> -1) AND (iSizeFileCompress < iSizeAllFiles ) then
    //COMPRIMIMOS AL FICHERO ZIP TODOS LOS FICHEROS ADJUNTOS
    'Leemos el path temporal
    sCommonPathRegistry = ToString(GetRegistryValue(".\CVM","TempDir"))
    If sCommonPathRegistry <> "" then
        If StrIn(sCommonPathRegistry,sSepL) <> M4_ERROR then    
            sSep =  sSepL     
        Else
            sSep =  sSepR             
        EndIf
    Else
        sSep  = ""
    EndIf
    
    sFinalSep = Mid(sCommonPathRegistry ,length(sCommonPathRegistry )-1,length(sCommonPathRegistry))
    If sFinalSep <> sSepL  AND sFinalSep <> sSepR Then
        sCommonPathRegistry = sCommonPathRegistry + sSep
    EndIf
    
    'El fichero comprimido tendrá el mismo el primero de los adjuntos pero se le cambia la extensión a zip
    'Leemos el nombre del archivo     
    sPathOnly = " "
    'Nombre del primer archivo
    GET_DIR_PATH (sFirstInit,sPathOnly)
         
    'Buscamos la posición de la extensión
    sName  =  Mid(sFirstInit,Length(sPathOnly)+1, Length(sFirstInit)-Length(sPathOnly)-1)
    iPosExtension = StrIn(sName ,sExt)
    If iPosExtension<> -1 then
       sName = Mid(sName  ,0 , iPosExtension)
    EndIf    
         
    'Ruta, nombre y extensión
    sFileZip =   sCommonPathRegistry  + sName  +  sExtZip 
            

    sFileInit = AI_FILE
    iPosNameFile = StrIn (sFileInit , "*")
    While (iPosNameFile <> -1)
        sFile = Mid ( sFileInit , 0 , iPosNameFile )
        'Invocamos a zipear el archivo
        'Si es el primero creamos el fichero zip sino lo añadimos
        If (sFirstInit =sFile ) then 
            M4GENERATEZIP (sFileZip ,sFile)
        Else
            M4GENERATEZIP (sFileZip, "-a" ,sFile)
        EndIf
        'Buscamos nuevamente el valor del "*"
        sFileInit  =  Mid ( sFileInit ,iPosNameFile + 1 , Length(sFileInit)- Length(sFile))
        iPosNameFile = StrIn (sFileInit,"*")    
    WEnd
    
    'Leemos el tamaño del último
    sFile = Mid ( sFileInit , 0 ,  Length(sFileInit))
    'Invocamos a zipear el archivo
        'Si es el primero creamos el fichero zip sino lo añadimos
    If (sFirstInit = sFile) then 
        M4GENERATEZIP (sFileZip ,sFile)
    Else
        M4GENERATEZIP (sFileZip, "-a" ,sFile)
    EndIf
    
    
    'Comprobamos el tamaño del fichero comprimido
    iSizeFileZip = 0 
    GET_FILE_SIZE (sFileZip , iSizeFileZip)
    
    //Lo convertimos a MB
    iSizeFileZip =  iSizeFileZip / (1024 * 1024)   
    
     
    SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("M4MAIL","FILE","SIZE_FILE_MAX")
    iSize = ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE)
    
    If (iSize <> -1) AND (iSize < iSizeFileZip ) then
        'No lo enviamos supera el limite
        AO_FILE = ""
    Else
        'Lo enviamos
        AO_FILE = sFileZip 
    EndIf   
    
    'Devolvemos que se ha generado el fichero
    AO_FILE_CREATE = sFileZip 
Else
    'No es necesario comprimir
    AO_FILE = AI_FILE
    'No se ha creado el fichero
    AO_FILE_CREATE = ""
EndIf

' Design Document  : 
' Description      : Generate zip file with mail attachments.
'
' ************************************************************
'
' Arguments:
'
'       AI_ATTACHMENTS: attachments file path, separated by *.
'       AO_ZIP_FILE: zip output file path.
'       AO_ZIP_FILE_SIZE: zip file size.
' ************************************************************

iRet = M4_SUCCESS
sAttachments = AI_ATTACHMENTS
sTempDir = NullValue()
sZipFile = NullValue()
sFile = NullValue()
iSize = 0
iTotalSize = 0
iZipFileSize = 0
sDirSep = ""
iPos = -1
sDocExtension = NullValue()

// Inicializaciones.
AO_ZIP_FILE = NullValue()
AO_ZIP_FILE_SIZE = NullValue()

// Verificar que hay ficheros adjuntos.
if (sAttachments = "" OR IsNull(sAttachments) = M4_TRUE) then
    return M4_SUCCESS
endif

// Bug 0324367. Verificar si los ficheros adjuntos es un unico fichero ya comprimido. 
// Si es así, no comprimir de nuevo.
iPos = StrIn(sAttachments, "*")
if (iPos = -1) then
    // Obtener extensión del fichero adjunto.
    iPos = LastIndexOf(sAttachments, ".")
    if (iPos <> -1) then
        sDocExtension = Mid(sAttachments, iPos + 1, Length(sAttachments) - (iPos + 1))
        if (sDocExtension = "zip") then
            return M4_SUCCESS
        endif
    endIf
endif

// Leer el tamaño a partir del cual se comprimen los ficheros y verificar si hay que comprimir.
SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("M4MAIL", "FILE", "SIZE_FILE_COMPRESS")
iSizeFileCompress = ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE)
if (iSizeFileCompress = -1) then
    return M4_SUCCESS
endif

// Parsear la cadena de ficheros adjuntos, separados por *, obtener el tamaño de los ficheros.
GET_FILE_SIZE_SUM(sAttachments, iTotalSize)

// Verificar si se tiene que generar el fichero comprimido con los ficheros adjuntos.
if (iTotalSize <= iSizeFileCompress) then
    return M4_SUCCESS
endif

// Crear fichero comprimido.
// ZIP_FILE..SysCreateBlobFile(sTempDir, "zip")
GET_TEMP_DIR(sDirSep, TEMP_DIR)
sZipFile = TEMP_DIR + sDirSep + "m4attachment.zip"

// Parsear la cadena de ficheros adjuntos, separados por *.
sAttachments = AI_ATTACHMENTS
iPos = StrIn(sAttachments, "*")
iFileNum = 0
while (iPos <> -1)
    
    sFile = Mid(sAttachments, 0, iPos)
    
    // Si es el primero creamos el fichero zip sino lo añadimos
    if (iFileNum = 0) then 
        iRet = M4GENERATEZIP(sZipFile, sFile)
    else
        iRet = M4GENERATEZIP(sZipFile, "-a", sFile)
    endif
    
    // Verificar que se ha añadir el fichero.
    if (iRet <> M4_SUCCESS) then
        return M4_ERROR
    endif
    
    sAttachments = Mid(sAttachments, iPos + 1, length(sAttachments) - length(sFile))
    iPos = StrIn(sAttachments, "*")
    iFileNum = iFileNum + 1
    
wend

// Añadir el último fichero.
sFile = Mid(sAttachments, 0, Length(sAttachments))
if (iFileNum = 0) then
    iRet = M4GENERATEZIP(sZipFile, sFile)
else
    iRet = M4GENERATEZIP(sZipFile, "-a", sFile)
endif

// Verificar que se ha añadir el fichero.
if (iRet <> M4_SUCCESS) then
    return M4_ERROR
endif

GET_FILE_SIZE(sZipFile, iZipFileSize)
AO_ZIP_FILE = sZipFile
AO_ZIP_FILE_SIZE = iZipFileSize / (1024 * 1024)

return M4_SUCCESS

return M4_SUCCESS

M4RCH_RULES3/ID_TI/SAV_PARAMS_40.SOURCE_CODE:
// bg 0329471
If CACHE_OFF = M4_TRUE Then
    Return M4_FALSE
EndIf

// eh 0328547
Return M4_TRUE

If IsNull( SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CC_CACHE_ENABLED ) = M4_TRUE Then
    SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CC_CACHE_ENABLED = M4_TRUE
   
    DefineInstance( "SAV_PARAMS_ALIAS", "SAV_PARAMS", M4_AUTOLOAD_NODESAYS, M4_INSTANCE_NOT_SHARED )

    sCode = "SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CC_CACHE_ENABLED = SAV_PARAMS_ALIAS!SAV_PARAMS._GET_CACHE_ENABLED()"
    iRet = ClcExecuteLN4Jit(sCode)

    If SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CC_CACHE_ENABLED = M4_FALSE Then
        SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.DESTROY_BLOCK()
    EndIf

    CloseChannel("SAV_PARAMS_ALIAS")
EndIf


Return SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CC_CACHE_ENABLED

// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
//  _CACHE_ITEM_DELETE
//
//  Deletes the cached value of an application parameter in a given scope, or
//  in all of them.
//
//  AI_APPLICATION: Application parameter application.
//  AI_SECTION: Application parameter section.
//  AI_KEY: Application parameter key.
//  AI_CONCEPT: Optional. Scope Id.
//  AI_VALUE_CONCEPT: Optional. Scope value.
//
//  Returns: M4_SUCCESS/M4_ERROR
// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

If _CACHE_ENABLED() = M4_FALSE Then
    Return M4_SUCCESS
EndIf

iPos = 0

// Deletes all ocurrences.
Do
    // Searchs in the cache.
    If IsNull(AI_CONCEPT) = M4_FALSE Then
        iPos = SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.FindRegister( "CK_APPLICATION", AI_APPLICATION, M4_EQUAL, "CK_SECTION", AI_SECTION, M4_EQUAL, "CK_KEY", AI_KEY, M4_EQUAL, "CV_CONCEPT", AI_CONCEPT, M4_EQUAL, "CV_CONCEPT_VAL", AI_VALUE_CONCEPT, M4_EQUAL, iPos )
    Else
        iPos = SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.FindRegister( "CK_APPLICATION", AI_APPLICATION, M4_EQUAL, "CK_SECTION", AI_SECTION, M4_EQUAL, "CK_KEY", AI_KEY, M4_EQUAL, iPos )
    EndIf
    
    If iPos <> -1 Then
        // Removes the item in the cache store.
        SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.Moveto( iPos )

        // Trace.
        bTrace = _CACHE_TRACE()
        If bTrace = M4_TRUE Then
            iCount = SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.Count() - 1
            sTraceFile = SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CC_TRACE_FILE
            sSep = Chr(M4_TAB)
            
            ConcatFile(sTraceFile, toString(todayNowGMT()) + sSep + toString(SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CI_STORE, 0) + sSep + "delete" + sSep + AI_APPLICATION + sSep + AI_SECTION + sSep + AI_KEY + sSep + sSep  + sSep + sSep + sSep, 0)
            ConcatFile(sTraceFile, toString(iPos, 0) + sSep + toString(iCount,0) + sSep + sSep, 0)
            
            If IsNull(SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CV_CONCEPT) = M4_TRUE Then
                ConcatFile(sTraceFile, sSep, 0)
            Else
                ConcatFile(sTraceFile, SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CV_CONCEPT + sSep, 0)
            EndIf
            
            If IsNull(SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CV_CONCEPT_VAL) = M4_TRUE Then
                ConcatFile(sTraceFile, sSep, 0)            
            Else
                ConcatFile(sTraceFile, SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CV_CONCEPT_VAL + sSep, 0)
            EndIf
            
            If IsNull(SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CV_VALUE) = M4_TRUE Then
                ConcatFile(sTraceFile, sSep, 0)            
            Else
                ConcatFile(sTraceFile,UTILS.STR_TO_CSV(SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CV_VALUE) + sSep, 0)
            EndIf            
            
            ConcatFile(sTraceFile,  toString(SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CI_SIZE,0), 0)
        Endif
        
        SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.DESTROY_REGISTER()
        
        If bTrace = M4_TRUE Then
            ConcatFile(sTraceFile, sSep + toString(SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CI_TOTAL_SIZE,0), 1)
        EndIf
    Endif
Until iPos = -1


Return M4_SUCCESS

If IsNull( SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CC_TRACE_ENABLED ) = M4_TRUE Then
    If GetRegistryValue( "SOFTWARE\Meta4\Mind\3.X\Machine", "LogonTrace" ) = "2" Then
        SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CC_TRACE_ENABLED = M4_TRUE
        SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CC_TRACE_FILE = GetRegistryValue(".\CVM","TempDir") + "\m4apc_" + SCH_SESSION!ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_SESSION_KEY + "_" + toString(SCH_SESSION!GetHandle(),0) + ".log"
        
        sSep = Chr(M4_TAB)
        ConcatFile( SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CC_TRACE_FILE, "Time" + sSep + "Store" + sSep + "Operation" + sSep + "Application" + sSep + "Section" + sSep + "Key" + sSep + "User" + sSep + "Role" + sSep + "Organization" + sSep + "Language" + sSep + "Position" + sSep + "TotalEntries" + sSep + "InsertGroup" + sSep + "Concept" + sSep + "ConceptVal" + sSep + "Value" + sSep + "EntrySize" + sSep + "TotalSize", 1)
    Else
        SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CC_TRACE_ENABLED = M4_FALSE
    EndIf
EndIf


Return SCH_SESSION!APP_PARAM_CACHE.CC_TRACE_ENABLED

RET_VALUE("CONFIGURATION","CACHES","DO_NOT_CACHE_APP_PARAMS")
    
If FINAL_RETURN_40.Count() > 0 Then
    If FINAL_RETURN_40[0].APP_VALUE = "1" Then
        Return(M4_FALSE)
    EndIf
EndIf


Return M4_TRUE

// Hard coded until dynamic metadata would be implemented.
If IsNull(AI_ID_APPLICATION) = M4_TRUE Then
    Return STORE_ANY
EndIf

If AI_ID_APPLICATION = "PEOPLENET_PLUS" Then
    If IsNull(AI_ID_SECTION) = M4_TRUE Then
        Return STORE_ANY
    ElseIf AI_ID_SECTION = "MENU" Then
        If IsNull(AI_ID_KEY) = M4_TRUE Then
            Return STORE_ANY
        Else
            If AI_ID_KEY = "FILTERS" OR AI_ID_KEY = "IS_MENU_SHOWED" OR AI_ID_KEY = "RECENTS" OR AI_ID_KEY = "RECENTSPINNED" OR AI_ID_KEY = "VIEW" OR AI_ID_KEY = "WORKAREAELEMENTS" Then
                Return STORE_USR
            Else
                Return STORE_GEN
            EndIf
        EndIF
    ElseIf AI_ID_SECTION = "LISTS" Then
        // Only user scope param ELEMENTS_VIEW
        Return STORE_USR
    Else
        Return STORE_GEN
    EndIf
ElseIf AI_ID_APPLICATION = "QUERY" Then
    If IsNull(AI_ID_SECTION) = M4_TRUE Then
        Return STORE_ANY
    ElseIf AI_ID_SECTION = "RECENTS" Then
        If IsNull(AI_ID_KEY) = M4_TRUE Then
            Return STORE_ANY
        Else
            If AI_ID_KEY = "RECENTS" OR AI_ID_KEY = "RECENTS_PN8" OR AI_ID_KEY = "SCENARIO_RECENTS" OR AI_ID_KEY = "TABLERECENTS" Then
                Return STORE_USR
            Else
                Return STORE_GEN
            EndIf
        EndIF
    Else
        Return STORE_GEN
    EndIf
ElseIf AI_ID_APPLICATION = "JOBSCHEDULER" Then
    If IsNull(AI_ID_SECTION) = M4_TRUE Then
        Return STORE_ANY
    ElseIf AI_ID_SECTION = "GENERAL" Then
        If IsNull(AI_ID_KEY) = M4_TRUE Then
            Return STORE_ANY
        Else
            If AI_ID_KEY = "SHOW_PROGRESS_INFO" Then
                Return STORE_USR
            Else
                Return STORE_GEN
            EndIf
        EndIF
    Else
        Return STORE_GEN
    EndIf
ElseIf AI_ID_APPLICATION = "POP2" Then
    If IsNull(AI_ID_SECTION) = M4_TRUE Then
        Return STORE_ANY
    ElseIf AI_ID_SECTION = "USER_STATUS" Then
        If IsNull(AI_ID_KEY) = M4_TRUE Then
            Return STORE_ANY
        Else
            If AI_ID_KEY = "CURRENT_STATUS" Then
                Return STORE_USR
            Else
                Return STORE_GEN
            EndIf
        EndIF
    Else
        Return STORE_GEN
    EndIf
ElseIf AI_ID_APPLICATION = "THINCLIENT" Then
    If IsNull(AI_ID_SECTION) = M4_TRUE Then
        Return STORE_ANY
    ElseIf AI_ID_SECTION = "PORTAL_PARAM" Then
        If IsNull(AI_ID_KEY) = M4_TRUE Then
            Return STORE_ANY
        Else
            If AI_ID_KEY = "PLCO_PA_INFORMATION_USER_DISPLAY" Then
                Return STORE_USR
            Else
                Return STORE_GEN
            EndIf
        EndIf
    Else
        Return STORE_GEN
    EndIf
ElseIf AI_ID_APPLICATION = "CONFIGURATION" Then
    If IsNull(AI_ID_SECTION) = M4_TRUE Then
        Return STORE_ANY
    ElseIf AI_ID_SECTION = "GTA" Then
        If IsNull(AI_ID_KEY) = M4_TRUE Then
            Return STORE_ANY
        Else
            If AI_ID_KEY = "PLCO_CONFIG_MANAGE_TIMESHEETS_FILTER" Then
                Return STORE_USR
            Else
                Return STORE_GEN
            EndIf
        EndIf
    Else
        Return STORE_GEN
    EndIf
Else
    Return STORE_GEN
EndIf

sLang = ToString( AI_LANGUAGE, 0 )


// Filtro de criterios
sBaseFilter = ""

if IsNull( AI_ID_APPLICATION ) = M4_FALSE AND AI_ID_APPLICATION <> "" then

    if IsNull( AI_ID_SECTION ) = M4_FALSE AND AI_ID_SECTION <> "" then 

        sBaseFilter = sBaseFilter + " AND V.ID_APLICATION = @ID_APPLICATION_FILTER"
        RET_VALUES_LONG_40.ID_APPLICATION_FILTER = AI_ID_APPLICATION
        
        sBaseFilter = sBaseFilter + " AND V.ID_SECTION = @ID_SECTION_FILTER"
        RET_VALUES_LONG_40.ID_SECTION_FILTER = AI_ID_SECTION
        
        if IsNull( AI_ID_KEY ) = M4_FALSE AND AI_ID_KEY <> "" then
            sBaseFilter = sBaseFilter + " AND V.ID_KEY = @ID_KEY_FILTER"
            RET_VALUES_LONG_40.ID_KEY_FILTER = AI_ID_KEY
        endif
    else
        ' Si viene solo el ID_APPLICATION y pueden venir varios separados por ||
        ' Ejemplo : "QUERY||M4REPORT"
        ' Separamos y incluimos en la select todos los application
        sBaseFilter = " AND ( "
        
        sToken = AI_ID_APPLICATION 
        sSep = "||"
        iHandle = -1

        sAplication  = UTILS.GET_ALL_TOKENS( sToken , sSep, iHandle )
        i = 0 
        while sAplication <> ""
            if i > 0 then
                sBaseFilter = sBaseFilter + " OR"
            endif

            'Se permite la notación APPLICATION--SECTION1--SECTION2 para excluir secciones
            iHandleSection = -1
            sSection = UTILS.GET_ALL_TOKENS (sAplication, "--", iHandleSection)

            j = 0
            while sSection <> ""
                if j = 0 then
                    sBaseFilter = sBaseFilter + " V.ID_APLICATION = '" + sSection + "'"
                else
                    sBaseFilter = sBaseFilter + " AND V.ID_SECTION <> '" + sSection + "'"
                endif
                sSection = UTILS.GET_ALL_TOKENS ("" , "--", iHandleSection)   
                j = j + 1
            wend

            sAplication = UTILS.GET_ALL_TOKENS ("" , sSep, iHandle)   
            i = i + 1
        wend 
        sBaseFilter = sBaseFilter + " )" 
    endif         
endif


// Filtro de conceptos sin sociedad
sSentence = "SELECT @ID_APLICATION = V.ID_APLICATION, @DT_LAST_UPDATE = V.DT_LAST_UPDATE, @ID_SECTION = V.ID_SECTION, @ID_KEY = V.ID_KEY, @ID_CONCEPT = V.ID_CONCEPT, @VALUE_CONCEPT = V.VALUE_CONCEPT, @PRIORITY = C.PRIORITY, @TYPE_VALUE = V.TYPE_VALUE, @ID_T3 = K.ID_T3, @IS_INTERNAL = K.IS_INTERNAL, @IS_ENCRYPTED = K.IS_ENCRYPTED, @DISTANCE = 0, @APP_VALUE_ENCRYPTED = V.APP_VALUE_ENCRYPTED, @APP_VALUE = V.APP_VALUE FROM &SAV_APP_VAL_LG V, SAV_CONCEPTS C, SAV_KEY K WHERE V.ID_CONCEPT = C.ID_CONCEPT AND V.ID_APLICATION = K.ID_APPLICATION(+) AND V.ID_KEY = K.ID_KEY(+) AND V.ID_SECTION = K.ID_SECTION(+)"
sFilter = ""
sParam = ""

iConcepts = SRAV_CONCEPTS!SRAV_CONCEPTS.Count()

for i = 0 to iConcepts - 1
    sConcept = SRAV_CONCEPTS!SRAV_CONCEPTS[i].ID_CONCEPT

    if sConcept <> "ID_ORGANIZATION" then
        
        sSql = "V.ID_CONCEPT = ?(2, 0, 255) AND V.VALUE_CONCEPT = ?(2, 0, 255)"
        
        if sConcept = "MIND" then
            sValue = "*ALL*"
        Elseif sConcept = "LANGUAGE" then
            sValue = sLang
        else
            if sConcept = "ID_APP_USER" then
                sValue = AI_ID_APP_USER
            else
                sValue = GetProperty( sConcept )
                if IsNull( sValue ) = M4_TRUE OR sValue = "" then
                    sValue = ToString( GetChannelValue( "SCH_SESSION", "ROOT_SESSION", sConcept, 0 ) )
                endif
            endif
        endif
        
        
        if Length( sFilter ) > 0 then
            sFilter = sFilter + " OR "
        endif
        sFilter = sFilter + sSql
        
        if Length( sParam ) > 0 then
            sParam = sParam + "|"
        endif
        sParam = sParam + sConcept
        
        if IsNull( sValue ) = M4_FALSE then
            sParam = sParam + "|" + sValue
        endif
    endif
next

RET_VALUES_LONG_40.SYS_SENTENCE = sSentence + sBaseFilter + " AND ( " + sFilter + " )"
RET_VALUES_LONG_40.SYS_PARAM = sParam 
RET_VALUES_LONG_40.Load_Blk()


// Filtro de sociedad
if Length( AI_ID_ORGANIZATION ) > 0 then
    sSentence = "SELECT @ID_APLICATION = V.ID_APLICATION, @DT_LAST_UPDATE = V.DT_LAST_UPDATE, @ID_SECTION = V.ID_SECTION, @ID_KEY = V.ID_KEY, @ID_CONCEPT = V.ID_CONCEPT, @VALUE_CONCEPT = V.VALUE_CONCEPT, @PRIORITY = C.PRIORITY, @TYPE_VALUE = V.TYPE_VALUE, @ID_T3 = K.ID_T3, @IS_INTERNAL = K.IS_INTERNAL, @IS_ENCRYPTED = K.IS_ENCRYPTED, @DISTANCE = T.DISTANCE, @APP_VALUE_ENCRYPTED = V.APP_VALUE_ENCRYPTED, @APP_VALUE = V.APP_VALUE FROM &SAV_APP_VAL_LG V, SAV_CONCEPTS C, SAV_KEY K, VCH_ORG_TREE T WHERE V.ID_CONCEPT = C.ID_CONCEPT AND V.ID_APLICATION = K.ID_APPLICATION(+) AND V.ID_KEY = K.ID_KEY(+) AND V.ID_SECTION = K.ID_SECTION(+) AND V.VALUE_CONCEPT = T.ID_PAR_ORGANIZATION(+)"
    sFilter = "V.ID_CONCEPT = 'ID_ORGANIZATION' AND V.VALUE_CONCEPT = T.ID_PAR_ORGANIZATION AND T.ID_ORGANIZATION = ?(2, 0, 255)"
    
    RET_VALUES_LONG_40.SYS_SENTENCE = sSentence + sBaseFilter + " AND ( " + sFilter + " )"
    RET_VALUES_LONG_40.SYS_PARAM = AI_ID_ORGANIZATION
    RET_VALUES_LONG_40.Load_Blk()
endif

// Copia y compactación de resultados
iCount = RET_VALUES_LONG_40.Count()

if iCount > 0 then

    if AI_REMOVE_REPEATED = M4_TRUE then
        RET_VALUES_LONG_40.SORT()
    endif

    sLastApplication = ""
    sLastSection = ""
    sLastKey = ""
    
    for i = 0 to iCount - 1
        RET_VALUES_LONG_40.MoveTo( i )

        sApplication = RET_VALUES_LONG_40.ID_APLICATION
        sSection = RET_VALUES_LONG_40.ID_SECTION
        sKey = RET_VALUES_LONG_40.ID_KEY

        if AI_REMOVE_REPEATED = M4_FALSE OR sLastApplication <> sApplication OR sLastSection <> sSection OR sLastKey <> sKey then
            FINAL_RETURN_40.AddRegister()

            FINAL_RETURN_40.ID_APLICATION = sApplication
            FINAL_RETURN_40.ID_SECTION = sSection
            FINAL_RETURN_40.ID_KEY = sKey
            FINAL_RETURN_40.ID_CONCEPT = RET_VALUES_LONG_40.ID_CONCEPT
            FINAL_RETURN_40.VALUE_CONCEPT = RET_VALUES_LONG_40.VALUE_CONCEPT
            FINAL_RETURN_40.TYPE_VALUE = RET_VALUES_LONG_40.TYPE_VALUE
            FINAL_RETURN_40.PATH_REG = ""
            FINAL_RETURN_40.DT_LAST_UPDATE = RET_VALUES_LONG_40.DT_LAST_UPDATE
            FINAL_RETURN_40.ID_T3 = RET_VALUES_LONG_40.ID_T3
            FINAL_RETURN_40.IS_INTERNAL = RET_VALUES_LONG_40.IS_INTERNAL
            FINAL_RETURN_40.STORE = STORE_GEN

            if IsNull( RET_VALUES_LONG_40.APP_VALUE_SORT ) = M4_TRUE then

' Method           : THINCLIENT_MSET
' Module           : ThinClient
' Version          : 5.x
' Date             : 2001.07.09
' Language         : LN4
' Description      : Sets the value for parameters in section AI_SECTION in 
'                       application DEFAULT_APPLICATION_NAME.
'                       Each parameter is defined by AI_KEY/AI_VALUE pair.
'                       These values are only applied to ID_APP_USER concept. 
' Arguments:
'   AI_SECTION: Name of the section.        (mandatory)
'   AI_KEY1: Name of the parameter 1.       (mandatory)
'   AI_VALUE1: Value of the parameter 1.    (mandatory)
'   AI_KEY2: Name of the parameter 2.       (optional)
'   AI_VALUE2: Value of the parameter 2.    (optional)
'   etc...                                  (optional)
' Return:
'   M4_SUCCESS on success
'   M4_ERROR othersiwe
' ************************************************************

' Thinclient application name.
DEFAULT_APPLICATION_NAME = "THINCLIENT"

' default return code.
retCode = M4_ERROR

' Check if there is input arguments.
if (GetArgumentNumber() = 0) then
    return M4_ERROR
endif

' Argument #1 is AI_SECTION.
ai_section = GetArgument(1)

' Get the number of variable arguments (parameter pairs).
numberOfArguments = GetArgumentNumber() - 1

' Check if numberOfArgument is a pair number
if (Div(numberOfArguments, 2) <> 0) then
    return M4_ERROR
endif

' load section AI_SECTION in RET_VALUES_LONG_40 node.
RET_VALUE(DEFAULT_APPLICATION_NAME, AI_SECTION, "")

' foreach parameter update/insert a new register.
index = 2
retCode = M4_SUCCESS
While ((numberOfArguments > 0) and (retCode = M4_SUCCESS))
    ' Get parameter name/value pair.
    ai_key = GetArgument(index)
    ai_value = GetArgument(index+1)
    index = index + 2
    numberOfArguments = numberOfArguments - 2
    
    retCode = THINCLIENT_PRIVATE_SET(ai_section, ai_key, ai_value)
Wend

' If there is not errors, persist changes in database.
if (retCode = M4_SUCCESS) then
    RET_VALUES_LONG_40.Persist_tree()
endif

' Arguments:

' Thinclient application name.

        RET_VALUES_LONG_40.APP_VALUE = AI_VALUE
    else

        id_application = RET_VALUES_LONG_40.ID_APLICATION

    MoveTo(i)
    If IsUpdated() = M4_TRUE Then
        If APP_VALUE <> APP_VALUE..SysOldValue Then
            SAV_PARAMS_40._CACHE_ITEM_UPDATE( ID_APLICATION, ID_SECTION, ID_KEY, ID_CONCEPT, VALUE_CONCEPT, APP_VALUE )
        EndIf
    ElseIf IsNew() = M4_TRUE Then
        SAV_PARAMS_40._CACHE_ITEM_DELETE( ID_APLICATION, ID_SECTION, ID_KEY, NullValue(), NullValue() )
    ElseIf IsDeleted() = M4_TRUE Then

    EndIf
Next


Return M4_SUCCESS

// Sets key value for requested application user

SAV_PARAMS_40.DESTROYBLOCK()
SAV_PARAMS_40.AddRegister()

SET_VALUE_PRIVATE (AI_APLICATION, AI_SECTION, AI_KEY, AI_CONCEPT, AI_VALUE_CONCEPT, AI_APP_VALUE)

SAV_PARAMS_40.DESTROYBLOCK()

If AI_CONCEPT = "ID_APP_USER" AND SAV_PARAMS_40._GET_PARAM_STORE(AI_APLICATION, AI_SECTION, AI_KEY) = SAV_PARAMS_40.STORE_USR Then
    // Moves user-only scope parameters to the appropriate node.
    USER_PARAM_VALUES.DESTROY_BLOCK()
    USER_PARAM_VALUES.AddRegister()
    
    USER_PARAM_VALUES.ID_APPLICATION = AI_APLICATION
    USER_PARAM_VALUES.ID_SECTION     = AI_SECTION
    USER_PARAM_VALUES.ID_KEY         = AI_KEY
    USER_PARAM_VALUES.ID_USER        = AI_VALUE_CONCEPT
    USER_PARAM_VALUES.APP_VALUE      = AI_APP_VALUE

    Return USER_PARAM_VALUES.SET_VALUES()
EndIf


// Generic parameters management.
// Sets key value for requested application user
SYS_SENTENCE = "FROM &SAV_APP_VAL_LG A WHERE A.ID_APLICATION = ?(2,50,0) AND A.ID_SECTION = ?(2,50,0) AND A.ID_KEY = ?(2,50,0) AND A.ID_CONCEPT = ?(2,30,0) AND A.VALUE_CONCEPT = ?(2,50,0)"
SYS_PARAM = AI_APLICATION + "|" + AI_SECTION + "|" + AI_KEY + "|" + AI_CONCEPT + "|" + AI_VALUE_CONCEPT
    
LOAD_BLK()
    
If Count() = 0 Then
    
    AddRegister()
    ID_APLICATION = AI_APLICATION
    ID_SECTION = AI_SECTION
    ID_KEY = AI_KEY
    IS_EDITABLE = 1
    ID_CONCEPT = AI_CONCEPT
    VALUE_CONCEPT = AI_VALUE_CONCEPT
    
    SAV_SECTION_KEYS.LOAD_KEY( AI_APLICATION, AI_SECTION, AI_KEY )
    
    bIsNotEof = SAV_SECTION_KEYS.Begin()
    
    if bIsNotEof = M4_TRUE then
        IS_ENCRYPTED = SAV_SECTION_KEYS.IS_ENCRYPTED
    endif
EndIf

if IS_ENCRYPTED = 1 then
    APP_VALUE_ENCRYPTED = AI_APP_VALUE
    APP_VALUE = NullValue()
else
    APP_VALUE_ENCRYPTED = NullValue()
    APP_VALUE = AI_APP_VALUE
endif

PERSIST_TREE()

// Sets key values for requested application users


bIsNotEof = SAV_PARAMS_40.Begin()

if bIsNotEof = M4_TRUE then

    // Extracts user-only scope parameters to the appropriate node.
    USER_PARAM_VALUES.DESTROY_BLOCK()
    bUserParams = M4_FALSE
    
    i = Count() - 1

    While i >= 0
        MoveTo( i )

        If ID_CONCEPT = "ID_APP_USER" AND SAV_PARAMS_40._GET_PARAM_STORE(ID_APLICATION, ID_SECTION, ID_KEY) = SAV_PARAMS_40.STORE_USR Then
            USER_PARAM_VALUES.AddRegister()
            USER_PARAM_VALUES.ID_APPLICATION = ID_APLICATION
            USER_PARAM_VALUES.ID_SECTION     = ID_SECTION
            USER_PARAM_VALUES.ID_KEY         = ID_KEY
            USER_PARAM_VALUES.ID_USER        = VALUE_CONCEPT
            USER_PARAM_VALUES.APP_VALUE      = APP_VALUE

            DestroyRegister()
            bUserParams = M4_TRUE
        EndIf
        
        i = i - 1
    Wend
    
    If bUserParams = M4_TRUE Then
        USER_PARAM_VALUES.SET_VALUES()
    EndIf
 
 
    // Generic parameters management.
    iCount = Count()
    
    if iCount > 0 then
    
        SYS_SENTENCE = "FROM &SAV_APP_VAL_LG A WHERE A.ID_APLICATION = ?(2,50,0) AND A.ID_SECTION = ?(2,50,0) AND A.ID_KEY = ?(2,50,0) AND A.ID_CONCEPT = ?(2,30,0) AND A.VALUE_CONCEPT = ?(2,50,0)"
    
        for i = 0 to iCount - 1
        
            MoveTo( i )
            SYS_PARAM = ID_APLICATION + "|" + ID_SECTION + "|" + ID_KEY + "|" + ID_CONCEPT + "|" + VALUE_CONCEPT
            
            iCountBefore = Count()
            LOAD_BLK()
            iCountAfter = Count()
            
            if iCountAfter <> iCountBefore  then
                MoveTo( i )
                CheckPointRegister()
                APP_VALUE = APP_VALUE
            endif
        next
        
        PERSIST_TREE()
    endif
    
    SAV_PARAMS_40.DESTROYBLOCK()
endif

counter = 0

for i=0 to len-1

    // converts to the decimal value
    char = mid(format,i,1)
        
    if (ISALPHA(char) = 0) then

        if (lastSpecial = 1) then
            // two consectuvie separators ?
            return NULLValue()
        endif
        lastSpecial = 1
       
        counter = counter + 1
        if (isnull(res) = M4_TRUE) then
            res = char
        else
            if (res <> char) then
                // two separators ?
                return NULLValue()
            endif
        endif
    else
        lastSpecial = 0
    endif

next

if (lastSpecial = 1) then
    return NULLValue()
endif

// checks the number of special characters
if (counter = 2) then
    return res
endif

return NULLValue()

pos = strin(format,".")

    return nullValue()
endif
return separator

    return 0

return length(format) - pos - 1

pos = strin(format,",")

return separator

pos = strin(format,".")
if (pos < 0) then
    return 0
endif
len = length(format)

trailing = 0

for i = pos+1 to len-1
    char = mid(format,i,1)
    if (char = "0") then
        trailing = trailing + 1
    else
        return trailing
    endif
next

return trailing

val = ascii(char)

    return 1
endif
return 0

bEscaped = M4_FALSE

If IsNull( sEscValue ) = M4_TRUE Then
    sEscValue = "[null]"
ElseIf Length( sEscValue ) = 0 Then
    sEscValue = "[empty]"
Else
    If IndexOf( sEscValue, chr(34), 0 ) <> -1 Then
        bEscaped = M4_TRUE
        sEscValue = Replace( sEscValue, chr(34), chr(34) + chr(34) )
    Endif

        sEscValue = chr(34) + sEscValue + chr(34)
    Endif
EndIf


Return sEscValue

'Cargamos las sociedades con permisos para el role actual.

if ID_APP_ROLE <> "M4ADM" AND ID_APP_ROLE <> "M4RAISE_PRIVILEGES" AND AI_BAS_ADMINISTRATOR <> M4_TRUE then

    sSelect = "SELECT DISTINCT @ID_RSM = C.ID_RSM, @ID_PROFILE = C.ID_PROFILE, @ID_ORGANIZATION_USED = B.ID_ORGANIZATION, @NM_ORGANIZATION = B.NM_ORGANIZATION "
    sSelect = sSelect + ", @ID_LEVEL = B.ID_LEVEL, @N_LEVEL = D.N_LEVEL "
    sSelect = sSelect + "FROM &SSC_ROLE_ORG A, SCH_ORGANIZATION_LEVEL B, M4RSC_APPROLE C, SCH_ORG_LEVELS D "
    sSelect = sSelect + "WHERE (A.ID_APP_ROLE_USED = C.ID_APP_ROLE AND A.ID_ORGANIZATION_USED = B.ID_ORGANIZATION AND "
    sSelect = sSelect + "A.ID_APP_ROLE_USED = ?(2,30,0) AND C.IS_ELIGIBILITY='1' AND B.ID_LEVEL = D.ID_LEVEL) "
    
    sSelect = sSelect + " UNION (SELECT DISTINCT @ID_RSM = B.ID_RSM, @ID_PROFILE = B.ID_PROFILE, @ID_ORGANIZATION_USED = A.ID_ORGANIZATION, @NM_ORGANIZATION = A.NM_ORGANIZATION "
    sSelect = sSelect + ", @ID_LEVEL = A.ID_LEVEL, @N_LEVEL = D.N_LEVEL "
    sSelect = sSelect + " FROM SCH_ORGANIZATION_LEVEL A, M4RSC_APPROLE B, M4RSC_APP_USR_ROLE C, SCH_ORG_LEVELS D "
    sSelect = sSelect + " WHERE (C.ID_APP_ROLE = B.ID_APP_ROLE AND C.ID_ORGANIZATION_US = A.ID_ORGANIZATION AND "
    sSelect = sSelect + " C.ID_APP_ROLE = ?(2,30,0) AND C.ID_APP_USR = ?(2,30,0) AND B.IS_ELIGIBILITY='0' AND A.ID_LEVEL = D.ID_LEVEL AND "
    'IHE 17/2/2011 Bug fixed: 0177986,0180627   (Tener en cuenta la fechas rol-sociedad)
    'IHE 05/04/2018 Filtrar por fecha corta de hoy para poder logarse hoy con rol-sociedad cerrada hoy
    'sSelect = sSelect + " C.DT_START <=?(5,0,0) AND C.DT_END>= ?(5,0,0) AND B.DT_START <=?(5,0,0) AND B.DT_END>= ?(5,0,0) ))"
    'sTodayNow = Tostring(TodayNow(),0)
    'SYS_PARAM_FILTER = ID_APP_ROLE + "|" + ID_APP_ROLE + "|" + SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_APP_USER + "|" + sTodayNow  + "|" + sTodayNow + "|" + sTodayNow  + "|" + sTodayNow 
    sSelect = sSelect + " C.DT_START <= #SHORT_TODAY () AND C.DT_END>= #SHORT_TODAY () AND B.DT_START <= #SHORT_TODAY () AND B.DT_END>= #SHORT_TODAY () ))"
    SYS_PARAM_FILTER = ID_APP_ROLE + "|" + ID_APP_ROLE + "|" + SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_APP_USER  
else
    'Si somos M4ADM cargamos todas las sociedades
    sSelect = "SELECT @ID_RSM = B.ID_RSM, @ID_PROFILE = B.ID_PROFILE, @ID_ORGANIZATION_USED = A.ID_ORGANIZATION, @NM_ORGANIZATION = A.NM_ORGANIZATION "
    sSelect = sSelect + ", @ID_LEVEL = A.ID_LEVEL, @N_LEVEL = C.N_LEVEL "
    sSelect = sSelect + "FROM &SCH_ORGANIZATION_LEVEL A, M4RSC_APPROLE B, SCH_ORG_LEVELS C "
    sSelect = sSelect + " WHERE A.ID_LEVEL = C.ID_LEVEL AND B.ID_APP_ROLE = ?(2,30,0)"

    SYS_PARAM_FILTER = ID_APP_ROLE
endif

SYS_SENTENCE_FILTER = sSelect
LOAD()


// Se calcula el estado de auditoría de las sociedades si se pide
if AI_BCHECK_AUDITORY = M4_TRUE then

    sUser = ROOT_SESSION.ID_APP_USER
    iLanguage = ROOT_SESSION.LANGUAGE
    
    ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE = 0
    
    bIsNofEof = Begin()
    while bIsNofEof  = M4_TRUE
        USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE = 0

        // bg 0331331. If an application parameter has been got at user scope, it is not necessary to request it again for each organization.
        If IsNull(USR_SCP_ACT_AUDIT) = M4_FALSE Then
            USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE = USR_SCP_ACT_AUDIT * 32
        Else
            sUserActionsAuditory = SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS!SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS.GET_VALUE_PARAM("LOGON", "SCH_SESSION", "USER_ACTIONS_AUDITORY", sUser, iLanguage, ID_ORGANIZATION_USED)
            iUserActionsAuditory = ToInt(sUserActionsAuditory)
            
            If IsNull(sUserActionsAuditory) = M4_FALSE AND SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS!SRTC_APP_VALUE_LG.RET_CONCEPT = "ID_APP_USER" Then
                USR_SCP_ACT_AUDIT = iUserActionsAuditory
            EndIf
        
            if iUserActionsAuditory > 0 then
                // -- XXXXXXXX00000 mask.
                USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE = iUserActionsAuditory * 32
                if IsNull(ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE) = M4_TRUE OR ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE < USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE then
                    ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE = USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE
                endif
            endif
        EndIf
        
        If IsNull(USR_SCP_LOG_AUDIT) = M4_FALSE Then
            USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE = USR_SCP_LOG_AUDIT + USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE
        Else
            sUserLogonAuditoy = SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS!SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS.GET_VALUE_PARAM("LOGON", "SCH_SESSION", "USER_LOGON_AUDITORY", sUser, iLanguage, ID_ORGANIZATION_USED)
            iUserLogonAuditoy = ToInt(sUserLogonAuditoy)
            
            If IsNull(sUserLogonAuditoy) = M4_FALSE AND SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS!SRTC_APP_VALUE_LG.RET_CONCEPT = "ID_APP_USER" Then
                USR_SCP_LOG_AUDIT = iUserLogonAuditoy
            EndIf            
        
            if iUserLogonAuditoy > 0 then
                // -- XXXXX mask.
                USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE = iUserLogonAuditoy + USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE
                if IsNull(ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE) = M4_TRUE OR ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE < USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE then
                    ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE = USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE
                endif
            endif
        EndIf
        
        USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD = 0
        USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD = 0
        USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT = 0

        // Gets user time audit configuration except for JS context.
        If ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE <> 4 Then
        
            If IsNull(USR_SCP_THD_RC) = M4_FALSE Then
                USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD = USR_SCP_THD_RC
            Else
                sThreshold = SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS!SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS.GET_VALUE_PARAM("LOGON", "SCH_SESSION", "USER_TIME_AUDITORY_RC_THRESHOLD", sUser, iLanguage, ID_ORGANIZATION_USED)
                iThresholdRC = ToInt(sThreshold)
                
                If IsNull(sThreshold) = M4_FALSE AND SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS!SRTC_APP_VALUE_LG.RET_CONCEPT = "ID_APP_USER" Then
                    USR_SCP_THD_RC = iThresholdRC
                EndIf           
                
                if iThresholdRC > 0 then
                    USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD = iThresholdRC
                    if IsNull(ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD) = M4_TRUE OR ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD > USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD then
                        ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD = USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD
                    endif
                endif
            EndIf
            
            If IsNull(USR_SCP_THD_WEB) = M4_FALSE Then
                USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD = USR_SCP_THD_WEB
            Else
                sThreshold = SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS!SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS.GET_VALUE_PARAM("LOGON", "SCH_SESSION", "USER_TIME_AUDITORY_WEB_THRESHOLD", sUser, iLanguage, ID_ORGANIZATION_USED)
                iThresholdWeb = ToInt(sThreshold)
                
                If IsNull(sThreshold) = M4_FALSE AND SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS!SRTC_APP_VALUE_LG.RET_CONCEPT = "ID_APP_USER" Then
                    USR_SCP_THD_WEB = iThresholdWeb
                EndIf                         
                
                if iThresholdWeb > 0 then
                    USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD = iThresholdWeb
                    if IsNull(ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD) = M4_TRUE OR ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD > USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD then
                        ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD = USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD
                    endif
                endif
            EndIf
            
            If IsNull(USR_SCP_SM_ACTV) = M4_FALSE Then
                USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT = USR_SCP_SM_ACTV
            Else
                sDevClientActv = SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS!SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS.GET_VALUE_PARAM("LOGON", "SCH_SESSION", "USER_TIME_AUDITORY_DEV_CLIENT", sUser, iLanguage, ID_ORGANIZATION_USED)
                iDevClientActv = ToInt(sDevClientActv)
                
                If IsNull(sDevClientActv) = M4_FALSE AND SRTC_LOGON_PARAMS!SRTC_APP_VALUE_LG.RET_CONCEPT = "ID_APP_USER" Then
                    USR_SCP_SM_ACTV = iDevClientActv
                EndIf                     
                                
                if iDevClientActv > 0 then
                    USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT = iDevClientActv
                    if IsNull(ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT) = M4_TRUE OR ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT < USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT then
                        ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT = USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT
                    endif
                endif
            EndIf
        EndIf
        
        bIsNofEof = GoNext()
    wend

    // -- Quitamos la marca de no inicializado.
    if IsNull(ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE) = M4_TRUE then
        ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE = 0
    endif
    
    if IsNull(ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD) = M4_TRUE then
        ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD = 0
    endif
    
    if IsNull(ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD) = M4_TRUE then
        ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD = 0
    endif
    
    if IsNull(ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT) = M4_TRUE then
        ROOT_SESSION.USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT = 0
    endif
endif


'Carga una socidad Nula con su RSM
'Bug Los campos se ponen a NULL para que funcione igual en SQLServer que oracle
sSelect = "SELECT @ID_RSM = A.ID_RSM, @ID_PROFILE = A.ID_PROFILE, @ID_ORGANIZATION_USED = NULL, @NM_ORGANIZATION = NULL, @ID_LEVEL = NULL, @N_LEVEL = NULL "
sSelect = sSelect + "FROM &M4RSC_APPROLE A WHERE A.ID_APP_ROLE = ?(2,30,0)"

SYS_SENTENCE_FILTER = sSelect
SYS_PARAM_FILTER = ID_APP_ROLE
LOAD()

/**
 *
 * Title:        GET_ORG_FOR_SWITCH_ROLE
 * Description:  Method that obtains the *best* organization for a role (where the parent node is positioned)
 *               a) It must be the organization with the least level.
 *               b) The default organization has priority over other organizations with the same level. 
 *               c) If the default organization is not the minimum level, another one must be chosen.
 * 
 * @param        AI_DEFAULT_ORG : Default organization
 * @param        AO_ORG: Selected organization
 * @return       M4_SUCCESS/M4_ERROR

*/
iCountOrgs = Count()
 
ROOT_SESSION.TRACE ("           Method: GET_ORG_FOR_SWITCH_ROLE start. Id role : " + ID_APP_ROLE + " Count Orgs: " + ToString(iCountOrgs,0) ) 

'No organizations for this role
if iCountOrgs  =  0 then
    ROOT_SESSION.TRACE ("             No organizations for this role." )
    ROOT_SESSION.TRACE ("           Method: GET_ORG_FOR_SWITCH_ROLE finished.")
    return  M4_ERROR
endif

'No organizations for this role, because the only record contains the null organization.
if iCountOrgs = 1 then
    Begin()
    if isnull(ID_ORGANIZATION_USED) = M4_TRUE then
        ROOT_SESSION.TRACE ("             No organizations for this role. Only Null Organization" )
        ROOT_SESSION.TRACE ("           Method: GET_ORG_FOR_SWITCH_ROLE finished.")
        return  M4_ERROR
    endif
endif
    
'Calculate the minimum level.
iMinLevel = 9999999
for i = 0 to iCountOrgs -1
    MoveTo (i)
    if ID_LEVEL < iMinLevel then
        iMinLevel = ID_LEVEL
    endif
next

'Look for the default organization and the minimum level
iPosOrg = FindRegister("ID_ORGANIZATION_USED",AI_DEFAULT_ORG,M4_EQUAL,"ID_LEVEL",iMinLevel,M4_EQUAL)
if (iPosOrg = M4_ERROR) then
    'If the default organization with the minimum level is not found, look for another with the minimum level.
    iPosOrg = FindRegister("ID_LEVEL",iMinLevel,M4_EQUAL)
endif
    
if (iPosOrg =  M4_ERROR) then
    'No candidate organization
    ROOT_SESSION.TRACE ("             No organizations with the correct level for this role." )
    ROOT_SESSION.TRACE ("           Method: GET_ORG_FOR_SWITCH_ROLE finished.")
    return  M4_ERROR
else
    'Return the organization found
    Moveto (iPosOrg)
    AO_ORG = ID_ORGANIZATION_USED
    ROOT_SESSION.TRACE ("             Org selected: " +  ID_ORGANIZATION_USED + " Level: " + Tostring(ID_LEVEL,0) )
    ROOT_SESSION.TRACE ("           Method: GET_ORG_FOR_SWITCH_ROLE finished.")
    return M4_SUCCESS
endif
ROOT_SESSION.TRACE ("           Method: GET_ORG_FOR_SWITCH_ROLE finished.")
return M4_ERROR
