// ===============================================================
//
// _CHECK_APP_ROLE Method in Node Structure ROOT_SESSION
//
// Arguments:
//	String sRoleId: Role identifier
//	Number iSetAsDefault: 1 if set as default role, 0 if not
//    Argumento variable: 1 - salva sobre usuarios
//                        0 - No salva sobre usuarios
//
// 1- Moves to the rigth record in root node and in APP_USER
// 2- Gets role if argument is empty
// 3- Calls to load roles if if empty
// 4- Check if sRoleId is one of the loaded roles
// 5- Call to check in Eligibilities if is valid this App role
// 6- Changes default role if told so
// 7- Sincronice ID_RSM and ID_APP_ROLE
//
// Return:
//   -10 if error in persist Users
//    -9 if RSM is NULL 
//    -8 if no valid role/user and there are no roles
//	-1 if error
//	 0 if success
//     9 if no valid role/user
//
// ===============================================================

LogPath = GetRegistryValue("SOFTWARE\Meta4\Mind\3.X\Machine","LogonPath")
if LogPath = "" then
    File = "c:/temp/LOGON.log"
else
    File = LogPath + "/LOGON.log"
endif

LogInf = ""
LogInf = GetRegistryValue("SOFTWARE\Meta4\Mind\3.X\Machine","LogonTrace")

if LogInf = "1" then
    ConcatFile(File, "_CHECK_APP_ROLE inicio ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File,TodayNow())
endif

// Recover 3rd parameter
iSave = 1
if GetArgumentNumber() = 3 then
    iSave = ToInt(GetArgument(3))
    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File, "    Recover parameter: ", FALSE)
        ConcatFile(File, ToString(iSave, 0))
    endif
else
    iSave = 1
    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File,"    No Recover parameter: 1 (Save)")
    endif
endif

//juanfay
//metemos una traza para ver el idioma
if LogInf = "1" then
    ConcatFile(File,"       JUANFAY El idioma cargado es: ", FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File,ROOT_SESSION.LANGUAGE)
endif

// 1- Moves to the rigth record in root node and in APP_USER

iIsNotEof = Begin()

if iIsNotEof = FALSE then
    return -1
endif

// 2- Gets role if argument is empty

SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.Load_prg()

iIsNotEof = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.Begin()
if iIsNotEof = FALSE then
    SetLog(ERRORLOG,0,24,16)
    return -1
endif
if sRoleId = "" then
    sRoleId  = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_APP_ROLE_DEF
endif
sNRole = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.N_APP_ROLE
sRSMId = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_RSM
sNRSM = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.N_RSM

if LogInf = "1" then
    ConcatFile(File, "    APP Role Look for: ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File, sRoleId)
endif


// 3- Calls to load roles if empty

iCount = APP_ROLE_SESSION.Count()

if LogInf = "1" then
    ConcatFile(File, "    Register in APP_ROLE_SESSION: ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File, iCount)
endif

if iCount = 0 then
    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File, "    Execute _LOAD_ROLES and SYNC_ROOT_SESSION ")
    endif
    _LOAD_ROLES()
endif

iCount = APP_ROLE_SESSION.Count()
if LogInf = "1" then
    ConcatFile(File, "    Register in APP_ROLE_SESSION: ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File, iCount)
endif

iCount = APP_ROLE_SESSION.Count()
if iCount <> 0 then
    // 4- Check if sRoleId is one of the loaded roles

    iCount = APP_ROLE_SESSION.Count()
    iFound = 0
    i = 0 
    While iFound = 0 and i < iCount
        APP_ROLE_SESSION.MoveTo( i )
        if APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_APP_ROLE = sRoleId then
            ID_APP_ROLE = sRoleId
            ID_RSM = APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_RSM
            ID_PROFILE = APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_PROFILE
            DEFAULT_PROJECT = ""
            iFound = 1
        endif
        i = i + 1
    wend
else

    // Si el role no está permitido no hay que buscarlo
    if ROLE_VALIDATION.CHECK_ROLE( sRoleId, 0 ) = M4_TRUE then
    
        // 5- Call to check in Eligibilities if is valid this App role
        Eligibility_Channel!Eligibility_Params3.AddRegister()
        Eligibility_Channel!Eligibility_Params3.ID_APP_USER=ID_APP_USER
        Eligibility_Channel!Eligibility_Params3.ID_APP_ROLE=sRoleId
    '    Eligibility_Channel!Eligibility_Params3.ID_PERSON=ID_PERSON
        Eligibility_Channel!Eligibility_Params3.Rootload()
        //iFound = Eligibility_Channel!Eligibility_Params3.IS_VALID
    
    
        RolesCount = ELIGIBILITY_CHANNEL!FINAL_APP_ROLES.Count()
    
        if LogInf = "1" then
            ConcatFile(File, "    Count Eligibility in Check Role: ",FALSE)
            ConcatFile(File, RolesCount)
        endif
        
        // Prepares the role authorization by IP address.
        sIP = NullValue()
        bDoCheckIPAuth = M4_FALSE
        
        IP_AUTH_PROLOGUE(sIP, bDoCheckIPAuth)        
    
        for i = 0 to RolesCount - 1
            ELIGIBILITY_CHANNEL!FINAL_APP_ROLES.MoveTo( i )
            if ELIGIBILITY_CHANNEL!FINAL_APP_ROLES.ID_APP_ROLE = sRoleId then
            
                bAddRole = M4_TRUE
                 
                // Performs the role authorization by IP address.        
                If bDoCheckIPAuth = M4_TRUE Then

                    If IsNull(ID_DEBUG_USER) = M4_FALSE Then
                        sUser = ID_DEBUG_USER
                    Else
                        sUser = ID_APP_USER
                    EndIf

                    iRet = IP_AUTH_CHECK(sIP, sRoleId, sUser, bAddRole)
                    
                    If iRet = M4_ERROR Then
                        Return M4_ERROR
                    EndIf
                EndIf
                
                If bAddRole = M4_TRUE Then 
                
                    iFound = Eligibility_Channel!Eligibility_Params3.IS_VALID

                    APP_ROLE_SESSION.AddRegister()
        
                    APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_APP_ROLE = ELIGIBILITY_CHANNEL!FINAL_APP_ROLES.ID_APP_ROLE
                    APP_ROLE_SESSION.N_APP_ROLE = ELIGIBILITY_CHANNEL!FINAL_APP_ROLES.N_APP_ROLE
                    APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_RSM = ELIGIBILITY_CHANNEL!FINAL_APP_ROLES.ID_RSM
                    APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_APP_USER = ID_APP_USER
        
                    if LogInf = "1" then
                        ConcatFile(File, "    APP_ROLE in Eligibility: ",FALSE)
                        ConcatFile(File, APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_APP_ROLE)
                    endif
        
                    if APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_APP_ROLE = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_APP_ROLE_DEF then
                        APP_ROLE_SESSION.IS_DEFAULT_ROLE = 1
                    endif
                EndIf
            endif
        next
    
    
    
        CLOSECHANNEL( "Eligibility_Channel" )
    Else
        iFound = 0
        if LogInf = "1" then
            ConcatFile(File, "    Role ignored: ",FALSE)
            ConcatFile(File, sRoleId)
        endif        
    EndIf
    
    if IsNull(iFound) = TRUE then
        iFound = 0
    endif
    if iFound <> 0 then
        ID_APP_ROLE = sRoleId
        ID_RSM = APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_RSM
        ID_PROFILE = APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_PROFILE
        DEFAULT_PROJECT = ""

        if LogInf = "1" then
            ConcatFile(File, "    Role in Session Meta4Object",FALSE)
            ConcatFile(File, ID_APP_ROLE)
            ConcatFile(File, "    RSM en Session Meta4Object",FALSE)
            ConcatFile(File, ID_RSM)
        endif
    else
        _REFRESH(1)
    endif
endif

if LogInf = "1" then
    ConcatFile(File, "    App Role found ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File, iFound)
endif

if iFound = 0 then
    /* Bug 0069438
    Si el role es nulo hay que sacar un mensaje diferente
    Si además no hay roles definidos hay que sacar otro
    */
    if APP_ROLE_SESSION.Count() = 0 then
        SetLog(ERRORLOG,0,24,32,ID_APP_USER)
        return -8
    else
	    if IsNull( sRoleId ) = M4_FALSE then
	        SetLog(ERRORLOG,0,24,23,sRoleId,ID_APP_USER)
	        return 9
        else
	        SetLog(ERRORLOG,0,24,31,ID_APP_USER)
	        return 9
        endif
    endif
endif

if IsNull( ID_RSM ) = M4_TRUE then
    SetLog(ERRORLOG,0,24,30,sRoleId,ID_APP_USER)
    return -9
endif

iCount = APP_ROLE_SESSION.Count()

if LogInf = "1" then
    ConcatFile(File, "    Registers in APP_ROLE_SESSION: ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File, iCount)
endif

if LogInf = "1" then
    i=0
    While i < iCount
        APP_ROLE_SESSION.MoveTo( i )
        ConcatFile(File, "    -> App. Role: ", FALSE)
        ConcatFile(File,APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_APP_ROLE, FALSE)
        ConcatFile(File, "    RSM: ", FALSE)
        ConcatFile(File,APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_RSM,FALSE)
        ConcatFile(File, "    Is Default: ", FALSE)
        ConcatFile(File,APP_ROLE_SESSION.IS_DEFAULT_ROLE)
        i = i + 1
    wend
endif





// 7- Sincronice ID_RSM and ID_APP_ROLE

'SCH_SESSION_SERVER!ROOT_SESSION.ID_RSM = ID_RSM
'SCH_SESSION_SERVER!ROOT_SESSION.ID_APP_ROLE = ID_APP_ROLE

if iSave = 1 then
    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File, "    Audit information")
    endif

    SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.DESTROYBLOCK()

    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File, "    User destroyed")
    endif

    SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.Load_prg()

    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File, "    User loaded")
    endif

    iIsNotEof = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.Begin()
    if iIsNotEof = FALSE then
        SetLog(ERRORLOG,0,24,16)
        return -1
    endif

    // 6- Changes default role if told so

    if iSetAsDefault = 1 then
        SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_APP_ROLE_DEF = sRoleId
        if LogInf = "1" then
            ConcatFile(File, "    ID_APP_ROLE_DEF: ",FALSE)
            ConcatFile(File, sRoleId)
        endif
    endif

    SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_RSM_LAST_CON = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_RSM_CON
    SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_RSM_CON = ID_RSM
    SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_APP_ROLE_LAST_CON = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_APP_ROLE_CON
    SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_APP_ROLE_CON = ID_APP_ROLE

    result = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.Persist_tree()

    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File, "    Persist user: ",FALSE)
        ConcatFile(File, result)
    endif

    if result = -1 then
        Type = ""
        Module = ""
        Submodule = ""
        Code = ""
        Aditiona_text = ""
        if result = -1 then
            GetLog(-1,Type,Module,Submodule,Code,Aditiona_text)
            if Module = 0 and Submodule = 19 and Code = 81 then
                'Error de concurrencia
                Purgelog(-1)
                SetLog(ERRORLOG,0,24,26)
                return -10
            else                    
                'error persistiendo
                SetLog(ERRORLOG,0,24,18)
                return -1
            endif
        endif
    endif
else
    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File, "    Is imposible save audit information")
    endif
endif

// Bug 0273571 y 0279174. Se debe asignar la sociedad por defecto si es válida para el rol en todos los casos
if IsNull(ID_ORGANIZATION) = M4_TRUE then
    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File, "    Loading default organization")
    endif

' ---Enh 0326291. 06/07/2018. Cambio de la sociedad por defecto de parámetros de aplicación a la tabla de usuarios
'    SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("LOGON","SCH_SESSION","ID_ORGANIZATION")
'    
'    if SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.Count() > 0 Then
'        xID_ORGANIZATION = SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN[0].APP_VALUE
'        xID_RSM = ""
'        xROL_NF = 0
'        xORG_NF = 0
'        xRet = CHECK_ORG_ROLE_SILENT(ID_APP_ROLE,xID_ORGANIZATION,"1",xID_RSM,xROL_NF, xORG_NF)
'        if xRet = 0 then
'            ID_ORGANIZATION = xID_ORGANIZATION
'            SAV_PARAMS!SetProperty("ID_ORGANIZATION", xID_ORGANIZATION)
'        endif
'    endif


        xID_ORGANIZATION = GET_USER_DEFAULT_ORG()
'------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------        
        xID_RSM = ""
        xROL_NF = 0
        xORG_NF = 0
        xRet = CHECK_ORG_ROLE_SILENT(ID_APP_ROLE,xID_ORGANIZATION,"1",xID_RSM,xROL_NF, xORG_NF)
        if xRet = 0 then
            ID_ORGANIZATION = xID_ORGANIZATION
            SAV_PARAMS!SetProperty("ID_ORGANIZATION", xID_ORGANIZATION)
        endif

'ISA----------------------------------------------

   
    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File, "    Default organization loaded: " + ID_ORGANIZATION)
    endif
endif

if IsNull(IS_MULTIORGANIZATION) = M4_TRUE then
    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File, "    Loading default IS_MULTIORGANIZATION")
    endif

    SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("LOGON","SCH_SESSION","IS_MULTIORGANIZATION")
    
    if SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.Count() > 0 Then
        IS_MULTIORGANIZATION = SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN[0].APP_VALUE
    endif
    if IsNull(IS_MULTIORGANIZATION) = M4_TRUE then
        IS_MULTIORGANIZATION = "0"
    endif
   
    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File, "    Default MULTIORGANIZATION loaded: " + IS_MULTIORGANIZATION)
    endif
endif

// Load text orientation for the language
if IsNull(IS_RTL_LANGUAGE) = M4_TRUE then
    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File, "    Loading RTL")
    endif
    
    IS_RTL_LANGUAGE = ROOT_LU_LANGS.CHECK_IS_RTL(LANGUAGE)
    if IsNull(IS_RTL_LANGUAGE) = M4_TRUE then
        IS_RTL_LANGUAGE = 0
    endif
    
    if LogInf = "1" then
        ConcatFile(File, "    RTL loaded: " + ToString(IS_RTL_LANGUAGE, 0))
    endif
endif

if LogInf = "1" then
    ConcatFile(File,"    SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_RSM_LAST_CON ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File,SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_RSM_LAST_CON)
    ConcatFile(File,"    SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_RSM_CON ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File,SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_RSM_CON)
    ConcatFile(File,"    SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_APP_ROLE_LAST_CON ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File,SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_APP_ROLE_LAST_CON)
    ConcatFile(File,"    SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_APP_ROLE_CON ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File,SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_APP_ROLE_CON)
    ConcatFile(File,"    SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.SUCCESS_LAST_CON ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File,SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.SUCCESS_LAST_CON)
    ConcatFile(File,"    SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.SUCCESS_CON ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File,SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.SUCCESS_CON)

    ConcatFile(File, "_CHECK_APP_ROLE final ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File,TodayNow())
endif

// Modificación para cliente ligero
''''USR_INF()

return 0

// ===============================================================
//
// _LOAD_ROLES Method in Node Structure ROOT_SESSION
//
// Arguments:
//
// 1- Loads node SSC_APPUSER_LOGON
// 2- Copies ID_PERSON to ROOT_SESSION
// 3- Loads node FINAL_APP_ROLES in Meta4Object ELIGIBILITY_CHANNEL
// with roles for our user
// 4- Updates node APP_ROLE_SESSION with default role mark
// 5- Removes those unauthorized roles from the current IP address.
//
// Return:
//	-1 if error
//	 0 if success
//
// ===============================================================

//Look for the Default App. Role in APP_USER and updated the node APP_ROLE_SESSION.

LogPath = GetRegistryValue("SOFTWARE\Meta4\Mind\3.X\Machine","LogonPath")
if LogPath = "" then
    File = "c:/temp/LOGON.log"
else
    File = LogPath + "/LOGON.log"
endif

LogInf = ""
LogInf = GetRegistryValue("SOFTWARE\Meta4\Mind\3.X\Machine","LogonTrace")

if LogInf = "1" then
    ConcatFile(File, "_LOAD_ROLES inicio ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File,TodayNow())
endif

'// 1- Loads node SSC_APPUSER_LOGON

'SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.Load_prg()
'
'// 2- Copies ID_PERSON to ROOT_SESSION
'
'iIsNotEof = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.Begin()
'
'if iIsNotEof = FALSE then
'    SetLog(ERRORLOG,0,24,16)
'    return -1
'endif

'ID_PERSON = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_PERSON

'if LogInf = "1" then
'    ConcatFile(File, "    ID_PERSON:",FALSE)
'    ConcatFile(File, ID_PERSON)
'endif


// 3- Loads node FINAL_APP_ROLES in Meta4Object ELIGIBILITY_CHANNEL
// with roles for our user
ELIGIBILITY_CHANNEL!ELIGIBILITY_PARAMS1.AddRegister()
ELIGIBILITY_CHANNEL!ELIGIBILITY_PARAMS1.ID_APP_USER = ID_APP_USER 
'ELIGIBILITY_CHANNEL!ELIGIBILITY_PARAMS1.ID_PERSON = ID_PERSON 
ELIGIBILITY_CHANNEL!ELIGIBILITY_PARAMS1.RootLoad()

iCount = ELIGIBILITY_CHANNEL!FINAL_APP_ROLES.Count()

if LogInf = "1" then
    ConcatFile(File, "    COUNT ELIGIBILITY: ",FALSE)
    ConcatFile(File, icount)
endif


if iCount <= 0 then

                lPos=IndexOf(sSerializedContext,StringToSearch,lAntPos+1)

                if sFirstChar="{" then 
                    StringTosearch= "}|"
                    lPos=IndexOf(sSerializedContext,StringToSearch,lAntPos+1)

                    if LogInf = "1" then

                        SetChannelValue("SCH_SESSION",sNode,sItem,-1,VarValue)
                    endif
                endif 
                if LogInf = "1" then
                    Valor=GetChannelValue("SCH_SESSION",sNode,sItem,-1)

/**
 *
 * Title:        SWITCH_ROLE
 * Description:  Method that discovers an alternative default role for thinclient apps
 * 
 * @param        xID_ORGANIZATION default organization from the application param.
 * @return      -1: Error
 *               0: No change done
 *               1: Change done
 * 
 * Item SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE is used as return code for the servlet
 * because returning -1 in USR_INF makes the logon stop. 
 *
 * SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE = -1   Error
 * SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE = 0    No change done
 * SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE = 1    Change done
 *
 *
 * @see SSC_PROG_OPTIONS_CACHE!SSC_PROG_OPTIONS_CACHE.HAS_SECURITY
 * @see SSC_PROG_OPTIONS_CACHE!SSC_PROG_OPTIONS_CACHE.IS_ENABLED
 * @see ROOT_SESSION.TRACE()
 * @see ROOT_SESSION.TRACE_SETLOG("msg", "code", "level")
 * @see ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE
 * @deprecated ROOT_SESSION.ENTRY_MODE
 * 
 */
 
iHasSecurity  = 0
iCheckEnabled = 0
iCountEnabledRoles = 0

' If you used ENTRY_MODE, use USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE
' This code will try to prevent impacts 
' ------------------------------------------------------
ENTRY_MODE = USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE

' Constants
' ------------------------------------------------------
THIN_CLIENT = 2
MOBILE_CLIENT = 8
EXP_PORTAL = 10

' Decide if the switch role has to be made (portal and mobile)
' ------------------------------------------------------------
if ( USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE <> THIN_CLIENT and USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE <> MOBILE_CLIENT and USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE <> EXP_PORTAL ) then
    TRACE (" No SWITCH_ROLE needed for entry mode: " + ToString (USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE,0) )
    TRACE ("Method SWITCH_ROLE finished " + ToString (TodayNow(),0))
    SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE = 0 
    return 0
else
    TRACE ( "Method SWITCH_ROLE start " + ToString (TodayNow(),0) )    
endif

'For EXP_PORTAL and SYSTEM users do not do the SWITCH_ROLE
'-------------------------------------------------------------
if ( USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE = EXP_PORTAL and  ConvertCase(SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_USER_TYPE, M4_UPPERCASE) = "SYSTEM") then
    TRACE (" No SWITCH_ROLE needed for entry mode: " + ToString (USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE,0) + " and User of type SYSTEM" )
    TRACE ("Method SWITCH_ROLE finished " + ToString (TodayNow(),0))
    SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE = 0 
    return 0
endif

' Check if HAS_SECURITY is active
' -------------------------------
iHasSecurity = SSC_SEC_OPT_CACHE!SSC_PROG_OPTIONS_CACHE.HAS_SECURITY ("THINCLIENT", "SWITCH_ROLE") 
if (iHasSecurity = 0) then
    TRACE (" Program option does not have security. ")
    TRACE ("Method SWITCH_ROLE finished " + ToString (TodayNow(),0))
    SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE = 0
    return 0
endif


' Check number of roles with IS_ENABLED active
' --------------------------------------------
iCheckEnabled = CHECK_ENABLED ("THINCLIENT")
if (iCheckEnabled <> M4_SUCCESS) then
    TRACE (" Cannot check the enabled roles for THINCLIENT. ")
    TRACE ("Method SWITCH_ROLE finished " + ToString (TodayNow(),0))
    SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE = 0
    return 0
endif


' Look for the best enabled role
' --------------------------------------------
sCandidateRole = ""  
sCandidateRoleOrg = "" 
iCandidateRoleOrgLevel = 0
sDefaultOrg = XID_ORGANIZATION
bCandidateRoleFound = M4_FALSE
iHasSuperUserRole  = 0


' Step 1) See if the default role is enabled (NOT considere here M4ADM, this role has always IS_ENABLED = 1)
' -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TRACE (" Default role: " + ID_APP_ROLE )
TRACE (" Default org: " + sDefaultOrg)
if ID_APP_ROLE <> "M4ADM" then
    TRACE (" Checking Default role "  + ID_APP_ROLE)
    iPosRolDef = APP_ROLE_SESSION.FindRegister("ID_APP_ROLE",ID_APP_ROLE,M4_TRUE,"IS_ENABLED",1,M4_EQUAL)
    if iPosRolDef <> M4_ERROR then
         APP_ROLE_SESSION.Moveto(iPosRolDef)
         TRACE (" Default role enabled. Looking for valid organization.")
         if APP_ROLE_ORG.GET_ORG_FOR_SWITCH_ROLE(sDefaultOrg,sCandidateRoleOrg) = M4_SUCCESS then 
            bCandidateRoleFound =  M4_TRUE
            sCandidateRole = APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_APP_ROLE
         else
            TRACE (" Default role " + ID_APP_ROLE + " has no valid organizations.")
         endif
    else
        TRACE (" Default role " + ID_APP_ROLE + " is not enabled.")
    endif
endif



'2) Buscando entre otros roles
' ------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (bCandidateRoleFound =  M4_FALSE)  then
    iCountRoles = APP_ROLE_SESSION.Count()
    TRACE (" Role Count " + ToString(iCountRoles,0))
    TRACE (" Looping over the roles ... ")
    i = 0
    while (bCandidateRoleFound =  M4_FALSE and i < iCountRoles)
        APP_ROLE_SESSION.MoveTo (i) 
        iCountRoleOrg = APP_ROLE_ORG.Count()
        TRACE ("    Checking Role : " + APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_APP_ROLE + ". Role Org Count " + ToString(iCountRoleOrg,0))
    
        if ( APP_ROLE_SESSION.IS_ENABLED = 1 ) then
            if ( APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_APP_ROLE = "M4ADM") then
                TRACE ("        M4ADM is not a valid candidate.")       
            else
                if APP_ROLE_ORG.GET_ORG_FOR_SWITCH_ROLE(sDefaultOrg,sCandidateRoleOrg) = M4_SUCCESS then
                    bCandidateRoleFound =  M4_TRUE
                    sCandidateRole = APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_APP_ROLE
                else
                    TRACE ("        Role " + APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_APP_ROLE + " has no valid organizations.") 
                endif
            endif  
        else 'IS_ENABLED = 0
            TRACE ("        Role " + APP_ROLE_SESSION.ID_APP_ROLE + " is not enabled.") 
        endif
        i = i + 1
    wend
endif

' If there are no candidate roles, Check SuperUserRole otherwise error
' -------------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( bCandidateRoleFound =  M4_FALSE) then
    'Check if this user has M4ADM (HasSuperUserRole)
    iPosSuperUserRole = APP_ROLE_SESSION.FindRegister("ID_APP_ROLE","M4ADM",M4_TRUE,"IS_ENABLED",1,M4_EQUAL)
    if iPosSuperUserRole <> M4_ERROR then
        TRACE (" Warning: No enabled roles. But this user has M4ADM role. Logon will continue without switch role.") 
        TRACE ("Method SWITCH_ROLE finished " + ToString (TodayNow(),0))
        SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE = 0
        return 0 
    else
        TRACE_SETLOG(" No enabled roles. SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE -1", "NO_ENABLED_ROLES", "error")
        TRACE ("Method SWITCH_ROLE finished " + ToString (TodayNow(),0))
        SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE = -1
        SSC_SEC_OPT_CACHE!SSC_PROG_OPTIONS_CACHE.EXECUTELN4JIT("DumpChannel()")
        return -1
    endif
endif

' If the candidate role and organization are the default, nothing is done 
' -----------------------------------------------------------------------
if ( ID_APP_ROLE = sCandidateRole and sDefaultOrg = sCandidateRoleOrg ) then
    TRACE (" The pair switch role/org is default role/default org. No changes. ")
    TRACE ("Method SWITCH_ROLE finished " + ToString (TodayNow(),0) )
    SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE = 0
    return 0
endif

' If there is no candidate organization for any enabled role, error. 
' -----------------------------------------------------------------------
if sCandidateRoleOrg = "" then
    TRACE_SETLOG(" No organizations for the enabled role. SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE -1", "NO_ORGANIZATIONS_FOR_THE_ENABLED_ROLE", "error")
    SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE = -1 
    TRACE ( "Method SWITCH_ROLE finished " + ToString (TodayNow(),0) )
    return -1
endif

' We change the role because we found a candidate role and organization
' -------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (ID_APP_ROLE <> sCandidateRole) then
    ID_APP_ROLE = sCandidateRole
    TRACE (" Role switched to " + sCandidateRole ) 
    sIdRSM = ""
    GET_ROLE_RSM ( ID_APP_ROLE , sIdRSM )       
    ID_RSM = sIdRSM
    TRACE (" RSM for this role switched to " + sIdRSM )
else
    TRACE (" Preserving role: " + ID_APP_ROLE )
endif

if (ID_ORGANIZATION <> sCandidateRoleOrg) then
    ID_ORGANIZATION = sCandidateRoleOrg
    TRACE (" Switching organization to: " + sCandidateRoleOrg )
else
    TRACE (" Preserving organization: " + ID_ORGANIZATION )
endif
        
TRACE ( "Method SWITCH_ROLE finished " + ToString (TodayNow(),0) )
SWITCH_ROLE_RETCODE = 1
return 1

// 2- Load in SCH_SESSION!APP_ROLE_SESSION the roles loaded in SCH_SESSION_SERVER!APP_ROLE_SESSION


    ROOT_SESSION.MoveTo(0)

            ConcatFile(File,SCH_SESSION_SERVER!APP_ROLE_SESSION[Pos].ID_APP_ROLE)
        endif

        iCountOrg = SCH_SESSION_SERVER!APP_ROLE_ORG.Count()
        for PosOrg=0 to iCountOrg - 1
            APP_ROLE_ORG.AddRegister()
            APP_ROLE_ORG.ID_ORGANIZATION_USED = SCH_SESSION_SERVER!APP_ROLE_ORG[PosOrg].ID_ORGANIZATION_USED
            APP_ROLE_ORG.NM_ORGANIZATION = SCH_SESSION_SERVER!APP_ROLE_ORG[PosOrg].NM_ORGANIZATION

            APP_ROLE_ORG.ID_RSM = SCH_SESSION_SERVER!APP_ROLE_ORG[PosOrg].ID_RSM
            APP_ROLE_ORG.ID_PROFILE = SCH_SESSION_SERVER!APP_ROLE_ORG[PosOrg].ID_PROFILE
            APP_ROLE_ORG.USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE = SCH_SESSION_SERVER!APP_ROLE_ORG[PosOrg].USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE
            APP_ROLE_ORG.USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD = SCH_SESSION_SERVER!APP_ROLE_ORG[PosOrg].USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD
            APP_ROLE_ORG.USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD = SCH_SESSION_SERVER!APP_ROLE_ORG[PosOrg].USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD
            APP_ROLE_ORG.USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT = SCH_SESSION_SERVER!APP_ROLE_ORG[PosOrg].USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT

            if LogInf = "1" then
                ConcatFile(File, "        Set the APP_ROLE_ORG in Client: ",FALSE)

            endif
        next
    next
endif

// 4- Sincronize the Items between Server and Client
valServer = 0
valCliente = 0
itemFilter = M4_SCOPE_BLOCK + M4_SCOPE_NODE + M4_TYPE_PROPERTY

NumItems = GetNodeNumberOfItems("ROOT_SESSION", itemFilter)
for IItems = 0 to NumItems-1
// Read the items of the Meta4Objects client and server.

    ItemId = GetNodeItemId("ROOT_SESSION",IItems, itemFilter)

    valCliente = GetValue("ROOT_SESSION",ItemId,0,0)
    valServer=GetChannelValue("SCH_SESSION_SERVER","ROOT_SESSION",ItemId,0,0)

// If the server have value, copy this to the client
// Si el del servidor tiene valor, copiamos eso al del cliente.    
    if (IsNull(valServer)=FALSE) then
        ret = SetValue("ROOT_SESSION",ItemId,0,0,valServer)

    else

// ===============================================================
//
// USR_INF_TEC Method in Node Structure ROOT_SESSION
//
// Arguments:  None
//
// -2- Initialize organization with the default value
// -1- Switch role if portal logon (can't be in _CHECK_APP_ROLE)
//  0- Load logon params in ROOT_SESSION items.
//  1- Copies ID_PERSON to ROOT_SESSION.
//  2- Checks the organization.
//  3- Insert the user and machine into Sentinel table.
//  4- Set user names, in the case of impersonation.
//
// Return:
// 
//    -1 -> Error 
//     0 if success
//
// ===============================================================

TRACE ("USR_INF_TEC: Start " + ToString(TodayNow()) + "----------------------------")

// -2- Initialize organization with the default value
xID_ORGANIZATION = ID_ORGANIZATION

// Bug 0273571. Se debe asignar la sociedad por defecto (si es válida) si aún no está definida ninguna sociedad
' ---Enh 0326291. 06/07/2018. Cambio de la sociedad por defecto de parámetros de aplicación a la tabla de usuarios
'If IsNull(ID_ORGANIZATION) = M4_TRUE Then
'    // Bg 0125858. Tenemos que establecer primero la organización en el canal sesión, para así poder 
'    // calcular después el resto de parámetros de ámbito organización.
'    SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("LOGON","SCH_SESSION","ID_ORGANIZATION")
'    
'    If SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.Count() > 0 Then
'        xID_ORGANIZATION = SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN[0].APP_VALUE
'        xID_RSM = ""
'        xROL_NF = 0
'        xORG_NF = 0
'        xRet = CHECK_ORG_ROLE_SILENT(ID_APP_ROLE,xID_ORGANIZATION,"1",xID_RSM,xROL_NF, xORG_NF)
'        If xRet = 0 then
'            ID_ORGANIZATION = xID_ORGANIZATION
'        Endif        
'    EndIf
'EndIf
If IsNull(ID_ORGANIZATION) = M4_TRUE Then
    // Bg 0125858. Tenemos que establecer primero la organización en el canal sesión, para así poder 
    // calcular después el resto de parámetros de ámbito organización.
        
        xID_ORGANIZATION = ROOT_SESSION.GET_USER_DEFAULT_ORG()
        xID_RSM = ""
        xROL_NF = 0
        xORG_NF = 0
        xRet = CHECK_ORG_ROLE_SILENT(ID_APP_ROLE,xID_ORGANIZATION,"1",xID_RSM,xROL_NF, xORG_NF)
        If xRet = 0 then
            ID_ORGANIZATION = xID_ORGANIZATION
        Endif        
endif

'-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

TRACE ("ID_ORGANIZATION: " + ToString(xID_ORGANIZATION, 0) )

// -1- Switch role only for portal and mobile (bugid 0316956)
//Enh:0324297. Varios roles del portal
//iRet = SWITCH_ROLE(xID_ORGANIZATION)
iRet = SWITCH_ROLE_MULTI(xID_ORGANIZATION)
if (iRet = 1) then
    TRACE ("USR_INF_TEC: Role has been switched")
    // Only portal. 
    xID_ORGANIZATION = ID_ORGANIZATION
endif

// 0- Load LOGON params in ROOT_SESSION items
LOAD_LOGON_PARAMS()

// 1- Copies ID_PERSON to ROOT_SESSION
ROOT_SESSION.MoveTo(0)
iIsNotEof = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.Begin()

TRACE ("    Load SSC_APPUSER_LOGON ")

if iIsNotEof = FALSE then
    CLOSECHANNEL("SAV_PARAMS")
    TRACE ("    Error: There is not user ")    
    SetLog(ERRORLOG,0,24,16)
    return -1
endif

ID_PERSON = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.ID_PERSON

TRACE ("    ID_PERSON:" + ID_PERSON)


// 2- Checks the organization
TRACE ("    ORGANIZATION CHECK: " + xID_ORGANIZATION )

xRet = 0
xID_RSM = ""

TRACE ("    IS_MULTIORGANIZATION: " + IS_MULTIORGANIZATION )
If IS_MULTIORGANIZATION = "1" then
    // Entornos multisocietarios. Se anula la sociedad si es incorrecta, pero no si es nula. 
    If IsNull(xID_ORGANIZATION) = M4_TRUE then
        TRACE ("    UNDEFINED ORGANIZATION BUT IS_MULTIORGANIZATION: " + IS_MULTIORGANIZATION )
        // Because of "impacts" we do not return here
    else
        xRet = CHECK_ORG_ROLE(ID_APP_ROLE,xID_ORGANIZATION,"1",xID_RSM)
        if xRet <> 0 then
            SET_SESSION_VALUE("ID_ORGANIZATION", NullValue())
            TRACE ("    INCORRECT ORGANIZATION: " + xID_ORGANIZATION )
        endif
    endif
else
    // Entornos monosocietarios: Se calcula la auditoría de usuario
    SET_SESSION_VALUE("USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE", 0)
    
    SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE( "LOGON", "SCH_SESSION", "USER_ACTIONS_AUDITORY" )

    if SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.Count() > 0 then
        if ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE) > 0 then
            // -- XXXXXXXX00000 mask.
            SET_SESSION_VALUE("USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE", ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE) * 32)
        EndIf
    EndIf

    SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE( "LOGON", "SCH_SESSION", "USER_LOGON_AUDITORY" )

    if SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.Count() > 0 then
        if ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE) > 0 then
            // -- XXXXX mask.
            SET_SESSION_VALUE("USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE", ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE) + USR_AUDIT_ACTIVE)
        EndIf
    EndIf

    SET_SESSION_VALUE("USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD", 0)
    SET_SESSION_VALUE("USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD", 0)
    SET_SESSION_VALUE("USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT", 0)
    
    // Gets user time audit configuration except for JS context.
    If ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE <> 4 Then
        SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE( "LOGON", "SCH_SESSION", "USER_TIME_AUDITORY_RC_THRESHOLD" )
    
        if SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.Count() > 0 then
            if ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE) > 0 then
                SET_SESSION_VALUE("USR_TIME_AUDIT_RC_THRESHOLD", ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE))
            EndIf
        EndIf
        
        SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE( "LOGON", "SCH_SESSION", "USER_TIME_AUDITORY_WEB_THRESHOLD" )
    
        if SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.Count() > 0 then
            if ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE) > 0 then
                SET_SESSION_VALUE("USR_TIME_AUDIT_WEB_THRESHOLD", ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE))
            EndIf
        EndIf
        
        SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE( "LOGON", "SCH_SESSION", "USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT" )
    
        if SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.Count() > 0 then
            if ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE) > 0 then
                SET_SESSION_VALUE("USR_TIME_AUDIT_DEV_CLIENT", ToInt(SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.APP_VALUE))
            EndIf
        EndIf
    EndIf

endif

CLOSECHANNEL("SAV_PARAMS")

// 3- Insert the user and machine into Sentinel table
if isNull(USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_MACHINE) = M4_FALSE then

   // Solo si estoy en single machine 
   iIdx = ExistNodeItemIndex("SCH_SESSION", "ROOT_SESSION", "_CHECK_FRONT")
   
   If iIdx >= 0 Then
        
      iDDBBCode = ToInt(GetRegistryValue(".\CVM\LDB", "DataBase"))            
      If iDDBBCode = 1 then ' SQL SERVER
      
        EXECUTEREALSQL = "EXECUTE dbo.UPDATE_USER_NETWORK_SQLSERVER '" + USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_MACHINE + "', '" + ID_APP_USER + "', '" + ID_APP_ROLE + "'"
        EXECUTEREALSQL(0)
                  
      else ' ORACLE
      
        EXECUTEREALSQL = "BEGIN UPDATE_USER_NETWORK_ORACLE('" + USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_MACHINE + "', '" + ID_APP_USER + "', '" + ID_APP_ROLE + "'); END;"
        EXECUTEREALSQL(0)             
      EndIf      
   EndIf
EndIf

// 4 - Set user names, in the case of impersonation
N_APP_USER = SSC_APPUSER_LOGON.N_APP_USER

If IsNull(ID_DEBUG_USER) = M4_FALSE Then
    SSC_APPUSER_DEBUGGER.DESTROYBLOCK()
    SSC_APPUSER_DEBUGGER.LOAD_BLK()
    
    If SSC_APPUSER_DEBUGGER.Count() = 1 Then
        N_DEBUG_USER = SSC_APPUSER_DEBUGGER.N_APP_USER
        TRACE ("Debugger user " + N_DEBUG_USER)
    EndIf
EndIf

TRACE ("Debugger user " + N_DEBUG_USER)

if IsNull(ID_ORGANIZATION) = M4_TRUE then
    TRACE_SETLOG("-role-" + ID_APP_ROLE + "-organization-" + "null", "USR_INF_TEC_STATUS", "info")
else
    TRACE_SETLOG("-role-" + ID_APP_ROLE + "-organization-" + ID_ORGANIZATION, "USR_INF_TEC_STATUS", "info")
endif

// End
TRACE ("USR_INF_TEC: End " + ToString(TodayNow()) + "----------------------------")

return (0)

/**
 *
 * Title:        USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH
 * Description:  Method that changes the role and organization for portal applications
 * 
 * @param        AI_ID_APP_ROLE     Role to change to.
 * @param        AI_ID_ORGANIZATION Organization to change to.
 * @return      -1: Error
 *               0: No change done
 *               1: Change done
 * 
 
 * 1)	Comprobar que estamos en portal. Si no estamos devuelve 0. 
 * 2)	Comprobar si el rol o la sociedad son nulos o vacíos, en ese caso devolver -1 y ERROR_NULL_ROLE_OR_ORG 
 * 3)	Comprobar si el rol y la sociedad son los actuales, en ese caso devolver 0. 
 * 4)	Comprobar si el rol va con la sociedad (CHECK_ROLE_ORG), en caso contrario devolver -1 y ERROR_ROLE_FOR_ORGANIZATION.
 * 5)	Comprobar que el rol es enabled, si no lo es devolver -1 y ERROR_ROLE_NOT_ENABLED. 
 * 6)	Una vez comprobado esto, se establece el rol mediante el método CHECK_APP_ROLE, en caso de error devolver -1 y ERROR_ROLE_CHANGE
 * 7)	Establecer valor de ID_ORGANIZATION.
 * 8)	Poner el valor del ítem IN_USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH, que servirá para determinar en USR_INF_FUN que es una segunda vez que se pasa. 
 * 9)	Llamar a ejecutar LOAD_LOGON_PARAMS y USR_INF_FUN.
 */


TRACE ("USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH: Start " + ToString(TodayNow()) + "----------------------------")


' 1) Comprobar que estamos en portal. Si no estamos devuelve 0, 2: Portal 8:Mobile 10: Pop2 Portal
' ------------------------------------------------------------
if ( USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE <> 2 and USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE <> 8 and USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE <> 10) then
    TRACE ( " No USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH for client type: " + ToString (USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE,0) )
    return 0
endif

' 2) Comprobar los argumentos. Si son vacíos devuelve -1
' ------------------------------------------------------------
If IsNull( AI_ID_APP_ROLE ) = M4_TRUE OR Length( AI_ID_APP_ROLE ) = 0 Then
    TRACE ( " USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH: Role is null or empty" )
    return -1 
EndIf

If IsNull( AI_ID_ORGANIZATION ) = M4_TRUE OR Length( AI_ID_ORGANIZATION ) = 0 Then
    TRACE ( " USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH: Organization is null or empty" )
    return -1 
EndIf


' 3) Comprobar los valores de rol y sociedad contra los actuales
' ------------------------------------------------------------
if ( AI_ID_APP_ROLE = ID_APP_ROLE and  AI_ID_ORGANIZATION = ID_ORGANIZATION ) Then
    TRACE ( " USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH: Values are the same" )
    return 0
endif


' 4) Comprobar el rol contra la sociedad
' ------------------------------------------------------------
ao_idRSM = ""

TRACE ( " USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH: Trying role " + AI_ID_APP_ROLE + " and organization " + AI_ID_ORGANIZATION)

iRet = CHECK_ORG_ROLE(AI_ID_APP_ROLE,AI_ID_ORGANIZATION, "1", ao_idRSM)
If iRet <> 0 then
    TRACE_SETLOG(" USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH: Role " + AI_ID_APP_ROLE + " does not match organization " + AI_ID_ORGANIZATION, "ERROR_ROLE_FOR_ORGANIZATION", "error")
    return -1
Endif 

' 5) Comprobar que el rol al que se cambia es del portal.
' ------------------------------------------------------------
iPosRol = APP_ROLE_SESSION.FindRegister("ID_APP_ROLE",AI_ID_APP_ROLE,M4_TRUE,"IS_ENABLED",1,M4_EQUAL)
if iPosRol = M4_ERROR then
    TRACE_SETLOG(" USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH: Role " + AI_ID_APP_ROLE + " is not enabled. ", "ERROR_ROLE_NOT_ENABLED", "error")
    return -1
Endif 


' 6) Establecer el rol mediante el método _CHECK_APP_ROLE
' ------------------------------------------------------------
iRet = _CHECK_APP_ROLE(AI_ID_APP_ROLE, 0, 1)
If iRet <> 0 then
    TRACE_SETLOG(" USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH: Role " + AI_ID_APP_ROLE + " cannot be set", "ERROR_ROLE_CHANGE", "error")
    return -1
Endif 

' 7) Establecer la sociedad
' ------------------------------------------------------------
ID_ORGANIZATION = AI_ID_ORGANIZATION

' 8) Establecer valor de item IN_USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH
' ------------------------------------------------------------
USR_IN_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH = 1

' 9) Hacer lo mismo que el USR_INF_REFRESH, pero los parámetros del SAV_PARAMS 
' hay que recargarlos con una instancia dinámica para que considere el cambio de rol
' ------------------------------------------------------------
CloseChannel("SAV_PARAMS")
CloseChannel("SAV_PARAMS_DYN")

LOAD_LOGON_PARAMS_DYN()
USR_INF_FUN()

CloseChannel("SAV_PARAMS_DYN")
CloseChannel("SAV_PARAMS")


' 10) Restablecer valor de item IN_USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH
' ------------------------------------------------------------
USR_IN_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH = 0


' 11) Traza con MSG/CODE/LEVEL para propósito de test
' ------------------------------------------------------------
TRACE_SETLOG("-role-" + ID_APP_ROLE + "-organization-" + ID_ORGANIZATION, "USR_ROLE_ORG_SWITCH_STATUS", "info")
return 1

DestroyBlock()
CI_TOTAL_SIZE = 0

If CC_TRACE_ENABLED = M4_TRUE Then
    sTraceFile = CC_TRACE_FILE
    sSep = Chr(M4_TAB)

    ConcatFile(sTraceFile, toString(todayNowGMT()) + sSep + "clean", 1)
EndIf

iSize = 0
If IsNull(CK_APPLICATION) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + Length(CK_APPLICATION)
If IsNull(CK_SECTION) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + Length(CK_SECTION)
If IsNull(CK_KEY) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + Length(CK_KEY)
If IsNull(CK_USER) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + Length(CK_USER)
If IsNull(CK_ROLE) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + Length(CK_ROLE)
If IsNull(CK_ORGANIZATION) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + Length(CK_ORGANIZATION)
If IsNull(CK_LANGUAGE) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + 4 // CK_LANGUAGE
If IsNull(CV_CONCEPT) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + Length(CV_CONCEPT)
If IsNull(CV_CONCEPT_VAL) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + Length(CV_CONCEPT_VAL)
If IsNull(CV_INTERNAL) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + 4 // CV_INTERNAL
If IsNull(CV_LAST_UPDATE) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + 8 // CV_LAST_UPDATE
If IsNull(CV_TYPE) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + 4 // CV_TYPE
If IsNull(CV_T3) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + Length(CV_T3)
If IsNull(CV_VALUE) = M4_FALSE Then iSize = iSize + Length(CV_VALUE)
iSize = iSize + 4 + 4   // CI_SIZE + CI_STORE

Return iSize

If AI_CHANGE = "UPDATED" Then

    CI_TOTAL_SIZE = CI_TOTAL_SIZE - CI_SIZE
    CI_SIZE = GET_ENTRY_SIZE()
    CI_TOTAL_SIZE = CI_TOTAL_SIZE + CI_SIZE
    
ElseIf AI_CHANGE = "NEW" Then
    
    CI_SIZE = GET_ENTRY_SIZE()
    CI_TOTAL_SIZE = CI_TOTAL_SIZE + CI_SIZE
    
EndIf


Return M4_SUCCESS

if AI_ID_T3 = "M4_T3_ORG_INFO" then
    'M4_T3_ORG_INFO tiene permisos siempre
    return M4_SUCCESS
endif

if ROOT_SESSION.IS_MULTIORGANIZATION = "1" and ROOT_SESSION.IS_OUTSOURCING = "1" then

    position = FindRegister( "ID_T3", AI_ID_T3, M4_EQUAL, "ID_ORGANIZATION", AI_ID_ORGANIZATION, M4_EQUAL )
    
    if position <> -1 then
        'Hay un resultado anterior
        MoveTo( position )
        return RESULT
    endif
    
    'Se busca el resultado en la caché
    info = M4_T3_ORG_INFO!M4_T3_ORG_INFO.CHECK_T3_ORG( AI_ID_T3, AI_ID_ORGANIZATION )
    
    if info = M4_SUCCESS OR info = M4_ERROR then
        'Ya se ha determinado si se puede o no ejecutar
        AddRegister()
        ID_T3 = AI_ID_T3
        ID_ORGANIZATION = AI_ID_ORGANIZATION
        RESULT = info
        return RESULT
    endif
    
    'Se carga el resultado
    before = Count()
    ID_T3_FILTER = AI_ID_T3
    ID_ORGANIZATION_FILTER = AI_ID_ORGANIZATION
    LOAD_BLK()
    after = Count()
    
    if after > before then
        'Se ha encontrado el resultado
        End()
        return RESULT
    endif
    
    'No se ha encontrado el resultado
    AddRegister()
    ID_T3 = AI_ID_T3
    ID_ORGANIZATION = AI_ID_ORGANIZATION
    RESULT = M4_ERROR
    return RESULT
endif

'Si no se es multiorganización o no se es outsourcing no se comprueba nada
return M4_SUCCESS

// ============================================================================
//
// Checks whether a role is valid or not

// Arguments
//      AI_ROLE (input string): Role to check
//      AI_TYPE (input string): Role type
//
// Returns true if role is valid, false otherwise
//      
// ============================================================================


if ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE <> 0 AND ROOT_SESSION.USR_AUDIT_CLIENT_TYPE <> 1 then
    // Si no es de tipo windows no se hace chequeo
    return M4_TRUE
endif


if IsNull( ROLES ) = M4_TRUE then

    // La primera vez se cargan lso roles del ESS/MSS
    DestroyBlock()
    ROLES = ""

    bAllow = M4_FALSE
    
' ---Enh 0326291. 06/07/2018. Cambio de la sociedad por defecto de parámetros de aplicación a la tabla de usuarios
'    if IsNull( SAV_PARAMS!GetProperty( "ID_ORGANIZATION" ) ) = M4_TRUE then
'        SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE( "LOGON", "SCH_SESSION", "ID_ORGANIZATION" )
'        
'        if SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.Count() > 0 then
'            SAV_PARAMS!SetProperty( "ID_ORGANIZATION", SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN[0].APP_VALUE )
'        endif
'    endif
     
    
     if IsNull( SAV_PARAMS!GetProperty( "ID_ORGANIZATION" ) ) = M4_TRUE then
        sUserDefOrg = ROOT_SESSION.GET_USER_DEFAULT_ORG()
        if length(sUserDefOrg) > 0 then
            SAV_PARAMS!SetProperty( "ID_ORGANIZATION", sUserDefOrg)
        endif
     endif

    
' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    
    SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE( "LOGON", "SCH_SESSION", "ALLOW_SSE_ROLES_IN_RICH_WEB" )
    
    if SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.Count() > 0 then
        if SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN[0].APP_VALUE = "1" then
            // Si el control está desactivado no se hace chequeo
            bAllow = M4_TRUE
        endif
    endif
    
    if bAllow = M4_FALSE then
	    SYS_SENTENCE = "SELECT @APP_VALUE = APP_VALUE FROM &SAV_APP_VAL_LG WHERE ID_APLICATION = 'SECURITY' AND ID_SECTION = 'USER_CREATION' AND ( ID_KEY = 'ID_APP_ROLE_LIST_SSE' OR ID_KEY = 'ID_APP_ROLE_LIST_SSM' ) AND APP_VALUE IS NOT NULL"
	    LOAD_BLK()
	    
	    totalRoles = ""
	    bIsNotEof = Begin()
	    while bIsNotEof = M4_TRUE
	        // Se van concatenando todos los roles metiéndolos entre corchetes
	        partialRoles = Replace( APP_VALUE, ",", "][" )
	        partialRoles = Replace( partialRoles, ";", "][" )
	        partialRoles = Replace( partialRoles, CHR( M4_CR ), "][" )
	        partialRoles = Replace( partialRoles, CHR( M4_NEW_LINE ), "" )
	        totalRoles = totalRoles + "[" + partialRoles + "]"
	        bIsNotEof = GoNext()
	    wend
	    
	    DestroyBlock()
	    ROLES = totalRoles
    endif
endif


if StrIn( ROLES, "[" + AI_ROLE + "]" ) <> -1 then
    // Si el role es del ESS/MSS no es válido
    return M4_FALSE
endif

return M4_TRUE

M4RCH_RULES3/ID_TI/SCO_AB_DP_ENTITLEMENT.SOURCE_CODE:
'Calculates the number of theoretical days an employee has available.
'Note: The entitlement types taken into account can be filtered by Incidence ID or Incidence Group ID.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_HR
' - ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE     -> defaulted to today's date
' - ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE   -> optional; if available, group ignored
' - ARG_SCO_ID_INC_GROUP   -> optional
'Returns number of days or -1 on error

nResult = -1

If IsNull(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE) = M4_TRUE Then
    dtAsAt = TodayGMT()
Else
    dtAsAt = ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
EndIf

'Validate arguments
If IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_HR) = M4_FALSE and IsNull(ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD) = M4_FALSE Then
    'Load employee details valid as at start date
    bResult = SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_LOAD_BY_HRP(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, dtAsAt)
    If bResult = M4_TRUE Then
        nResult = SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_GET_THEO_DAYS_BY_INCIDENCE(dtAsAt, ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE, ARG_SCO_ID_INC_GROUP)
    EndIf
Else
    'Arguments missing (internal call, no advanced error handling)
EndIf

Return(nResult)

'Inits all entitlements for given employee upon new hire.
'Note: The entitlements are prorated taking the start date into account.
'The schemes associated and the scheme year depends on the start date of the employee.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_HR
' - ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START
'Returns M4SUCCESS or M4_ERROR

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

'Validate arguments
If IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_HR) = M4_FALSE and IsNull(ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD) = M4_FALSE and IsNull(ARG_SCO_DT_START) = M4_FALSE Then
    'Load employee details
    bResult = SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_LOAD_BY_HRP(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, ARG_SCO_DT_START)
    'Init entitlements
    bStarterProration = M4_TRUE
    SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_INIT_ENTITLEMENTS_HRP(ARG_SCO_DT_START, bStarterProration)
Else
    'Arguments missing (internal call, no advanced error handling)
    bResult = M4_ERROR
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Initialises all entitlements for given employees.
'Updates all records from given year on (consecutive records depend on previous results).
'Note: Only one sentence applied (population or dynamic filter, population has priority)
'The cut-off date used is the first day of the year.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_YEAR
' - ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
' - ARG_SCO_ID_SCHEME               -> not implemented yet!
' - ARG_SCO_IND_POPULATION_TYPE     -> 1 if public
' - ARG_SCO_ID_POPULATION
' - ARG_SCO_DYNAMIC_FILTER_SQL
'Returns the number of employees processed, -1 on error

iResult = 0

'Convert year into as-at date
dtAsAt = NumbersToDate(ToInt(ARG_SCO_YEAR))
sEntitlementTypeId = NullValue()
If IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE) = M4_FALSE and Trim(ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE, M4_TRIM_ALL) <> "" Then sEntitlementTypeId = ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE

ARG_SCO_IND_POPULATION_TYPE = ToInt(ARG_SCO_IND_POPULATION_TYPE)

'Process filters
sSentence = NullValue()
sParams = NullValue()
If IsNull(ARG_SCO_IND_POPULATION_TYPE) = M4_FALSE and Trim(ARG_SCO_IND_POPULATION_TYPE, M4_TRIM_ALL) <> "" and IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_POPULATION) = M4_FALSE and Trim(ARG_SCO_ID_POPULATION, M4_TRIM_ALL) <> "" Then
    'Resolve population if required
    iBaseTable = 2  'HR period
    bResult = SRCO_MT_POPULATION!SRCO_API_POPULATION.SRCO_RESOLVE_POPULATION(ARG_SCO_ID_POPULATION, ARG_SCO_IND_POPULATION_TYPE, iBaseTable)
    If bResult = M4_SUCCESS Then
        sSentence = SRCO_MT_POPULATION!SRCO_API_POPULATION.SRCO_P_SENTENCE
        sParams = SRCO_MT_POPULATION!SRCO_API_POPULATION.SRCO_P_PARAM
    EndIf
ElseIf IsNull(ARG_SCO_DYNAMIC_FILTER_SQL) = M4_FALSE and Trim(ARG_SCO_DYNAMIC_FILTER_SQL, M4_TRIM_ALL) <> "" Then
    'Dynamic filter
    sSentence = ARG_SCO_DYNAMIC_FILTER_SQL
EndIf

'Validate arguments
If IsNull(dtAsAt) = M4_FALSE Then
    'Load employee details
    iResult = SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_LOAD_BY_SENTENCE(sSentence, sParams, dtAsAt, sEntitlementTypeId)
    iEmployeeCount = 0
    If iResult = M4_TRUE Then
        'Init entitlements
        bStarterProration = M4_TRUE
        Do
            iEmployeeCount = iEmployeeCount + 1
            SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_INIT_ENTITLEMENTS_HRP(dtAsAt, bStarterProration)
            SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.GONEXT()
        Until SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.IsEoF() = M4_TRUE
    EndIf
    iResult = iEmployeeCount
Else
    'Arguments missing (internal call, no advanced error handling)
    iResult = -1
EndIf


Return(iResult)

'Updates given entitlement for given employee
'Updates all records from start date on (consecutive records depend on previous results).
'Note: Only existing summary records taken into account!
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_HR
' - ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START            -> today's date if null
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END              -> plus inf
' - ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
'Returns M4SUCCESS or M4_ERROR

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

If IsNull(ARG_SCO_DT_START) = M4_TRUE Then
    dtStart = TodayGMT()
Else
    dtStart = ARG_SCO_DT_START
EndIf

dtEnd = M4_PLUS_INF

'Validate arguments
If IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_HR) = M4_FALSE and IsNull(ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD) = M4_FALSE and IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE) = M4_FALSE Then
    'Load employee details valid as at start date
    bResult = SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_LOAD_BY_HRP(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, dtStart)
    'Update entitlements
    SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_UPDATE_SUMMARY(ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE, dtStart, dtEnd)
    'Save changes
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.Persist_Tree()
Else
    'Arguments missing (internal call, no advanced error handling)
    bResult = M4_ERROR
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Updates all entitlements for given employee upon change.
'Updates all records from start date on (conecutive records depend on previous results).
'Note: Only existing entitlements are taken into account!
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_HR
' - ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START            -> today's date if null
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END              -> plus inf
'Returns M4SUCCESS or M4_ERROR

bResult = M4_SUCCESS
'Not implemented!!!
Return(M4_ERROR)

If IsNull(ARG_SCO_DT_START) = M4_TRUE Then
    dtStart = TodayGMT()
Else
    dtStart = ARG_SCO_DT_START
EndIf

dtEnd = M4_PLUS_INF

'Validate arguments
If IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_HR) = M4_FALSE and IsNull(ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD) = M4_FALSE Then
    'Load employee details valid as at start date
    bResult = SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_LOAD_BY_HRP(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, dtStart)
    'Identifies all entitlements of employee
    iEntitlements = 0



    'Loop through all entitlements and update each of them
    For i = 0 to 0 - 1
        sEntitlementTypeID = ""
        'Update entitlements
        SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_UPDATE_SUMMARY(sEntitlementTypeID, dtStart, dtEnd)
    Next
    'Save changes
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.Persist_Tree()
Else
    'Arguments missing (internal call, no advanced error handling)
    bResult = M4_ERROR
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Updates entitlement related to given incidence for given employee
'Note: Only existing summary records taken into account!
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_HR
' - ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD
' - ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START            -> today's date if null
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END              -> start date if null
'Returns M4SUCCESS or M4_ERROR

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

If IsNull(ARG_SCO_DT_START) = M4_TRUE Then
    dtStart = TodayGMT()
Else
    dtStart = ARG_SCO_DT_START
EndIf

'Validate arguments
If IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_HR) = M4_FALSE and IsNull(ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD) = M4_FALSE and IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE) = M4_FALSE Then
    'Identify entitlement type associated to incidence
    sEntitlementTypeId = SCO_AB_ENT_TYPE.SCO_GET_TYPE_BY_INCIDENCE(ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE)
    'Only continue if entitlement type valid (if null no entitlement affected by incidence
    If IsNull(sEntitlementTypeId) = M4_FALSE Then
        'Load employee details valid as at start date
        bResult = SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_LOAD_BY_HRP(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, dtStart)
        'Update entitlements
        SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_UPDATE_SUMMARY(sEntitlementTypeId, dtStart, ARG_SCO_DT_END)
        'Save changes
        SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.Persist_Tree()
    EndIf
Else
    'Arguments missing (internal call, no advanced error handling)
    bResult = M4_ERROR
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Validates incident against available entitlements
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_HR
' - ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD
' - ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END
'Returns M4SUCCESS or M4_ERROR

bResult = M4_ERROR

'Validate arguments
If IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_HR) = M4_FALSE and IsNull(ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD) = M4_FALSE and IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE) = M4_FALSE and IsNull(ARG_SCO_DT_START) = M4_FALSE and IsNull(ARG_SCO_DT_END) = M4_FALSE Then
    'Load employee details
    bResultLoad = SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_LOAD_BY_HRP(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, ARG_SCO_DT_START)
    If bResultLoad = M4_TRUE Then
        'Validate incident
        bResult = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_VALIDATE_INCIDENCE(ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE, ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END)
    EndIf
Else
    'Arguments missing (internal call, no advanced error handling)
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Adds register with given details.
'Note: If there is already a register for the given operaiton type and dates, units will be added.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END
' - ARG_SCO_ID_OPERATION_TYPE
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_UNITS
'Returns  position of added register

iPos = FindRegister("SCO_ID_OPERATION_TYPE", ARG_SCO_ID_OPERATION_TYPE, M4_EQUAL, "SCO_DT_START", ARG_SCO_DT_START, M4_EQUAL, "SCO_DT_END", ARG_SCO_DT_END, M4_EQUAL, 0)
If iPos <> -1 Then
    MoveTo(iPos)
    SCO_NUM_UNITS = SCO_NUM_UNITS + ARG_SCO_NUM_UNITS
Else
    AddRegister()
    SCO_DT_START = ARG_SCO_DT_START
    SCO_DT_END = ARG_SCO_DT_END
    SCO_ID_OPERATION_TYPE = ARG_SCO_ID_OPERATION_TYPE
    SCO_NUM_UNITS = ARG_SCO_NUM_UNITS
EndIf

Return(GetCurrent())

'Loads records by given operation type
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_OPERATION_TYPE
'Returns sum of all records loaded.

nResult = 0

DestroyBlock()

sSentence = "FROM &SCO_AB_H_HRP_ENT_DETAILS A WHERE A.SCO_ID_OPERATION_TYPE = ?(2,5,0)"

SCO_SYS_SENTENCE = sSentence
SCO_SYS_PARAM = ARG_SCO_ID_OPERATION_TYPE

Load_BLK()

If Begin() = M4_TRUE Then
    nResult = SCO_NUM_UNITS..SysTotalItems(M4_TOTAL_SUM)
EndIf

Return(nResult)

M4RCH_RULES3/ID_TI/SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMAR.SOURCE_CODE:
'Identify available entitlement of given period
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END
'Returns available entitlement

nResult = 0

'Take entitlement of previous period into account unless Cfwd/ expiry data falls within given period
If Not (SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1 >= ARG_SCO_DT_START and SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1 < ARG_SCO_DT_END) Then
    nResult = SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1
EndIf

'Add entitlement
nResult = nResult + SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT
'Add manual adjustment
nResult = nResult + SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT
'Remove used
nResult = nResult - SCO_NUM_USED

Return(nResult)

'Identifies incidences related to current summary (type and date)

nResult = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_INCIDENCES.SCO_GET_UNITS_BY_TIME_UNIT(SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT_DAY)

Return(nResult)

'Identifies manually added details related to given summary record (by type and dates)

nResult = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_GET_UNITS_BY_OP_TYPE(SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_MANUAL)

Return(nResult)

'Identify duration of given period in days
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END
' - ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE
' - ARG_SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT

'Returns number of days

iResult = SCO_DP_HR_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_DP_HR_THEORETICAL_TIME_API.SCO_GET_DURATION(SCO_ID_HR, SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, NullValue(), ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE, ARG_SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT, ARG_SCO_DT_START, NullValue(), ARG_SCO_DT_END, NullValue())

Return(iResult)

'Loads records filtered by given date
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
'Returns the position of the register loaded or -1 if non loaded

'Look for record in current block
iPos = FindRegister("SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE", ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE, M4_EQUAL, "SCO_DT_START", ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL, "SCO_DT_END", ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL, 0)
If iPos <> -1 Then
    MoveTo(iPos)
    iResult = iPos
Else
    sSentence = "FROM &SCO_AB_H_HRP_ENT_SUMMARY A"
    sSentence = sSentence + " WHERE A.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE = ?(2,5,0) AND A.SCO_DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0)"

    SCO_SYS_SENTENCE = sSentence
    SCO_SYS_PARAM = ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE + "|" + ToString(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT) + "|" + ToString(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)

    iCountBefore = Count()
    Load_BLK()
    iCountAfter = Count()
    If iCountAfter > iCountBefore Then
        iResult = iCountAfter - 1
        End()
    Else
        iResult = -1
    EndIf
EndIf

Return(iResult)

'Loads records filtered by given incident that end on or after incident start date (to update Cfwd/ if required).
'Note: cleans block first!
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END
'Returns number of registers loaded

DestroyBlock()

sFrom = "FROM &SCO_AB_H_HRP_ENT_SUMMARY A, SCO_X_AB_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE B"
sJoin = " WHERE A.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE = B.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE"
sWhere = " AND B.SCO_ID_INCIDENCE = ?(2,9,0) AND A.SCO_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0)"
sOrderBy = " ORDER BY A.SCO_DT_START"

SCO_SYS_SENTENCE = sFrom + sJoin + sWhere + sOrderBy
SCO_SYS_PARAM = ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE + "|" + ToString(ARG_SCO_DT_START, M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)

Load_BLK()
Begin()
iResult = Count()

Return(iResult)

'Updates value CARRIED FORWARD of entitlement summary and adds details with given information.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

If SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD <> ARG_SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD Then
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_CFWD, ARG_SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD - SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD)
    SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD = ARG_SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Updates value ENTITLEMENT of entitlement summary and adds details with given information.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

If SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT <> ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT Then
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_ENT, ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT - SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT)
    SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT = ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT
    'Update entitlement that expires at the end of the scheme year
    SCO_UPDATE_ENTITLEMENT_EXPIRY(ARG_SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD)
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Updates value ENTITLEMENT N-1 of entitlement summary and adds details with given information.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1
' - ARG_SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENT_N1

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

If SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 <> ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 Then
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_ENT_N1, ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 - SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1)
    SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 = ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1
    'Unused entitlement N-1 expires (no negative values)
    SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENT_N1 = Max(SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 - SCO_NUM_USED, 0)
    'Update Cfwd/ expiry date
    If IsNull(SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1) = M4_FALSE and SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 <> 0 Then
        SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1 = ARG_SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENT_N1
    Else
        SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1 = NullValue()
    EndIf
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Updates value SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENTITLEMENT and SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT of entitlement summary.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

'Update expiry date of entitlement n-1
If SCO_NUM_USED < SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 Then
    'Unused entitlement N-1 expires (no negative values)
    SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENT_N1 = Max(SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 - SCO_NUM_USED, 0)
    SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1 = SCO_DT_END
Else
    SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENT_N1 = 0
    SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1 = NullValue()
EndIf

'Identify used of current period (no negative values)
'Note: Used against entitlement of previous period not taken into account.
nUsedCurrentPeriod = Max(SCO_NUM_USED - SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1, 0)

'Update entitlement that expires at the end of the scheme year
If SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT + SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT - nUsedCurrentPeriod > ARG_SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD Then
    SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENTITLEMENT = (SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT + SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT - nUsedCurrentPeriod) - ARG_SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD
    SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT = SCO_DT_END
Else
    SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENTITLEMENT = 0
    SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT = NullValue()
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Updates value LOST of entitlement summary and adds details with given information.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_LOST

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

If SCO_NUM_LOST <> ARG_SCO_NUM_LOST Then
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_LOST, ARG_SCO_NUM_LOST - SCO_NUM_LOST)
    SCO_NUM_LOST = ARG_SCO_NUM_LOST
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Updates value MANUAL ADJUSTMENT of entitlement summary and adds details with given information.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

If SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT <> ARG_SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT Then
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_MANUAL_ADJ, ARG_SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT - SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT)
    SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT = ARG_SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT
    'Update entitlement that expires at the end of the scheme year
    SCO_UPDATE_ENTITLEMENT_EXPIRY(ARG_SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD)
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Updates entitlement summary and details with given information.
'Note: The total remaining is calculated automatically.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END
' - ARG_SCO_ID_SCHEME
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENT
' - ARG_SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1
' - ARG_SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENT_N1
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_USED
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_LOST
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD
'Returns M4_ERROR or M4_SUCCESS

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

'Locate summary record valid as at start date
iPos = FindRegister("SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE", ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE, M4_EQUAL, "SCO_DT_START", ARG_SCO_DT_START, M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL, "SCO_DT_END", ARG_SCO_DT_START, M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL, 0)
If iPos = -1 Then
    iPos = SCO_LOAD_BY_DATE(ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE, ARG_SCO_DT_START)
EndIf

If iPos = -1 Then
    'Add new register
    AddRegister()
    'Update values and add detail record for each
    SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE = ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
    SCO_DT_START = ARG_SCO_DT_START
Else
    'Update existing register where required and add detail record if value updated (null values will not be changed)
    MoveTo(iPos)
    'Validate end date (must fall within existing period)
    'If SCO_DT_END >= ARG_SCO_DT_END Then    
        'Not implemented because scheme year is fix, becomes an issue with variable scheme years!!!
    'EndIf
EndIf

SCO_DT_END = ARG_SCO_DT_END
SCO_ID_SCHEME = ARG_SCO_ID_SCHEME
If SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT <> ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT and IsNull(ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT) = M4_FALSE Then
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_ENT, ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT - SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT)
    SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT = ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT
EndIf
If SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENTITLEMENT <> ARG_SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENT and IsNull(ARG_SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENT) = M4_FALSE Then
    SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENTITLEMENT = ARG_SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENT
EndIf
If IsNull(SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENTITLEMENT) = M4_FALSE and SCO_NUM_EXPIRATION_ENTITLEMENT <> 0 Then
    SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT = ARG_SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT
Else
    'Delete entitlement expiry date if no entitlement to expire
    SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT = NullValue()
EndIf

If SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 <> ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 and IsNull(ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1) = M4_FALSE Then
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_ENT_N1, ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 - SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1)
    SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 = ARG_SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1
EndIf
If IsNull(SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1) = M4_FALSE and SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 <> 0 Then
    SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1 = ARG_SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENT_N1
Else
    'Delete entitlement expiry date if no entitlement to expire
    SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1 = NullValue()
EndIf

If SCO_NUM_USED <> ARG_SCO_NUM_USED and IsNull(ARG_SCO_NUM_USED) = M4_FALSE Then
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_USED, ARG_SCO_NUM_USED - SCO_NUM_USED)
    SCO_NUM_USED = ARG_SCO_NUM_USED
EndIf
If SCO_NUM_LOST <> ARG_SCO_NUM_LOST and IsNull(ARG_SCO_NUM_LOST) = M4_FALSE Then
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_LOST, ARG_SCO_NUM_LOST - SCO_NUM_LOST)
    SCO_NUM_LOST = ARG_SCO_NUM_LOST
EndIf
If SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD <> ARG_SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD and IsNull(ARG_SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD) = M4_FALSE Then
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_CFWD, ARG_SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD - SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD)
    SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD = ARG_SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD
EndIf
If SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT <> ARG_SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT and IsNull(ARG_SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT) = M4_FALSE Then
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_MANUAL_ADJ, ARG_SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT - SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT)
    SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT = ARG_SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT
EndIf

'Calculate and update total remaining
nTotalRemaining = SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT + SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 + SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT - (SCO_NUM_USED + SCO_NUM_LOST + SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD)
If SCO_TOT_REMAINING <> nTotalRemaining and IsNull(nTotalRemaining) = M4_FALSE Then
    SCO_TOT_REMAINING = nTotalRemaining
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_TOT_REM, nTotalRemaining)
EndIf

'Make maximum Cfwd/ available for further processing
SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD = ARG_SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD

Return(bResult)

'Updates TOTAL REMAINING of entitlement summary and adds details with given information.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

nEntitlement = 0
nEntitlementN1 = 0
nManualAdjustment = 0
nUsed = 0
nLost = 0
nCarriedForward = 0

If IsNull(SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT) = M4_FALSE Then nEntitlement = SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT
If IsNull(SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1) = M4_FALSE Then nEntitlementN1 = SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1
If IsNull(SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT) = M4_FALSE Then nManualAdjustment = SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT
If IsNull(SCO_NUM_USED) = M4_FALSE Then nUsed = SCO_NUM_USED
If IsNull(SCO_NUM_LOST) = M4_FALSE Then nLost = SCO_NUM_LOST
If IsNull(SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD) = M4_FALSE Then nCarriedForward = SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD


nTotalRemaining = nEntitlement + nEntitlementN1 + nManualAdjustment - (nUsed + nLost + nCarriedForward)
If SCO_TOT_REMAINING <> nTotalRemaining and IsNull(nTotalRemaining) = M4_FALSE Then
    SCO_TOT_REMAINING = nTotalRemaining
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_TOT_REM, nTotalRemaining)
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Updates value USED of entitlement summary and adds details with given information.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_USED
' - ARG_SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

If SCO_NUM_USED <> ARG_SCO_NUM_USED Then
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_DETAILS.SCO_ADD_REGISTER(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, SCO_ID_OP_TYPE_AUTO_USED, ARG_SCO_NUM_USED - SCO_NUM_USED)
    SCO_NUM_USED = ARG_SCO_NUM_USED
    'Update entitlement that expires at the end of the scheme year
    SCO_UPDATE_ENTITLEMENT_EXPIRY(ARG_SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD)
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Validates incident against available entitlements
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END
'Returns M4SUCCESS or M4_ERROR
bResult = M4_ERROR

DestroyBlock()

'Load entitlement summaries (more than one record if incident spans more than one scheme year)
iSummaryRecords = SCO_LOAD_BY_INCIDENCE(ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE, ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END)
'Loop through all records
iNumRecords = iSummaryRecords - 1
For i = 0 to iNumRecords
    MoveTo(i)
    bIntermediateResult = M4_SUCCESS

    'Miramos si las bolsas cargadas abarcan las fechas completas del periodo solicitado
    iPosIni = FindRegister("SCO_DT_START",ARG_SCO_DT_START,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL)
    iPosFin = FindRegister("SCO_DT_END",ARG_SCO_DT_END,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
    If iPosIni = -1 or iPosFin = -1 then
        bIntermediateResult = M4_ERROR
    EndIf

    'Incident must be completely coverred by summary records
    If i = 0 Then
        'Make sure first record starts on or before incident
        If SCO_DT_START > ARG_SCO_DT_START Then
            bIntermediateResult = M4_ERROR
        EndIf
    ElseIf i = iNumRecords Then
        'Make sure last record ends on or after incident
        If SCO_DT_END < ARG_SCO_DT_END Then
            bIntermediateResult = M4_ERROR
        EndIf
    EndIf
    If iNumRecords > 0 and i > 0 Then
        'Mare sure there are no gaps between summary records
        If SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY[i-1].SCO_DT_END <> SCO_DT_START - 1 Then
            bIntermediateResult = M4_ERROR
        EndIf
    EndIf
    If bIntermediateResult = M4_ERROR Then
        'Stop loop on error
        i = iNumRecords
    Else
        'Controll entitlement
        'Identify start and end of current slice
        dtStartSlice = Max(ARG_SCO_DT_START, SCO_DT_START)
        dtEndSlice = Min(ARG_SCO_DT_END, SCO_DT_END)
        'Take Cfwd/ expiry date into account
        If SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1 >= dtStartSlice and SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1 < dtEndSlice Then
            'Cfwd/ expiry date causes another slice
            'Identify duration of slice inculding Cfwd/ expiry date
            iDuration1 = SCO_GET_DURATION(dtStartSlice, SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1, ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE, "04")
            'Identify available entitlement
            nAvailable1 = SCO_GET_AVAILABLE(dtStartSlice, SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1)
            'Compare to available entitlement
            If iDuration1 > nAvailable1 Then
                bIntermediateResult = M4_ERROR
            Else
                'Identify duration of slice beginning after Cfwd/ expiry date
                iDuration2 = SCO_GET_DURATION(SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1 + 1, dtEndSlice, ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE, "04")
                'Identify available entitlement
                nAvailable2 = SCO_GET_AVAILABLE(SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1 + 1, dtEndSlice)
                'Difference between available1 and available2 is expired entitlement
                nExpired = nAvailable1 - nAvailable2
                'Difference of expired and duration1 reduces available2 (only if duration1 greater than expired)
                If iDuration1 > nExpired Then
                    nAvailable2 = nAvailable2 - (iDuration1 - nExpired)
                EndIf
                'Compare to available entitlement
                If iDuration2 > nAvailable2 Then
                    bIntermediateResult = M4_ERROR
                Else
                    iDuration = iDuration1 + iDuration2
                EndIf
            EndIf
        Else
            'Identify duration of slice
            iDuration = SCO_GET_DURATION(dtStartSlice, dtEndSlice, ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE, "04")
            'Identify available entitlement
            nAvailable = SCO_GET_AVAILABLE(dtStartSlice, dtEndSlice)
            'Compare to available entitlement
            If iDuration > nAvailable Then
                bIntermediateResult = M4_ERROR
            EndIf
        EndIf
    EndIf
    'Continue on success
    If bIntermediateResult = M4_SUCCESS Then
        'Update following scheme year summary records if used entitlement affects Cfwd/
        nCfwdReduction = iDuration - SCO_NUM_LOST
        If SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD < nCfwdReduction Then
            'Not carried forward because of dates or max cfwd/ of scheme
            nCfwdReduction = 0
        Else
            iCurrentRegister = i
            While nCfwdReduction > 0 and SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD > 0 and iCurrentRegister < iNumRecords and bIntermediateResult = M4_SUCCESS
                'Position on next register
                iCurrentRegister = iCurrentRegister + 1
                MoveTo(iCurrentRegister)
                'Make sure this register follows previous register directly
                If SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY[iCurrentRegister-1].SCO_DT_END <> SCO_DT_START - 1 Then
                    bIntermediateResult = M4_ERROR
                Else
                    'Check if Cfwd/ entitlement used is still available
                    nAvailableAfterDeduction = SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT + SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT + SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 - nCfwdReduction
                    If SCO_NUM_USED > nAvailableAfterDeduction Then
                        bIntermediateResult = M4_ERROR
                    Else
                        'The following should be changed to implement Cfwd/ expiry date!!!

                        'Update values that are used for validation!

                        'Update Cfwd/ entitlement
                        SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 = SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 - nCfwdReduction
                        If SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 = 0 Then
                            SCO_DT_EXPIRY_ENTITLEMENT_N1 = NullValue()
                        ElseIf SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1 < 0 Then
                            'Reduction causes negative remaining
                            bIntermediateResult = M4_ERROR
                        Else
                            'If reduction affects used Cfwd/ entitlement
                            If nCfwdReduction > SCO_NUM_LOST Then
                                nCfwdReduction = nCfwdReduction - SCO_NUM_LOST
                                SCO_NUM_LOST = 0
                                SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD = SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD - nCfwdReduction 
                                If SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD < 0 Then
                                    'Set to 0 and stop loop (not carried forward because of dates or max cfwd/ of scheme)
                                    SCO_NUM_CARRIED_FORWARD = 0
                                    nCfwdReduction = 0
                                EndIf
                            Else
                                'Reduce reduction from LOST
                                SCO_NUM_LOST = SCO_NUM_LOST - nCfwdReduction
                                'Reduction does not affect used entitlement
                                nCfwdReduction = 0
                            EndIf
                        EndIf
                    EndIf
                EndIf
            WEnd
        EndIf
    EndIf
    'Stop loop on error or if incident fully processed
    If bIntermediateResult = M4_ERROR or ARG_SCO_DT_END <= SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY[i].SCO_DT_END Then
        i = iNumRecords
    EndIf
    'Update result with intermediate result
    bResult = bIntermediateResult
Next

Return(bResult)

    dtStart = Max(SCO_DT_START, SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_DT_START)
