'Calculates the number of theoretical days an employee has available.
'Note: The entitlement types taken into account can be filtred by Incidence ID or Incidence Group ID.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
' - ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE
' - ARG_SCO_ID_INC_GROUP
'Returns number of days

nResult = 0

dtFilter = ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
iFilter = -1
If IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE) = M4_FALSE and Trim(ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE, M4_TRIM_ALL) <> "" Then
    'Filter by incidence id
    iFilter = 1
ElseIf IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_INC_GROUP) = M4_FALSE and Trim(ARG_SCO_ID_INC_GROUP, M4_TRIM_ALL) <> "" Then
    'Filter by incidence group id
    iFilter = 2
Else
    'No filter
    iFilter = 0
EndIf

'Loop through all schemes at Reference Model level
iRecords = SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_REF_MOD.SCO_LOAD_BY_DATE(dtFilter)
For i = 0 to iRecords -1
    bTakeIntoAccount = M4_FALSE
    If iFilter > 0 Then
        iPos = SCO_AB_ENT_TYPE.SCO_GET_TYPE_DETAILS(SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_REF_MOD[i].SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE)
        If iPos <> -1 Then
            If iFilter = 1 Then
                'Compare incidence
                If SCO_AB_ENT_TYPE[iPos].SCO_ID_INCIDENCE = ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE Then
                    bTakeIntoAccount = M4_TRUE
                EndIf
            Else
                'Compare incidence group
                If SCO_AB_ENT_TYPE[iPos].SCO_ID_INC_GROUP = ARG_SCO_ID_INC_GROUP Then
                    bTakeIntoAccount = M4_TRUE
                EndIf
            EndIf
        EndIf
    Else
        bTakeIntoAccount = M4_TRUE
    EndIf
    'Add days of current scheme if entitlement type meets filter
    If bTakeIntoAccount = M4_TRUE Then
        iPosScheme = SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME.SCO_LOAD(SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_REF_MOD[i].SCO_ID_SCHEME, dtFilter)
        If iPosScheme <> -1 Then
            'Identify entitlement
            nResult = nResult + SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME[iPosScheme].SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT
        EndIf
    EndIf
Next

'Loop through all schemes at HR Period level
iRecords = SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_HR_PERIOD.SCO_LOAD_BY_DATE(dtFilter)
For i = 0 to iRecords -1
    bTakeIntoAccount = M4_FALSE
    If iFilter > 0 Then
        iPos = SCO_AB_ENT_TYPE.SCO_GET_TYPE_DETAILS(SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_HR_PERIOD[i].SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE)
        If iPos <> -1 Then
            If iFilter = 1 Then
                'Compare incidence
                If SCO_AB_ENT_TYPE[iPos].SCO_ID_INCIDENCE = ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE Then
                    bTakeIntoAccount = M4_TRUE
                EndIf
            Else
                'Compare incidence group
                If SCO_AB_ENT_TYPE[iPos].SCO_ID_INC_GROUP = ARG_SCO_ID_INC_GROUP Then
                    bTakeIntoAccount = M4_TRUE
                EndIf
            EndIf
        EndIf
    Else
        bTakeIntoAccount = M4_TRUE
    EndIf
    'Add days of current scheme if entitlement type meets filter
    If bTakeIntoAccount = M4_TRUE Then
        iPosScheme = SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME.SCO_LOAD(SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_HR_PERIOD[i].SCO_ID_SCHEME, dtFilter)
        If iPosScheme <> -1 Then
            'Identify entitlement
            nResult = nResult + SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME[iPosScheme].SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT
        EndIf
    EndIf
Next

Return(nResult)

'Inits entitlements of current HR Period for scheme year identified by given date
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
' - ARG_SCO_IND_STARTER_PRORATION

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

dtFilter = Max(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, STD_DT_START)

'Loop through all schemes at Reference Model level
iRecords = SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_REF_MOD.SCO_LOAD_BY_DATE(dtFilter)
For i = 0 to iRecords -1
    'Invoke method with following details: Entitlement Type ID and Scheme ID
    bResult = SCO_INIT_SCHEME(SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_REF_MOD[i].SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE, SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_REF_MOD[i].SCO_ID_SCHEME, ARG_SCO_IND_STARTER_PRORATION)
Next

'Loop through all schemes at HR Period level
iRecords = SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_HR_PERIOD.SCO_LOAD_BY_DATE(dtFilter)
For i = 0 to iRecords -1
    'Invoke method with following details: Entitlement Type ID and Scheme ID
    bResult = SCO_INIT_SCHEME(SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_HR_PERIOD[i].SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE, SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_HR_PERIOD[i].SCO_ID_SCHEME, ARG_SCO_IND_STARTER_PRORATION)
Next

'Prepare delete of summary records that are obsolete (all that are not assigned to employee)
SCO_PREPARE_DELETE(dtFilter)

'Save data
BeginTransaction()
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_DELETE_OBSOLETE(0, 1)
    SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.Persist_Tree()
EndTransaction(M4_COMMIT)

Return(bResult)

'Calculates entitlement for given scheme
'Note: Only calculates entitlement according to scheme, all other fields are updated by the method Update Summary!
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
' - ARG_SCO_ID_SCHEME
' - ARG_SCO_IND_STARTER_PRORATION
'Returns M4_ERROR or M4_SUCCESS

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

dtFilter = Max(SCO_AS_AT_DATE, STD_DT_START)

'Identify scheme
iPosScheme = SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME.SCO_LOAD(ARG_SCO_ID_SCHEME, dtFilter)
If iPosScheme <> -1 Then
    'Init variables
    nEntitlementPrevious = NullValue()
    nExpiryEntitlement = NullValue()
    dtExpiryEntitlement = NullValue()
    nCarryForward = NullValue()
    dtExpiryCarryForward = NullValue()
    nUsed = NullValue()
    nLost = NullValue()
    nManualAdjustment = NullValue()
    nLostPrevious = NullValue()
    dtSchemeYearStart = Today()
    dtSchemeYearEnd = Today()

    'Identify scheme year
    SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME[iPosScheme].SCO_GET_SCHEME_YEAR(dtFilter, dtSchemeYearStart, dtSchemeYearEnd)
    'Identify entitlement
    nEntitlement = SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME[iPosScheme].SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT
    'Prorate entitlement if required
    If ARG_SCO_IND_STARTER_PRORATION = M4_TRUE Then
        'Compare start date of HR Period to scheme year begin
        If STD_DT_START > dtSchemeYearStart Then
            iMonthsInSchemeYear = DateDiff(STD_DT_START, dtSchemeYearEnd, M4_MONTH)
            nEntitlement = nEntitlement * (iMonthsInSchemeYear / 12)
            nEntitlement = SCO_ROUND(nEntitlement)
        EndIf
    EndIf
    'Adapt scheme year start date to start date of employee
    If STD_DT_START > dtSchemeYearStart Then
        dtSchemeYearStart = STD_DT_START
    EndIf

    'Identify maximum Cfwd/
    nMaxCfwd = SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME[iPosScheme].SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD
    'Identify entitlement that expires at the end of the scheme year
    'Note: manual adjustment and used not taken into account because they are Null
    If nEntitlement > nMaxCfwd Then
        nExpiryEntitlement = nEntitlement - nMaxCfwd
        dtExpiryEntitlement = dtSchemeYearEnd
    EndIf

    'Update initial entitlement values of current scheme year's summary
    bResult = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_UPDATE_SUMMARY(ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE, dtSchemeYearStart, dtSchemeYearEnd, ARG_SCO_ID_SCHEME, nEntitlement, nExpiryEntitlement, dtExpiryEntitlement, nEntitlementPrevious, dtExpiryCarryForward, nUsed, nLost, nCarryForward, nManualAdjustment, nMaxCfwd)

    'Update summary with Cfwd/, manually details, days taken
    bResult = SCO_UPDATE_SUMMARY(ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE, dtFilter, M4_PLUS_INF)
Else
    'Scheme does not exist
    bResult = M4_ERROR
EndIf

Return(bResult)

'Loads node by given HR Period
'Argumments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_HR
' - ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
'Returns result of Begin()

'Clean node
DestroyBlock()

'Define filter
SCO_AS_AT_DATE = ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
SCO_SYS_SENTENCE = "FROM &STD_HR_PERIOD A WHERE A.STD_ID_HR = ?(2,9,0) AND A.STD_OR_HR_PERIOD = ?(6,2,0)"
SCO_SYS_PARAM = ARG_SCO_ID_HR + "|" + ToString(ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, 0)

'Partial load: Begin() triggers load according to load mode of node!
Return(Begin())

'Loads node filtered by given sentence.
'Note: Additional filter by Entitlement Type ID possible.
'Argumments:
' - ARG_SCO_SENTENCE
' - ARG_SCO_PARAM
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE              -> used as scheme year start date
' - ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
'Returns result of Begin()

'Clean node
DestroyBlock()

'Define filter
SCO_AS_AT_DATE = ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
SCO_SYS_SENTENCE = ARG_SCO_SENTENCE
SCO_SYS_PARAM = ARG_SCO_PARAM
sSchemeYearStart = ToString(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)
sSchemeYearEnd = ToString(AddYears(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, 1) - 1, M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)

If IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE) = M4_FALSE and ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE <> "" Then
    'Add entitlement type filter if required
    'Filter HR Periods valid within scheme year
    SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE = ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
    sFrom = "FROM &STD_HR_PERIOD A, SCO_HR_THEOR_TIME C, SCO_AB_H_REF_MOD_SCHEME D, SCO_AB_H_HRP_SCHEME B"
    sJoin = " WHERE B.SCO_ID_HR(+) = A.STD_ID_HR AND B.SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD(+) = A.STD_OR_HR_PERIOD AND C.STD_ID_HR(+) = A.STD_ID_HR AND C.STD_OR_HR_PERIOD(+) = A.STD_OR_HR_PERIOD AND C.SCO_ID_REF_MOD = D.SCO_ID_REF_MOD(+)"
    sWhere = " AND A.STD_DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND A.STD_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0)"
    sWhere = sWhere + " AND ((B.SCO_DT_START <= #GREATEST(?(4,0,0), A.STD_DT_START) AND B.SCO_DT_END >= #GREATEST(?(4,0,0), A.STD_DT_START) AND B.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE = ?(2,5,0)) OR (C.DT_START <= #GREATEST(?(4,0,0), A.STD_DT_START) AND C.DT_END >= #GREATEST(?(4,0,0), A.STD_DT_START) AND D.SCO_DT_START <= #GREATEST(?(4,0,0), A.STD_DT_START) AND D.SCO_DT_END >= #GREATEST(?(4,0,0), A.STD_DT_START) AND D.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE = ?(2,5,0)))"
    sAsAtDate = ToString(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)
    SCO_SYS_SENTENCE_FIX = sFrom + sJoin + sWhere
    SCO_SYS_PARAM_FIX = sSchemeYearEnd + "|" + sSchemeYearStart + "|" + sAsAtDate + "|" + sAsAtDate + "|" + ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE + "|" + sAsAtDate + "|" + sAsAtDate + "|" + sAsAtDate + "|" + sAsAtDate + "|" + ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
Else
    'Filter HR Periods valid within scheme year
    sFrom = "FROM &STD_HR_PERIOD A"
    sWhere = " WHERE A.STD_DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND A.STD_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0)"
    SCO_SYS_SENTENCE_FIX = sFrom + sWhere
    SCO_SYS_PARAM_FIX = sSchemeYearEnd + "|" + sSchemeYearStart
EndIf

'Partial load: Begin() triggers load according to load mode of node!
Return(Begin())

'Deletes all summary records that are not assigned to the employee (obsolete)
'Argument:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
'Result in SCO_DELETE_OBSOLETE.

SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_DT_CUT_OFF_DELETE = ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE

sSentence = "DELETE SCO_AB_H_HRP_ENT_SUMMARY A WHERE A.SCO_ID_HR = @SCO_ID_HR AND A.SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD = @SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD AND A.SCO_DT_START <= @SCO_DT_CUT_OFF_DELETE AND A.SCO_DT_END >= @SCO_DT_CUT_OFF_DELETE"

sHRPEntitlementTypeList = SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_HR_PERIOD.SCO_P_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE_LIST
sRefModEntitlementTypeList = SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_REF_MOD.SCO_P_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE_LIST

sEntitlementTypeList = ""

bFirst = M4_TRUE
If IsNull(sHRPEntitlementTypeList) = M4_FALSE and sHRPEntitlementTypeList <> "" Then
    sEntitlementTypeList = sHRPEntitlementTypeList
    bFirst = M4_FALSE
EndIf
If IsNull(sRefModEntitlementTypeList) = M4_FALSE and sRefModEntitlementTypeList <> "" Then
    If bFirst = M4_TRUE Then
        bFirst = M4_FALSE
    Else
        sEntitlementTypeList = sEntitlementTypeList + ","
    EndIf
    sEntitlementTypeList = sEntitlementTypeList + sRefModEntitlementTypeList
EndIf


If bFirst <> M4_TRUE Then
    sSentence = sSentence + " AND A.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE NOT IN (" + sEntitlementTypeList + ")"
EndIf

SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_DELETE_OBSOLETE = sSentence

Return(M4_SUCCESS)

'Rounds the given number
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_NUM
'Returns the rounded result

nResult = Round(ARG_SCO_NUM, 0)

Return(nResult)

'Updates summary for given entitlement (only if record for given date exists!)
'- update summary of previous scheme year (Cfwd, lost)
'- udpate summary of current scheme year (entitlement n-1, manual details, used)
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END
'Returns M4_ERROR or M4_SUCCESS

bResult = M4_SUCCESS

dtSummaryFilter = ARG_SCO_DT_START

Do
    bCalculateNextPeriod = M4_FALSE
    'Identify current summary
    iPosCurrent = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_LOAD_BY_DATE(ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE, dtSummaryFilter)
    If iPosCurrent <> -1 Then
        'Identify scheme year start and end
        dtSchemeYearStart = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY[iPosCurrent].SCO_DT_START
        dtSchemeYearEnd = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY[iPosCurrent].SCO_DT_END
        'Idenfity previous summary if previous scheme year in the past (ended before today GMT)
        dtPreviousPeriodEnd = dtSchemeYearStart - 1
        If dtPreviousPeriodEnd < TodayGMT() Then
            iPosPrevious = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_LOAD_BY_DATE(ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE, dtPreviousPeriodEnd)
            If iPosPrevious <> -1 Then
                'Identify scheme of previous scheme year
                sPreviousPeriodSchemeId = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY[iPosPrevious].SCO_ID_SCHEME
                iPosPreviousPeriodScheme = SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME.SCO_LOAD(sPreviousPeriodSchemeId, dtPreviousPeriodEnd)
                'Identify maximum Cfwd/ according to scheme
                If iPosPreviousPeriodScheme <> -1 Then
                    nPreviousPeriodMaxCarryForward = SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME[iPosPreviousPeriodScheme].SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD
                Else
                    nPreviousPeriodMaxCarryForward = 0
                EndIf
                'Identify summary details of previous scheme year (entitlement and remaining)
                nPreviousPeriodEntitlement = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY[iPosPrevious].SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT
                nPreviousPeriodEntitlementN1 = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY[iPosPrevious].SCO_NUM_ENTITLEMENT_N1
                nPreviousPeriodManualAdjustment = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY[iPosPrevious].SCO_NUM_MANUAL_ADJUSTMENT
                nPreviousPeriodUsed = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY[iPosPrevious].SCO_NUM_USED
                nPreviousPeriodRemaining = nPreviousPeriodEntitlement + nPreviousPeriodEntitlementN1 + nPreviousPeriodManualAdjustment - nPreviousPeriodUsed
                'Calculate Cfwd/ and lost entitlement of previous scheme year
                If nPreviousPeriodMaxCarryForward > 0 Then
                    'No Cfwd/ over more than one year (remaining of previous period limited to new entitlement (new and manual adjustment) of previous period)
                    nPreviousPeriodRemainingLimited = Min(nPreviousPeriodRemaining, nPreviousPeriodEntitlement + nPreviousPeriodManualAdjustment)
                    'Apply maximum carry forward
                    nCarryForward = Min(nPreviousPeriodRemainingLimited, nPreviousPeriodMaxCarryForward)
                    'Only positive values carried forward
                    nCarryForward = Max(0, nCarryForward)
                    'Identify lost (expired) entitlement (previous scheme year!!!)
                    nLostPrevious = nPreviousPeriodRemaining - nCarryForward
                Else
                    'Identify lost (expired) entitlement (previous scheme year!!!)
                    nLostPrevious = nPreviousPeriodRemaining
                    nCarryForward = 0
                EndIf
                'Update CARRIED FORWARD of previous scheme year's summary
                SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.MoveTo(iPosPrevious)
                SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_UPDATE_CFWD(dtSummaryFilter, nCarryForward)
                'Update LOST of previous scheme year's summary
                SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_UPDATE_LOST(dtSummaryFilter, nLostPrevious)
                'Update TOTAL REMAINING of previous scheme year's summary
                SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_UPDATE_TOTAL_REMAINING(dtSummaryFilter)
                'Update ENTITLEMENT N-1 of current scheme year's summary
                SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.MoveTo(iPosCurrent)
                SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_UPDATE_ENT_N1(dtSummaryFilter, nCarryForward, dtSchemeYearEnd)
            EndIf
        'Else
            'Previous scheme year still active and entitlements available for use
        EndIf

        'Position on current scheme year
        SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.MoveTo(iPosCurrent)
        'Identify manually modified entitlement
        nManualEntitlement = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_GET_DETAILS_MANUAL()
        'Update MANUAL ADJUSTMENT of current scheme year's summary
        SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_UPDATE_MANUAL_ADJ(dtSummaryFilter, nManualEntitlement, SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD)
        'Identify days taken (real time period, incidencs that start in previous period or end in following period are already prorated)
        nDaysTaken = SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_GET_DAYS_TAKEN()
        'Update USED of current scheme year's summary
        SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_UPDATE_USED(dtSummaryFilter, nDaysTaken, SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_NUM_MAX_CFWD)
        'Reset LOST and CARRIED FORWARD of current scheme year's summary (set by following scheme year)
        SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_UPDATE_LOST(dtSummaryFilter, 0)
        SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_UPDATE_CFWD(dtSummaryFilter, 0)
        'Update TOTAL REMAINING of current scheme year's summary
        SCO_AB_ENT_HRP_SUMMARY.SCO_UPDATE_TOTAL_REMAINING(dtSummaryFilter)

        'If given period spans several scheme years, continue loop
        If IsNull(ARG_SCO_DT_END) = M4_FALSE and ARG_SCO_DT_END > dtSchemeYearEnd Then
            bCalculateNextPeriod = M4_TRUE
            dtSummaryFilter = dtSchemeYearEnd + 1
        EndIf
    Else
        'Summary does not exist, no update! Stop loop
        bCalculateNextPeriod = M4_FALSE
    EndIf
Until bCalculateNextPeriod = M4_FALSE

Return(bResult)

'Loads records filtered by given date
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
'Returns number of records loaded

sSentence = "FROM &SCO_AB_H_HRP_SCHEME A"
sSentence = sSentence + " WHERE A.SCO_DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0)"
sParam = ToString(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT) + "|" + ToString(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)

SCO_SYS_SENTENCE = sSentence
SCO_SYS_PARAM = sParam

iCountBefore = Count()
Load_BLK()

'Loop through all loaded records, add them to scheme list (used to identify all schemes of employee) and delete registers that do not correspond to entitlement type
sEntitlementTypeId = SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
If IsNull(sEntitlementTypeId) = M4_FALSE and sEntitlementTypeId <> "" Then
    bDelete = M4_TRUE
Else
    bDelete = M4_FALSE
EndIf
sEntitlementTypeList = ""
bFirst = M4_TRUE
MoveTo(iCountBefore)
While IsEOF() = M4_FALSE
    If bFirst = M4_TRUE Then
        bFirst = M4_FALSE
    Else
        sEntitlementTypeList = sEntitlementTypeList + ","
    EndIf
    sEntitlementTypeList = sEntitlementTypeList + "'" + SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE + "'"
    'Delete register if type does not meet filter
    If bDelete = M4_TRUE and sEntitlementTypeId <> SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE Then
        DestroyRegister()
    Else
        GoNext()
    EndIf
WEnd

SCO_P_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE_LIST = sEntitlementTypeList

iResult = Count() - iCountBefore

Return(iResult)

M4RCH_RULES3/ID_TI/SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME_BY_.SOURCE_CODE:
'Adds filter by sys sentence to exclude schemes that are overridden at HR Period level.

sFrom = "FROM &SCO_HR_THEOR_TIME A, SCO_AB_H_REF_MOD_SCHEME B"
sJoin = " WHERE A.SCO_ID_REF_MOD = B.SCO_ID_REF_MOD"
sWhere = " AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM SCO_AB_H_HRP_SCHEME C WHERE A.STD_ID_HR = C.SCO_ID_HR AND A.STD_OR_HR_PERIOD = C.SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD"
sWhere = sWhere + " AND B.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE = C.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE"
sWhere = sWhere + " AND C.SCO_DT_START <= @SCO_AS_AT_DATE And C.SCO_DT_END >= @SCO_AS_AT_DATE"
sWhere = sWhere + ")"

SCO_SYS_SENTENCE_FIX = sFrom + sJoin + sWhere

Return(M4_SUCCESS)

'Loads records filtered by given date
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
'Returns number of records loaded

sFrom = "FROM &SCO_HR_THEOR_TIME A, SCO_AB_H_REF_MOD_SCHEME B"
sJoin = " WHERE A.SCO_ID_REF_MOD = B.SCO_ID_REF_MOD"
sWhere = " AND A.DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND A.DT_END >= ?(4,0,0) AND B.SCO_DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND B.SCO_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0)"
sDate = ToString(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)
sParam = sDate + "|" + sDate + "|" + sDate + "|" + sDate

SCO_SYS_SENTENCE = sFrom + sJoin + sWhere
SCO_SYS_PARAM = sParam
SCO_AS_AT_DATE = ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE

iCountBefore = Count()
Load_BLK()

'Loop through all loaded records, add them to scheme list (used to identify all schemes of employee) and delete registers that do not correspond to entitlement type
sEntitlementTypeId = SCO_AB_ENT_HR_PERIOD.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
If IsNull(sEntitlementTypeId) = M4_FALSE and sEntitlementTypeId <> "" Then
    bDelete = M4_TRUE
Else
    bDelete = M4_FALSE
EndIf
sEntitlementTypeList = ""
bFirst = M4_TRUE
MoveTo(iCountBefore)
While IsEOF() = M4_FALSE
    If bFirst = M4_TRUE Then
        bFirst = M4_FALSE
    Else
        sEntitlementTypeList = sEntitlementTypeList + ","
    EndIf
    sEntitlementTypeList = sEntitlementTypeList + "'" + SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE + "'"
    'Delete register if type does not meet filter
    If bDelete = M4_TRUE and sEntitlementTypeId <> SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE Then
        DestroyRegister()
    Else
        GoNext()
    EndIf
WEnd

SCO_P_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE_LIST = sEntitlementTypeList

iResult = Count() - iCountBefore

Return(iResult)

M4RCH_RULES3/ID_TI/SCO_AB_ENT_SCHEME.SOURCE_CODE:
'Calculates scheme year begin and end based on given date.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START (by reference)
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END (by reference)
'Returns SUCCESS and result in arguments

'For now the scheme year corresponds to the calendar year
iDay = 0: iMonth = 0: iYear = 0
DateToNumbers(ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE, iYear, iMonth, iDay)

dtStart = NumbersToDate(iYear)
dtEnd = NumbersToDate(iYear + 1) - 1

ARG_SCO_DT_START = dtStart
ARG_SCO_DT_END = dtEnd

Return(M4_SUCCESS)

'Loads scheme definition if required as at given date.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_SCHEME
' - ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
'Returns position of given scheme or -1 if not available.

If SCO_AS_AT_DATE <> ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE Then
    'Destroy block if loaded data do not correspond in dates to requested data
    DestroyBlock()
    'Update date
    SCO_AS_AT_DATE = ARG_SCO_AS_AT_DATE
    'No schemes loaded
    iPos = -1
Else
    'Locate given scheme
    iPos = FindRegister("SCO_ID_SCHEME", ARG_SCO_ID_SCHEME, M4_EQUAL, 0)
EndIf

If iPos < 0 Then
    'Load given scheme
    SCO_SYS_SENTENCE = "FROM &SCO_AB_SCHEME A WHERE A.SCO_ID_SCHEME = ?(2,5,0)"
    SCO_SYS_PARAM = ARG_SCO_ID_SCHEME
    'Load
    Load_PRG()
EndIf

'Locate given scheme again
iPos = FindRegister("SCO_ID_SCHEME", ARG_SCO_ID_SCHEME, M4_EQUAL, 0)
If iPos <> -1 Then
    MoveTo(iPos)
EndIf

Return(iPos)

'Identifies entitlement type by incidence id
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE
'Returns entitlement type or null

sReturnValue = NullValue()

    MoveTo(iPos)
    sReturnValue = SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE

Return(sReturnValue)

'Identifies entitlement type details
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE
'Returns register index or -1 on error

iReturnValue = -1

If Begin() = M4_FALSE Then Load_BLK()

iPos = FindRegister("SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE", ARG_SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT_TYPE, M4_EQUAL, 0)

If iPos <> -1 Then
    MoveTo(iPos)
    iReturnValue = iPos
EndIf

Return(iReturnValue)

M4RCH_RULES3/ID_TI/SCO_DP_HR_THEORETICAL.SOURCE_CODE:
'Calculates the duration of the given incident in the required time unit.
'Period or Role No. required!
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_HR
' - ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD
' - ARG_SCO_OR_HR_ROLE
' - ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE
' - ARG_SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START
' - ARG_SCO_START_TIME      -> can be null
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END
' - ARG_SCO_END_TIME        -> can be null
'Returns the duration or null on error.

nResult = NullValue()

'Identify definition of incident
If IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE) = M4_FALSE and Trim(ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE, M4_TRIM_ALL) <> "" Then
    If SCO_DP_TT_INCIDENCE.Begin() = M4_FALSE Then SCO_DP_TT_INCIDENCE.Load_BLK()
    iPos = SCO_DP_TT_INCIDENCE.FindRegister("SCO_ID_INCIDENCE", ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE, M4_EQUAL, 0)
    If iPos <> -1 Then
        'Incident managed by natural or working days
        bWorkingDays = SCO_DP_TT_INCIDENCE[iPos].SCO_CK_WORKING
        If bWorkingDays <> M4_TRUE Then
            'Duration in natural days/hours
            nResult = SCO_GET_DURATION_NATURAL(ARG_SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT, ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_START_TIME, ARG_SCO_DT_END, ARG_SCO_END_TIME)
        Else
            'Calculate duration in working days/hours
            iExecutionMode = 3 'Theoretical time and calendar
            nTotWorkingHours = 0
            nTotCalendarHours = 0
            nWorkingDays = 0
            nCalendarWorkingDays = 0
            nTotWorkingSaturdays = 0
            nTotWorkingSundays = 0
            nTotCalendarWorkingSaturdays = 0
            nTotCalendarWorkingSundays = 0
            //iResult = SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_HR_THEOR_TIME.SCO_CALC_THEOR_TIME(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_ROLE, ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, iExecutionMode, nTotWorkingHours, nTotCalendarHours, nWorkingDays, nCalendarWorkingDays, nTotWorkingSaturdays, nTotWorkingSundays, nTotCalendarWorkingSaturdays, nTotCalendarWorkingSundays)
            'Duration in natural days/hours
            If ARG_SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT = "04" Then
                'Duration in days
                iResult = SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_HR_THEOR_TIME.SCO_CALC_THEOR_TIME(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_ROLE, ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, iExecutionMode, nTotWorkingHours, nTotCalendarHours, nWorkingDays, nCalendarWorkingDays, nTotWorkingSaturdays, nTotWorkingSundays, nTotCalendarWorkingSaturdays, nTotCalendarWorkingSundays)
                nResult = nWorkingDays - nCalendarWorkingDays
            ElseIf ARG_SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT = "05" Then
                'Duration in hours
                If ARG_SCO_DT_START = ARG_SCO_DT_END Then
                    'Partial day: two types of calculation: with GTA, time slot and not null start and end hour or the classical one (limited to working hours)
                
                    If SCO_IS_GTA_PARTIAL_DAY_CALC(ARG_SCO_START_TIME,ARG_SCO_END_TIME,ARG_SCO_ID_HR,ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD,ARG_SCO_DT_START) = 1 Then
                        nResult = SCO_GTA_PARTIAL_DAY_CALC(ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_START_TIME,ARG_SCO_END_TIME)
                    Else
                        'Partial day - limited to working hours
                        iResult = SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_HR_THEOR_TIME.SCO_CALC_THEOR_TIME(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_ROLE, ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, iExecutionMode, nTotWorkingHours, nTotCalendarHours, nWorkingDays, nCalendarWorkingDays, nTotWorkingSaturdays, nTotWorkingSundays, nTotCalendarWorkingSaturdays, nTotCalendarWorkingSundays)
                        nNaturalHours = Round(DateDiff(ARG_SCO_START_TIME, ARG_SCO_END_TIME, M4_HOUR), 2)
                        nResult = Min(nNaturalHours, nTotWorkingHours - nTotCalendarHours)                                    
                    EndIf
                    DestroyBlock()'sometimes the SCO_IS_GTA_PARTIAL_DAY_CALC method create a block and the method SCO_GTA_PARTIAL_DAY_CALC use it, but now we can destroy it
                Else
                    'Full days
                    iResult = SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_HR_THEOR_TIME.SCO_CALC_THEOR_TIME(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_ROLE, ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, iExecutionMode, nTotWorkingHours, nTotCalendarHours, nWorkingDays, nCalendarWorkingDays, nTotWorkingSaturdays, nTotWorkingSundays, nTotCalendarWorkingSaturdays, nTotCalendarWorkingSundays)                   
                    nResult = nTotWorkingHours - nTotCalendarHours
                EndIf
            EndIf
        EndIf
    EndIf
EndIf

Return(nResult)

'Calculates the duration of the given incident in the required time unit.
'Period or Role No. required!
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_HR
' - ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD
' - ARG_SCO_OR_HR_ROLE
' - ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE
' - ARG_SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START
' - ARG_SCO_START_TIME      -> can be null
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END
' - ARG_SCO_END_TIME        -> can be null
'Returns the duration or null on error.
'-------------------------------------------------------------
'--- Localizado en España, debido al parametro adicional en el TT
'-------------------------------------------------------------

nResult = NullValue()

'Identify definition of incident
If IsNull(ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE) = M4_FALSE and Trim(ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE, M4_TRIM_ALL) <> "" Then
    If SCO_DP_TT_INCIDENCE.Begin() = M4_FALSE Then SCO_DP_TT_INCIDENCE.Load_BLK()
    iPos = SCO_DP_TT_INCIDENCE.FindRegister("SCO_ID_INCIDENCE", ARG_SCO_ID_INCIDENCE, M4_EQUAL, 0)
    If iPos <> -1 Then
        'Incident managed by natural or working days
        bWorkingDays = SCO_DP_TT_INCIDENCE[iPos].SCO_CK_WORKING
        If bWorkingDays <> M4_TRUE Then
            'Duration in natural days/hours
            nResult = SCO_GET_DURATION_NATURAL(ARG_SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT, ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_START_TIME, ARG_SCO_DT_END, ARG_SCO_END_TIME)
        Else
            'Calculate duration in working days/hours
            iExecutionMode = 3 'Theoretical time and calendar
            nTotWorkingHours = 0
            nTotCalendarHours = 0
            nWorkingDays = 0
            nCalendarWorkingDays = 0
            nTotWorkingSaturdays = 0
            nTotWorkingSundays = 0
            nTotCalendarWorkingSaturdays = 0
            nTotCalendarWorkingSundays = 0
            nDummy = 0  'No se utiliza
            //iResult = SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_HR_THEOR_TIME.SCO_CALC_THEOR_TIME(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_ROLE, ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, iExecutionMode, nTotWorkingHours, nTotCalendarHours, nWorkingDays, nCalendarWorkingDays, nTotWorkingSaturdays, nTotWorkingSundays, nTotCalendarWorkingSaturdays, nTotCalendarWorkingSundays,nDummy)
            'Duration in natural days/hours
            If ARG_SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT = "04" Then
                'Duration in days
                iResult = SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_HR_THEOR_TIME.SCO_CALC_THEOR_TIME(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_ROLE, ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, iExecutionMode, nTotWorkingHours, nTotCalendarHours, nWorkingDays, nCalendarWorkingDays, nTotWorkingSaturdays, nTotWorkingSundays, nTotCalendarWorkingSaturdays, nTotCalendarWorkingSundays,nDummy)
                nResult = nWorkingDays - nCalendarWorkingDays
            ElseIf ARG_SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT = "05" Then
                'Duration in hours
                If ARG_SCO_DT_START = ARG_SCO_DT_END Then
                    'Partial day: two types of calculation: with GTA, time slot and not null start and end hour or the classical one (limited to working hours)
                
                    If SCO_IS_GTA_PARTIAL_DAY_CALC(ARG_SCO_START_TIME,ARG_SCO_END_TIME,ARG_SCO_ID_HR,ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD,ARG_SCO_DT_START) = 1 Then
                        nResult = SCO_GTA_PARTIAL_DAY_CALC(ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_START_TIME,ARG_SCO_END_TIME)
                    Else
                        'Partial day - limited to working hours
                        iResult = SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_HR_THEOR_TIME.SCO_CALC_THEOR_TIME(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_ROLE, ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, iExecutionMode, nTotWorkingHours, nTotCalendarHours, nWorkingDays, nCalendarWorkingDays, nTotWorkingSaturdays, nTotWorkingSundays, nTotCalendarWorkingSaturdays, nTotCalendarWorkingSundays,nDummy)
                        //nNaturalHours = Round(DateDiff(ARG_SCO_START_TIME, ARG_SCO_END_TIME, M4_HOUR), 2)
                        nNaturalHours   = Round(DateDiff(ARG_SCO_START_TIME, ARG_SCO_END_TIME, M4_MINUTE) /60 , 2)
                        nResult = Min(nNaturalHours, nTotWorkingHours - nTotCalendarHours)                                    
                    EndIf
                    DestroyBlock()'sometimes the SCO_IS_GTA_PARTIAL_DAY_CALC method create a block and the method SCO_GTA_PARTIAL_DAY_CALC use it, but now we can destroy it
                Else
                    'Full days
                    iResult = SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_HR_THEOR_TIME.SCO_CALC_THEOR_TIME(ARG_SCO_ID_HR, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD, ARG_SCO_OR_HR_ROLE, ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, iExecutionMode, nTotWorkingHours, nTotCalendarHours, nWorkingDays, nCalendarWorkingDays, nTotWorkingSaturdays, nTotWorkingSundays, nTotCalendarWorkingSaturdays, nTotCalendarWorkingSundays,nDummy)                   
                    nResult = nTotWorkingHours - nTotCalendarHours
                EndIf
            EndIf
        EndIf
    EndIf
EndIf

Return(nResult)

'Calculates the duration in natural days/hours depending on the required time unit.
'Arguments:
' - ARG_SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT
' - ARG_SCO_DT_START
' - ARG_SCO_START_TIME      -> can be null
' - ARG_SCO_DT_END
' - ARG_SCO_END_TIME        -> can be null
'Returns the duration or null on error.

nResult = NullValue()

'Duration in natural days/hours
If ARG_SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT = "04" Then
    'Duration in days
    nResult = DateDiff(ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, M4_DAY) + 1
ElseIf ARG_SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT = "05" Then
    'Duration in hours
    If ARG_SCO_DT_START = ARG_SCO_DT_END Then
        'Partial day
        //nResult = Round(DateDiff(ARG_SCO_START_TIME, ARG_SCO_END_TIME, M4_HOUR), 2)
        nResult = Round(DateDiff(ARG_SCO_START_TIME, ARG_SCO_END_TIME, M4_MINUTE) /60 , 2)
    Else
        'Full days
        nResult = (DateDiff(ARG_SCO_DT_START, ARG_SCO_DT_END, M4_DAY) + 1) * 24
    EndIf
EndIf

Return(nResult)

'SCO_GTA_PARTIAL_DAY_CALC
'Calculate the duration of a partial day incidence (not natural) with a day with time slots
'Example:
' Reference time slot = 09:00-13:00, 14:00-17:00
' Incidence = from 08:00-13:30
' The duration of the incidence (not natural) is not 5:30, but 4:00

nHrsDuration = 0

'We use this variables in datetime format
dtStartInc = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_START_TIME)
dtEndInc = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_END_TIME)

'First we load the Reference time slots
Call("SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS","SRCO_LOAD_REFERENCE_TS") 'by indirection because the method is "node item"

'Then we loop over the Reference time slots, and we take the common time between Reference time slot and Incidence
For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()-1
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)
    dtStartRefTS = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT
    dtEndRefTS = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT
    
    'nCommonDays  = CommonTimestamp(dtStartRefTS,dtEndRefTS, dtStartInc,dtEndInc)
    'nCommonHrs   = nCommonDays  * 24
    nCommonHrs = 0
    If dtStartRefTS < dtEndInc and dtEndRefTS > dtStartInc Then
        dtStartCommon = Max(dtStartRefTS,dtStartInc)
        dtEndCommon   = Min(dtEndRefTS  ,dtEndInc  )
        nCommonMin    = DateDiff(dtStartCommon,dtEndCommon,M4_MINUTE)
        nCommonHrs    = nCommonMin/60
    EndIf
    
    nHrsDuration = nHrsDuration + nCommonHrs   

Next

Return(Round(nHrsDuration,2))

'SCO_IS_GTA_CALC
' If with GTA, time slot and not null start and end hour => 1
' In other case => 0
nRet = 0

If ARG_SCO_START_TIME <> nullvalue() and ARG_SCO_END_TIME <> nullvalue() Then
    If SCO_WITH_GTA() = 1 Then
    
        'With GTA and not null start and end hour, so we need to know if there are time slots in this day
        'if we have registers in SCO_HR_RWD_THEOR_TIME_SLOTS, then we have time slots (this is the table we the user can define an exception for a time slots in the Detail screen)
        'if not we must find the time table ID (using the applyvalue)
        
        AddRegister()
        SCO_ID_HR = ARG_SCO_ID_HR
        SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD = ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD
        SCO_DT_START = ARG_SCO_DT_START           
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Load_blk()
        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count() > 0 Then
            nRet = 1    
        Else
        
            'We use the apply value to take the TimeTableId (but we don't load any value!)
            'First we initialize the M4O
            nRet = SCO_APPLYVAL_PERIOD!SCO_INTERMEDIATE_NODE_PERIOD.SETPERIOD(ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_DT_START,0)
            nRet = SCO_APPLYVAL_PERIOD!SCO_INTERMEDIATE_NODE_PERIOD.SCO_SET_PK_PAY(ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_DT_START,"xx","xx") 'we put any value to avoid warnings in JS, but we don't want to load the incidences tables
            nRet = SCO_APPLYVAL_PERIOD!SCO_INTERMEDIATE_NODE_PERIOD.DESTROYBLOCK()'Clear the node
            nRet = SCO_APPLYVAL_PERIOD!SCO_INTERMEDIATE_NODE_PERIOD.SCO_SETDATES_COR(ARG_SCO_DT_START)'We put the correction date (current date)
            nRet = SCO_APPLYVAL_PERIOD!SCO_INTERMEDIATE_NODE_PERIOD.SETDATES(ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_DT_START)'We put the date (current date)
            nRet = SCO_APPLYVAL_PERIOD!SCO_INTERMEDIATE_NODE_PERIOD.SCO_SETAPPLYVALUE_I(ARG_SCO_ID_HR,ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD)'PK of this employee
            'We call the method that calculate the TimeTableId 
            sCycle = "" : sIDWeekModel = "" : nWeek = 0 : sDayType = "" : sTimeTable = "" : bIsTheorRecalculation = 0
            nRet = SCO_APPLYVAL_PERIOD!SCO_INTERMEDIATE_NODE_PERIOD.SCO_GTA_CALC_CYCLE_WEEK_DAY(ARG_SCO_DT_START,sCycle,sIDWeekModel,nWeek,sDayType,sTimeTable,bIsTheorRecalculation)

            SCO_ID_DAY_TYPE = sDayType
            SCO_ID_TIMETABLE = sTimeTable
            
            If SCO_ID_TIMETABLE <> nullvalue() and SCO_ID_TIMETABLE <> "" Then
                nRet = 1    
            EndIf
        EndIf
    EndIf
EndIf
Return(nRet)

'SCO_IS_GTA_CALC
' If with GTA, time slot and not null start and end hour => 1
' In other case => 0
'-------------------------------------------------------------
'--- Localizado en España, debido al aplicavalor español
'-------------------------------------------------------------


nRet = 0

If ARG_SCO_START_TIME <> nullvalue() and ARG_SCO_END_TIME <> nullvalue() Then
    If SCO_WITH_GTA() = 1 Then
    
        'With GTA and not null start and end hour, so we need to know if there are time slots in this day
        'if we have registers in SCO_HR_RWD_THEOR_TIME_SLOTS, then we have time slots (this is the table we the user can define an exception for a time slots in the Detail screen)
        'if not we must find the time table ID (using the applyvalue)
        
        AddRegister()
        SCO_ID_HR = ARG_SCO_ID_HR
        SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD = ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD
        SCO_DT_START = ARG_SCO_DT_START           
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Load_blk()
        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count() > 0 Then
            nRet = 1    
        Else
        
            'We use the apply value to take the TimeTableId (but we don't load any value!)
            'First we initialize the M4O
            nRet = SSP_APPLYVAL_PER!SSP_APPLYVALUE_PER.SETPERIODS(ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_DT_START,0)
            nRet = SSP_APPLYVAL_PER!SSP_APPLYVALUE_PER.SCO_SET_PK_PAY(ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_DT_START,"xx","xx") 'we put any value to avoid warnings in JS, but we don't want to load the incidences tables
            nRet = SSP_APPLYVAL_PER!SSP_APPLYVALUE_PER.DESTROYBLOCK()'Clear the node
            nRet = SSP_APPLYVAL_PER!SSP_APPLYVALUE_PER.SCO_SETDATES_COR(ARG_SCO_DT_START)'We put the correction date (current date)
            nRet = SSP_APPLYVAL_PER!SSP_APPLYVALUE_PER.SETDATES(ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_DT_START,ARG_SCO_DT_START)'We put the date (current date)
            nRet = SSP_APPLYVAL_PER!SSP_APPLYVALUE_PER.SSP_SETAPPLY_PERIOD(ARG_SCO_ID_HR,ARG_SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD)'PK of this employee
            'We call the method that calculate the TimeTableId 
            sCycle = "" : sIDWeekModel = "" : nWeek = 0 : sDayType = "" : sTimeTable = "" : bIsTheorRecalculation = 0
            nRet = SSP_APPLYVAL_PER!SSP_APPLYVALUE_PER.SCO_GTA_CALC_CYCLE_WEEK_DAY(ARG_SCO_DT_START,sCycle,sIDWeekModel,nWeek,sDayType,sTimeTable,bIsTheorRecalculation)

            SCO_ID_DAY_TYPE = sDayType
            SCO_ID_TIMETABLE = sTimeTable
            
            If SCO_ID_TIMETABLE <> nullvalue() and SCO_ID_TIMETABLE <> "" Then
                nRet = 1    
            EndIf
        EndIf
    EndIf
EndIf
Return(nRet)

'With GTA or not 
nWithGTA = SCO_WITH_GTA

If nWithGTA = nullvalue() Then
    SAV_PARAMS!SAV_PARAMS.RET_VALUE("CONFIGURATION","GTA","LEVEL")
    If SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN.Begin() = M4_TRUE then
        sLevel = SAV_PARAMS!FINAL_RETURN[0].APP_VALUE
    EndIf
    If sLevel = "0" or sLevel = "1" Then 
        nWithGTA  = 1
    Else
        nWithGTA  = 0
    EndIf
EndIf

Return(nWithGTA)

M4RCH_RULES3/ID_TI/SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SOURCE_CODE:
'SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF
'Filter the real or reference time slots
'Args:
' ARG_REAL_REF. Values: REAL, REFERENCE
' ARG_TIMESLOT_TYPE: Values: null = ALL, TIMESLOT_TYPE (Fixed, Variable,...)
' ARG_EQUAL_OR_DIF_TS_TP: Values: M4_EQUAL, M4_DISTINCT, null (= M4_EQUAL)

If ARG_TIMESLOT_TYPE = nullvalue() or ARG_TIMESLOT_TYPE = "" Then ARG_TIMESLOT_TYPE = "ALL"
If ARG_EQUAL_OR_DIF_TS_TP = nullvalue() or ARG_EQUAL_OR_DIF_TS_TP = "" Then ARG_EQUAL_OR_DIF_TS_TP = M4_EQUAL

'we dont do anything if the last call was equal than this
If SCO_LAST_REAL_OR_REF_ARG <> ARG_REAL_REF or SCO_LAST_TIMESLOT_TYPE_ARG <> ARG_TIMESLOT_TYPE or SCO_LAST_EQUAL_OR_DIF_TS_TP_AR <> ARG_EQUAL_OR_DIF_TS_TP Then
    SCO_LAST_REAL_OR_REF_ARG = ARG_REAL_REF
    SCO_LAST_TIMESLOT_TYPE_ARG = ARG_TIMESLOT_TYPE
    SCO_LAST_EQUAL_OR_DIF_TS_TP_AR = ARG_EQUAL_OR_DIF_TS_TP 
    
    CleanFilter()

    'we don't do anything if there are no registers
    If Count()>0 Then

        'Real
        If ARG_REAL_REF = "REAL" Then
        
            If (ARG_TIMESLOT_TYPE <> "ALL" or SCO_NUM_REG_REF > 0 ) Then 
                'if we want all the types and there are no reference is not needed to do anything, in other case we are here
                    
                sFilter = "If SCO_REAL_OR_REFERENCE_TIMESLOT="+chr(M4_DOUBLE_QUOTE)+"REAL"+chr(M4_DOUBLE_QUOTE)
                If ARG_TIMESLOT_TYPE <> "ALL" Then
                    If ARG_EQUAL_OR_DIF_TS_TP = M4_EQUAL Then
                        sFilter = sFilter +" and SCO_ID_TIMESLOT_TYPE ="+chr(M4_DOUBLE_QUOTE)+ARG_TIMESLOT_TYPE+chr(M4_DOUBLE_QUOTE)
                    ElseIf ARG_EQUAL_OR_DIF_TS_TP = M4_DISTINCT Then
                        sFilter = sFilter +" and SCO_ID_TIMESLOT_TYPE <>"+chr(M4_DOUBLE_QUOTE)+ARG_TIMESLOT_TYPE+chr(M4_DOUBLE_QUOTE)                    
                    EndIf
                EndIf
                sFilter = sFilter + " Then Return(1) Else Return(0)"
                
                AddFilter(sFilter)
            EndIf
    
        'Reference
        ElseIf ARG_REAL_REF = "REFERENCE" Then
           
            If SCO_NUM_REG_REF > 0 Then 
                'if there are reference registers we get it
                sFilter = "If SCO_REAL_OR_REFERENCE_TIMESLOT="+chr(M4_DOUBLE_QUOTE)+"REFERENCE"+chr(M4_DOUBLE_QUOTE)+" Then Return(1) Else Return(0)"
                AddFilter(sFilter)    
            Else
                'if there are not reference registers we get the fixed
                ARG_TIMESLOT_TYPE = "FIXED"
                sFilter = "If SCO_ID_TIMESLOT_TYPE ="+chr(M4_DOUBLE_QUOTE)+ARG_TIMESLOT_TYPE+chr(M4_DOUBLE_QUOTE)+" Then Return(1) Else Return(0)"
                AddFilter(sFilter)    
            EndIf
        EndIf
        
    EndIf 'end of: we don't do anything if there are no registers
EndIf 'end of: we dont do anything if the last call was equal than this

'SRCO_LOAD_REFERENCE_TS
'Load the referenc TS

'Load all the TS
nTSCount = Count()
If nTSCount = 0 Then

    'If there are anything means that the user don't modify it, so we load the definition of the time table
    sTest = SRCO_GTA_RWD_DAY_TT.SCO_FIND_TIMETABLE(SCO_DP_HR_THEORETICAL_TIME_API.SCO_ID_DAY_TYPE,SCO_DP_HR_THEORETICAL_TIME_API.SCO_ID_TIMETABLE)
    If sTest <> nullvalue() Then
        'load of the ts of the timetable
        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.Count()=0 Then SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.Load_blk()

        nTSCount = SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.Count()
        nNumRegRef = 0
        nNumRegReal = 0
        For i=0 to nTSCount-1
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.MoveTo(i)
            AddRegister()
            SCO_STARTS_AT = SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.SCO_TIMESLOT_STARTS_AT
            SCO_ENDS_AT = SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.SCO_TIMESLOT_ENDS_AT
            SCO_ID_TIMESLOT_TYPE = SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.SCO_ID_TIMESLOT_TYPE       
            SCO_REAL_OR_REFERENCE_TIMESLOT = SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.SCO_REAL_OR_REFERENCE_TIMESLOT   
            If SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.SCO_REAL_OR_REFERENCE_TIMESLOT = "REAL" Then nNumRegReal = nNumRegReal + 1
            If SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.SCO_REAL_OR_REFERENCE_TIMESLOT = "REFERENCE" Then nNumRegRef = nNumRegRef + 1            
            
            '**************************************************************************************************************************
            'Starts at in date & time format. To use it to comparations with other date & time format (for example, the clock in/out)
            'note: if the theoretical time is defined between two days (night employees) we consider the next day                               
            If i=0 Then hIni = SCO_STARTS_AT
            'start:
            hCurr = SCO_STARTS_AT
            dtCurDay = SCO_DP_HR_THEORETICAL_TIME_API.SCO_DT_START
            If hCurr < hIni Then dtCurDay = dtCurDay + 1
            SCO_DT_STARTS_AT = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(dtCurDay,hCurr)
            
            'end:
            hCurr = SCO_ENDS_AT
            dtCurDay = SCO_DP_HR_THEORETICAL_TIME_API.SCO_DT_START
            If hCurr < hIni Then dtCurDay = dtCurDay + 1
            SCO_DT_ENDS_AT = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(dtCurDay,hCurr)

            '**************************************************************************************************************************
        Next
        SCO_NUM_REG_REF = nNumRegRef
        SCO_NUM_REG_REAL = nNumRegReal
    EndIf
Else 
    hPrev = nullvalue()
    For i=0 to nTSCount-1
        MoveTo(i)
        '**************************************************************************************************************************
        'Starts at in date & time format. To use it to comparations with other date & time format (for example, the clock in/out)
        'note: if the theoretical time is defined between two days (night employees) we consider the next day

        If i=0 Then hIni = SCO_STARTS_AT
        'start:
        hCurr = SCO_STARTS_AT
        dtCurDay = SCO_DP_HR_THEORETICAL_TIME_API.SCO_DT_START
        If hCurr < hIni Then dtCurDay = dtCurDay + 1
        SCO_DT_STARTS_AT = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(dtCurDay,hCurr)
        
        'end:
        hCurr = SCO_ENDS_AT
        dtCurDay = SCO_DP_HR_THEORETICAL_TIME_API.SCO_DT_START
        If hCurr < hIni Then dtCurDay = dtCurDay + 1
        SCO_DT_ENDS_AT = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(dtCurDay,hCurr)
          
        '**************************************************************************************************************************
    Next
EndIf

'Filter the reference TS
SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REFERENCE","","")

Return(M4_SUCCESS)

WEnd
Begin()

'SCO_CALC_EMPL_CALC_DATES
'Calculate the start and end calculation dates of employee
'Arguments: ARG_DT_START_GENERAL, ARG_DT_END_GENERAL

'In general is the start/end of calculation
dStart = ARG_DT_START_GENERAL
dEnd = ARG_DT_END_GENERAL

If SCO_IS_AUTOMATIC_RECALCULATION = 0 Then
    '******* NO Automatic recalculation ******

    '---- Start ----
    'We check with the start of the cycle of the employee (we will execute all the cycles in the period of time)
    dStart = Max(DT_START,dStart)

    
    '---- End ----
    'If we are not recalculating the theoretical, we need to check until when it is needed to recalculate alerts and counters
    If RECALC_HR_THEO = 0 Then
    
    	If (RECALC_ABS = 1 or RECALC_PRES = 1 or SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC = 1) Then 
    		'in case of new incidence or change the theoretical, we calculate until the days by parameter
    		dEnd = dEnd + RWD_NUM_DAYS_RECALC_AFTER_CHG
    
    	ElseIf SCO_IS_CLOCK_INOUT_EXEC = 1 and SCO_FROM_JS = 0 and dEnd < Today() Then	
    		'in case of clocking (not JS), we calculate until the days by parameter or today
    		dEnd = Min(dEnd + RWD_NUM_DAYS_RECALC_AFTER_CHG,Today())
    	EndIf
        'We check with the end of the employee 
        dEnd = Min(STD_DT_END_PER,dEnd)  
    
    Else
        'We check with the end of the cycle of the employee (we will execute all the cycles in the period of time)
        dEnd = Min(DT_END,dEnd)    
    EndIf

Else
    '******* Automatic recalculation ******

    '---- Start ----
    'If we are in automatic recalculation, we use the minimum date to recalculate
    dMinRecDate = M4_PLUS_INF 
    For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.Count()-1
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.MoveTo(i)
        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_IS_RECALCULATED = 0 Then
            dMinRecDate = Min(dMinRecDate,SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_DATE_TO_RECALC)
        EndIf
    Next
    dStart = dMinRecDate 

    'We check with the start of the employee period (normally we only execute the last cycle)
    dStart = Max(STD_DT_START_PER,dStart)


    '---- End ----
    'The end date is the maximum data calculated
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.Count()>0 Then
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.Begin()
        dEnd = Max(SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.SCO_MAX_CALC_CLOCK_DATE,SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.SCO_MAX_CALC_THEO_DATE)
    EndIf     

    'We check with the end of the employee period (normally we only execute the last cycle)
    dEnd = Min(STD_DT_END_PER,dEnd)
    
    '---- Type of automatic recalculation ----
    'Change in theoretical time
    sRecType = "GTA_ENGINE_THEO"    
    nRegRecal = SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.FindRegister("SCO_RECALC_TYPE",sRecType,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_IS_RECALCULATED",0,M4_EQUAL)
    If nRegRecal <> M4_ERROR Then
        RECALC_HR_THEO = 0
        SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC = 1    
    Else
        RECALC_HR_THEO = 0
        SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC = 0        
    EndIf
    
    'Change in incidences
    sRecType = "GTA_ENGINE_INC"
    nRegRecal = SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.FindRegister("SCO_RECALC_TYPE",sRecType,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_IS_RECALCULATED",0,M4_EQUAL)
    If nRegRecal <> M4_ERROR Then 
        RECALC_ABS = 1 
        RECALC_PRES = 1 
    Else
        RECALC_ABS = 0
        RECALC_PRES = 0
    EndIf    
    
    'Change in clock
    sRecType = "GTA_ENGINE_CLOCK"     
    nRegRecal = SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.FindRegister("SCO_RECALC_TYPE",sRecType,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_IS_RECALCULATED",0,M4_EQUAL)
    If nRegRecal <> M4_ERROR Then 
        SCO_IS_CLOCK_INOUT_EXEC = 1
    Else
        SCO_IS_CLOCK_INOUT_EXEC = 0
    EndIf     
    
EndIf

'Fill the properties
SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL = dStart 
SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL = dEnd

'SCO_CALL_AFTER_CHANGE_THEO
'We have to recalculate alerts, counters,...

SCO_INI_LOG_SIZE = GetLogSize()

nPrev1 = RECALC_HR_THEO
RECALC_HR_THEO = 0

nPrev2 = SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC
SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC = 1
SCO_IS_AFTER_M_CHANGE_THEOR_EX = 1

If ARG_EXECUTE_ALL_ALERTS_COUNTER = 1 Then

ElseIf ARG_EXECUTE_ALL_ALERTS_COUNTER = 0 Then
    SCO_EXECUTE_ALL_ALERTS_COUNTER = 2 'Only online
EndIf

nRet = SRCO_GTA_CALC_ACTIV_HR(ARG_ID_HR,ARG_DT_START,ARG_DT_END,ARG_OR_HR_PERIOD)

RECALC_HR_THEO = nPrev1
SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC = nPrev2
SCO_EXECUTE_ALL_ALERTS_COUNTER = nPrev3
SCO_IS_AFTER_M_CHANGE_THEOR_EX = 0

Return(nRet)

'SCO_CHNG_CALC_TYPE
'After change the calculation type


If SCO_PRES_CALC_TYPE = 1 Then '1-> Create activity (default)

    RECALC_HR_THEO = 1
    SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC = 1
    RECALC_ABS = 1

    RECALC_PRES = 1

        SCO_DT_LAUNCH_EXAMPLE_JS_2 = numberstodate(DxYear(dNewDate),DxMonth(dNewDate),daysofmonth(dNewDate))

        SCO_DT_LAUNCH_EXAMPLE_JS_3 = numberstodate(DxYear(dNewDate),DxMonth(dNewDate),1)
        SCO_DT_LAUNCH_EXAMPLE_JS_4 = numberstodate(DxYear(dNewDate),DxMonth(dNewDate),daysofmonth(dNewDate))
        
    ElseIf SCO_PRES_CALC_TYPE = 2 or SCO_PRES_CALC_TYPE = 3 Then
    
        SCO_JS_FUR_CALC_DATES_OPTION = 3    
        SCO_DT_LAUNCH_EXAMPLE_JS_1 = Today()
        SCO_DT_LAUNCH_EXAMPLE_JS_2 = Today()-1

'SCO_CTRL_MAX_NUM_EMPL_ONLINE
'executed by SRCO_GTA_CALC_ACTIV_HR, before the calculation

'SCO_JS_EXECUTE_GTA_FROM_JS
'Execute the M4O from JS

'we put the param into properties
SCO_JS_GET_PARAM_FROM_JS(ARG_PARAM)

'we put the main variables that manage the flow
SCO_CHNG_CALC_TYPE()

'We control de execution date
If SCO_PRES_CALC_TYPE = 1 Then
    If SCO_JS_FUR_CALC_DATES_OPTION = 4 Then '4 -> Use the next month of the execution day
        dNewDate = DateAdd(Today(),1,M4_MONTH)
    ElseIf SCO_JS_FUR_CALC_DATES_OPTION = 5 Then '5 -> Use X months after the day of execution
        dNewDate = DateAdd(Today(),SCO_JS_FUR_NUM_MONTH,M4_MONTH)
    EndIf

    If dNewDate <> nullvalue() Then
        DT_START_P = numberstodate(DxYear(dNewDate),DxMonth(dNewDate),1)
        DT_END_P = numberstodate(DxYear(dNewDate),DxMonth(dNewDate),daysofmonth(dNewDate))
    EndIf

ElseIf SCO_PRES_CALC_TYPE = 2 or SCO_PRES_CALC_TYPE = 3 Then
    If SCO_JS_FUR_CALC_DATES_OPTION = 2 Then '2 -> Use the execution day
        DT_START_P = Today()
        DT_END_P = DT_START_P 
    ElseIf SCO_JS_FUR_CALC_DATES_OPTION = 3 Then '3 -> Use the previous day to the execution
        DT_START_P = Today()-1
        DT_END_P = DT_START_P
    EndIf
EndIf

'Is going to start a scheduled "times" calculation, of type %0:n between the dates %1:d and %2:d.

    sParam = Mid(sParam,IndexOf(sParam,sSep,0)+2,Length(sParam))    
    
Else

    'We loop over the rest of the string and create a syssentence
    sEmplString = Mid(sParam,0,IndexOf(sParam,sSep,0))

    If sEmplString <> "" Then
        
        sSentence = "FROM &SCO_HR_THEOR_TIME A WHERE "   
        sSentenceWhere = "(" 

        While sEmplString <> "" 

            sOneEmpl = Mid(sEmplString,0,IndexOf(sEmplString,sSepEmpl,0))
            
            If sSentenceWhere <> "(" Then sSentenceWhere = sSentenceWhere + " OR ( "
            sSentenceWhereThis = ""

            sIDHr = Mid(sOneEmpl,0,IndexOf(sOneEmpl,sSepItemsEmpl,0))
            sOneEmpl = Mid(sOneEmpl,IndexOf(sOneEmpl,sSepItemsEmpl,0)+2,Length(sOneEmpl))     
            If sIDHr <> "" Then 
                If sSentenceWhereThis <> "" Then sSentenceWhereThis = sSentenceWhereThis + " AND "
                sSentenceWhereThis = sSentenceWhereThis + " A.STD_ID_HR = '" + sIDHr + "' "
            EndIf
            
            sOrPer = Mid(sOneEmpl,0,IndexOf(sOneEmpl,sSepItemsEmpl,0))
            sOneEmpl = Mid(sOneEmpl,IndexOf(sOneEmpl,sSepItemsEmpl,0)+2,Length(sOneEmpl))              
            If sOrPer <> "" Then 
                If sSentenceWhereThis <> "" Then sSentenceWhereThis = sSentenceWhereThis + " AND "
                sSentenceWhereThis = sSentenceWhereThis + " A.STD_OR_HR_PERIOD = " + sOrPer + " "
            EndIf            

            dDtStart = ToDate(Mid(sOneEmpl,0,IndexOf(sOneEmpl,sSepItemsEmpl,0)))
            sOneEmpl = Mid(sOneEmpl,IndexOf(sOneEmpl,sSepItemsEmpl,0)+2,Length(sOneEmpl))              
            If dDtStart <> M4_MINUS_INF Then 
                If sSentenceWhereThis <> "" Then sSentenceWhereThis = sSentenceWhereThis + " AND "
                sSentenceWhereThis = sSentenceWhereThis + " A.DT_START = #TO_DATE('" + ToString(dDtStart,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT) + "') "
            EndIf   

            sSentenceWhere = sSentenceWhere + sSentenceWhereThis + ")"
            sEmplString = Mid(sEmplString,IndexOf(sEmplString,sSepEmpl,0)+2,Length(sEmplString))    
        WEnd
        
        sSentence = sSentence + sSentenceWhere 
        
        SYSSENTENCE_JS_SELECTED = sSentence 
        
    EndIf    

EndIf

'SCO_LOAD_EMPL_COUNTERS
'Load employee counters

SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.DESTROYBLOCK()

'Variables
dtStart = SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL
dtEnd   = SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL 

'1.- We have to to load all the counters in the period of calculation (plus the previous day)
sSentence = " FROM &SCO_V_VE_DETAILED_INFO A "
sSentence = sSentence + " WHERE ( ( A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0) ) " 
sParam = ToString(dtEnd) + "|" + ToString(dtStart-1)
bPutFinal = M4_FALSE

'2.- We have to load the previous values of the counters that we need to acumulate (to summ the previous values to the value calculated in each moment )
' the counters that we need to acumulate are in properties in SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF
' we need to calculate a diferent date for each type
If SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_WEEK_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM <> nullvalue() and SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_WEEK_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM <> "" Then
    dtWeekCounterToCum = dtStart - DayOfTheWeek(dtStart) 'previous week
    sSentence = sSentence + " OR ( A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_ID_VAR_ELEMENT IN (?(2,2000,0))  ) "
    sParam = sParam + "|" + ToString(dtEnd) + "|" + ToString(dtWeekCounterToCum) + "|" + SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_WEEK_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM      
    bPutFinal = M4_TRUE
EndIf

If SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_CYCLE_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM <> nullvalue() and SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_CYCLE_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM <> "" Then
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_CYCLES.SCO_FIND_CYCLE(SCO_ID_REF_MOD)
    nNumWeeksOfTheCycle = SCO_GTA_REF_W_MOD.Count()
    dtCycleCounterToCum = dtStart - DayOfTheWeek(dtStart) - (7 * (nNumWeeksOfTheCycle-1)) 'previous cycle
    sSentence = sSentence + " OR ( A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_ID_VAR_ELEMENT IN (?(2,2000,0))  ) "
    sParam = sParam + "|" + ToString(dtEnd) + "|" + ToString(dtCycleCounterToCum) + "|" + SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_CYCLE_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM      
    bPutFinal = M4_TRUE
EndIf

If SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_MONTH_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM <> nullvalue() and SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_MONTH_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM <> "" Then
    dtMonthCounterToCum =  dtStart - DxDay(dtEnd)  'previous month
    sSentence = sSentence + " OR ( A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_ID_VAR_ELEMENT IN (?(2,2000,0))  ) "
    sParam = sParam + "|" + ToString(dtEnd) + "|" + ToString(dtMonthCounterToCum) + "|" + SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_MONTH_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM      
    bPutFinal = M4_TRUE
EndIf

If SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_VE_PER_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM <> nullvalue() and SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_VE_PER_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM <> "" Then
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.Count() > 0 Then
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.Begin()
        dtVECounterToCum = SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.SCO_DT_START_DROITS_CLC -1 
        sSentence = sSentence + " OR ( A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_ID_VAR_ELEMENT IN (?(2,2000,0))  ) "
        sParam = sParam + "|" + ToString(dtEnd) + "|" + ToString(dtVECounterToCum) + "|" + SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_VE_PER_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM 
        bPutFinal = M4_TRUE
    EndIf
EndIf

If SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_YEAR_M_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM <> nullvalue() and SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_YEAR_M_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM <> "" Then
    dtYearMonthCounterToCum = DateAdd(dtStart,-1,M4_YEAR)-1 'one year before
    sSentence = sSentence + " OR ( A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_ID_VAR_ELEMENT IN (?(2,2000,0))  ) "
    sParam = sParam + "|" + ToString(dtEnd) + "|" + ToString(dtYearMonthCounterToCum) + "|" + SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_YEAR_M_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM 
    bPutFinal = M4_TRUE
EndIf

If SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_YEAR_W_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM <> nullvalue() and SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_YEAR_W_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM <> "" Then
    dtYearWCounterToCum = DateAdd(dtStart,-1,M4_YEAR)-1 'one year before
    sSentence = sSentence + " OR ( A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START <= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END >= ?(4,0,0) AND A.SCO_ID_VAR_ELEMENT IN (?(2,2000,0))  ) "
    sParam = sParam + "|" + ToString(dtEnd) + "|" + ToString(dtYearWCounterToCum) + "|" + SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_YEAR_W_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM 
    bPutFinal = M4_TRUE
EndIf

If bPutFinal = M4_TRUE Then sSentence = sSentence + ")"


SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SYS_SENTENCE = sSentence
SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SYS_PARAM = sParam

SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.Load_blk()

nMonth = DxMonth(dtCurStart)

    If nMonth = 1 Then nNewYear = nYear-1 Else nNewYear = nYear
    If nMonth = 1 Then nNewMonth = 12 Else nNewMonth = nMonth - 1

    If nMonth = 12 Then nNewMonth = 1 Else nNewMonth = nMonth + 1
