If SCO_GTA_CALC_COUNT!SCO_GTA_CALC_COUNT.Count()>0 Then
    SCO_GTA_CALC_COUNT!SCO_GTA_CALC_COUNT.Begin()
    SCO_COUNT_FILTER_2 = SCO_GTA_CALC_COUNT!SCO_GTA_CALC_COUNT.SCO_COUNT_FILTER
EndIf

Return(SCO_COUNT_FILTER_2)

'SRCO_CALL_INIT_APPLY_VALUE
'Call init apply value: general. One call for all the employees
SCO_LAST_MONTH_EXEC_APPVAL = ""
If SCO_P_APPLYVAL_DATA_FOR_VISUAL = M4_FALSE Then
    nRet = SCO_APPLYVAL_PERIOD!DMD_COMPONENTS_APPLICABLE.SCO_SYS_SENTENCE()
Else
    nRet = SCO_APPLYVAL_PERIOD!DMD_COMPONENTS_APPLICABLE.SCO_SYS_SENT_FOR_GTA_VISUALIZ()
EndIf
nRet = SCO_APPLYVAL_PERIOD!SCO_INTERMEDIATE_NODE_PERIOD.INITAPPLYVALUE(GTA_DMD,GTA_DMD_GROUP)

Return(nRet)

'SRCO_CALL_INIT_APPLY_VALUE
'Call init apply value: general. One call for all the employees
'--------------------------------
'--- Sobreescrito en España por que el aplicavalor es otro (no se puede mapear por que el nodo raiz se llama de modo diferente)
'--------------------------------

SCO_LAST_MONTH_EXEC_APPVAL = ""
If SCO_P_APPLYVAL_DATA_FOR_VISUAL = M4_FALSE Then
    nRet = SSP_APPLYVAL_PER!DMD_COMPONENTS_APPLICABLE.SCO_SYS_SENTENCE()
Else
    nRet = SSP_APPLYVAL_PER!DMD_COMPONENTS_APPLICABLE.SCO_SYS_SENT_FOR_GTA_VISUALIZ()
EndIf
nRet = SSP_APPLYVAL_PER!SSP_APPLYVALUE_PER.INITAPPLYVALUE(GTA_DMD,GTA_DMD_GROUP)

Return(nRet)

'Main method

StartCalc = ARG_DT_START
EndCalc = ARG_DT_END

'Calcul individuel ou non
If IsNull(ARG_ID_HR) = FALSE and IsNull(ARG_OR_HR_PERIOD) = FALSE Then
    CalcHrReg = GetCurrent()
EndIf

'Some controls
If SCO_FROM_JS <> 1 Then
    nbReg = SRCO_CALC_COUNT()
    If nbReg = 0 Then
        If SCO_SHOW_ALL_MESSAGES = 1 Then setlog(1,18,10,6)
        Return(0)
    EndIf
EndIf

'Control of maximum employees online (France)
SCO_CTRL_MAX_NUM_EMPL_ONLINE()

'To regenerate (by application param) the calendar (it can be long)
If RECALC_CALENDRIER = 1 Then
    AUX = "GTA : All calendars between " + FORMAT(StartCalc,0) + " and " + FORMAT(EndCalc,0) + "."
    SCO_CALC_CALENDAR!SCO_CALEN_PRO.SCO_NEW_CALENDAR(AUX,StartCalc,EndCalc,nullvalue())
EndIf

'Alerts definition and severity level load
If SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.Count()=0 Then
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.Load_prg()
EndIf
If SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.Count()=0 Then
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.Load_prg()
EndIf

'Counters definition load
SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_LOAD_COUNTER_DEF(StartCalc,EndCalc)
If SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_ERROR_IN_COUNTER_DEF = M4_TRUE Then
    Return(M4_ERROR)
EndIf

'Call to apply value: general. One call for all the employees
nRet = SRCO_CALL_INIT_APPLY_VALUE()

Begin()
NB_HR_CALC = 0
nEmplWithAlerts = 0
nEmplWithBlockingAlerts = 0
SCO_MAX_ALERT_STATUS_EMPL = 0

'Loop over employees cycle historic
'For i= 0 To nbReg-1
While IsEOF() = M4_FALSE
    'soit calcul de toute la population selectionnée
    'soit en lancement individuel sur le matricule en cours
    If IsNull(CalcHrReg) = M4_TRUE or CalcHrReg = GetCurrent() Then
               
        If SELECT_CALC = 1 then
        
            'Employee
            idHr     = STD_ID_HR
            orPeriod = STD_OR_HR_PERIOD
            SCO_LAST_MONTH_EXEC_APPVAL = "" : SCO_NUM_WEEK_HRS = nullvalue() : SCO_NUM_WEEK_UNIT = nullvalue()

            'Load the Max calc date of the employee
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.DESTROYBLOCK()
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.Load_blk()  
            
            'Automatic recalculation date
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.DESTROYBLOCK()
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.Load_blk()  
       
            'Calc the start and end day for calculation of this employee
            SCO_CALC_EMPL_CALC_DATES(StartCalc,EndCalc)

            'Load of table of time ("reak worked days")
            SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DESTROYBLOCK()
            SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_START_P = SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL
            SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_END_P = SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL
            SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.ID_HR_P = idHr
            SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.OR_HR_PERIOD_P = orPeriod
            SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.LOAD_BLK()

            'Only for employees that have a cycle with units (i.e. managed by days) if there are a change in the theoretical, we need to recalculate the theoretical hours of all the week
            ' remember that for this cycles the TT M4O calculate the hours using a weekly value. 
            ' So we need to recalculate from the beginning of the week until the end of the week
            ' We will do it if the first day to recalculate is a day with units
            If SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC = 1 Then
                If SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.Count() > 0 Then
                    SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.Begin()
                    If SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_ID_ENTER_TYPE = "2" Then 'units
                        
                        'we go to the start of the week (but not before the hire or change of cycle)
                        dStartWeek = SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL - DayOfTheWeek(SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL) + 1
                        'dNewStart = Max(dStartWeek,STD_DT_START_PER,DT_START)
                        dNewStart = Max(dStartWeek,STD_DT_START_PER)

                        'we go to the end of the week (but not after the termination or change of cycle)
                        dEndWeek = SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL + 7 - DayOfTheWeek(SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL)
                        'dNewEnd = Min(dEndWeek,STD_DT_END_PER,DT_END)
                        dNewEnd = Min(dEndWeek,STD_DT_END_PER)
                        
                        If SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL <> dNewStart or SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL <> dNewEnd Then
                            
                            SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL = dNewStart 
                            SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL   = dNewEnd 
                            'Load (again) of table of time ("reak worked days")
                            SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DESTROYBLOCK()
                            SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_START_P = SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL
                            SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_END_P = SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL
                            SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.ID_HR_P = idHr
                            SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.OR_HR_PERIOD_P = orPeriod
                            SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.LOAD_BLK()                            
                
                        EndIf
                    EndIf
                EndIf
            EndIf    
            
            
            'VE period load (if needed)
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.SCO_LOAD_VE_PER(SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL,SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL)            
            
            'Chargement des présences sur la période
            SRCO_GTA_PRESENCES.DESTROYBLOCK()
            SRCO_GTA_PRESENCES.DT_START_P = SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL
            SRCO_GTA_PRESENCES.DT_END_P = SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL
            SRCO_GTA_PRESENCES.Load_prg()
            
            'Chargement des absences sur la période
            SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.DESTROYBLOCK()
            SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.DT_START_P = DateAdd(SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL,-1, M4_MONTH) 'we load the absences of the previous month too, because we needed to know if there are a "suspension" absence in this period
            SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.DT_END_P = SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL + 1  'we load the absences of the next day of the end of the period too, because we needed to know if the end day of the period is the last day before a suspension
            SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.Load_prg()
            
            'Chargement des astreintes sur la période
            SCO_H_HR_PERIOD_DUTY.DESTROYBLOCK()
            SCO_H_HR_PERIOD_DUTY.DT_START_P = SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL
            SCO_H_HR_PERIOD_DUTY.DT_END_P= SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL
            SCO_H_HR_PERIOD_DUTY.Load_prg()
            
            'Load of the GTA data
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EMPL_GTA_DATA.DESTROYBLOCK()
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EMPL_GTA_DATA.SCO_DT_START_P = SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EMPL_GTA_DATA.SCO_DT_END_P = SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL            
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EMPL_GTA_DATA.Load_blk()
            
            'Load of the role data
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_HR_ROLE.DESTROYBLOCK()
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_HR_ROLE.SCO_DT_START_P = SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_HR_ROLE.SCO_DT_END_P = SCO_DT_END_CALC_EMPL
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_HR_ROLE.Load_blk()   
            
            'Load the frequency of pay of this employee
            If SCO_GTA_CALC_COUNT!SCO_GTA_CALC_COUNT.SCO_USE_PAY_FREQ_HIST() = 1 Then
                SCO_GTA_H_HR_PAY_F.DESTROYBLOCK()
                SCO_GTA_H_HR_PAY_F.Load_blk()
                If SCO_GTA_H_HR_PAY_F.Count() > 0 Then
                    SCO_GTA_H_HR_PAY_F.Begin()
                    SCO_EMPLOYEE_ID_PAY_FREQ = SCO_GTA_H_HR_PAY_F.SCO_ID_PAY_FREQUENCY
                EndIf
            EndIf            
            
            'Load the number of VE calculated by pay for this employee
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.DESTROYBLOCK()
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.Load_blk()   
            
            'Load the pays in the calculation period of the employee, by VE dates 
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAYS_BY_VE_DATES.DESTROYBLOCK()
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAYS_BY_VE_DATES.Load_blk()
            
            'Load employee counters
            SCO_LOAD_EMPL_COUNTERS()
                                   
            'Clean the Calc node
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_CALC.DESTROYBLOCK()
            
            '-- Vidage et chargement des noeuds de Lecture/ecriture des heures réelles par matricule
            SRCO_AUX_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DESTROYBLOCK()
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS_AUX.DESTROYBLOCK()          
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS_AUX.DESTROYBLOCK()    
                        
            '------------------------------------------------------------------------
            '------------------------- Employee calculation ------------------------- 
            nRet = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CALC.SRCO_CALC_EMPL()
            '------------------------------------------------------------------------ 
            '------------------------------------------------------------------------

            'Icon for max alert severity level of the employee
            sMaxAlertSevLevIcon = ""
            nMaxAlertSevLev = SCO_MAX_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL_EMPL 
            If nMaxAlertSevLev <> nullvalue() Then
                nEmplWithAlerts = nEmplWithAlerts + 1
                nRegAlSevLev = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.FindRegister("SCO_ID_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL",nMaxAlertSevLev,M4_EQUAL)
                If nRegAlSevLev <> M4_ERROR Then    
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.MoveTo(nRegAlSevLev)  
                    sMaxAlertSevLevIcon = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.SCO_RW_ICON
                EndIf          
            EndIf
            SCO_MAX_ALERT_SEV_LEV_EMPL_ICO = sMaxAlertSevLevIcon
            
            If SCO_MAX_ALERT_STATUS_EMPL > 0 Then nEmplWithBlockingAlerts = nEmplWithBlockingAlerts + 1

        Else
            CALCULATED = 0
            'setlog(M4_DEBUGINFOLOG,18,10,503,STD_ID_HR)
        EndIf
    'fin traitement individuel
    EndIf
    GoNext()
WEnd 'end of: Loop over employees cycle historic

If CalcHrReg <> nullvalue() Then MoveTo(CalcHrReg)

'End calculation message
'SCO_CALC_THEOR_TIME may generate warnings when the weekly hours doesn't come from the cycle but from ott or contract or ... or default.

bWarnings = M4_FALSE
bErrors = M4_FALSE
nLogSize = GetLogSize()
nIniLogSize = SCO_INI_LOG_SIZE 

If nLogSize > 0 Then

    nType = 0 
    nModule = 0 
    nSubModule = 0 
    nMessage = 0 
    sAdditionalText = ""
    
    For nIndex=nIniLogSize to nLogSize 

        GetLog(-1*nIndex, nType, nModule, nSubModule, nMessage, sAdditionalText)
       
        If nType = M4_WARNINGLOG Then 
            bWarnings = M4_TRUE 
        ElseIf nType = M4_ERRORLOG Then
            bErrors = M4_TRUE 
        EndIf     
    Next
        
'    nIndex = 1
'    Do 
'        GetLog(-1*nIndex, nType, nModule, nSubModule, nMessage, sAdditionalText)
'        
'        If nType = M4_WARNINGLOG Then 
'            bWarnings = M4_TRUE 
'        ElseIf nType = M4_ERRORLOG Then
'            bErrors = M4_TRUE 
'        EndIf  
'          
'        nIndex = nIndex + 1
'        
'    Until bErrors = M4_TRUE or nIndex > nLogSize    
EndIf  

If bWarnings = M4_FALSE and bErrors = M4_FALSE and SCO_SHOW_ALL_MESSAGES = 1 Then
    If nEmplWithAlerts = 0 Then
        setlog(M4_DEBUGINFOLOG,18,10,501,Tostring(NB_HR_CALC,0))'Le calcul s'est déroulé correctement. %0:n salariés calculés avec succès.
    ElseIf nEmplWithBlockingAlerts = 0 Then
        setlog(M4_DEBUGINFOLOG,18,10,511,Tostring(NB_HR_CALC,0))'... but with alerts
    Else
        setlog(M4_DEBUGINFOLOG,18,10,512,Tostring(NB_HR_CALC,0))'... but with bloquing alerts
    EndIf
Else

    If bErrors = M4_TRUE Then 

        If nEmplWithAlerts = 0 Then
            setlog(M4_ERRORLOG, 18, 10, 525, tostring(NB_HR_CALC, 0))'Le calcul s'est déroulé avec error. %0:n salariés calculés avec succès. Mais il y a des avertissements, consultez les détails.
        ElseIf nEmplWithBlockingAlerts = 0 Then
            setlog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,523,Tostring(NB_HR_CALC,0))'... but with alerts
        Else
            setlog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,524,Tostring(NB_HR_CALC,0))'... but with bloquing alerts
        EndIf    
        
    ElseIf SCO_SHOW_ALL_MESSAGES = 1 Then
        If nEmplWithAlerts = 0 Then
            setlog(M4_WARNINGLOG, 18, 40, 128, tostring(NB_HR_CALC, 0))'Le calcul s'est déroulé correctement. %0:n salariés calculés avec succès. Mais il y a des avertissements, consultez les détails.
        ElseIf nEmplWithBlockingAlerts = 0 Then
            setlog(M4_WARNINGLOG,18,10,513,Tostring(NB_HR_CALC,0))'... but with alerts
        Else
            setlog(M4_WARNINGLOG,18,10,514,Tostring(NB_HR_CALC,0))'... but with bloquing alerts
        EndIf 
    EndIf
EndIf    

SCO_NUM_EMPL_WITH_ALERTS = nEmplWithAlerts 
SCO_NUM_EMPL_WITH_BLOCK_ALERTS = nEmplWithBlockingAlerts 

If bErrors = M4_TRUE Then
    Return(M4_ERROR)
Else
    Return(M4_SUCCESS)
EndIf

If isnull(DT_END_P) = TRUE or isnull(DT_START_P) = TRUE then
    DT_START_P = numberstodate(DxYear(today()),DxMonth(today()),1)
    DT_END_P = numberstodate(DxYear(today()),DxMonth(today()),daysofmonth(today()))
    Setlog(1,18,10,174) '"Une ou plusieurs dates pour la consultation sont nulles.\nLe premier et le dernier jour du mois seront pris comme dates pour la consultation."
Else
    DT_START_P = ARG_DT_START
    DT_END_P = ARG_DT_END
EndIf

    
CalcHrReg = NullValue()

'Calcul individuel ou non
If IsNull(ARG_ID_HR) = FALSE and IsNull(ARG_OR_HR_PERIOD) = FALSE Then
    CalcHrReg = GetCurrent()
EndIf

'-- Bornes
dtStart = DT_START_P
dtEndMax = DT_END_P

nbReg = SRCO_CALC_COUNT()

If nbReg = 0 Then
    setlog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,6)
    return(0)
EndIf

Begin()

idHr     = STD_ID_HR
orPeriod = STD_OR_HR_PERIOD   

'Load of the GTA data
SRCO_GTA_RWD_EMPL_GTA_DATA.DESTROYBLOCK()
SRCO_GTA_RWD_EMPL_GTA_DATA.SCO_DT_START_P = ARG_DT_START
SRCO_GTA_RWD_EMPL_GTA_DATA.SCO_DT_END_P = ARG_DT_END
SRCO_GTA_RWD_EMPL_GTA_DATA.Load_blk()


'-- Chargement des heures réelles existantes sur la période
SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DESTROYBLOCK()

SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.ID_STATUS_P = 2
SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_START_P = ARG_DT_START
SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_END_P = ARG_DT_END
SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.ID_HR_P = idHr
SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.OR_HR_PERIOD_P = orPeriod
SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_VISUALIZATION = 1

SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.LOAD_BLK()
SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_REFRESH_ORIGIN()
return(0)

nRet = SCO_CONTROL_DATES(0)

If nRet <> M4_ERROR Then
    
    SCO_TA_WEEKDAY.DESTROYBLOCK()
    SCO_TA_WEEKDAY.LOAD_BLK()
    
    DESTROYBLOCK()
    SRCO_SYSSENTENCE_DEF(1)
    nRet = LOAD_BLK()
    
    If ARG_LOAD_FROM_PRES <> 0 Then
        SRCO_CALC_COUNT()
    
        'loop to transfer the registers to the node to the presentation (without partial load)
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_PRES.DESTROYBLOCK()
        Begin()
        While IsEOF() = M4_FALSE
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_PRES.AddRegister()
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_PRES.CopyRegister("","SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS",-1,M4_SCOPE_REGISTER + M4_TYPE_ALL,M4_SCOPE_REGISTER + M4_TYPE_ALL)
            GoNext()
        WEnd
        Begin()
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_PRES.CHECKPOINTBLOCK()
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_PRES.Begin()
    EndIf
    
    Begin()
EndIf

return(nRet)

'Load default values

'By default the present month
DT_START_P = numberstodate(DxYear(today()),DxMonth(today()),1)
DT_END_P = numberstodate(DxYear(today()),DxMonth(today()),daysofmonth(today()))

If ARG_FROM = "1" Then 'calculation

    'If there are a pay in the Session M4O
    SRCO_GTA_LOAD_SESSION_PAY.SCO_GTA_LOAD_SESSION_PAY()

    'Load the count of the filter
    'SRCO_CALC_COUNT_FILTER()

EndIf

'-- préparation du directSQL sur la table :
'-- Condition sur l'origine de l'enregistrement : 
'-- Seulement à supprimer les données d'origine 1 : Calculées par ce traitement
'-- On garde les enregistrements d'origine 2 : Modifiées par saisie

SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS = "DELETE SCO_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS A"
SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS = SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS + " WHERE A.DT_START <= @DT_END_P AND"
SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS = SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS + " A.DT_START >= @DT_START_P AND"
SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS = SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS + " A.ID_ORGANIZATION = @ID_ORGANIZATION AND"
SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS = SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS + " A.SCO_ID_ORIGIN = 1 AND"
SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS = SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS + " A.STD_ID_HR = @STD_ID_HR AND "
SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS = SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS + " A.STD_OR_HR_PERIOD = @STD_OR_HR_PERIOD "
'R&D 20100607 : Mantis 217 /Apres lancement du calcul de l'activité, le recalcul ne se faisait que sur la partie correspondante au dernier cycle sur la période.
SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS = SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS + " AND A.SCO_ID_REF_MOD = @SCO_ID_REF_MOD "
SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS = SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS + " AND A.SCO_OR_REF_MOD = @SCO_OR_REF_MOD "

return(0)

If SAVE_DATA = 1 Then 
    BeginDBTransaction()
    
    
    '----------------------------------------------------
    'R&D SCE 02/12/2010
    'mantis 3510 : 
    'we delete from the table M4SCO_GTA_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS exactly the lines that we want to insert,

    'SRCO_PREPARE_DELETE()
    'SRCO_DELETE_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS(0,1)        
    SCO_DEL_ACTIV.SCO_DEL_ACTIV()
    '----------------------------------------------------

    'Real worked days
    SRCO_AUX_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.INSERT_BLK()

    'Real time slots
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS_AUX.Persist_tree()

    'Alerts
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS_AUX.Persist_tree()    
    'SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS_AUX.SCO_SAVE_ALERTS()
    
    'Counters
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.Persist_tree()    
    
    'Max calc date of the employee
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.Persist_tree()    

    'Automatic recalculation date
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.Persist_tree()    
    
    'Number of VE calculated by pay
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.Persist_tree()    

    EndDBTransaction(COMMIT)
EndIf

return(0)

'SCO_CALC_HOURS_DAILY
'Calc hours daily
'Global rule

nbHrTheo = ARG_HR_THEO
nbAbsHr = 0


'Complete day (if not met the other conditions)
'The absence hours are the theoretical hours
nbAbsHr = nbHrTheo

'Half days
' Two options: half day incidence or incidence for more days that start or end in half day
If (SCO_CK_HALFDAY = "1" and  SCO_DT_START = SCO_DT_END) or (SCO_CK_HALFDAYS_BEGIN = "1" and ARG_D_FILTER = SCO_DT_START) or (SCO_CK_HALFDAYS_END = "1" and ARG_D_FILTER = SCO_DT_END)  Then
    nbAbsHr = Format(nbHrTheo/2,2)
EndIf

'Daily incidences without start and end hour, but in hours units (for employees without timeslots)
If SCO_DT_START = SCO_DT_END and SCO_START_TIME = nullvalue() and SCO_END_TIME = nullvalue() and SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT = "05" Then
    nbAbsHr = Min(SCO_UNITS,nbHrTheo)
EndIf

'Incidence with start and end hour
If SCO_DT_START = SCO_DT_END and SCO_START_TIME <> nullvalue() and SCO_END_TIME <> nullvalue() Then
    'By default: end time minus start time
    nbAbsHr = Min(Format(24 * (SCO_END_TIME - SCO_START_TIME), 2),nbHrTheo)

    'If the day type has time slots, we need to calculate the working hours, in global we don't store the working hours for all the incidences (there is only one field)
    'we check that we are in the correct day in the Calc node
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_CALC.GetCurrent() <> M4_ERROR Then
        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_CALC.SCO_DT_CUR = ARG_D_FILTER Then
        
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REFERENCE","","")
            nTheoTSCount = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()
            If nTheoTSCount > 0 Then
                'there are time slots, so we need to loop over them to take the intersection between time slots and incidence
                nbAbsHr = 0 
                
                For i=0 to nTheoTSCount-1
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)
                    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT < SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME and SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT > SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME Then
                        'nAbsDayTS = CommonTimestamp(SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT,SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT,SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME,SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME)
                        'nAbsHrTS  = 24 * nAbsDayTS 

                        nAbsHrTS = 0
                        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT < SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME and SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT > SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME Then
                            dtStartCommon = Max(SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT,SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME)
                            dtEndCommon   = Min(SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT,SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME)
                            nCommonMin    = DateDiff(dtStartCommon,dtEndCommon,M4_MINUTE)
                            nAbsHrTS      = nCommonMin/60
                        EndIf                                               
                        nbAbsHr   = nbAbsHr + nAbsHrTS
                    EndIf
                Next
            EndIf
        EndIf
    EndIf
EndIf

Return(nbAbsHr)

                        'nAbsHrTS  = 24 * nAbsDayTS 

                        nAbsHrTS = 0
                        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT < SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME and SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT > SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME Then
                            dtStartCommon = Max(SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT,SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME)
                            dtEndCommon   = Min(SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT,SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME)
                            nCommonMin    = DateDiff(dtStartCommon,dtEndCommon,M4_MINUTE)
                            nAbsHrTS      = nCommonMin/60
                        EndIf                                               
                        nbAbsHr   = nbAbsHr + nAbsHrTS
                    EndIf
                Next
            EndIf
        EndIf
    EndIf
EndIf

Return(nbAbsHr)

'SCO_FILL_DATE_AND_TIME_PRP
'Fill date and time properties

If SCO_START_TIME <> nullvalue() and SCO_END_TIME <> nullvalue() Then
    'Daily incidence
    dtStartInc = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(SCO_DT_START,SCO_START_TIME)
    dtEndInc = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(SCO_DT_START,SCO_END_TIME)

Else
    'Not daily
    dtStartInc = SCO_DT_START '00:00:00
    dtEndInc = SCO_DT_END + 1 'one day more

EndIf

SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME = dtStartInc 
SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME = dtEndInc 


//Num suspensions in period
If SCO_CK_CONTR_SUSP = "1" Then nIsSuspension = 1 Else nIsSuspension = 0
SCO_NUM_SUSPENSIONS_IN_PERIOD = SCO_NUM_SUSPENSIONS_IN_PERIOD + nIsSuspension

'SCO_FILL_HALF_DAY_TYPE
'

If SCO_CK_HALFDAY = "1" Then
    If SCO_CK_HALFDAYS_END = "1" Then
        SCO_HALF_DAY_TYPE = "01" 'morning
    Else
        SCO_HALF_DAY_TYPE = "02" 'afternoon
    EndIf
Else
    SCO_HALF_DAY_TYPE = nullvalue()
EndIf

'SRCO_CALC_HOURS
'Calculation of the hours of absence in a day
'Arguments fixed:
'  ARG_D_FILTER :Date. The day to filter
'  ARG_DT_START_FILTER: Date time. The date time when the day start (normally 00:00, but can change for night employees). Normally is the value of the field SCO_DT_START_OF_DAY
'  ARG_DT_END_FILTER: Date time. The date time when the day end (normally 00:00 of the next day, but can change for night employees). Normally is the value of the field SCO_DT_END_OF_DAY
'  ARG_HR_THEO: theoretical hours of the day
'  ARG_DAY_THEO: theoretical day of the day (for employees managed by days)
'Variable arguments: 
'  pairs ID property, value. If there are variable arguments, the method will sum only the incidences that have these properties with these values.
'  if there are one more argument at the end this means the default valur of the property if not exist a record for this incidence

'Variables and arguments
nbAbsHr = 0
nbAbsTotHr = 0
dFilter = ARG_D_FILTER 'Date
dtStartFilter = ARG_DT_START_FILTER 'Date time
dtEndFilter = ARG_DT_END_FILTER 'Date time
nbHrTheo = ARG_HR_THEO
nDayTheo = ARG_DAY_THEO

'Loop over the absences
Begin()
nRegister = FindRegister("SCO_DT_START",dFilter+1,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END",dFilter-1,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
While nRegister <> -1
    MoveTo(nRegister)
    nNumArg = GetArgumentNumber()
    nNumVarArg = nNumArg - 5
    
    'First we check if we need to process the incidence or not: Incidence by hours or days and Filter by properties
    bProcessInc = M4_FALSE  
    If IsNull(SCO_END_TIME) = FALSE and IsNull(SCO_START_TIME) = FALSE Then
        'Incidence by hours: the incidence must be into the start and end time
        If SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME < dtEndFilter and SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME > dtStartFilter Then bProcessInc = M4_TRUE 
        
    Else
        'Incidence by days: the day incidence must be in the filter day
        If SCO_DT_START <= dFilter and SCO_DT_END >= dFilter Then bProcessInc = M4_TRUE 
    EndIf
    
    'Filter by properties
    If nNumVarArg > 0 and bProcessInc = M4_TRUE Then
        
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_INCIDENCE.SCO_FIND_INCIDENCE(SCO_ID_INCIDENCE)
        i=6

        sDefValue = ""
        If Div(nNumArg,2) = 0 Then 'if the total number if even then the last argument is the default value
            sDefValue = GetArgument(nNumArg)
            nNumArg = nNumArg - 1
        EndIf
        
        While i<=nNumArg 
            If Div(i,2)= 0 Then sIDProperty = GetArgument(i) 'if is even is the ID propery
            If Div(i,2)<> 0 Then 'if is odd is the value
                sValueProperty = GetArgument(i) 
                
                nRegIncProp = SRCO_GTA_RWD_INC_PROP.FindRegister("SCO_ID_PROPERTY",sIDProperty,M4_EQUAL)
                If nRegIncProp = M4_ERROR Then 
                    'there are not register, we use the default value               
                    sValueOfThePropInInc = sDefValue 
                Else
                    'we take the value
                    sValueOfThePropInInc = SRCO_GTA_RWD_INC_PROP[nRegIncProp].SCO_PROPERTY_VALUE
                EndIf
                
                If sValueOfThePropInInc <> sValueProperty Then
                    bProcessInc = M4_FALSE
                    i=nNumArg
                EndIf
            EndIf
            i = i + 1
        WEnd                
    EndIf

    'We process the absence
    If bProcessInc = M4_TRUE Then
        nbAbsHr = 0
        nbAbsHr = SCO_CALC_HOURS_DAILY(nbHrTheo,dFilter)
        'we sum if there are more than one absence in the same day
        nbAbsTotHr = nbAbsTotHr + nbAbsHr
    EndIf
    
    'Find the next register
    nRegister = FindRegister("SCO_DT_START",dFilter+1,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END",dFilter-1,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,nRegister+1)
Wend 'end of: Loop over the absences

'Control: no more than 24 hours
nbAbsTotHr = Min(nbAbsTotHr,24)

'We calc the incidence in days:
If nbHrTheo <> 0 and nDayTheo <> nullvalue() Then
    SCO_INC_DAY = (nbAbsTotHr * nDayTheo) / nbHrTheo
Else
    SCO_INC_DAY = 0
EndIf

return(nbAbsTotHr)

'SCO_CALC_HOURS_DAILY
'Calc hours daily
'Global rule

nbHrTheo = ARG_HR_THEO
nbPresHr = 0


'Complete day (if not met the other conditions)
'The absence hours are the theoretical hours
nbPresHr = nbHrTheo

'Half days
' Two options: half day incidence or incidence for more days that start or end in half day
If (SCO_CK_HALFDAY = "1" and  SCO_DT_START = SCO_DT_END) or (SCO_CK_HALFDAYS_BEGIN = "1" and ARG_D_FILTER = SCO_DT_START) or (SCO_CK_HALFDAYS_END = "1" and ARG_D_FILTER = SCO_DT_END)  Then
    nbPresHr = Truncate(nbHrTheo/2,2)
EndIf

'Incidence by hours
If SCO_DT_START = SCO_DT_END and SCO_START_TIME <> nullvalue() and SCO_END_TIME <> nullvalue() Then
    'end time minus start time
    nbPresHr = Truncate(24 * (SCO_END_TIME - SCO_START_TIME), 2)

ElseIf SCO_DT_START = SCO_DT_END and SCO_ID_TIME_UNIT = "05" Then
    'if the user has write the hours directly in the units field
    nbPresHr = SCO_UNITS
EndIf

Return(nbPresHr)

'SCO_FILL_DATE_AND_TIME_PRP
'Fill date and time properties

If SCO_START_TIME <> nullvalue() and SCO_END_TIME <> nullvalue() Then
    'Daily incidence
    dtStartInc = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(SCO_DT_START,SCO_START_TIME)
    dtEndInc = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(SCO_DT_START,SCO_END_TIME)

Else
    'Not daily
    dtStartInc = SCO_DT_START '00:00:00
    dtEndInc = SCO_DT_END + 1 'one day more

EndIf

SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME = dtStartInc 
SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME = dtEndInc

'SCO_FILL_HALF_DAY_TYPE
'

If SCO_CK_HALFDAY = "1" Then
    If SCO_CK_HALFDAYS_END = "1" Then
        SCO_HALF_DAY_TYPE = "01" 'morning
    Else
        SCO_HALF_DAY_TYPE = "02" 'afternoon
    EndIf
Else
    SCO_HALF_DAY_TYPE = nullvalue()
EndIf

'SRCO_CALC_HOURS
'Calculation of the hours of presences in a day
'  ARG_D_FILTER :Date. The day to filter
'  ARG_DT_START_FILTER: Date time. The date time when the day start (normally 00:00, but can change for night employees). Normally is the value of the field SCO_DT_START_OF_DAY
'  ARG_DT_END_FILTER: Date time. The date time when the day end (normally 00:00 of the next day, but can change for night employees). Normally is the value of the field SCO_DT_END_OF_DAY
'  ARG_HR_THEO: theoretical hours of the day


'-- init des variables
nbAbsHr = 0
nbAbsTotHr = 0
dFilter = ARG_D_FILTER 'Date
dtStartFilter = ARG_DT_START_FILTER 'Date time
dtEndFilter = ARG_DT_END_FILTER 'Date time
nbHrTheo = ARG_HR_THEO

Begin()
nRegister = FindRegister("SCO_DT_START",dFilter+1,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END",dFilter-1,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
While nRegister <> -1
    MoveTo(nRegister)
    
    bProcessInc = M4_FALSE
    
    If IsNull(SCO_END_TIME) = FALSE and IsNull(SCO_START_TIME) = FALSE Then
        'Incidence by hours: the incidence must be into the start and end time
        If SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME <= dtEndFilter and SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME >= dtStartFilter Then bProcessInc = M4_TRUE 
        
    Else
        'Incidence by days: the day incidence must be in the filter day
        If SCO_DT_START <= dFilter and SCO_DT_END >= dFilter Then bProcessInc = M4_TRUE 
    EndIf

    'We process the presence
    If bProcessInc = M4_TRUE Then
        nbAbsHr = 0
        nbAbsHr = SCO_CALC_HOURS_DAILY(nbHrTheo,dFilter)
        'we sum if there are more than one absence in the same day
        nbAbsTotHr = nbAbsTotHr + nbAbsHr
    EndIf
    
    'Find the next register
    nRegister = FindRegister("SCO_DT_START",dFilter+1,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END",dFilter-1,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,nRegister+1)
Wend

'Control: no more than 24 hours
nbAbsTotHr = Min(nbAbsTotHr,24)

'We calc the incidence in days:
If nbHrTheo <> 0 Then
    SCO_INC_DAY = nbAbsTotHr/nbHrTheo
Else
   SCO_INC_DAY = nbHrTheo
EndIf

return(nbAbsTotHr)

M4RCH_RULES3/ID_TI/SRCO_GTA_RWD_CALC.SOURCE_CODE:
'SCO_AL_CLOCK_IN_ABS
'Alert: clock in/out over absence
'We look if there is an overlapping between clocking and absences
'Also, if there are odd clock, we check if the last clock is over an absence (so we don't need to wait to the next clock to know that there is a problem)
'Note: we use the real clock, not the effective

nCur = SCO_DT_CUR
nError = M4_FALSE    
nNumClockInPer = 0
sStringClockInPer = ""

dtClockIn = M4_MINUS_INF
dtClockOut = M4_MINUS_INF  

For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.Count()-1
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.Moveto(i)

    nClockCurRec = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.GetCurrent()                
    If Div(nClockCurRec+1,2) <> 0 Then 
        'If we are in a odd record
        If nClockCurRec <> SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.Count()-1 Then
            'and it is not the last one register
            'we only take the in date and time and go to the next register
            dtClockIn = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
        Else
            'and it is the last register
            'we control if this clock is over an absence
            
            dtClock = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
            nRegAbs = SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.FindRegister("SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME",dtClock,M4_SMALLER,"SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME",dtClock,M4_GREATER)
            If nRegAbs <> M4_ERROR Then
                SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.Moveto(nRegAbs)
                sNMInc = SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.SCO_NM_INCIDENCE
        
                nNumClockInPer = nNumClockInPer + 1
                If sStringClockInPer <> "" Then sStringClockInPer = sStringClockInPer + ", "
                sStringClockInPer = sStringClockInPer + SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_HOUR_TO_STRING(dtClock) + " (" + sNMInc + ")"
            EndIf           
        EndIf
    Else
        'If we are in a even record
        'we take the out date and time and we do the control
        dtClockOut = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR

        nRegAbs = SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.FindRegister("SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME",dtClockOut,M4_SMALLER,"SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME",dtClockIn,M4_GREATER)
        If nRegAbs <> M4_ERROR Then
            SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.Moveto(nRegAbs)
            sNMInc = SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.SCO_NM_INCIDENCE
    
            nNumClockInPer = nNumClockInPer + 1
            If sStringClockInPer <> "" Then sStringClockInPer = sStringClockInPer + ", "
            sStringClockInPer = sStringClockInPer + SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_HOUR_TO_STRING(dtClockIn) + "-" + SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_HOUR_TO_STRING(dtClockOut) + " (" + sNMInc + ")"
        EndIf            
    EndIf

Next

If nNumClockInPer > 0 Then 
    nError = M4_TRUE
    If SCO_EMPL_DECLARATIVE = 1 Then 
        sClockDec = GetNodeItemData(GetThisNodeId(),"SCO_LBL_DECLARATION",M4_ITEM_NAME)
    Else
        sClockDec = GetNodeItemData(GetThisNodeId(),"SCO_LBL_CLOCK",M4_ITEM_NAME)
    EndIf    
EndIf
SCO_SET_ALERT("SCO_AL_CLOCK_IN_ABS",SCO_AL_CLOCK_IN_ABS,nError,"Arg1",ToString(nNumClockInPer,0),"Arg2",sStringClockInPer,"Arg3",sClockDec)

'SCO_AL_CLOCK_IN_FIX
'Alert: clock in/out in fixed slot (but not in tolerance part)
'For each fixed time slot we try to find clock in/out into it
'Note: we use the real clock, not the effective

nCur = SCO_DT_CUR
nError = M4_FALSE    
nNumClockInPer = 0
sStringClockInPer = ""

'We loop the theoretical fixed time slot
SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REAL","FIXED",M4_EQUAL)
For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()-1
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)

    'We take the tolerance period for this time slot
    nNumMinTolInBef = 0
    nNumMinTolInAft = 0
    nNumMinTolOutBef = 0
    nNumMinTolOutAft = 0        
    
    If SCO_TOLE_IB <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolInBef = SCO_TOLE_IB
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_IB <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolInBef = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_IB 
    
    If SCO_TOLE_IA <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolInAft = SCO_TOLE_IA 
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_IA <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolInAft = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_IA 
    
    If SCO_TOLE_OB <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolOutBef = SCO_TOLE_OB 
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_OB <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolOutBef = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_OB 
    
    If SCO_TOLE_OA <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolOutAft = SCO_TOLE_OA
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_OA <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolOutAft = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_OA


    dtTheoStart = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT                
    dtTheoEnd = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT                   
    
    'Period of the fixed time slot without the tolerance
    dtStartPer = DateAdd(dtTheoStart,nNumMinTolInAft ,M4_MINUTE)
    dtEndPer   = DateAdd(dtTheoEnd ,-nNumMinTolOutBef,M4_MINUTE)

    'we have to loop over the clock in the tolerance period
    nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtStartPer,M4_GREATER,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtEndPer,M4_SMALLER)
    nFirstInFound = M4_FALSE
    While nRegClockInPer <> M4_ERROR

        SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.MoveTo(nRegClockInPer)
        dtClock = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR

        nNumClockInPer = nNumClockInPer + 1
        If sStringClockInPer <> "" Then sStringClockInPer = sStringClockInPer + ", "
        sStringClockInPer = sStringClockInPer + SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_HOUR_TO_STRING(dtClock)

        nRegClockInPer = nRegClockInPer + 1
        nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtStartPer,M4_GREATER,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtEndPer,M4_SMALLER,nRegClockInPer)
    WEnd

Next 'end if: We loop the theoretical fixed time slot

If nNumClockInPer > 0 Then 
    nError = M4_TRUE

    If SCO_EMPL_DECLARATIVE = 1 Then 
        sClockDec = GetNodeItemData(GetThisNodeId(),"SCO_LBL_DECLARATION",M4_ITEM_NAME)
    Else
        sClockDec = GetNodeItemData(GetThisNodeId(),"SCO_LBL_CLOCK",M4_ITEM_NAME)
    EndIf
EndIf

SCO_SET_ALERT("SCO_AL_CLOCK_IN_FIX",SCO_AL_CLOCK_IN_FIX,nError,"Arg1",ToString(nNumClockInPer,0),"Arg2",sStringClockInPer,"Arg3",sClockDec)

'SCO_AL_CLOCK_IN_FOB
'Alert: clock in/out in slots forbidden
'For each clock we look if it is in a forbidden slots
'Note: we use the real clock, not the effective

GTA_FORB_TS_TP = "FORBIDDEN"
nCur = SCO_DT_CUR
nError = M4_FALSE    
nNumClockInPer = 0
sStringClockInPer = ""

SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REAL","ALL","")

nThTsCount = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()

If nThTsCount > 0 Then

    For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.Count()-1
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.Moveto(i)
        dtClock = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
    
        nRegThTSForb = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.FindRegister("SCO_DT_STARTS_AT",dtClock,M4_SMALLER,"SCO_DT_ENDS_AT",dtClock,M4_GREATER,"SCO_ID_TIMESLOT_TYPE",GTA_FORB_TS_TP,M4_EQUAL )
    
        If nRegThTSForb <> M4_ERROR  Then 
            nNumClockInPer = nNumClockInPer + 1
            If sStringClockInPer <> "" Then sStringClockInPer = sStringClockInPer + ", "
            sStringClockInPer = sStringClockInPer + SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_HOUR_TO_STRING(dtClock)    
        EndIf
    
    Next

EndIf

If nNumClockInPer > 0 Then 
    nError = M4_TRUE

    If SCO_EMPL_DECLARATIVE = 1 Then 
        sClockDec = GetNodeItemData(GetThisNodeId(),"SCO_LBL_DECLARATION",M4_ITEM_NAME)
    Else
        sClockDec = GetNodeItemData(GetThisNodeId(),"SCO_LBL_CLOCK",M4_ITEM_NAME)
    EndIf       
EndIf

SCO_SET_ALERT("SCO_AL_CLOCK_IN_FORB",SCO_AL_CLOCK_IN_FORB,nError,"Arg1",ToString(nNumClockInPer,0),"Arg2",sStringClockInPer,"Arg3",sClockDec)

'SCO_AL_CLOCK_IN_TOL
'Alert: clock in/out in tolerance slot
'For each tolerance slot we try to find clock in/out into it
'Note: we use the real clock, not the effective

nCur = SCO_DT_CUR
nError = M4_FALSE    
nNumClockInPer = 0
sStringClockInPer = ""

'We loop the theoretical fixed time slot
SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REAL","FIXED",M4_EQUAL)
For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()-1
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)

    'We take the tolerance period for this time slot
    nNumMinTolInBef = 0
    nNumMinTolInAft = 0
    nNumMinTolOutBef = 0
    nNumMinTolOutAft = 0        
    
    If SCO_TOLE_IB <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolInBef = SCO_TOLE_IB
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_IB <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolInBef = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_IB 
    
    If SCO_TOLE_IA <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolInAft = SCO_TOLE_IA 
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_IA <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolInAft = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_IA 
    
    If SCO_TOLE_OB <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolOutBef = SCO_TOLE_OB 
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_OB <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolOutBef = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_OB 
    
    If SCO_TOLE_OA <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolOutAft = SCO_TOLE_OA

    'Start tolerance period
    If nNumMinTolInBef <> 0 or nNumMinTolInAft <> 0 Then
    
        dtTheoDate = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT                
        dtStartPer = DateAdd(dtTheoDate,-nNumMinTolInBef,M4_MINUTE)
        dtEndPer   = DateAdd(dtTheoDate, nNumMinTolInAft,M4_MINUTE)

        'we have to loop over the clock in the tolerance period
        nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtStartPer,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtEndPer,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL)
        nFirstInFound = M4_FALSE
        While nRegClockInPer <> M4_ERROR

            SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.MoveTo(nRegClockInPer)
            dtClock = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR

            nNumClockInPer = nNumClockInPer + 1
            If sStringClockInPer <> "" Then sStringClockInPer = sStringClockInPer + ", "
            sStringClockInPer = sStringClockInPer + SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_HOUR_TO_STRING(dtClock)

            nRegClockInPer = nRegClockInPer + 1
            nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtStartPer,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtEndPer,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,nRegClockInPer)
        WEnd
    EndIf 'end of: Start tolerance period


    'End tolerance period
    If nNumMinTolOutBef <> 0 or nNumMinTolOutAft <> 0 Then

        dtTheoDate = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT        
        dtStartPer = DateAdd(dtTheoDate,-nNumMinTolOutBef,M4_MINUTE)
        dtEndPer   = DateAdd(dtTheoDate, nNumMinTolOutAft,M4_MINUTE)

        'we have to loop over the clock in the tolerance period
        nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtStartPer,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtEndPer,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL)
        nFirstInFound = M4_FALSE
        While nRegClockInPer <> M4_ERROR
        
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.MoveTo(nRegClockInPer)
            dtClock = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR

            nNumClockInPer = nNumClockInPer + 1
            If sStringClockInPer <> "" Then sStringClockInPer = sStringClockInPer + ", "
            sStringClockInPer = sStringClockInPer + SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_HOUR_TO_STRING(dtClock)
            
            nRegClockInPer = nRegClockInPer + 1
            nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtStartPer,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtEndPer,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,nRegClockInPer)
        WEnd

    EndIf 'end of: End tolerance period

Next 'end if: We loop the theoretical fixed time slot

sSepList = "#"

    'loop over the diferent list of forbidden day sequence
    Do 
        nPosSepList = IndexOf(sListForbDaySeq,sSepList,0)
        If nPosSepList <> M4_ERROR Then 
            sCurList = Mid(sListForbDaySeq,0,nPosSepList)
            sListForbDaySeq = Mid(sListForbDaySeq,nPosSepList+1,length(sListForbDaySeq))
        Else
            sCurList = sListForbDaySeq
            sListForbDaySeq = ""
        EndIf
        
        'loop over the days types to check it, from the end to the begining
        i=0
        nMatchNum = 0
        sCurListIni = sCurList 
        Do 
            nPosSepDay = LastIndexOf(sCurList,sSepDays)
            If nPosSepDay <> M4_ERROR Then 
                sDayType = Mid(sCurList,nPosSepDay+1,length(sCurList))
                sCurList = Mid(sCurList,0,nPosSepDay)
            Else
                sDayType = sCurList
                sCurList = ""
            EndIf
            
            SCO_LOAD_MORE_DAYS(-i)
            nCurDayType = nullvalue()
            If GetCurrent()-i >=0 Then
                nCurDayType = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CALC[GetCurrent()-i].SCO_ID_DAY_TYPE
            EndIf
            If nCurDayType = sDayType Then nMatchNum = nMatchNum + 1
    
            i=i+1
            If nMatchNum <> i Then sCurList = ""
        Until sCurList = ""     'end of :loop over the days types to check it
        
        If i = nMatchNum Then 
            'Error!!
            nError = M4_TRUE
            sSeqOfDaysToShowInMsg = sCurListIni
            sListForbDaySeq = ""
        EndIf
        
    Until sListForbDaySeq = ""  'end of :loop over the diferent list of forbidden day sequence

EndIf

'SCO_AUTO_RECALC_OP_AFT_CALC_EM
'Automatic recalculation operations after calc employee
' 1.- We calculate the Max calc date of engine calculation of the employee
' 2.- If we are not in automatic recalculation, we detect if we have to save a automatic recalculation (if the max date calculated this time is smaller than the maximum date calculated ever for this employee)
' 3.- If this is a automatic recalculation (and there are not previous error), we have to save that the recalculation has been made, in order to not executed again
' 4.- Variable elements (VE): If this is a recalculation of a period of time that has been transferred to payroll, we have to save a automatic recalculation for the VE transfer, but in this case using the start of the recalculation

dMaxDtCalculatedNow = ARG_MAX_DT_CALC_NOW
bPrevError = ARG_PREV_ERROR
bIsClockEjec = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_CLOCK_INOUT_EXEC 

If dMaxDtCalculatedNow <> nullvalue() Then 
    
    
    '1.- Max calc date of calculation of the employee
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.Count()>0 Then
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.Begin()
        If bIsClockEjec = 1 Then
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.SCO_MAX_CALC_CLOCK_DATE = Max(dMaxDtCalculatedNow,SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.SCO_MAX_CALC_CLOCK_DATE)
        Else
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.SCO_MAX_CALC_THEO_DATE = Max(dMaxDtCalculatedNow,SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.SCO_MAX_CALC_THEO_DATE)    
        EndIf
    Else 
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.AddRegister()
        If bIsClockEjec = 1 Then
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.SCO_MAX_CALC_CLOCK_DATE = dMaxDtCalculatedNow
        Else
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.SCO_MAX_CALC_THEO_DATE = dMaxDtCalculatedNow    
        EndIf
    EndIf
    
    If bIsClockEjec = 1 Then dtMaxCalcDate = SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.SCO_MAX_CALC_CLOCK_DATE Else dtMaxCalcDate = SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.SCO_MAX_CALC_THEO_DATE 
    
    
    '2.- Calc the date of recalculation of the employee, if needed
    If SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_AUTOMATIC_RECALCULATION = 0 Then 'this is not a automatic recalculation
        'if the max date calculated this time is smaller than the maximum date calculated ever for this employee, we need to recalculate this dates in the automatic recalculation
        ' or if there are alerts of counters offline: ????????????? hacer?
        If dMaxDtCalculatedNow < dtMaxCalcDate Then
            
            If bIsClockEjec = 1 Then 
                sRecType = "GTA_ENGINE_CLOCK" 
            ElseIf SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_HR_THEO = 1 or SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC = 1  Then 
                sRecType = "GTA_ENGINE_THEO"
            ElseIf SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_ABS = 1 or SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_PRES = 1 Then
                sRecType = "GTA_ENGINE_INC"        
            EndIf
            
            nRegRecal = SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.Findregister("SCO_RECALC_TYPE",sRecType,M4_EQUAL)
            If nRegRecal = M4_ERROR Then
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.Addregister()
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_DATE_TO_RECALC = dMaxDtCalculatedNow + 1
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_RECALC_TYPE = sRecType 
            Else
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.MoveTo(nRegRecal)
                If SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_IS_RECALCULATED = 0 Then
                    dNewRecalcDate = Min(SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_DATE_TO_RECALC,dMaxDtCalculatedNow + 1)
                Else
                    dNewRecalcDate = dMaxDtCalculatedNow + 1
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_IS_RECALCULATED = 0
                EndIf
                
                If dNewRecalcDate <> SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_DATE_TO_RECALC Then
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.DeleteRegister()
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.CLONEREGISTER()
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SETINSERTED()
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_DATE_TO_RECALC = dNewRecalcDate 
                EndIf
            EndIf
                            
        EndIf
    EndIf 'end of: 'this is not a recalculation
    
    '3.- If this is a automatic recalculation (and there are not previous error), we have to save that the recalculation has been made, in order to not executed again
    If bPrevError <> M4_ERROR and SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_AUTOMATIC_RECALCULATION = 1 Then
    
        'We mark all the registers of recalculation
        For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.Count()-1
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.MoveTo(i)
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_IS_RECALCULATED = 1
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_RECALC_DATE = TodayNow()
        Next
    EndIf
    
    '4.- Variable elements (VE): If this is a recalculation of a period of time that has been transferred to payroll, we have to save a automatic recalculation for the VE transfer
    ' but in this case using the start of the recalculation
    
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.Count()>0 Then
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.Begin()
        dtStartCalculatedNow = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_DT_START_CALC_EMPL
        dMaxDtVETrans = SRCO_GTA_RWD_MAX_CALC_DATE.SCO_MAX_VE_TRANS_DATE
        If dtStartCalculatedNow < dMaxDtVETrans and dMaxDtVETrans <> nullvalue() Then
        
            'we have to save an automatic recalculation for the VE transfer 
            sRecType = "VE_TRANSFER"
            nRegRecal = SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.Findregister("SCO_RECALC_TYPE",sRecType,M4_EQUAL)
            If nRegRecal = M4_ERROR Then
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.Addregister()
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_DATE_TO_RECALC = dtStartCalculatedNow + 1
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_RECALC_TYPE = sRecType 
            Else
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.MoveTo(nRegRecal)
                If SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_IS_RECALCULATED = 0 Then
                    dNewRecalcDate = Min(SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_DATE_TO_RECALC,dtStartCalculatedNow + 1)
                Else
                    dNewRecalcDate = dtStartCalculatedNow + 1
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_IS_RECALCULATED = 0
                EndIf
                
                If dNewRecalcDate <> SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_DATE_TO_RECALC Then
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.DeleteRegister()
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.CLONEREGISTER()
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SETINSERTED()
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.SCO_DATE_TO_RECALC = dNewRecalcDate 
                EndIf
            EndIf
        EndIf
    EndIf

EndIf

'SCO_C_CLOCK_LUNCH_DF
'Counter description: Sum of the delays and overflows on the lunch time
'For each fixed time slot we try to find clock in/out into it
'Note: we use the real clock, not the effective
'Important note: here we suposse that the odd clock are clock in and the even clock are clock out !!!!!!!!!!
' This is executed only in a clock out or after the day

dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
nError = M4_FALSE    
nNumClockInPer = 0
nNumClockInPer2 = 0
nCounter = 0

RealLunchTime = 0
RealLunchStart = 0
RealLunchEnd = 0
DiffLunchTime = 0

If SCO_ACT_C_CLOCK_LUNCH_DF = "1" Then 'if the counter is activated by the user and if is the proper day depending in the storage periodicity (example, Sunday for a weekly counter)

    'Counter code: fill the nCounter variable with the today value of the counter
    'SCO_EMPL_CLOCK_OR_DECLARATIVE?
    If SCO_EMPL_CLOCK_INOUT = 1 Then
    
        'We loop the theoretical fixed time slot
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REAL","BREAKFAST",M4_EQUAL)
        nTheorTS = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()
        nClockEf = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.Count()
        
        'if there are lunch theor ts and clock info and the number of clock are even
        If nTheorTS > 0 and nClockEf > 0 and Div(nClockEf,2) = 0 Then

            For i=0 to nTheorTS-1 
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)
                
                ' Time slots of lunch
                dtTheoStart = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT
                dtTheoEnd   = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT
                
                nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheoEnd,M4_SMALLER)

                While nRegClockInPer <> M4_ERROR
                
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.MoveTo(nRegClockInPer)
                    dtClock = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
                    
                    'this is an end of timeslot
                    If Div(nRegClockInPer,2) <> 0 Then 
                        RealLunchStart = dtClock
                        
                        nRegClockInPer2 = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",RealLunchStart,M4_GREATER)
                        If nRegClockInPer2 <> M4_ERROR Then
                            SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.MoveTo(nRegClockInPer2)
                            dtClock = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
                                      
                            'this is a start
                            RealLunchEnd = dtClock
                            If dtTheoStart < RealLunchEnd Then
                                RealLunchTime = RealLunchTime + SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(RealLunchStart,RealLunchEnd)
                            EndIf
                        EndIf
                    EndIf

                    nRegClockInPer = nRegClockInPer + 1
                    nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheoEnd,M4_SMALLER,nRegClockInPer)
                WEnd
            Next 'end if: We loop the theoretical fixed time slot

        EndIf

        nCounter = RealLunchTime - SCO_REAL_LUNCH_HRS(2)
        
        nCounter = SCO_C_CLOCK_LUNCH_DF + nCounter 'to sum the previous value, depending in the intialization periodicity 
    EndIf

EndIf
Return(nCounter)

                'we have to loop over the clock in the fixed period -> AVANCE
                If dtPreviousTheoEnd = 0 Then

                EndIf
                nFirstInFound = M4_FALSE
                While nRegClockInPer <> M4_ERROR
            
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.MoveTo(nRegClockInPer)
                    dtClock = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
            			
                    ' Compare the first clock, the "last" smaller_or_equal
                    If Div(nRegClockInPer+1,2)<> 0 Then OverflowBeforeWhile = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtClock, dtTheoStart)
        
                    nRegClockInPer = nRegClockInPer + 1
                    If dtPreviousTheoEnd = 0 Then
                        nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheoStart,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,nRegClockInPer)
                    Else
                        nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtPreviousTheoEnd,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheoStart,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,nRegClockInPer)
                    EndIf
                WEnd
                If OverflowBeforeWhile > 0 Then OverflowBeforeFor = OverflowBeforeFor + OverflowBeforeWhile 
                dtPreviousTheoEnd = dtTheoEnd
        
                ' Search overflow after outclock -> DEBORDEMENT 
                If (i + 1) <= (nTheorTS - 1) Then
                    i = i + 1
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)
                    dtNextTheoStart = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT
                    i = i - 1
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)
                    dtTheoStart = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT
                    dtTheoEnd   = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT
                Else
                    dtNextTheoStart = 0
                EndIf
    
                'we have to loop over the clock in the fixed period
                If dtNextTheoStart = 0 Then
                    nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheoEnd,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
                Else
                    nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheoEnd,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtNextTheoStart,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL)
                EndIf
                nFirstInFound = M4_FALSE
    
                While nRegClockInPer <> M4_ERROR
    	
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.MoveTo(nRegClockInPer)
                    dtClock = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
    			
                    ' Compare with the last clock
                    If ((Div(nRegClockInPer,2)<> 0) AND (OverflowAfterWhile = 0)) Then OverflowAfterWhile = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtTheoEnd, dtClock)
    
                    nRegClockInPer = nRegClockInPer + 1
                    If dtNextTheoStart = 0 Then
                        nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheoEnd,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,nRegClockInPer)
                    Else
                        nRegClockInPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheoEnd,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtNextTheoStart,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,nRegClockInPer)
                    EndIf
                WEnd
                If OverflowAfterWhile > 0 Then OverflowAfterFor = OverflowAfterFor + OverflowAfterWhile
    	
            Next 'end if: We loop the theoretical fixed time slot

            nCounter = OverflowBeforeFor + OverflowAfterFor
            nCounter = SCO_C_EFFEC_OVERFLOW + nCounter 'to sum the previous value, depending in the intialization periodicity 

        'EndIf    
    EndIf
EndIf
Return(nCounter)

'SCO_C_EFFECT_TM_TMRW

            'we didnt consider the deleted register
            If SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.ISDELETED()<>M4_TRUE and SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_FIND_REG = 1 Then

                ' End Hour after midnight
                If DxDay(dtRef) <> DxDay(dtEnd) Then
    
                    If DxDay(dtRef) <> DxDay(dtStart) Then
                        ' Start Hour after midnight
                        nCounter = nCounter + SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtStart, dtEnd)

                        dtMidnight = NumbersToDate(DxYear(dtEnd), DxMonth(dtEnd), DxDay(dtEnd), 0, 0, 0)

            While SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.IsEOF()=M4_FALSE

                    dtClockIn = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR

                            dtMidnight = NumbersToDate(DxYear(dtClockOut), DxMonth(dtClockOut), DxDay(dtClockOut), 0, 0, 0)

                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GONEXT()

            If SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.ISDELETED()<>M4_TRUE and SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_FIND_REG = 1 Then
            
            
                For i=0 to 1 'loop over previous and next day


                    'For each night slice we have to find the time slots that affect it
                    If i=0 Then 
                        dtTemp = dtCur-1 //previous day, i.e. the employee works "very early"
                    Else
                        dtTemp = dtCur   //next day, i.e. the employee works "very late"
                    EndIf
                    dtNightStart = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(dtTemp,hNightStart)

                    'we have 4 cases

                    ' night slice:     (------------)
                    ' time slot  :(----)
                    ' time slot  :                  (----)
                    ' result:             nothing
                    If dtRTSEnd <= dtNightStart or dtRTSStart >= dtNightEnd Then
                        ' no change
                        nNightSlice = 0

                    '2a.- if the time slot starts into the night slice
                    ' night slice:    (------------)
                    ' time slot  :             (------)
                    ' result:                  (---)
                    ElseIf dtRTSStart >= dtNightStart and dtRTSStart < dtNightEnd and dtRTSEnd >= dtNightEnd Then
                        nNightSlice = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtRTSStart,dtNightEnd)

                    '3a.- if the time slot ends into the night slice

                        nCounter = nCounter + nNightSlice
                        
                    '5a.- 
                    ' night slice:    (------------)
                    ' time slot1:   (-----------------) 
                    ' result:         (------------)
                    ElseIf dtRTSStart < dtNightStart and dtRTSEnd > dtNightEnd Then
                        nNightSlice = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtNightStart,dtNightEnd)

            EndIf 'end of: we didnt consider the deleted register

    Else

        If nClockEf > 0 and Div(nClockEf,2) = 0 Then

            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.Begin()
            dtClockIn = M4_MINUS_INF
            dtClockOut = M4_MINUS_INF
            'we loop over the clock info
            While SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.IsEOF()=M4_FALSE

                nClockCurRec = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GetCurrent()
                If Div(nClockCurRec+1,2) <> 0 Then 
                    'If we are in a odd record
                    'we only take the in date and time and go to the next register
                    dtClockIn = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
                Else
                    'If we are in a even record
                    'we take the out date and time and we do the control
                    dtClockOut = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR


                    For i=0 to 1 'loop over previous and next day


                        'For each night slice we have to find the time slots that affect it
                        If i=0 Then 
                            dtTemp = dtCur-1 //previous day, i.e. the employee works "very early"
                        Else
                            dtTemp = dtCur   //next day, i.e. the employee works "very late"
                        EndIf
                        dtNightStart = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(dtTemp,hNightStart)
                        dtNightEnd = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(dtTemp,hNightEnd)
                        dtNightEnd = dtNightEnd + 1

                    
                        'we have 4 cases
                        '1a.- if the TS in completely excluded of the night slice: nothing
                        ' night slice:     (------------)
                        ' time slot  :(----)
                        ' time slot  :                  (----)
                        ' result:             nothing
                        If dtClockOut <= dtNightStart or dtClockIn >= dtNightEnd Then
                            ' no change
                            nNightSlice = 0
                            nCounter = nCounter + nNightSlice 
                        
                        '2a.- if the time slot starts into the night slice
                        ' night slice:    (------------)
                        ' time slot  :             (------)
                        ' result:                  (---)
                        ElseIf dtClockIn >= dtNightStart and dtClockIn < dtNightEnd and dtClockOut >= dtNightEnd Then
                            nNightSlice = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtClockIn,dtNightEnd)
                            nCounter = nCounter + nNightSlice
                            
                        '3a.- if the time slot ends into the night slice
                        ' night slice:    (------------)
                        ' time slot  : (------)
                        ' result:         (---)
                        ElseIf dtClockIn <= dtNightStart and dtClockOut > dtNightStart and dtClockOut <= dtNightEnd Then
                            nNightSlice = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtNightStart,dtClockOut)
                            nCounter = nCounter + nNightSlice
        
                        '4a.- if the time slot are into the night slice
                        ' night slice:    (------------)
                        ' time slot1:        (------) 
                        ' result:            (------)
                        ElseIf dtClockIn >= dtNightStart and dtClockOut <= dtNightEnd Then
                            nNightSlice = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtClockIn,dtClockOut)
                            nCounter = nCounter + nNightSlice
                            
                        '5b.- 
                        ' night slice:    (------------)
                        ' time slot1:   (-----------------) 
                        ' result:         (------------)
                        ElseIf dtClockIn < dtNightStart and dtClockOut > dtNightEnd Then
                            nNightSlice = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtNightStart,dtNightEnd)
                            nCounter = nCounter + nNightSlice
                        EndIf
                        
                    Next 'end of:loop over previous and next day                                             
                    
                EndIf 'end of: If we are in a even record
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GONEXT()               
            WEnd 'end of: we loop over the clock info
                        
        'Else
            'exist?
                
        EndIf 'end of: we only create real time slots for clocking employees if there are clocking info and the number of clock is even
    EndIf 

    nCounter = SCO_C_NIGHT_SLICE1 + nCounter 'to sum the previous value, depending in the intialization periodicity 

EndIf
Return(nCounter)

'SCO_CADJR_CLIP_EMPL_MNG_DAY
'Clocking adj. rules: Clip employees managed by day
' If the number of clocking hours are greater that a parameter, then the employee works all day
', in other case don't work anything
'Note: if there are an absence, we count it into the parameter

'Examples: 
'   Theoretical hours: 8h
'   Parameter: 5h
'
'   Clock day 1: 4h => Real days: 0
'   Clock day 2: 6h => Real days: 1
'   Clock day 3: 4h. Absence: 4h => Real days: 0,5
'********************************************************************************************************

dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
nNumMinHrs = SCO_NUM_MIN_HRS_CEMD

If SCO_CLIP_EMP_MAN_DAY = "1" and SCO_EMPL_MANAGEMENT_BY_DAYS = 1 and nNumMinHrs <> nullvalue() and SCO_IS_END_OF_DAY_PROCESS = 1 and SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.Count() > 0 Then 'if the user want to activate this functionality

    If SCO_GROSS_CLOCK_DEC_HOURS + SCO_ABS_HRS > nNumMinHrs Then
        'All day: we leave the first clock, create other the number of theoretical hours after, and delete the rest
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.Begin()
        dtStart = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR 
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GONEXT()
        While SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.IsEOF() = M4_FALSE
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.DESTROYREGISTER()
        WEnd
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.AddRegister()
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_TIME_PLUS_NUMBER(dtStart,SCO_WORK_THEO_HRS-SCO_ABS_HRS)
        
    Else
        'None work: we delete all the clocks
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.DESTROYBLOCK()
    EndIf
