'SCO_CADJR_CLIP_MAX_WORK_HRS
'Clocking adjustment rules: Clocking adj. rules: Clip if max num of work hrs
'********************************************************************************************************
' We have to clip the working hours of the day to a maximum defined by a param (SCO_MAX_WORK_HRS)
' The maximum hours to clip if defined by other param (SCO_MAX_CLIP_WORKHRS)
' For example: if the SCO_MAX_WORK_HRS = 10 and the working hours are 14, we put 10 hours working hours 
' In the same example, if SCO_MAX_CLIP_WORKHRS = 3, we put 11 hours working hours 
'
' Time slots: first we eliminate the "clock time slots" in the forbidden or inexistent, after in the variable 
' and then in the fixed (starting at the end), until we have eliminated the amount needed
'
' Example (SCO_MAX_WORK_HRS = 10, SCO_MAX_CLIP_WORKHRS = 3):
' Theor TS        (---V---)(---F---)(---L---)(---F---)(---V---)       TotalSumOfTs = 12, TotalSumFixed = 7
' "clock TS"  (----------------------------------------------------)  TotalClock   = 14 => FinalEffective = 11
' step 1:         (-------------------------------------------)       step 1: we clip to "forbiden or inexistant" 
' final:          (-----------------------------------------)         step 2: after, we erase the remain (1) starting at the end
'
'Important note: here we suppose that the odd clock are clock in and the even clock are clock out !!!!!!!!!!
' This is executed only in a clock out or after the day
''********************************************************************************************************

'variables
dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
nClockEf = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.Count()
nMaxWkHrs = SCO_MAX_WORKING_HRS
nMaxClipHrs = SCO_MAX_CLIP_WORKHRS

'if the user want to activate this functionality and there are clock info and the number of clock are even
If SCO_CLIP_MAX_WORKHRS = "1" and nClockEf > 0 and Div(nClockEf,2) = 0 and nMaxWkHrs <> nullvalue()Then

    '***********************************************************************************************
    'First we calculate the effective working hours in this moment
    nNumEffHrs = 0
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.Begin()
    While SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.IsEOF() = M4_FALSE  'we loop over the clock info
        nClockCurRec = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GetCurrent()
        If Div(nClockCurRec+1,2) <> 0 Then 
            'If we are in a odd record
            'we only take the in date and time and go to the next register
            dtClockIn = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GONEXT()
        Else
            'If we are in a even record
            'we take the out date and time
            dtClockOut = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
            
            nNumEffHrsInThisTS = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtClockIn,dtClockOut)
            nNumEffHrs = nNumEffHrs + nNumEffHrsInThisTS
            
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GONEXT()
        EndIf 'end of: If we are in a even record
    WEnd 'end of: we loop over the clock info
    
    '***********************************************************************************************
    'Check if the number of hours is greater than the maximum
    If nNumEffHrs > nMaxWkHrs Then
    
        'Hours to clip
        nNumHrsToClip = nNumEffHrs - nMaxWkHrs
        If nNumHrsToClip <> nullvalue() Then nNumHrsToClip = Min(nNumHrsToClip,nMaxClipHrs)
        
        'New number of hours
        nNewWkHrs = nNumEffHrs - nNumHrsToClip

        'Hours of theoretical time slots not forbidden
        ' to eliminate first the "clock time slots" in the forbidden or inexistent
        nNumHrsThTSNotForb = 0
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REAL","FORBIDDEN",M4_DISTINCT)
        For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()-1
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)
            dtTSStart = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT
            dtTSEnd = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT        
            nNumHrsThTSNotForbInThisTS= SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtTSStart,dtTSEnd)
            nNumHrsThTSNotForb = nNumHrsThTSNotForb + nNumHrsThTSNotForbInThisTS
        Next

        'If the "Hours of theoretical time slots not forbidden" is greater or equal than the new number of hrs
        ' we clip to them (i.e. we eliminate the clock in forbidden or inexistant)
        If nNumHrsThTSNotForb >= nNewWkHrs Then
            SCO_CADJR_TOOL_CLIP_SEL_TS_TP("FORBIDDEN",M4_DISTINCT)
            
            If nNumHrsThTSNotForb = nNewWkHrs Then
                'We have finish
                Return(M4_SUCCESS)
            Else
                'we update the number of hours to clip
                nNumHrsToClip = nNumHrsToClip - (nNumEffHrs - nNumHrsThTSNotForb)
                
                'Hours of theoretical time slots fixed
                ' to eliminate, second, the "clock time slots" in the variable
                nNumHrsThTSFixed = 0
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REAL","FIXED",M4_EQUAL)
                For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()-1
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)
                    dtTSStart = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT
                    dtTSEnd = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT        
                    nNumHrsThTSFixedInThisTS= SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtTSStart,dtTSEnd)
                    nNumHrsThTSFixed = nNumHrsThTSFixed + nNumHrsThTSFixedInThisTS
                Next            
    
                'If the "'Hours of theoretical time slots fixed" is greater or equal than the new number of hrs
                ' we clip to them (i.e. we eliminate the clock in forbidden or inexistant)
                If nNumHrsThTSFixed >= nNewWkHrs Then
                    SCO_CADJR_TOOL_CLIP_SEL_TS_TP("FIXED",M4_EQUAL)

                    If nNumHrsThTSFixed = nNewWkHrs Then
                        'We have finish
                        Return(M4_SUCCESS)
                    Else
                        'we update the number of hours to clip
                        nNumHrsToClip = nNumHrsToClip - (nNumEffHrs - nNumHrsThTSFixed)                    
                    EndIf        
                EndIf
            EndIf        
        EndIf
        
        'We need to erase the remain effective "time slots" starting at the end, until the new number of hours
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.End()      
        While SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.IsEOF() = M4_FALSE and nNumHrsToClip > 0  'we loop over the clock info
            nClockCurRec = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GetCurrent()
            If Div(nClockCurRec+1,2) <> 0 Then 
                'If we are in a odd record
                'we only take the in date and time and go to the next register
                dtClockIn = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
                
                nNumEffHrsInThisTS = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtClockIn,dtClockOut)
                
                'If the TS is smaller or equal than the remain hrs to erase, we erase the hole TS
                ' , i.e. the both registers
                If nNumEffHrsInThisTS <= nNumHrsToClip Then
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.DESTROYREGISTER()
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.DESTROYREGISTER()
                    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GetCurrent() = M4_ERROR Then SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.End()  
                    nNumHrsToClip = nNumHrsToClip - nNumEffHrsInThisTS                     
                Else
                'if the TS is greater than the remain hrs to erase, we move the end to the left
                ', i.e. we go the the next register and we change the value
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GONEXT()
                    dtNewEnd = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_TIME_PLUS_NUMBER(dtClockOut,-nNumHrsToClip)
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtNewEnd
                    nNumHrsToClip = 0
                EndIf
                
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GOPREVIOUS()
            Else
                'If we are in a even record
                'we take the out date and time
                dtClockOut = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR                
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GOPREVIOUS()
            EndIf 'end of: If we are in a even record
        WEnd 'end of: we loop over the clock info        

    EndIf 'enf if: Check if the number of hours is greater than the maximum

EndIf 'end if: if the user want to activate this functionality and there are clock info and the number of clock are even

'Dependences rule: to be overwrited if needed.
x = SCO_CADJR_TOLERANCE_MNG 'we need that the tolerance management will be executed (if it is activated by the user)
x = SCO_CADJR_CLIP_FIXED_2_FIX
x = SCO_CADJR_CLIP_FORB_INEX
x = SCO_CADJR_CLIP_MIN_LUNCH_TIME

'********************************************************************************************************
'SCO_CADJR_CLIP_MIN_LUNCH_TIME
'Clocking adjustment rules: Clocking adj. rules: Clip to minimum lunch time
'********************************************************************************************************
'We calculate the time not worked in the Lunch time slot. If it is greater than the minimum lunck time, we clip it
'???????????? Note that if there are more than one lunch time slots in a day, the SCO_MINIMUM_LUNCH means the sum in all the lunch time slots 
'
'Important note: here we suposse that the odd clock are clock in and the even clock are clock out !!!!!!!!!!
' This is executed only in a clock out or after the day
'
'Example1
'Theoretical lunch time slot    (----------------------------------)
' Clock in/out               ------------------------------------------
' Clock in/out after rule    -------------)              (-------------
'
'Example2
'Theoretical lunch time slot    (----------------------------------)
' Clock in/out               ------------------------------)            
' Clock in/out after rule    -----------------------)                   
'
'Example3
'Theoretical lunch time slot    (----------------------------------)
' Clock in/out               ------------------)    (------------------
' Clock in/out after rule    -------------)              (-------------
'
'Example4
'Theoretical lunch time slot    (----------------------------------)
' Clock in/out              -)       (---) (-------) (----------)     (-------
' Clock in/out after rule   -)  (---------)              (---------)  (-------
'
'
'********************************************************************************************************

'variables
dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
nMinLunch = SCO_MINIMUM_LUNCH

If SCO_CLIP_LUNCH = "1" and nMinLunch > 0 and nMinLunch <> nullvalue() Then 'if the user want to activate this functionality

    nRealLunchHrs = SCO_REAL_LUNCH_HRS(2) 'effective clock info
    sNumWorkedHrsString = SCO_NUM_WORKED_HRS_STRING
    
    If nRealLunchHrs <> nullvalue() and nRealLunchHrs < nMinLunch Then 'if the lunch hrs are smaller than the parameter


        SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REAL","BREAKFAST",M4_EQUAL)
        nTheorTS = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()
        nClockEf = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.Count()
        'if there are lunch theor ts and clock info and the number of clock are even
        If nTheorTS > 0 and nClockEf > 0 and Div(nClockEf,2) = 0 Then
            nWorkedHoursAtLunchTime = 0
        
            For i=0 to nTheorTS-1 'we loop the Lunch time slots
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)
                dtTheorTSStartAt = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT
                dtTheorTSEndAt = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT
                nHoursLunchTS = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtTheorTSStartAt,dtTheorTSEndAt)
                nPosArr= StrIn(sNumWorkedHrsString,"@")
                nLnegthEnd = StrIn(sNumWorkedHrsString,"|")-nPosArr-1
                nNumWorkedTS  = ToInt(Mid(sNumWorkedHrsString,0,nPosArr))
                nNumWorkedHrs = ToDouble(Mid(sNumWorkedHrsString,nPosArr+1,nLnegthEnd ))
                sNumWorkedHrsString = Mid(sNumWorkedHrsString,StrIn(sNumWorkedHrsString,"|")+1,Length(sNumWorkedHrsString))

                nHoursAllowToWorkAtLunchTime = nHoursLunchTS - (nMinLunch/nTheorTS) 'if there are more than one lunch time slots, we consider that we have to lunch the same time in all
    
                If nNumWorkedTS  = 1 Then
                    'there are only one "worked time slot" in the lunch time slot
                    If nNumWorkedHrs = 0 Then
                        'the employee has not any lunch time, we have to create gap in the middle of the lunch time slot (Example1)
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.AddRegister()
                        dtNewDate = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_TIME_PLUS_NUMBER(dtTheorTSStartAt,nHoursAllowToWorkAtLunchTime/2)
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtNewDate 
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.AddRegister()
                        dtNewDate = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_TIME_PLUS_NUMBER(dtTheorTSEndAt,-nHoursAllowToWorkAtLunchTime/2)
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtNewDate 
                    Else
                        'we have to move the start or end date of the "worked time slot" 
                        nClockReg = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheorTSStartAt,M4_GREATER,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheorTSEndAt,M4_SMALLER)
                        If nClockReg <> M4_ERROR Then
                            If Div(nClockReg+1,2)<> 0 Then
                                'this is a start, so we move to the rigth 
                                'first we have to check if the end is into the lunch time slot
                                nClockRegEnd = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheorTSStartAt,M4_GREATER,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheorTSEndAt,M4_SMALLER,nClockReg+1)
                                If nClockRegEnd <> M4_ERROR Then
                                    'there are end, so we move to the rigth, but not too much
                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.MoveTo(nClockRegEnd)
                                    dtClockEnd = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
                                    nNumToMinus = nHoursAllowToWorkAtLunchTime + SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtClockEnd,dtTheorTSEndAt)

                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.MoveTo(nClockReg)
                                    dtNewDate = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_TIME_PLUS_NUMBER(dtTheorTSEndAt, -nNumToMinus)
                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtNewDate                                     
                                Else
                                    'there are not end (into the lunch time slot), so we move to the rigth 
                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.MoveTo(nClockReg) 
                                    dtNewDate = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_TIME_PLUS_NUMBER(dtTheorTSEndAt,-nHoursAllowToWorkAtLunchTime)
                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtNewDate                                     
                                EndIf
                            Else
                                'this is a end, so we move to the left (Example2)
                                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.MoveTo(nClockReg)
                                dtNewDate = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_TIME_PLUS_NUMBER(dtTheorTSStartAt,nHoursAllowToWorkAtLunchTime)
                                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtNewDate 
                            EndIf
                        EndIf
                    EndIf
                Else
                    'we have to create two "worked time slots" at the begining and end and delete the rest
                    ' to do this we loop over the clock info into the lunch time slot
                    ' for the first register: 
                    '   · if is a end, we move it (Example3)
                    '   · if is a start, we move it and create the end (Example4)
                    ' for the last register: 
                    '   · if is a start, we move it (Example3)
                    '   · if is a end, we move it and create the end (Example4)
                    ' for the resto of the register, we deleted (Example4)
                    
                    ' we loop over the clock info into the lunch time slot
                    nClockReg = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheorTSStartAt,M4_GREATER,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheorTSEndAt,M4_SMALLER)
                    nNumCloc = 0
                    nNumRegCreatedOrDeleted = 0
                    While nClockReg <> M4_ERROR 
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.MoveTo(nClockReg)
                        nNumCloc = nNumCloc + 1 
                        If nNumCloc = 1 Then 'for the first register
                            If Div(nClockReg+1,2)<> 0 Then
                                'this is a start, we move it and create the end (Example4)
                                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtTheorTSStartAt
                                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.InsertRegister()' the insertregister is in the register before
                                dtNewDate = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_TIME_PLUS_NUMBER(dtTheorTSStartAt,nHoursAllowToWorkAtLunchTime/2)
                                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtNewDate 
                                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GONEXT()'for be in the current register
                                nLastClockReg = nClockReg + 2 'because we have inserted one register   
                                nNumRegCreatedOrDeleted = nNumRegCreatedOrDeleted + 1
                            Else
                                'this is an end, we move it (Example3)
                                dtNewDate = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_TIME_PLUS_NUMBER(dtTheorTSStartAt,nHoursAllowToWorkAtLunchTime/2)
                                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtNewDate    
                                nLastClockReg = nClockReg + 1                         
                            EndIf                             
                        ElseIf nNumCloc > 2 Then
                            'for the third we go to the second, and destroy it (and the same with the next) (Example4)
                            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GOPREVIOUS()
                            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.DESTROYREGISTER()
                            nLastClockReg = nClockReg 
                            nNumRegCreatedOrDeleted = nNumRegCreatedOrDeleted + 1
                            'we dont need to move the register neither increase nClockReg 
                        Else
                            nLastClockReg = nClockReg + 1   
                        EndIf
                        nClockReg = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheorTSStartAt,M4_GREATER,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtTheorTSEndAt,M4_SMALLER,nLastClockReg)
                    WEnd ' end of: we loop over the clock info into the lunch time slot
                    
                    'For the last register (we are in this register)
'                    If nNumCloc > 2 Then
'                        'for the third we go to the second, and destroy it (and the same with the next) (Example4)
'                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GOPREVIOUS()
'                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.DESTROYREGISTER()
'                    EndIf
                    nLastClockReg = nLastClockReg + nNumRegCreatedOrDeleted ' to keep the parity after creations and destroys
                    If Div(nLastClockReg,2) <> 0 Then
                        'if is a start, we move it (Example3)
                        dtNewDate = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_TIME_PLUS_NUMBER(dtTheorTSEndAt,-nHoursAllowToWorkAtLunchTime/2)
                        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GetCurrent() <> M4_ERROR Then
                            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtNewDate    
                        EndIf
                    Else
                        'if is a end, we move it and create the end (Example4)
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtTheorTSEndAt
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.InsertRegister()' the insertregister is in the register before
                        dtNewDate = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_TIME_PLUS_NUMBER(dtTheorTSEndAt,-nHoursAllowToWorkAtLunchTime/2)
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtNewDate                                         
                    EndIf
                    'end of: For the last register (we are in this register)

                EndIf               
            
            Next 'end of: we loop the Lunch time slots
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SORT()
        EndIf 'end of: if there are lunch theor ts and clock info and the number of clock are even    
    
    EndIf 'end of: if the lunch hrs are smaller than the parameter

EndIf 'end of: if the user want to activate this functionality

'Dependences rule: to be overwrited if needed.
x = SCO_CADJR_TOLERANCE_MNG 'we need that the tolerance management will be executed (if it is activated by the user)

'*******************************************************************************************************************************
'SCO_CADJR_TOLERANCE_MNG
'Clocking adjustment rules: Tolerance management
'For each theoretical fixed time slot, we have to define two tolerance periods of time (one at the begin and other at the end)
'If we find some clock in/out in this period we have to move it to the init or end of the theoretical fixed time slot
'This movement is optional using the property: SCO_TOLE_MOVE_CLOCK, with values: 
'   0: no, the tolerance is using to not create alerts
'   1: yes, to start or end of the theoretical fixed time slot 
' This can be exeuted after each clock or at the end of the day
'*******************************************************************************************************************************
'Basic example:
' Theoretical fixed time slots :       (--------------------)            (------------------)     (-------------)
' Tolerance periods                  (----)               (-)                             (---)   (-------)    
' Tolerance values                   2    2               1 0           0 0               2   1   0       7    0 0
' Clock in/out                           |     | |         |       |  |   |      ||           |       | | |     |
' Clock in/out after rule              |       | |          |      |  |   |      ||         |     |     | |     |
' Meaning of the four changes: 
'  1: The employee has been late 2 minutes, but we modify the clock in at put it at the theoretical start hour
'  2: The employee has been out 1 minute before the hour, but we modify the clock in at put it at the theoretical end hour
'  3: The employee has been out 1 minute after the hour, but we modify the clock in at put it at the theoretical end hour
'  4: The employee has been in 3 minute after the hour and get out and in again in the minutes 5 and 7, we modify the clock 
'     in of minute 3 at put it at the theoretical end hour, but not the minutes 5 and 7.
'     We don't modify the clock in/out out of the tolerance period 
'
'
'What happen if there is more than one clock in/out in the tolerance period?
' 1.- We don't consider if there are "clock out" before the first "clock in" (this is for start tolerance period, the equivalent for the end)
'  (if we have this info from the clock system)
' 2.- if we find a "clock in" at the "left side" (before the start of the theoretical fixed time slot) and there are more clock in the left side, we move the first and delete the rest
' 3.- if we find the first "clock in" at the "right side" we move it and don't do anything with the rest
'
'
'More examples
'1.-
'Tolerance period                           (-----------------|--------------------)                       
'Clock in/out                                      |  |   |             |
'Clock in/out after rule                                      |         |
'
'2.-
'Tolerance period                           (-----------------|--------------------)                       
'Clock in/out                                           |             |     | 
'Clock in/out after rule                                      |       |     |
'
'3.-
'Tolerance period                           (-----------------|--------------------)                       
'Clock in/out                                                      |       |   | |  
'Clock in/out after rule                                      |            |   | |


'*******************************************************************************************************************************

'Ctes:
GTA_IN  = "1"
GTA_OUT = "0"

'If there are clocking information
If SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.Count()>0 Then

    'We loop the theoretical fixed time slot
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REAL","FIXED",M4_EQUAL)
    
    For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()-1
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)
        
        'First we check if in this time slot we have to move the clock or not   
        sMoveClock = ""
        If SCO_TOLE_MOVE_CLOCK <> "" and SCO_TOLE_MOVE_CLOCK <> nullvalue() Then sMoveClock = SCO_TOLE_MOVE_CLOCK
        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_MOVE_CLOCK <> "" and SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_MOVE_CLOCK <> nullvalue() Then sMoveClock = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_MOVE_CLOCK
        
        If sMoveClock = "1" Then
        
            'We take the tolerance period for this time slot
            nNumMinTolInBef = 0
            nNumMinTolInAft = 0
            nNumMinTolOutBef = 0
            nNumMinTolOutAft = 0        
            
            If SCO_TOLE_IB <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolInBef = SCO_TOLE_IB
            If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_IB <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolInBef = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_IB 
            
            If SCO_TOLE_IA <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolInAft = SCO_TOLE_IA 
            If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_IA <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolInAft = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_IA 
            
            If SCO_TOLE_OB <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolOutBef = SCO_TOLE_OB 
            If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_OB <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolOutBef = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_OB 
            
            If SCO_TOLE_OA <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolOutAft = SCO_TOLE_OA
            If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_OA <> nullvalue() Then nNumMinTolOutAft = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_TOLE_OA
        
        
            'Start tolerance period
            If nNumMinTolInBef <> 0 or nNumMinTolInAft <> 0 Then
            
                dtTheoDate = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT          
                dtStartTolPer = DateAdd(dtTheoDate,-nNumMinTolInBef,M4_MINUTE)
                dtEndTolPer   = DateAdd(dtTheoDate, nNumMinTolInAft,M4_MINUTE)
        
                'we have to loop over the clock in the tolerance period
                nRegClockInTolPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtStartTolPer,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtEndTolPer,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL)
                nFirstInFound = M4_FALSE
                While nRegClockInTolPer <> M4_ERROR
                
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.MoveTo(nRegClockInTolPer)
                    dtClock = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
                    sInOut  = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_IN_OR_OUT
                    bInLeftSide = M4_FALSE
                    If dtClock < dtTheoDate Then bInLeftSide = M4_TRUE
                    
                    If (nFirstInFound = M4_FALSE and sInOut <> GTA_OUT) or (bInLeftSide=M4_TRUE and nFirstInFound = M4_TRUE) Then
                        'We only need to do somethin if:
                        ' we don't have found the first "in" (or null) and this is not "out"
                        ' we are in the left side and this is not the first "in"
                    
                        If nFirstInFound = M4_FALSE then 
                            'if this is the first found: we mark for the next and we move it                       
                            nFirstInFound = M4_TRUE
                            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtTheoDate
                            nRegClockInTolPer = nRegClockInTolPer + 1
                        Else
                            'if not, we have to delete it
                            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.DESTROYREGISTER()
                        EndIf
                    Else
                        nRegClockInTolPer = nRegClockInTolPer + 1
                    EndIf
                    
                    nRegClockInTolPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtStartTolPer,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtEndTolPer,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,nRegClockInTolPer)
                WEnd
            EndIf 'end of: Start tolerance period
        
            'End tolerance period
            If nNumMinTolOutBef <> 0 or nNumMinTolOutAft <> 0 Then
        
                dtTheoDate = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT        
                dtStartTolPer = DateAdd(dtTheoDate,-nNumMinTolOutBef,M4_MINUTE)
                dtEndTolPer   = DateAdd(dtTheoDate, nNumMinTolOutAft,M4_MINUTE)
        
                'we have to loop over the clock in the tolerance period
                nRegClockInTolPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtStartTolPer,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtEndTolPer,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL)
                nFirstInFound = M4_FALSE
                While nRegClockInTolPer <> M4_ERROR
                
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.MoveTo(nRegClockInTolPer)
                    dtClock = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
                    sInOut  = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_IN_OR_OUT
                    bInRigthSide = M4_FALSE
                    If dtClock > dtTheoDate Then bInRigthSide = M4_TRUE
                    
                    If (nFirstInFound = M4_FALSE and sInOut <> GTA_IN) or (bInRigthSide=M4_TRUE and nFirstInFound = M4_TRUE) Then
                        'We only need to do somethin if:
                        ' we don't have found the first "out" (or null) and this is not "in"
                        ' we are in the rigth side and this is not the first "in"
                    
                        If nFirstInFound = M4_FALSE then 
                            'if this is the first found: we mark for the next and we move it                       
                            nFirstInFound = M4_TRUE
                            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtTheoDate
                            nRegClockInTolPer = nRegClockInTolPer + 1
                        Else
                            'if not, we have to delete it
                            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.DESTROYREGISTER()
                        EndIf
                    Else
                        nRegClockInTolPer = nRegClockInTolPer + 1
                    EndIf
                    
                    nRegClockInTolPer = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.FindRegister("SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtStartTolPer,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",dtEndTolPer,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,nRegClockInTolPer)
                WEnd
        
            EndIf
        EndIf 'end if: First we check if in this time slot we have to move the clock or not 
    Next

EndIf 'end of: If there are clocking information

'********************************************************************************************************
'SCO_CADJR_CLIP_FIXED_2_FIX
'Tool for clocking adjustment rules: Clip employees to the time slot types by argument
'Used in "Clip employees with only fixed time slots to fixed times slots" or "Clip in slots forbidden or inexistent"
'********************************************************************************************************
'We loop the pairs of clock in and out and in each case:
'  if is completely out of the theoretical fixed time slots: we deleted it (both, clock in and out)
'  if the initial or the end is out of the theoretical fixed time slots and there are a overlap: we move the initial or end or both
'  if in the previous case there are more than one theoretical fixed time slots with overlaping, we have to create new clock in and out 
'
'Important note: here we suposse that the odd clock are clock in and the even clock are clock out !!!!!!!!!!
' This is executed only in a clock out or after the day
'
'Example 1
'Theoretical time slots            (----------------)        (--------------------------)
' Clock in/out                 (-----------------------)(--)    (-------------------------)    
' Clock in/out after rule          (----------------)           (-----------------------)    

'Example 2
'Theoretical time slots            (----------------)        (--------------------------)
' Clock in/out                 (--------------------------------------)  (------------------)
' Clock in/out after rule          (----------------)        (--------)  (--------------)
'********************************************************************************************************

dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
   
SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REAL",ARG_TS_TYPE,ARG_EQUAL_OR_DIF)
nTheorTS = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()
nClockEf = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.Count()
'if there are theor ts and clock info and the number of clock are even
If nTheorTS > 0 and nClockEf > 0 and Div(nClockEf,2) = 0 Then

    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.Begin()
    dtClockIn = M4_MINUS_INF
    dtClockOut = M4_MINUS_INF            
    'we loop over the clock info
    While SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.IsEOF()=M4_FALSE

        nClockCurRec = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GetCurrent()                
        If Div(nClockCurRec+1,2) <> 0 Then 
            'If we are in a odd record
            'we only take the in date and time and go to the next register
            dtClockIn = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GONEXT()
        Else
            'If we are in a even record
            'we take the out date and time and we do the control
            dtClockOut = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
            
            'we search theoretical fixed time slots with overlaping with the current clock in/out
            nRegTheorTS = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.FindRegister("SCO_DT_STARTS_AT",dtClockOut,M4_SMALLER,"SCO_DT_ENDS_AT",dtClockIn,M4_GREATER)
            If nRegTheorTS = M4_ERROR Then
                'if is completely out of the theoretical fixed time slots: we deleted it (both, clock in and out)
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.DESTROYREGISTER()
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.MoveTo(nClockCurRec-1)
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.DESTROYREGISTER()                        
            Else
                'if there are overlaping we loop over the overlaping theoretical fixed time slots 
                bFirstTime = M4_TRUE
                While nRegTheorTS <> M4_ERROR 
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(nRegTheorTS)
                    dtTheorTSStartAt = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT
                    dtTheorTSEndAt = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT
                    
                    If bFirstTime = M4_TRUE Then
                        If dtClockIn < dtTheorTSStartAt Then
                            'we move the clock in
                            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.MoveTo(nClockCurRec-1)
                            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtTheorTSStartAt
                            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.MoveTo(nClockCurRec)                            
                        EndIf
                        If dtClockOut > dtTheorTSEndAt Then
                            'we move the clock out
                            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = dtTheorTSEndAt                                 
                        EndIf
                    Else

                        'we add a new clock in and clock out
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.InsertRegister()
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = Max(dtTheorTSStartAt,dtClockIn)
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GONEXT()                            

                        'we add a new clock in and clock out
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.InsertRegister()
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR = Min(dtTheorTSEndAt,dtClockOut)
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GONEXT()                             
                    
                    EndIf                       
                
                    bFirstTime = M4_FALSE
                    nRegTheorTS = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.FindRegister("SCO_DT_STARTS_AT",dtClockOut,M4_SMALLER,"SCO_DT_ENDS_AT",dtClockIn,M4_GREATER,nRegTheorTS+1)                       
                WEnd 'end of: if there are overlaping we loop over the overlaping theoretical fixed time slots 
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GONEXT()
            EndIf                   

        EndIf 'end of: If we are in a even record
    WEnd 'end of: we loop over the clock info
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SORT()
EndIf 'end of: if there are theor ts and clock info and the number of clock are even

'If SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_CLOCK_INOUT_EXEC = 0 or SCO_EMPL_CLOCK_OR_DECLARATIVE = 0 Then  'Change this line if want that the clocking employees in future days have the same behavior that the not clocking

'SCO_CALC_REAL_TS
'Calc real time slots
' NOT CLOCKING EMPLOYEES
'   Real time slot = theoretical time slot - absences + presences
' CLOCKING EMPLOYEES
'   Real time slot = clocking info after clocking adjustemnt rules + presences
'   Note that we don't consider absences for clocking employees. If there are a clock over an absences we consider that the employee is working. Normally an alert warning the manager of this situation    

dDtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
nSomeRealTSDeleted = M4_FALSE
bConsiderPresences = M4_TRUE
bConsiderRegToDel = M4_FALSE

'We load the real time slots if exists
SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.CLEANFILTER()
SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.Load_blk()

'If we are in the period of calc, not loaded previous data then we have to calc (or recalc) the real time slot
If ARG_FROM_LOAD = 0 Then

    '***********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
    ' NOT CLOCKING/DECLARATIVES EMPLOYEES
    ' We have to create the real time slot = theoretical time slot - absences + presences
    '***********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
'    If SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_CLOCK_INOUT_EXEC = 0 or SCO_EMPL_CLOCK_OR_DECLARATIVE = 0 Then 'If the employee is without clocking/declaratives 
    If SCO_EMPL_CLOCK_OR_DECLARATIVE = 0 Then 'If the employee is without clocking/declaratives 
    
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REFERENCE","","")
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Begin()
        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()>0 Then
            'There are theoretical time slots    
        
            '****************************************************************************************
            'We have to consider the absences        
            '****************************************************************************************       
            If SCO_ABS_HRS = SCO_WORK_THEO_HRS Then
                'If the absence is complete, we have to delete all the real time slots, if exists
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.DELETEALLREGISTERS()
                nSomeRealTSDeleted = M4_TRUE
                
            Else
                'in other case we need to put the theoretical time slot minus the absences "time slot" if exists
    
                For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()-1 'we put the theoretical
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)
                    dtStartThTS = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT
                    dtEndThTS   = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT
                    nReg = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.FindRegister("SCO_DT_STARTS_AT",dtStartThTS,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_ENDS_AT",dtEndThTS,M4_EQUAL)
                    If nReg = M4_ERROR Then               
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.AddRegister()
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_FIND_REG = 1                    
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT = dtStartThTS 
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT = dtEndThTS   
                    Else
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.MoveTo(nReg)
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_FIND_REG = 1
                    EndIf
                Next
    
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SORT()
                
                If SCO_ABS_HRS <> 0 Then
                    '--------------------------------------------------------------------
                    'Absences in hours
                    '--------------------------------------------------------------------
                    'If there are absences by hours in this day, we have to erase the absences "time slot" needed
    
                    'We loop over the time slots
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.Begin()
                    While SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.IsEOF()<>M4_TRUE
    
                        dtRTSStart = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT
                        dtRTSEnd = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT                
                    
                        'we didnt consider the deleted register
                        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.ISDELETED()<>M4_TRUE and SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_FIND_REG = 1 Then
                            
                            'For each time slots we have to find the incidences that affect it
                            nRegInc = SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.FindRegister("SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME",dtRTSEnd,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME",dtRTSStart,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
                            'nRegInc = SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.FindRegister("SCO_DT_START",dDtCur,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_START_TIME",hRTSEnd,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_END_TIME",hRTSStart,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
                            While nRegInc <> M4_ERROR
                                SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.MoveTo(nRegInc)
                                dtIncStart = SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME
                                dtIncEnd = SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME
                                
                                'we have 4 cases
                                '1.- if the TS in completely included in the incidence: we have to delete the TS
                                ' original TS:     (------------)
                                ' incidence:   (---------------------)                            
                                ' result TS:          nothing
                                If dtIncStart <= dtRTSStart and dtIncEnd >= dtRTSEnd Then
                                
                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.DeleteRegister()
                                
                                '2.- if the incidence end after that the TS: we have to change the TS start
                                ' original TS:    (------------)
                                ' incidence:   (------)                            
                                ' result TS:          (--------)                               
                                ElseIf dtIncStart <= dtRTSStart and dtIncEnd < dtRTSEnd Then
                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT = dtIncEnd
    
                                '3.- if the incidence start after that the TS: we have to change the TS end
                                ' original TS:    (------------)
                                ' incidence:               (------)                            
                                ' result TS:      (--------)                               
                                ElseIf dtIncStart > dtRTSStart and dtIncEnd >= dtRTSEnd Then
                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT = dtIncStart
    
                                '4.- if the incidence are into the TS: we have to change the TS end and create a new TS
                                ' original TS:    (------------)
                                ' incidence:           (--)                            
                                ' result TS:      (----)  (----)
                                ElseIf dtIncStart > dtRTSStart and dtIncEnd < dtRTSEnd Then
                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT = dtIncStart
                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.InsertRegister()
                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_FIND_REG = 1
                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT = dtIncEnd
                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT = dtRTSEnd
                                
                                    'after we want the node with good order and move to the present register to continue in the next loop in the new register
                                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SORT()
                                    nRegReal = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.Findregister("SCO_DT_STARTS_AT",dtRTSStart,M4_EQUAL)
                                    If nRegReal <> M4_ERROR Then
                                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.MoveTo(nRegReal)
                                        dtRTSStart = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT
                                        dtRTSEnd = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT                                    
                                    EndIf
                                EndIf
                                
                                nRegInc = SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.FindRegister("SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME",dtRTSEnd,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME",dtRTSStart,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,nRegInc+1)
                            WEnd 'end of: For each time slots we have to find the incidences that afect it
                            
                        EndIf 'end of: we didnt consider the deleted register             
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.GONEXT()
                    WEnd 'end of: We loop over the time slots
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.Begin()
    
                EndIf 'end of: If there are absences by hours in this day, we have to erase the absences "time slot" needed
    
            EndIf 'end of: We have to consider the absences  
        
'            'We will consider the presences in the next block, at the same time for clocking and not clocking employees
'            bConsiderPresences = M4_TRUE

            
    
            If SCO_ABS_HRS <> SCO_WORK_THEO_HRS or SCO_SUP_HRS > 0 Then
                bConsiderRegToDel = M4_TRUE 
            EndIf
            
        Else
            'There are not theoretical time slots, so we have to delete all the real time slots that can exist
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.DELETEALLREGISTERS()
            nSomeRealTSDeleted = M4_TRUE
        EndIf 'end of: There are or not theoretical time slots


    '***********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
    ' CLOCKING/DECLARATIVES EMPLOYEES
    ' We have to create the real time slot = clocking info after clocking adjustemnt rules + presences
    ' Note that we don't consider absences. If there are a clock over an absences we consider that the employee is working. Normally an alert warning the manager of this situation
    '***********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
    Else
        nClockEf = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.Count()
        'If  nClockEf > 0 and Div(nClockEf,2) = 0 Then
        If  nClockEf > 0 Then
            'we only create real time slots for clocking employees if there are clocking info and the number of clock is even
            bConsiderRegToDel = M4_TRUE 
    
            'We put the clocking info in the real time slots    
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.Begin()
            dtClockIn = M4_MINUS_INF
            dtClockOut = M4_MINUS_INF            
            'we loop over the clock info
            While SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.IsEOF()=M4_FALSE

                nClockCurRec = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GetCurrent()                
                If Div(nClockCurRec+1,2) <> 0 Then 
                    'If we are in a odd record
                    'we only take the in date and time and go to the next register
                    dtClockIn = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
                Else
                    'If we are in a even record
                    'we take the out date and time and we do the control
                    dtClockOut = SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR
                    
                    nReg = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.FindRegister("SCO_DT_STARTS_AT",dtClockIn,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_ENDS_AT",dtClockOut,M4_EQUAL)
                    If nReg = M4_ERROR Then               
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.AddRegister()
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_FIND_REG = 1                    
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT = dtClockIn
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT = dtClockOut
                    Else
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.MoveTo(nReg)
                        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_FIND_REG = 1
                    EndIf
                EndIf 'end of: If we are in a even record
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.GONEXT()               
            WEnd 'end of: we loop over the clock info
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SORT()

'            'We will consider the presences in the next block, at the same time for clocking and not clocking employees
'            bConsiderPresences = M4_TRUE
            
        ElseIf nClockEf = 0 Then
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.DELETEALLREGISTERS()
            nSomeRealTSDeleted = M4_TRUE
        
        EndIf 'end of: we only create real time slots for clocking employees if there are clocking info and the number of clock is even
    EndIf 'end of: If the employee is without or with clocking 


    '***********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
    ' CLOCKING AND NOT CLOCKING EMPLOYEES
    ' We have to consider the presences
    '***********************************************************************************************************************************************************************
    If bConsiderPresences = M4_TRUE and SCO_SUP_HRS > 0 Then
        'For each presence of the day in hours, we have to add the time slot
        ' note that if we have a presence without hours information we cannot add anything to the real time slot
        nRegPres = SRCO_GTA_PRESENCES.FindRegister("SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME",SCO_DT_END_OF_DAY,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME",SCO_DT_START_OF_DAY,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
        While nRegPres <> M4_ERROR
            SRCO_GTA_PRESENCES.MoveTo(nRegPres)
            dtPresStart = SRCO_GTA_PRESENCES.SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME
            dtPresEnd = SRCO_GTA_PRESENCES.SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME
        
            'we try to find if there are real TS register where the presence are included
            nRegRealTS = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.FindRegister("SCO_DT_STARTS_AT",dtPresEnd,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_ENDS_AT",dtPresStart,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_FIND_REG",1,M4_EQUAL)
            If nRegRealTS = M4_ERROR Then

                nRegRealTSAfter  = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.FindRegister("SCO_DT_STARTS_AT",dtPresEnd,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_FIND_REG",1,M4_EQUAL)
                nRegRealTSBefore = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.FindRegister("SCO_DT_ENDS_AT",dtPresStart,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_FIND_REG",1,M4_EQUAL)
                'If the new register is one minute less or more than a existing register, we join them
                If nRegRealTSAfter <> M4_ERROR and nRegRealTSBefore <> M4_ERROR Then
                    'the new register is in the middle of two, we join the three registers (modify one of the existing and delete the other)
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.MoveTo(nRegRealTSAfter)
                    dtNewRealEnd = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.DeleteRegister()
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.MoveTo(nRegRealTSBefore)
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT = dtNewRealEnd 
                    
                ElseIf nRegRealTSAfter <> M4_ERROR Then
                    'the new register is before a existing register, we modify the existing
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.MoveTo(nRegRealTSAfter)
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT = dtPresStart 
                
                ElseIf nRegRealTSBefore <> M4_ERROR Then
                    'the new register is after a existing register, we modify the existing
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.MoveTo(nRegRealTSBefore)
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT = dtPresEnd 

                Else
                    'if not, we add the register
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.AddRegister()
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_FIND_REG = 1                        
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT = dtPresStart
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT = dtPresEnd 
                EndIf
            Else
                'we have to modify the real TS
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.MoveTo(nRegRealTS)
                
                If dtPresStart<>SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT and dtPresEnd<>SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT Then
                    dtNewRealStart = Min(dtPresStart,SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT)
                    dtNewRealEnd   = Max(dtPresEnd,SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT)     
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT = dtNewRealStart 
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT   = dtNewRealEnd    
                EndIf
            EndIf

            nRegPres = SRCO_GTA_PRESENCES.FindRegister("SCO_DT_START_AND_TIME",SCO_DT_END_OF_DAY,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END_AND_TIME",SCO_DT_START_OF_DAY,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,nRegPres+1)           
        WEnd 'end of: For each presence of the day in hours, we have to add the time slot     

        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SORT()

    EndIf 'end of: We have to consider the presences
    
    
    'We have to join the register with the same start that the previous end and to delete the registers not found
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.Begin()
    sTranslatedTS = ""
    dtPrevEnd = nullvalue() : dtMaxEnd = M4_MINUS_INF : nPosIni = -1
    While SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.IsEOF()<>M4_TRUE
    
        'Join the register with the same start that the previous end
        'Example: if we have the time slots: 09:00-10:00, 10:00-11:00. We join it in: 09:00-11:00
        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.ISDELETED() <> M4_TRUE and SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_FIND_REG = 1 Then
        
            If dtPrevEnd = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT Then
                'we delete the register
                dtMaxEnd = Max(dtMaxEnd,SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT)
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.DeleteRegister()
                nSomeRealTSDeleted = M4_TRUE                    
            Else
            
                'we put the new end in the initial record, if need it
                'If nPosIni <> (SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.GetCurrent()-1) and nPosIni >=0 and dtMaxEnd <> M4_MINUS_INF Then 
                If nPosIni >=0 and dtMaxEnd <> M4_MINUS_INF Then 
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS[nPosIni].SCO_DT_ENDS_AT = dtMaxEnd 
                    dtMaxEnd = M4_MINUS_INF
                EndIf
                'this is the new initial record
                nPosIni = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.GetCurrent()
            EndIf
            
            dtPrevEnd = SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT
        EndIf
    
        'Delete/destroy the registers not found
        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_FIND_REG <> 1 Then
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.DeleteRegister()
            nSomeRealTSDeleted = M4_TRUE
        EndIf
        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.ISDELETED() = M4_TRUE and SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_TIMESLOT_ORDINAL = nullvalue() Then
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.DESTROYREGISTER()
        Else
        
            If SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.ISDELETED() = M4_FALSE Then
                If sTranslatedTS <> "" Then sTranslatedTS = sTranslatedTS +","
                sTranslatedTS = sTranslatedTS + SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_HOUR_TO_STRING(SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT) + " - " + SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_HOUR_TO_STRING(SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT)
            EndIf
        
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.GONEXT()
        EndIf
    WEnd

'    If nPosIni <> SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.Count() and nPosIni >=0 and dtMaxEnd <> M4_MINUS_INF Then 
    If nPosIni >=0 and dtMaxEnd <> M4_MINUS_INF Then 
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS[nPosIni].SCO_DT_ENDS_AT = dtMaxEnd 
    EndIf

    SCO_TRANSLATED_TS_REAL = sTranslatedTS
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.Begin()        

EndIf 'end of: If we are in the period of calc, not loaded previous data then we have to calc (or recalc) the real time slot

'If we have marked some register to delete, we hide it, because we don't want that the alerts or counters see it. Before save we will show them again
If nSomeRealTSDeleted = M4_TRUE Then
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_REAL_TS.ADDFILTER(-OP_DELETED)
EndIf

'SCO_CALC_START_END_HRS
'Calc start & end hours of the day

dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR

'End
hEnd = SCO_HOUR_END_OF_DAY
sIsNextDay = SCO_HR_END_IS_AF_DAY
If hEnd = nullvalue() then hEnd = Today() 'by default 00:00 (the time part of a date is 00:00)
If sIsNextDay = nullvalue() then sIsNextDay = "1"

If sIsNextDay = "1" Then
    dtCurEnd = dtCur + 1
Else
    dtCurEnd = dtCur
EndIf 

dtEnd = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DATE_PLUS_HOUR(dtCurEnd,hEnd)
SCO_DT_END_OF_DAY = dtEnd


'Start
SCO_LOAD_MORE_DAYS(-1)

nCurrRecord = GetCurrent()
If nCurrRecord <> 0 Then
    dtYesterdayEndHour = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CALC[nCurrRecord-1].SCO_DT_END_OF_DAY
EndIf
If dtYesterdayEndHour = nullvalue() Then dtYesterdayEndHour = dtCur

SCO_DT_START_OF_DAY = dtYesterdayEndHour

'SCO_CALC_STATUS
'Status: we allways put the status 2

nStatus = 2
Return(nStatus)

'''old code
'''Status: normally we put the final status (2), we only put 1 (previous) if this a a recalculation of the theoretical and the theoretical is modified by the manager
'
''existModifValidRev = SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.FindRegister("DT_START",SCO_DT_CUR,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_ID_ORIGIN",2,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_ID_STATUS",2,EQUAL)
''nStatus = 2 'final data
''If existModifValidRev <> -1 and SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_HR_THEO = 1 Then
''    nStatus = 1 'previous data
''EndIf  
'
''Return(nStatus)

'SCO_CALC_TT
'Calculation of theoretical time, calendar, day type and time table ID

dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR

'If we have to calculate the theoretical and this is a calculated register
If (SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_HR_THEO = 1 and SCO_ID_ORIGIN = 1) or SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_CYCLE_EXEC = 1 Then

    'We control the locked of theoretical
    If SCO_LOCK_THEOR_TIME = "Y" Then
        'You can not recalculate the theoretical time, because it has been blocked. This occurred in the employee %0:s, ordinal period %1:n and day %2:d.
        Setlog(M4_WARNINGLOG,18,10,509,STD_ID_HR,ToString(STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,0),ToString(SCO_DT_CUR,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT))
    Else

'''        'TT call
'''        nExeMod = 3 'Theoretical Time + calendar
'''        nbCalendarWhr= 0: nbTheoRefWHr = 0     
'''        nWkngDays  = 0  : nWkngSatDays = 0        : nWkngSunDays = 0
'''        nCalWkngDays = 0: nWkngSatCalDays = 0     : nWkngSunCalDays = 0
'''        nSPEC_CHAR_DAYS = 0 : nCAL_MON_FRIDAY_DAYS = 0 : nHOL_MON_TO_FRIDAY = 0                       
'''    
'''        'SCO_CALC_THEOR_TIME uses now the new parameter SCO_USE_WD,before calling it, set SCO_USE_WD := 0 = "do not use WorkDays data"
'''        SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_HR_THEOR_TIME.SCO_USE_WD = 0     
'''        'SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_HR_THEOR_TIME.SCO_CALC_THEOR_TIME(STD_ID_HR, STD_OR_HR_PERIOD, SCO_OR_HR_ROLE, dtCur, dtCur, nExeMod, nbTheoRefWHr, nbCalendarWhr, nWkngDays, nCalWkngDays, nWkngSatDays, nWkngSunDays, nWkngSatCalDays, nWkngSunCalDays, nSPEC_CHAR_DAYS, nCAL_MON_FRIDAY_DAYS, nHOL_MON_TO_FRIDAY)
'''        SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_HR_THEOR_TIME.SCO_CALC_THEOR_TIME(STD_ID_HR, STD_OR_HR_PERIOD, SCO_OR_HR_ROLE, dtCur, dtCur, nExeMod, nbTheoRefWHr, nbCalendarWhr, nWkngDays, nCalWkngDays, nWkngSatDays, nWkngSunDays, nWkngSatCalDays, nWkngSunCalDays)
'''    
        'TT call
        nbCalendarWhr= 0: nbTheoRefWHr = 0     
        nWkngDays    = 0: nWkngSatDays = 0        : nWkngSunDays = 0
        nCalWkngDays = 0: nWkngSatCalDays = 0     : nWkngSunCalDays = 0        
        SCO_CALC_TT_LOC(nbTheoRefWHr, nbCalendarWhr, nWkngDays, nCalWkngDays, nWkngSatDays, nWkngSunDays, nWkngSatCalDays, nWkngSunCalDays)

        SCO_OR_REF_MOD = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_OR_REF_MOD    

        'on récupère le code calendrier et le type de jour du salarié à cette date pour info       
        SCO_ID_CALENDAR = SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_CALENDAR_REP.P_ID_CALENDAR
        ''SCO_ID_CALENDAR = SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_CALENDAR_REP.SFR_ID_CALENDAR
        nReg = SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_CALENDAR_REP.Findregister("SCO_DT_DAY",dtCur,M4_EQUAL)
        If nReg <> M4_ERROR Then
            SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_CALENDAR_REP.MoveTo(nReg)
            SCO_ID_DAYCALEN_TYPE = SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_CALENDAR_REP.SCO_ID_DAYCALEN_TYPE
        EndIf
        //If IsNull(SCO_ID_CALENDAR) = M4_TRUE Then SCO_ID_CALENDAR = GetNodeItemData("","SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS","SCO_LBL_NO_CALENDAR",M4_ITEM_NAME)  '"PAS DE CALENDRIER"
    
        'Units
        nNumOfUnits = NullValue()
        If SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_DAY_TYPE.count()> 0 and SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_DAY_TYPE.IsEOF() = M4_FALSE Then 
            If SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_DAY_TYPE.SCO_ID_ENTER_TYPE = "2" Then 'other units
                nNumOfUnits = SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_DAY_TYPE.SCO_WKNG_HRS_DAY
            EndIf
        EndIf
        
        If nbCalendarWhr <> 0 Then
            SCO_WORK_THEO_HRS = 0
            SCO_ABS_CAL_HRS   = nbCalendarWhr    
        Else
            SCO_WORK_THEO_HRS = nbTheoRefWHr
            SCO_ABS_CAL_HRS   = 0
        EndIf    
        
        'Employees managed by days
        If SCO_EMPL_MANAGEMENT_BY_DAYS = 1 Then 
            If nNumOfUnits = nullvalue() Then
                'employees managed by days must have days defined with "other units"
                Setlog(M4_WARNINGLOG,18,10,510,STD_ID_HR,ToString(STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,0),ToString(SCO_DT_CUR,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT),SCO_ID_DAY_TYPE)
            Else
                If nCalWkngDays <> 0 Then
                    SCO_WORK_THEO_DAY = 0
                    SCO_ABS_CAL_DAY   = nCalWkngDays    
                Else
                    SCO_WORK_THEO_DAY = nNumOfUnits 
                    SCO_ABS_CAL_DAY   = 0
                EndIf
            
                If SCO_WORK_THEO_DAY = 0 Then
                    SCO_NUM_AVG_HRS_DAY_4_UNIT_DAY  = 0
                Else
                    SCO_NUM_AVG_HRS_DAY_4_UNIT_DAY = Truncate(SCO_WORK_THEO_HRS / SCO_WORK_THEO_DAY,2)
                EndIf

            EndIf
        Else
            SCO_WORK_THEO_DAY = nullvalue()
            SCO_ABS_CAL_DAY   = nullvalue()
            SCO_NUM_AVG_HRS_DAY_4_UNIT_DAY = nullvalue()
        EndIf
        
        'Start and end of the day
        If DayOfTheWeek(SCO_DT_CUR) = 1 Then
            SCO_CHK_START_WEEK = "Y"
            SCO_CHK_END_WEEK = "N"
        ElseIf DayOfTheWeek(SCO_DT_CUR) = 7 Then
            SCO_CHK_START_WEEK = "N"
            SCO_CHK_END_WEEK = "Y"
        Else
            SCO_CHK_START_WEEK = "N"
            SCO_CHK_END_WEEK = "N"
        EndIf      
        'For the change of cycle: if it is start/end of cycle it is start/end of week
        If SCO_CHK_START_REF_MOD = "Y" Then SCO_CHK_START_WEEK = "Y"
        If SCO_CHK_END_REF_MOD = "Y" Then SCO_CHK_END_WEEK = "Y"        
        
        'Label of the day of the week
        reg_nmWeekDay = SCO_TA_WEEKDAY.FindRegister("SCO_ID_DAY",DayOfTheWeek(SCO_DT_CUR),EQUAL)
        If reg_nmWeekDay <> -1 Then SCO_COMMENT = SCO_TA_WEEKDAY[reg_nmWeekDay].SCO_NM_DAY  
        
        SCO_DT_LAST_THEO_UPDATE = M4_MINUS_INF

    EndIf
 
ElseIf SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC = 1 and SCO_ID_ENTER_TYPE = "2" and SCO_EMPL_MANAGEMENT_BY_DAYS = 1 Then

    'Only for employees that have a cycle with units and managed by days if there are a change in the theoretical, we need to recalculate the theoretical hours of all the week
    'Remember that for these cycles the TT M4O calculate the hours using a weekly value. We need to do a similar calculation, but taking into account the data modified by the user
    'Note that we don't recalculate the days, in this case we are using the days (modified manually by the user) to recalculate the hours!
    
    'First we must recalculate (one time per week) the sum of units of the week (for example 5 days) and the number of hours of the week (for example 35 hours)
    nNumWeekUnits = 0
    nNumWeekHrs = 0    
    If SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_NUM_WEEK_UNIT = nullvalue() or SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_NUM_WEEK_HRS = nullvalue() or DayOfTheWeek(dtCur) = 1 Then
        'If this is the first register or Monday, we have to calculate the sum of units of the week and the number of hours of the week 
    
        nNumWeekUnits = 0 : nNumWeekHrs = 0
        'Sum of units of the week
        ' we have to use the "times" of this node (worked days) if exist, if not we have to search in the day of the week (for example, in hire, termination, change of cycle or not calculation)
        'nCurReg = SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.getCurrent() : nCount = SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.Count()
        dStartWeek = dtCur - DayOfTheWeek(dtCur) + 1
        dLoop = dStartWeek 
        For i=1 to 7 'loop over the week days

            nRegRead = SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.FindRegister("DT_START",dLoop,M4_EQUAL)
            
            'If (i < DayOfTheWeek(dtCur)) or (nCurReg + i > nCount) Then
            If nRegRead = M4_ERROR Then
                'we need to use the week information
                nNumWeekUnits = nNumWeekUnits + SRCO_RWD_GTA_WEEK.SCO_GET_UNIT_OF_WEEK_DAY(SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_OR_WEEK,i)
                                
            Else
                'we need to move to this register
                'nRegRead = nCurReg+i-DayOfTheWeek(dtCur)
                SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.MoveTo(nRegRead )
                'We have to sum the calendar too
                nNumWeekUnits = nNumWeekUnits + SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_WORK_THEO_DAY + SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_ABS_CAL_DAY
            EndIf
            dLoop = dLoop + 1
        Next

        'Number of hours of the week: we use TT
        SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_HR_THEOR_TIME.SCO_LOAD_THEOR_TIME(STD_ID_HR, STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,dtCur,dtCur)
        SCO_THEORETICAL_TIME!SCO_TT_PERIOD_VALUES.SCO_CALC_THEO_WEEK_VALUE(dtCur,dtCur,nNumWeekHrs) 'the last argument is by reference
        
        nNumWeekUnits = ToDouble(nNumWeekUnits)
        nNumWeekHrs = ToDouble(nNumWeekHrs)
        
        'Put the values in the variables
        SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_NUM_WEEK_UNIT = nNumWeekUnits 
        SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_NUM_WEEK_HRS = nNumWeekHrs 
    Else
        nNumWeekUnits = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_NUM_WEEK_UNIT
        nNumWeekHrs = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_NUM_WEEK_HRS
    EndIf

    If nNumWeekUnits <> 0 Then 
        SCO_NUM_AVG_HRS_DAY_4_UNIT_DAY = Truncate(nNumWeekHrs/nNumWeekUnits,2)
    Else 
        SCO_NUM_AVG_HRS_DAY_4_UNIT_DAY = 0
    EndIf

    'Last, for this day, we can calculate the number of hours
    SCO_WORK_THEO_HRS = SCO_WORK_THEO_DAY * SCO_NUM_AVG_HRS_DAY_4_UNIT_DAY
      
EndIf

Return(M4_SUCCESS)

'Call clocking adjustemnt rules (if the employee has clock/declarative the present day and we are in a clocking execution or is as recalc in the past)
' 1.- Load the clock in/out or declarative info
' 2.- Copy the info to the effective node
' 3.- Calculate the gross clock/declarative hours
' 4.- Execute the clocking adjustment rules, that will be executed in the effective node and modify it

dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
If SCO_EMPL_CLOCK_OR_DECLARATIVE = 1 Then
    If SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_CLOCK_INOUT_EXEC = 1 or ( (SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC = 1 or SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_ABS = 1 or SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_PRES = 1) and Today()>=dtCur) Then
        '1.- Load the clock in/out or declarative info
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.Load_blk()
        
        '2.- Copy the info to the effective node 
        For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.Count()-1
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK.MoveTo(i)
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.AddRegister()
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK.CopyRegister("","SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK",-1,SCOPE_REGISTER+TYPE_FIELD,SCOPE_REGISTER+TYPE_PROPERTY)
        Next
        
        ' 3.- Calculate the gross clock/declarative hours
        SCO_CALC_GROSS_CLOCK_DEC_HRS()    
        
        ' 4.- Execute the clocking adjustment rules, that will be executed in the effective node and modify it
        ExecuteGroup("SCO_CLOCK_ADJUST_RULES")
    EndIf

'SCO_CNTRL_THEO_TS_IN_DAY
'Control theoretical time slots into the "work day" (journée/jornada)
' Remenber that the "work day" can be between two days. For example, can start at fisrt of January 12:00 and end at second of January 12:00
' This rule is to control wrong start and end pof day values

nRet = M4_SUCCESS
dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
sIdHr = STD_ID_HR

If SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count() > 0 Then

    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Begin()
    dtStartTheoTS = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT

    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.End()
    dtEndTheoTS = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT
    
    dtStartOfDay = SCO_DT_START_OF_DAY
    dtEndOfDay = SCO_DT_END_OF_DAY 

    If dtStartOfDay > dtStartTheoTS or dtEndOfDay < dtEndTheoTS Then
        'The values of start or end hour of the day are incoherent with the theoretical time slots. The theoretical time slots cannot start before or end after the start/end hour of the day.
        'You must change the start or end hour of the day through the properties SCO_HOUR_END_OF_DAY and SCO_HR_END_IS_AF_DAY in the apply value system. 
        'This happens in the day %0:d, employee %1:s, period ordinal %2:n.
        'The start of the day is %3:d, the end of the day is %4:d, the start of the theoretical time slots is %5:d and the start of the theoretical time slots is %6:d.
        SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,567,ToString(dtCur,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT),sIdHr,ToString(STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,0),dtStartOfDay,dtEndOfDay,dtStartTheoTS,dtEndTheoTS)
        nRet = M4_ERROR
    EndIf
EndIf

Return(nRet)

'Cycle prorate coefficient
'Prorate in case of change of cycle
dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR

'We have to load the previous days until the initiation of the cycle (normally 6)
nNumWeeksOfTheCycle = SCO_NUM_WEEKS_OF_CYCLE
If nNumWeeksOfTheCycle > 1 Then nNumCompleteWeeks = SCO_OR_REF_MOD - 1 Else nNumCompleteWeeks = 0 
nNumDaysUntilCycleStart = - (7*nNumCompleteWeeks) - DayOfTheWeek(dtCur) + 1 'the begining of the cycle
SCO_LOAD_MORE_DAYS(nNumDaysUntilCycleStart)

'We have to loop backward until the first of the next situations:
'  Start of the cycle
bEnd = M4_FALSE
nCurrReg = GetCurrent()
Do
    If SCO_CHK_START_REF_MOD = "Y"  Then
        dtIniCycle = SCO_DT_CUR
        bEnd = M4_TRUE
    EndIf
    GoPrevious()
Until (bEnd = M4_TRUE or GetCurrent() = M4_ERROR)
MoveTo(nCurrReg)

'we don't want to take into account the termination or the begining of a suspension, so we sum these days until the end of the cycle
If SCO_IS_TERMINATION = 1 or SCO_IS_LAST_DAY_BEF_SUSP = 1 Then
    If nNumWeeksOfTheCycle > 1 Then nNumCompleteWeeks = nNumWeeksOfTheCycle - SCO_OR_REF_MOD Else nNumCompleteWeeks = 0 
    dtCur = dtCur + 7 - DayOfTheWeek(dtCur) + (nNumCompleteWeeks * 7)
EndIf

nCoef = (DateDiff(dtCur,dtIniCycle,M4_DAY) + 1) / (7*nNumWeeksOfTheCycle)

Return(nCoef)
