'SCO_EXEC_ALERTS
'Execution of the alerts
'We loop the alerts and check that the property exist in this node
'After we check if we need to execute the alert: 
' · the theoretical alerts only if we calculate theoretical
' · the clocking alerts only after clocking
' · the real alerts always 
'We check if the alert is activated by the user
'And finally, we execute the alert concept rule(s)
'*********************************************************************

'Variables and constant
dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
sThisNode = GetThisNodeId()
sGTA_THEOR_ALERT = "01"
sGTA_REAL_ALERT  = "02"
sGTA_CLOCK_ALERT = "04"
nIsAfterChangeTheorExec = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC 
nIsRecalcTheo = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_HR_THEO
nIsClock_InOut = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_CLOCK_INOUT_EXEC
nExecAllMode = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_EXECUTE_ALL_ALERTS_COUNTER '1 -> All (def val), 2 -> Only online, 3 -> Only offnile
nAlertStatusOK       = 0
nAlertStatusErrTheo  = 1
nAlertStatusErrClock = 2
nAlertStatusErrReal  = 3

'We load the alerts of this day (if exists)
SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS.Load_blk()

'We loop the alerts. This node is loaded only one time for all the employees
For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.Count()-1
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.MoveTo(i)

    'Alert with/withoutLN4
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_NOT_LN4_CODE_4_ALERT = 0 Then
    
        'Check that the property exist in this node
        sIdPropertyItem = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_ID_PROPERTY
        If ExistNodeItemIndex(sThisNode,sIdPropertyItem) <> M4_ERROR Then
        
            'Check if we need to execute the alert: 
            ' · the theoretical alerts only if we calculate theoretical
            ' · the clocking alerts only for clocking/declarative employees in the past (and we are not creating the theoretical, but yes in the case of modify the theoretical in the past)
            ' · the real alerts always for not clocking/declarative employees, and for clocking/declarative employees equal that clock alerts
            ' · if the alert is marked like offline only in offline execution (or in clock execution)
            sAlertType = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_ID_ALERT_TYPE
            nAlertOnlyOffline = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_CHK_EXECUTE_ONLY_OFFLINE
            If (nIsAfterChangeTheorExec = 1 and sAlertType = sGTA_THEOR_ALERT) or (SCO_EMPL_CLOCK_OR_DECLARATIVE = 1 and (sAlertType = sGTA_CLOCK_ALERT or sAlertType = sGTA_REAL_ALERT) and nIsRecalcTheo = 0 and dtCur<=Today()) or (sAlertType = sGTA_REAL_ALERT and SCO_EMPL_CLOCK_OR_DECLARATIVE = 0) Then
'           If (nIsAfterChangeTheorExec = 1 and sAlertType = sGTA_THEOR_ALERT) or (nIsClock_InOut = 1 and SCO_EMPL_CLOCK_OR_DECLARATIVE = 1 and (sAlertType = sGTA_CLOCK_ALERT or sAlertType = sGTA_REAL_ALERT)) or (sAlertType = sGTA_REAL_ALERT) Then 
                If nExecAllMode = 1 or (nExecAllMode = 2 and nAlertOnlyOffline = 0) or (nExecAllMode = 3 and nAlertOnlyOffline = 1) Then
    
                    'Check if the alert is activated by the user. The alerts are "GTA properties", so they have the value of the severity via the apply value
                    sAlertValue = GetValue(sThisNode,sIdPropertyItem,-1)
                    nRegActive = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.FindRegister("SCO_ID_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL",sAlertValue,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_CHK_ACTIVE",1,M4_EQUAL)
                    If nRegActive <> M4_ERROR Then
                    
                        'We call the alert concept
                        Call(sThisNode,sIdPropertyItem)
        
                    Else
                        'If the alert is not activated, we execute the SCO_SET_ALERT with the third parameter M4_FALSE to delete the alert if exists (this is the case of one user deactivating an alert previously activated)
                        SCO_SET_ALERT(sIdPropertyItem,sAlertValue,M4_FALSE)
                    EndIf 'End of: Check if the alert is activated
                EndIf 'End of: Check online/offline
            EndIf 'End of: Check if we need to execute the alert
        EndIf 'End of: Check that the property exist here
    Else
        'Simple alerts

        sIdPropertyItem = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_ID_PROPERTY
        sLeftType  = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_PROPERTY_TO_COMPARE_TYPE
        sLeftItem  = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_PROPERTY_TO_COMPARE
        sRigthType = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_PROPERTY_USED_TO_COMP_TYPE 
        sRigthItem = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_PROPERTY_USED_TO_COMPARE 
        sOperator  = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_OPERATOR
        sRigthTypeVal = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_VALUE_IN_COMPARATION_TYPE
        
        'Check that the property exist in this node and the main data are not null
        If ExistNodeItemIndex(sThisNode,sIdPropertyItem) <> M4_ERROR and sLeftItem <> nullvalue() and sRigthTypeVal <> nullvalue() Then

            'Check if we need to execute the alert: 
            ' If there are a counter or two in the definition: when both are activated
            ' If there are not counters in the definition: always
            bExecAlert = M4_FALSE
            
            If sLeftType = "COUNTER" or sRigthType = "COUNTER" Then
                'there are counters in the definition
                If sLeftType = "COUNTER" and sLeftItem <> nullvalue() Then
                    sIdActCounterItemLeft = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_CALC_ID_END_ACT_ITEM(sLeftItem)
                    If ExistNodeItemIndex(sThisNode,sIdActCounterItemLeft) <> M4_ERROR Then
                        If GetValue(sThisNode,sIdActCounterItemLeft,-1) = "1" Then 
                            bExecAlertLeft = M4_TRUE
                        EndIf
                    EndIf
                EndIf
                
                If sRigthType = "COUNTER" and sRigthItem <> nullvalue() Then
                    sIdActCounterItemRigth = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_CALC_ID_END_ACT_ITEM(sRigthItem)
                    If ExistNodeItemIndex(sThisNode,sIdActCounterItemRigth) <> M4_ERROR Then
                        If GetValue(sThisNode,sIdActCounterItemRigth,-1) = "1" Then 
                            bExecAlertRigth = M4_TRUE
                        EndIf
                    EndIf
                EndIf
                
                If sLeftType = "COUNTER" and sRigthType <> "COUNTER" and bExecAlertLeft = M4_TRUE Then
                    bExecAlert = M4_TRUE
                ElseIf sRigthType = "COUNTER" and sLeftType <> "COUNTER" and bExecAlertRigth = M4_TRUE Then
                    bExecAlert = M4_TRUE
                ElseIf sLeftType = "COUNTER" and sRigthType = "COUNTER" and bExecAlertLeft = M4_TRUE and bExecAlertRigth = M4_TRUE Then             
                    bExecAlert = M4_TRUE
                Else
                    bExecAlert = M4_FALSE        
                EndIf                
                
            Else
                'there aren't counters in the definition                
                bExecAlert = M4_TRUE
            EndIf
            
            If bExecAlert = M4_TRUE Then 'if we have to executed the alert
            
                'Check if the alert is activated by the user. The alerts are "GTA properties", so they have the value of the severity via the apply value
                sAlertValue = GetValue(sThisNode,sIdPropertyItem,-1)
                nRegActive = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.FindRegister("SCO_ID_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL",sAlertValue,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_CHK_ACTIVE",1,M4_EQUAL)
                If nRegActive <> M4_ERROR Then
                
                    'We create and execute the code
                    If sRigthTypeVal = "OTHER_VALUE" Then
                        sRigthValue = ToString(SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_VALUE_USED_TO_COMPARE)
                    ElseIf sRigthItem <> nullvalue() Then 
                        sRigthValue = sRigthItem 
                    EndIf
                    
                    'Note that the left and rigth part must be numbers (or number of hours (17) than internally it is the same)
                    sCode = "If " + sLeftItem + " " + sOperator + " " + sRigthValue + " Then Return(1) Else Return(0)"
                    If sCode <> nullvalue() Then
                        nError = ExecuteLn4Jit(sCode)
                        
                        'we execute the method SCO_SET_ALERT 
                        If nError = 0 Then
                            'no error, no params
                            SCO_SET_ALERT(sIdPropertyItem,sAlertValue,nError)
                        Else
                            If GetNodeItemData("",sThisNode,sLeftItem,M4_ITEM_M4TYPE) = 17 or GetNodeItemData("",sThisNode,sLeftItem,M4_ITEM_INTERNAL_TYPE) = 89 Then                                
                                'if the type it is number of hours, we show it in the format choosed by the user
                                sLeftItemValueFormMessage = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_NUM_HOUR_TO_STRING(GetValue(sThisNode,sLeftItem,-1))
                            Else
                                sLeftItemValueFormMessage = ToString(GetValue(sThisNode,sLeftItem,-1),GetNodeItemScale(sThisNode,sLeftItem))
                            EndIf                            
                            
                            If sRigthTypeVal = "OTHER_VALUE" Then
                                'only the left param
                                SCO_SET_ALERT(sIdPropertyItem,sAlertValue,nError,"Arg1",sLeftItemValueFormMessage)
                            Else
                                'both params
                                If GetNodeItemData("",sThisNode,sRigthItem,M4_ITEM_M4TYPE) = 17 or GetNodeItemData("",sThisNode,sRigthItem,M4_ITEM_INTERNAL_TYPE) = 89 Then                                
                                    'if the type it is number of hours, we show it in the format choosed by the user
                                    sRigthItemValueFormMessage = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_NUM_HOUR_TO_STRING(GetValue(sThisNode,sRigthItem,-1))
                                Else
                                    sRigthItemValueFormMessage = ToString(GetValue(sThisNode,sRigthItem,-1),GetNodeItemScale(sThisNode,sRigthItem))
                                EndIf
                                SCO_SET_ALERT(sIdPropertyItem,sAlertValue,nError,"Arg1",sLeftItemValueFormMessage,"Arg2",sRigthItemValueFormMessage)                                            
                            EndIf
                        EndIf
                    EndIf    
                Else
                    'If the alert is not activated, we execute the SCO_SET_ALERT with the third parameter M4_FALSE to delete the alert if exists (this is the case of one user deactivating an alert previously activated)
                    SCO_SET_ALERT(sIdPropertyItem,sAlertValue,M4_FALSE)
                EndIf 'End of: Check if the alert is activated            
            
            EndIf 'end of: 'if we have to executed the alert
            
        EndIf 'end of: Check that the property exist here
            
    EndIf 'end of: Alert with/without LN4
Next


'-------------Alert status & maximum severity level -------------
'We loop the alerts node to recalculate the alert status (about blocking alerts) and the maximum severity level
nMaxAlertSevLevel = -1
nIdAlertStatus = nAlertStatusOK
For i=0 to SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS.Count()-1
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS.MoveTo(i)

'SCO_EXEC_C_ACUM_PREV_VAL
'Exec counters: acumulate previous value, if needed
'1.- We calculate the date of the previous value
'2.- We search the previous value
'Arguments:
' ARG_ID_ENT
' ARG_DT_START_TO_STORE
'Return: nothing

'Arguments
sIDEnt  = ARG_ID_ENT
dtStartToStore = ARG_DT_START_TO_STORE

'variables
dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
sCalcNode = GetThisNodeId()
nCounterVarType = GetNodeItemData(sCalcNode,sIDEnt,M4_ITEM_M4TYPE)  
vValue = GetValue(sCalcNode,sIDEnt,-1)

'Note that if we are here it means that this counters is activated today and we need to acumulate the previous value

'1.- We calculate the date of the previous value
' Normally that it is one less day that the date to store
dtPrev = dtStartToStore - 1       
'if the previous date is into the previous suspension period, we use the previous date to the start of the suspension
If SCO_DT_START_PREV_SUSPENSION <> nullvalue() and SCO_DT_END_PREV_SUSPENSION <> nullvalue() Then
    If dtPrev >= SCO_DT_START_PREV_SUSPENSION and dtPrev <= SCO_DT_END_PREV_SUSPENSION  Then
        dtPrev = SCO_DT_START_PREV_SUSPENSION - 1
    EndIf
EndIf

'2.- We search the previous value
nCountReg = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.FindRegister("SCO_ID_VAR_ELEMENT",sIDEnt,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START",dtPrev,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END",dtPrev,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
If nCountReg <> M4_ERROR Then
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.MoveTo(nCountReg)
    If SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.ISDELETED() = M4_FALSE Then
        sPrevValue = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_FINAL_VALUE

        'we accumulate the previous value
        If nCounterVarType = 6 or nCounterVarType = 8 or nCounterVarType = 9  Then
            'number like types
            vValue = ToDouble(sPrevValue) + vValue        
        ElseIf nCounterVarType = 1 or nCounterVarType = 2 or nCounterVarType = 3 or nCounterVarType = 7 or nCounterVarType = 11 or nCounterVarType = 13 or nCounterVarType = 14 or nCounterVarType = 15 Then
            'strings like types
            vValue = sPrevValue + vValue 
        ElseIf nCounterVarType = 4 or nCounterVarType = 5 or nCounterVarType = 12  Then
            'date like types
            vValue = ToDate(sPrevValue) + vValue                     
        EndIf
        
        SetValue(sCalcNode,sIDEnt,-1,vValue)
    EndIf
EndIf

'SCO_EXEC_C_COPY_VALUE_MODIF_US
'Copy value to the calc node (with highest priority) if has been modify by user
'If the value has been modified by the user we want to maintain this value (not calculate other value), so we need to put this value in the calc node (because other counter can use this value)
'Note that this method is executed only if the counter is activated
'Arguments:
' ARG_ID_ENT
' ARG_DT_START_TO_STORE

'First we will find if the counter has been modified by the user
nRegCounter = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.FindRegister("SCO_ID_VAR_ELEMENT",ARG_ID_ENT,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START",ARG_DT_START_TO_STORE,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_ID_STATUS",2,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_ID_ORIGIN",1,M4_DISTINCT)
If nRegCounter <> M4_ERROR Then

    SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.Moveto(nRegCounter)
    vValue = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_FINAL_VALUE
    sCalcNode = GetThisNodeId()
    
    'we set the value modified by the manager with the higher priority
    SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,ARG_ID_ENT,-1,vValue)

EndIf

'SCO_EXEC_C_DEACTIVATE
'Exec counters: deactivate counter if needed
'Arguments:
' ARG_ID_ENT
' ARG_ID_END_ACT_ITEM
' ARG_STORAGE_SCOPE
'Return: bCounterIsActivated

'Arguments
sIDEnt  = ARG_ID_ENT
sIDEndActItem = ARG_ID_END_ACT_ITEM
nStorScope = ARG_STORAGE_SCOPE

'variables
dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
sM4O = GetChannelId()
sCalcNode = GetThisNodeId()
nExecOfflineOnlineCounters = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_EXECUTE_ALL_ALERTS_COUNTER


If nStorScope = 2 Then '--- Week ---------------------
    If SCO_CHK_END_WEEK = "N" Then
        'if today is not the end of the week, we deactivate the counter
        SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem,-1,"0")
    EndIf

ElseIf nStorScope = 3 Then '--- Cycle ---------------------
    If SCO_CHK_END_REF_MOD = "N" Then
        'if today is not the end of the cycle, we deactivate the counter
        SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem,-1,"0")
    EndIf        

ElseIf nStorScope = 10 Then '--- CompleteMonth ---------------------
    If DxDay(dtCur) <> DaysOfMonth(dtCur) Then
        'if today is not the end of the month, we deactivate the counter
        SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem,-1,"0")
    EndIf                    

ElseIf nStorScope = 11 Then '--- VE period ---------------------
    'First we try to find the VE period for today
    nVEPerReg = SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.FindRegister("SCO_DT_START_DROITS_CLC",dtCur,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END_DROITS_CLC",dtCur,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
    If nVEPerReg <> M4_ERROR Then
    
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.MoveTo(nVEPerReg)
        If dtCur <> SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.SCO_DT_END_DROITS_CLC Then
            'if today is not the end of the VE Period, we deactivate the counter
            SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem,-1,"0")                    
        EndIf
    Else
        'The counter %0:s is activated and the counter has been defined with scope 'Variable Elements period' but don't exist a Variable Elements period for the current day. This happens in employee %1:s, period ordinal %2:n and date %3:d.
        SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,518,sIDEnt,STD_ID_HR,ToString(STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,0),ToString(dtCur,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT))
        Return(M4_ERROR)
    EndIf

ElseIf nStorScope = 12 Then '--- Year defined by day and month ---------------------
    'The day and the month are defined by the user using two properties
    sDayProp = sIDEnt + "_SPER_D"
    sMonthProp = sIDEnt + "_SPER_M"
    dDateOfStorage = nullvalue()
    If ExistNodeItemIndex(sCalcNode,sDayProp) <> M4_ERROR and ExistNodeItemIndex(sCalcNode,sMonthProp) <> M4_ERROR Then
        nDay = GetValue(sCalcNode,sDayProp,-1) 
        nMonth = GetValue(sCalcNode,sMonthProp,-1) 
        
        If nDay <> nullvalue() and nMonth <> nullvalue () Then
            dDateOfStorage = NumbersToDate(DxYear(dtCur),nMonth,nDay)
        Else
            'to launch the error, we need to get the name of the counter and properties
            sNMEnt = "" : sNMDayProp = "" : sNMMonthProp = ""
            nRegCounterDef = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.FindRegister("SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT",sIDEnt,M4_EQUAL)
            If nRegCounterDef <> M4_ERROR Then sNMEnt = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF[nRegCounterDef].SCO_NM_ENTITLEMENT
            sNMDayProp = GetNodeItemData(sCalcNode,sDayProp,M4_ITEM_NAME)
            sNMMonthProp = GetNodeItemData(sCalcNode,sMonthProp,M4_ITEM_NAME)
            
            'The counter %0:s is activated and the counter has been defined with scope '%6:s' but the properties %4:s and %5:s are not filled for the current day. This happens in employee %1:s, period ordinal %2:n and date %3:d.
            SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,519,sIDEnt+"-"+sNMEnt,STD_ID_HR,ToString(STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,0),ToString(dtCur,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT),sDayProp+"-"+sNMDayProp,sMonthProp+"-"+sNMMonthProp,SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_NM_SCOPE)                    
            Return(M4_ERROR)
        EndIf
    Else
        'Error of development. You must create the item properties %0:s and %1:s for the counter %2:s in the node %3:s of the M4O %4:s.
        SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,520,sDayProp,sMonthProp,sIDEnt,sCalcNode,sM4O)                    
        Return(M4_ERROR)
    EndIf
    
    If dtCur <> dDateOfStorage Then
        'if today is not the end of the year period, we deactivate the counter
        SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem,-1,"0")
    EndIf      

ElseIf nStorScope = 13 Then '--- Year defined by day of the week and week of the year ---------------------
    'The day of the week and the week of the year are defined by the user using two properties
    sDayProp = sIDEnt + "_SPER_DW"
    sWeekProp = sIDEnt + "_SPER_W"
    dDateOfStorage = nullvalue()
    If ExistNodeItemIndex(sCalcNode,sDayProp) <> M4_ERROR and ExistNodeItemIndex(sCalcNode,sWeekProp) <> M4_ERROR Then
        nDay = GetValue(sCalcNode,sDayProp,-1) 
        nWeek = GetValue(sCalcNode,sWeekProp,-1) 
        
        If nDay <> nullvalue() and nWeek <> nullvalue () Then
            SCO_ISO_WEEK_DATE!SCO_ISO_WEEK_DATE.SCO_ISOWEEKDATE_TO_DATE(DxYear(dtCur),nWeek,nDay,dDateOfStorage) 
        Else
            'to launch the error, we need to get the name of the counter and properties
            sNMEnt = "" : sNMDayProp = "" : sNMWeekProp = ""
            nRegCounterDef = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.FindRegister("SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT",sIDEnt,M4_EQUAL)
            If nRegCounterDef <> M4_ERROR Then sNMEnt = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF[nRegCounterDef].SCO_NM_ENTITLEMENT
            sNMDayProp = GetNodeItemData(sCalcNode,sDayProp,M4_ITEM_NAME)
            sNMWeekProp = GetNodeItemData(sCalcNode,sWeekProp,M4_ITEM_NAME)        
        
            'The counter %0:s is activated and the counter has been defined with scope '%6:s' but the properties %4:s and %5:s are not filled for the current day. This happens in employee %1:s, period ordinal %2:n and date %3:d.
            SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,519,sIDEnt+"-"+sNMEnt,STD_ID_HR,ToString(STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,0),ToString(dtCur,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT),sDayProp+"-"+sNMDayProp,sWeekProp+"-"+sNMWeekProp,SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_NM_SCOPE)                                    
            Return(M4_ERROR)
        EndIf
    Else
        'Error of development. You must create the item properties %0:s and %1:s for the counter %2:s in the node %3:s of the M4O %4:s.
        SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,520,sDayProp,sWeekProp,sIDEnt,sCalcNode,sM4O)                                    
        Return(M4_ERROR)
    EndIf
    
    If dtCur <> dDateOfStorage Then
        'if today is not the end of the year period, we deactivate the counter
        SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem,-1,"0")
    EndIf      
            
EndIf


'We check the offline/online behavior of counters
    'nExecOfflineOnlineCounters : global parameter
    '0 -> None
    '1 -> All (def val)
    '2 -> Only online
    '3 -> Only ofline        
If nExecOfflineOnlineCounters = 0 Then
    SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem,-1,"0")
ElseIf nExecOfflineOnlineCounters = 2 and SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_CK_ONLINE = "0" Then
    SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem,-1,"0")
ElseIf nExecOfflineOnlineCounters = 3 and SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_CK_ONLINE = "1" Then
    SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem,-1,"0")
EndIf

If GetValue(sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem ,-1) = "1" Then 
    bCounterIsActivated = M4_TRUE
Else
    bCounterIsActivated = M4_FALSE
EndIf                

Return(bCounterIsActivated)

'SCO_EXEC_C_DT_START_TO_STORE
'Exec counters: ...
'Arguments:
' ARG_ID_ENT
' ARG_STORAGE_SCOPE
' ARG_COUNTER_IS_ACT
'Return: bAccPrevVal 

'Arguments
sIDEnt  = ARG_ID_ENT
nStorScope = ARG_STORAGE_SCOPE
bCounterIsActivated = ARG_COUNTER_IS_ACT

'variables
dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR

dtStartToStore = nullvalue()
If bCounterIsActivated = M4_TRUE Then 'If counter is activated
    If nStorScope = 1 Then '--- Day ---------------------
        dtStartToStore = dtCur 'current day
        
    ElseIf nStorScope = 2 Then '--- Week ---------------------
        dtStartToStore = dtCur-DayOfTheWeek(dtCur)+1 'the begining of the week
        
        'Change of cycle
        dtStartToStore = Max(dtStartToStore,SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_START)

    ElseIf nStorScope = 3 Then '--- Cycle ---------------------
        nNumWeeksOfTheCycle = SCO_NUM_WEEKS_OF_CYCLE
        If nNumWeeksOfTheCycle > 1 Then nNumCompleteWeeks = SCO_OR_REF_MOD - 1 Else nNumCompleteWeeks = 0 
        dtStartToStore = dtCur - (7*nNumCompleteWeeks) - DayOfTheWeek(dtCur) + 1 'the begining of the cycle

        'Change of cycle
        dtStartToStore = Max(dtStartToStore,SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_START)
            
    ElseIf nStorScope = 10 Then '--- CompleteMonth ---------------------
        dtStartToStore = NumbersToDate(DxYear(dtCur), DxMonth(dtCur),1) 'the begining of the month

    ElseIf nStorScope = 11 Then '--- VE period ---------------------
        'First we try to find the VE period for today
        nVEPerReg = SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.FindRegister("SCO_DT_START_DROITS_CLC",dtCur,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END_DROITS_CLC",dtCur,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
        If nVEPerReg <> M4_ERROR Then
        
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.MoveTo(nVEPerReg)
            dtStartToStore = SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.SCO_DT_START_DROITS_CLC 'start of the VE period (we always supose that there are not gaps or overlapping in VE periods)
        Else
            'The counter %0:s is activated and the counter has been defined with scope 'Variable Elements period' but don't exist a Variable Elements period for the current day. This happens in employee %1:s, period ordinal %2:n and date %3:d.
            SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,518,sIDEnt,STD_ID_HR,ToString(STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,0),ToString(dtCur,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT))                       
            Return(M4_ERROR)
        EndIf

    ElseIf nStorScope = 12 or nStorScope = 13  Then '--- Year defined by day and month OR Year defined by day of the week and week of the year ---------------------
        dtStartToStore = DateAdd(dtCur,-1,M4_YEAR)+1 'the previous date is one year ago
                
    EndIf
    
    'Hire (for all counters)
    dtStartToStore = Max(dtStartToStore,SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.STD_DT_START_PER)
    
    
EndIf 'end of: If counter is activated
SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_DT_START_TO_STORE = dtStartToStore 

Return(dtStartToStore)

'SCO_EXEC_C_IS_NEED_AC_PREV_VAL
'Exec counters: calculate if it is needed to acumulate the previous value,
' and too, if the value is the last value of an accumulation, i.e. is is the previous day of an initialization
'Arguments:
' ARG_ID_ENT
' ARG_STORAGE_SCOPE
' ARG_INI_SCOPE
' ARG_COUNTER_IS_ACT
' ARG_DT_START_TO_STORE
'Return: bAccPrevVal 

'Arguments
sIDEnt  = ARG_ID_ENT
nStorScope = ARG_STORAGE_SCOPE
nIniScope = ARG_INI_SCOPE
bCounterIsActivated = ARG_COUNTER_IS_ACT
dtStartToStore = ARG_DT_START_TO_STORE

'variables
dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
sM4O = GetChannelId()
sCalcNode = GetThisNodeId()

bAccPrevVal  = M4_FALSE
bIsLastAcVal = M4_TRUE
If nStorScope <> nIniScope and bCounterIsActivated = M4_TRUE Then 'if the storage periodicity <> initialization periodicity and the counter is activated
 
    'In general we need to accumulate the previous value (if the storage periodicity <> initialization periodicity and the counter is activated)
    bAccPrevVal  = M4_TRUE
    bIsLastAcVal = M4_FALSE
    
    'We have to do the calculation in the day of the save (if the storage is daily in the present day, if the storage is weekly in the first day of the week,...)
    If dtStartToStore <> dtCur Then
        nNumDaysToLoad = dtCur - dtStartToStore
        SCO_LOAD_MORE_DAYS(-nNumDaysToLoad)
        nCurReg = GetCurrent()        
        nReg = FindRegister("SCO_DT_CUR",dtStartToStore,M4_EQUAL)
    Else
        'by performance, in this case the record it is the present record, so we don't need to do any load neither find
        nCurReg = GetCurrent()        
        nReg = nCurReg 
    EndIf
    
    If nReg <> M4_ERROR Then
        MoveTo(nReg)
    
        'we calculate if it is needed to do the initialization, i.e. NOT to accumulate the previous value
        If nIniScope = 2 Then '--- Week ---------------------
            If SCO_CHK_START_WEEK = "Y" Then
                'if today is the start of the week, we do the ini
                bAccPrevVal = M4_FALSE
            EndIf
            
            If SCO_CHK_END_WEEK = "Y" Then
                'if today is the end day of the week, it is the last day of the accumulation
                bIsLastAcVal = M4_TRUE
            EndIf        
    
        ElseIf nIniScope = 3 Then '--- Cycle ---------------------
            If SCO_CHK_START_REF_MOD = "Y" Then
                'if today is the start of the cycle, we do the ini
                bAccPrevVal = M4_FALSE
            EndIf        
    
            If SCO_CHK_END_REF_MOD = "Y" Then
                'if today is the end of the cycle, it is the last day of the accumulation
                bIsLastAcVal = M4_TRUE
            EndIf 
    
        ElseIf nIniScope = 10 Then '--- CompleteMonth ---------------------
            If DxDay(dtCur) = 1 Then
                'if today is the start of the month, we do the ini
                bAccPrevVal = M4_FALSE
            EndIf        
            
            If DxDay(dtCur) = DaysOfMonth(dtCur) Then
                'if today is the end of the month, it is the last day of the accumulation
                bIsLastAcVal = M4_TRUE
            EndIf                     
    
        ElseIf nIniScope = 11 Then '--- VE period ---------------------
            'First we try to find the VE period for today
            nVEPerReg = SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.FindRegister("SCO_DT_START_DROITS_CLC",dtCur,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END_DROITS_CLC",dtCur,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
            If nVEPerReg <> M4_ERROR Then
            
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.MoveTo(nVEPerReg)
                If dtCur = SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.SCO_DT_START_DROITS_CLC Then
                    'if today is the start of the VE period, we do the ini
                    bAccPrevVal = M4_FALSE                   
                EndIf
                
                If dtCur = SRCO_GTA_RWD_VE_PERIODS.SCO_DT_END_DROITS_CLC Then
                    'if today is the end of the VE period, it is the last day of the accumulation
                    bIsLastAcVal = M4_TRUE
                EndIf                 
                
            Else
                'The counter %0:s is activated and the counter has been defined with scope 'Variable Elements period' but don't exist a Variable Elements period for the current day. This happens in employee %1:s, period ordinal %2:n and date %3:d.
                SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,518,sIDEnt,STD_ID_HR,ToString(STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,0),ToString(dtCur,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT))           
                Return(M4_ERROR)
            EndIf
    
        ElseIf nIniScope = 12 Then '--- Year defined by day and month ---------------------
            'The day and the month are defined by the user using two properties
            sDayProp = sIDEnt + "_IPER_D"
            sMonthProp = sIDEnt + "_IPER_M"
            dDateOfStorage = nullvalue()
            If ExistNodeItemIndex(sCalcNode,sDayProp) <> M4_ERROR and ExistNodeItemIndex(sCalcNode,sMonthProp) <> M4_ERROR Then
                nDay = GetValue(sCalcNode,sDayProp,-1) 
                nMonth = GetValue(sCalcNode,sMonthProp,-1) 
                
                If nDay <> nullvalue() and nMonth <> nullvalue () Then
                    dDateOfIni = NumbersToDate(DxYear(dtCur),nMonth,nDay)
                Else
                    'to launch the error, we need to get the name of the counter and properties
                    sNMEnt = "" : sNMDayProp = "" : sNMMonthProp = ""
                    nRegCounterDef = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.FindRegister("SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT",sIDEnt,M4_EQUAL)
                    If nRegCounterDef <> M4_ERROR Then sNMEnt = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF[nRegCounterDef].SCO_NM_ENTITLEMENT
                    sNMDayProp = GetNodeItemData(sCalcNode,sDayProp,M4_ITEM_NAME)
                    sNMMonthProp = GetNodeItemData(sCalcNode,sMonthProp,M4_ITEM_NAME)                
                
                    'The counter %0:s is activated and the counter has been defined with scope '%6:s' but the properties %4:s and %5:s are not filled for the current day. This happens in employee %1:s, period ordinal %2:n and date %3:d.
                    SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,519,sIDEnt+"-"+sNMEnt ,STD_ID_HR,ToString(STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,0),ToString(dtCur,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT),sDayProp+"-"+sNMDayProp,sMonthProp+"-"+sNMMonthProp,SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_NM_SCOPE_INI)
                    Return(M4_ERROR)
                EndIf
            Else
                'Error of development. You must create the item properties %0:s and %1:s for the counter %2:s in the node %3:s of the M4O %4:s.
                SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,520,sDayProp,sMonthProp,sIDEnt,sCalcNode,sM4O)                                               
                Return(M4_ERROR)
            EndIf
            
            If dtCur = dDateOfIni Then
                'if today is the start of the year period, we do the ini
                bAccPrevVal = M4_FALSE
            EndIf      
            
            If dtCur = dDateOfIni-1 Then
                'if today is the end of the year period, it is the last day of the accumulation
                bIsLastAcVal = M4_TRUE
            EndIf          
    
        ElseIf nIniScope = 13 Then '--- Year defined by day of the week and week of the year ---------------------
            'The day of the week and the week of the year are defined by the user using two properties
            sDayProp = sIDEnt + "_SPER_DW"
            sWeekProp = sIDEnt + "_SPER_W"
            dDateOfStorage = nullvalue()
            If ExistNodeItemIndex(sCalcNode,sDayProp) <> M4_ERROR and ExistNodeItemIndex(sCalcNode,sWeekProp) <> M4_ERROR Then
                nDay = GetValue(sCalcNode,sDayProp,-1) 
                nWeek = GetValue(sCalcNode,sWeekProp,-1) 
                
                If nDay <> nullvalue() and nWeek <> nullvalue () Then
                    SCO_ISO_WEEK_DATE!SCO_ISO_WEEK_DATE.SCO_ISOWEEKDATE_TO_DATE(DxYear(dtCur),nWeek,nDay,dDateOfIni) 
                Else
                    'to launch the error, we need to get the name of the counter and properties
                    sNMEnt = "" : sNMDayProp = "" : sNMWeekProp = ""
                    nRegCounterDef = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.FindRegister("SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT",sIDEnt,M4_EQUAL)
                    If nRegCounterDef <> M4_ERROR Then sNMEnt = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF[nRegCounterDef].SCO_NM_ENTITLEMENT
                    sNMDayProp = GetNodeItemData(sCalcNode,sDayProp,M4_ITEM_NAME)
                    sNMWeekProp = GetNodeItemData(sCalcNode,sWeekProp,M4_ITEM_NAME)                                
                
                    'The counter %0:s is activated and the counter has been defined with scope '%6:s' but the properties %4:s and %5:s are not filled for the current day. This happens in employee %1:s, period ordinal %2:n and date %3:d.
                    SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,519,sIDEnt+"-"+sNMEnt,STD_ID_HR,ToString(STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,0),ToString(dtCur,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT),sDayProp+"-"+sNMDayProp,sWeekProp+"-"+sNMWeekProp,SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_NM_SCOPE_INI)                                                                  
                    Return(M4_ERROR)
                EndIf
            Else
                'Error of development. You must create the item properties %0:s and %1:s for the counter %2:s in the node %3:s of the M4O %4:s.
                SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,520,sDayProp,sWeekProp,sIDEnt,sCalcNode,sM4O)                                    
                Return(M4_ERROR)
            EndIf
            
            If dtCur = dDateOfIni Then
                'if today is the start of the year period, we do the ini
                bAccPrevVal = M4_FALSE
            EndIf    
              
            If dtCur = dDateOfIni-1 Then
                'if today is the end of the year period, it is the last day of the accumulation
                bIsLastAcVal = M4_TRUE
            EndIf                    
    
        EndIf
    EndIf
    
    MoveTo(nCurReg)
EndIf 'end if: if the storage periodicity <> initialization periodicity and the counter is activated

SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_IS_AC_FINAL = bIsLastAcVal 

Return(bAccPrevVal)

'***************************************************************************************************************************************************************
'SCO_EXEC_COUNTERS
'Execute the counters
'1.- We loop over the counters to:
' 1.1.- Activate the counters to execute
' 1.2.- Calculation of the start date to store: we use this to calculate the date to the previous value (one day less) and we use it too for the step 3
' 1.3.- If the value has been modified by the user we want to maintain this value (not calculate other value), so we need to put this value in the calc node (because other counter can use this value)
' 1.4.- If the storage periodicity <> initialization periodicity, we search the previous value and we put it in the concept (i.e. we accumulate the previous value)
'       we do this in two steps: 
'       1.4.1.- Calculation of it is needed to accumulate the previous value
'       1.4.2.- Accumulate the previous value in the concept, if needed
'2.- We execute the counters, via the execution group
'3.- We loop over the counters again, to put the present day values in the node to save
'***************************************************************************************************************************************************************

dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
sM4O = GetChannelId()
sCalcNode = GetThisNodeId()
nCounterDefCount = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.Count()

If SCO_IS_IN_SUSPENSION = M4_FALSE Then 'If we are not in suspension the present day
    '***************************************************************************************************************************************************************
    '1.- we loop over the counters
    For i=0 to nCounterDefCount -1 'loop counters definition again
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.MoveTo(i)
            
        sIDEnt = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT
        nStorScope = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_ID_SCOPE
        nIniScope = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_ID_SCOPE_INI
        sIDEndActItem = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_ID_END_ACT_ITEM 'property where the user (via apply value) has said if the counter is activated or not
        sRecalcAftChgType = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_CK_RECALC_AFTER_CHANGE
           
        If GetValue(sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem ,-1) = "1" Then 
            bCounterIsActivated = M4_TRUE
        Else
            bCounterIsActivated = M4_FALSE
        EndIf
        
        
        '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        '0.- Check that we need to calculate this counter        
        'There are some cases that we don't need to calculate all the counters loaded in the definition
        bCalculateThisCounter = M4_TRUE
        
        ' a) We never calculate the real counters (clock or incidence) for clock or declarative employees in the future
        If dtCur > Today() and SCO_EMPL_CLOCK_OR_DECLARATIVE = 1 and sRecalcAftChgType <> "THEORETICAL" Then
            SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem,-1,"0")
            bCalculateThisCounter = M4_FALSE
            bCounterIsActivated = M4_FALSE        
        
        ElseIf SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_AUTOMATIC_RECALCULATION = 0 Then

        ' b) We are in a theoretical calculation and we have defined the parameter SCO_CALC_REAL_COUNT_AFTER_THEO like 2 (only to not clocking/declarative employees)
        '    => we don't have to calculate the real/clocking counters for clocking/declarative employees
            If (SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_HR_THEO = 1 or SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC = 1) and SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_CALC_REAL_COUNT_AFTER_THEO = 2 and SCO_EMPL_CLOCK_OR_DECLARATIVE = 1 and sRecalcAftChgType <> "THEORETICAL" Then        
                SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem,-1,"0")
                bCalculateThisCounter = M4_FALSE
                bCounterIsActivated = M4_FALSE
            EndIf        

        ' c) We are in a real/clocking execution => we don't want to calculate the theoretical counters
            If (SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_HR_THEO = 0 and SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC = 0) and sRecalcAftChgType = "THEORETICAL" Then        
                SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem,-1,"0")
                bCalculateThisCounter = M4_FALSE
                bCounterIsActivated = M4_FALSE
            EndIf  
            
        Else
        ' c) Automatic recalculation
            'If the counter is theoretical and the execution is not about theoretical, we don't need to execute the counter
            If sRecalcAftChgType = "THEORETICAL" Then
                nRegRecalTheo = SRCO_GTA_RWD_RECALCUL.Findregister("SCO_RECALC_TYPE","GTA_ENGINE_THEO",M4_EQUAL,"SCO_DATE_TO_RECALC",dtCur,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_IS_RECALCULATED",0,M4_EQUAL)
                If nRegRecalTheo = M4_ERROR Then        
                    SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem,-1,"0")
                    bCalculateThisCounter = M4_FALSE
                    bCounterIsActivated = M4_FALSE                
                EndIf
            EndIf
        EndIf        
        
        If bCalculateThisCounter = M4_TRUE Then 'if we need to calculate this counter
        
        
            '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            '1.1.- We activate the counters to execute
            ' We calculate if the counter must be executed or not, taking into account the storage periodicity
            ' Exactly, we only need to deactivate the counters activated by the user that are not needed to execute
            ' we don't need to consider the daily counters because are executed everyday
            ' if the current day is the termination of the employee, we don't need to consider any counter, because we need to execute all the counters (activated by the user)
        
            If SCO_IS_TERMINATION = M4_FALSE and SCO_IS_LAST_DAY_BEF_SUSP = M4_FALSE and bCounterIsActivated = M4_TRUE Then 'if is not termination and not the last day before suspension and it is activated by the user

                bCounterIsActivated = SCO_EXEC_C_DEACTIVATE(sIDEnt,sIDEndActItem,nStorScope)
            
            EndIf 'end of: 'if is not termination and not the last day before suspension and it is activated by the user
        
            '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            '1.2.- Calculation of the start date to store
            dtStartToStore = SCO_EXEC_C_DT_START_TO_STORE(sIDEnt,nStorScope,bCounterIsActivated)   

            '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------        
            '1.3.- If the value has been modified by the user
            If bCounterIsActivated = M4_TRUE Then
                SCO_EXEC_C_COPY_VALUE_MODIF_US(sIDEnt,dtStartToStore)
            EndIf
        
            '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            '1.4.1.- Calculation of it is needed to accumulate the previous value
            bAccPrevVal = SCO_EXEC_C_IS_NEED_AC_PREV_VAL(sIDEnt,nStorScope,nIniScope,bCounterIsActivated,dtStartToStore)       
            
            '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
            '1.4.2.- Accumulate the previous value in the concept, if needed
            If bAccPrevVal = M4_TRUE Then

                SCO_EXEC_C_ACUM_PREV_VAL(sIDEnt,dtStartToStore)
        
            EndIf 'end of: Accumulate the previous value
        
        ElseIf sRecalcAftChgType = "THEORETICAL" Then
            'For theoretical counters, if we don't need to execute the counter, we will put the value calculated in the item,
            ' to be used by other counters or alerts
            
            nRegCounter = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.FindRegister("SCO_ID_VAR_ELEMENT",sIDEnt,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START",dtCur,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END",dtCur,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_ID_STATUS",2,M4_EQUAL)
            If nRegCounter <> M4_ERROR Then
            
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.Moveto(nRegCounter)
                vValue = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_FINAL_VALUE
                SetValuePriority(0,sCalcNode,sIDEnt,-1,vValue)        

            EndIf
            
        EndIf 'end of: if we need to calculate this counter
    Next


    '***************************************************************************************************************************************************************
    '2.- We execute the counters, via the execution group
    nRet = ExecuteGroup("SCO_COUNTERS")

EndIf

'***************************************************************************************************************************************************************
'3.- We loop over the counters again: we put the present day values in the node to save
For i=0 to nCounterDefCount -1 'loop counters definition again
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.MoveTo(i)
       
    sIDEnt = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT
    vValue = GetValue(sCalcNode,sIDEnt,-1)
    sIDEndActItem = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_ID_END_ACT_ITEM 'property where the user (via apply value) has said if the counter is activated or not
    sRecalcAftChgType = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_CK_RECALC_AFTER_CHANGE
    nCounterVarType = GetNodeItemData(sCalcNode,sIDEnt,M4_ITEM_M4TYPE)  
    nCounterIntType = GetNodeItemData(sCalcNode,sIDEnt,M4_ITEM_INTERNAL_TYPE)
    If nCounterVarType = 6 and nCounterIntType = 89 Then nCounterVarType = 17 'for the number of hours
       
    If GetValue(sCalcNode,sIDEndActItem ,-1) = "1" Then 
        bCounterIsActivated = M4_TRUE
    Else
        bCounterIsActivated = M4_FALSE
    EndIf
    
    dtStartToStore = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_DT_START_TO_STORE
    bIsLastAcVal = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.SCO_IS_AC_FINAL

    '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    'We put the new vale in the node to save
    bCreateNew = M4_FALSE 
    bDelete = M4_FALSE 
        
    If bCounterIsActivated = M4_TRUE and vValue <> nullvalue() and vValue <> 0 and SCO_IS_IN_SUSPENSION = M4_FALSE Then 'If counter is activated and it is not null or zero
    
        nCountReg = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.FindRegister("SCO_ID_VAR_ELEMENT",sIDEnt,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START",dtStartToStore,M4_EQUAL)
        If nCountReg <> M4_ERROR Then
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.MoveTo(nCountReg)
            If SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.ISDELETED() = M4_TRUE Then 
                bCreateNew = M4_TRUE
            Else
                bCreateNew = M4_FALSE
            EndIf
        Else
            bCreateNew = M4_TRUE
        EndIf
        
        If bCreateNew = M4_TRUE Then
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.AddRegister()
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_ID_VAR_ELEMENT = sIDEnt
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START = dtStartToStore             
        Else
            dOldDtEnd = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END
        EndIf
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END = dtCur
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_IS_AC_FINAL = bIsLastAcVal 
       
        'final value: if the register has been modified manually by the user, we don't modify the calculated value        
        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_ID_ORIGIN = 1 or SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_CALCULATED_VALUE = nullvalue() Then       
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_CALCULATED_VALUE = vValue 
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.VAR_TYPE = nCounterVarType 
        EndIf
        
        'final value: if the register has been modified manually by the user, we don't modify the final value
        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_ID_ORIGIN = 1 or SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_FINAL_VALUE = nullvalue() Then
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_FINAL_VALUE = vValue 
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.VAR_TYPE11 = nCounterVarType 
        EndIf
    
    ElseIf SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_HR_THEO = 1 or SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_IS_AFTER_CHANGE_THEOR_EXEC = 1 or sRecalcAftChgType <> "THEORETICAL" Then
        'The counter is not activated, we need to delete the counter if exists
        ' this is for the next case: the user activate one counter and calculate. After, he deactivates the counter, so we need to delete it
        ' Note that we only deleted registers claculated by the system, never the registers modify by the user
        ' Exception: in a clock/real execution we dont delete the theoretical counters
        nCountReg = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.FindRegister("SCO_ID_VAR_ELEMENT",sIDEnt,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END",dtCur,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_ID_ORIGIN",1,M4_EQUAL)
        If nCountReg <> M4_ERROR Then
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.MoveTo(nCountReg)
            dOldDtEnd = SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.DeleteRegister()
            bDelete = M4_TRUE
        EndIf   
    EndIf

    '---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------   
    'Calculation of the number of final VE by Pay
    ' If is a final VE
    If bIsLastAcVal = M4_TRUE and SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_DEF.ID_DMD_COMPONENT <> nullvalue() Then 
    
        'Insert: we must increase the number of final VE by Pay by 1
        If bCreateNew = M4_TRUE Then
    
            nRegNumVE = SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.FindRegister("SCO_DT_START_DROITS_CLC",dtCur,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END_DROITS_CLC",dtCur,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
            If nRegNumVE = M4_ERROR Then
                nRegNumPay = SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAYS_BY_VE_DATES.FindRegister("SCO_DT_START_DROITS_CLC",dtCur,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END_DROITS_CLC",dtCur,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
                If nRegNumPay = M4_ERROR Then
                    'Don't exist a Variable Elements period for the current day. This happens in employee %0:s, period ordinal %1:n and date %2:d.
                    SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,536,STD_ID_HR,ToString(STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,0),ToString(dtCur,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT))
                Else
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.AddRegister()
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.SCO_DT_ACCRUED = SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAYS_BY_VE_DATES[nRegNumPay].SCO_DT_ACCRUED
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.SCO_ID_PAY_FREQUENCY = SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAYS_BY_VE_DATES[nRegNumPay].SCO_ID_PAY_FREQUENCY
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.SCO_NUM_FINAL_VE = 1
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.SCO_DT_START_DROITS_CLC = SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAYS_BY_VE_DATES[nRegNumPay].SCO_DT_START_DROITS_CLC
                    SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.SCO_DT_END_DROITS_CLC = SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAYS_BY_VE_DATES[nRegNumPay].SCO_DT_END_DROITS_CLC
                EndIf
            Else
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.MoveTo(nRegNumVE )
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.SCO_NUM_FINAL_VE = SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.SCO_NUM_FINAL_VE + 1         
            EndIf
            
        ElseIf bCreateNew = M4_FALSE and dOldDtEnd <> dtCur Then
            'Update of the end date and the new one is ina diferent pay that the old one
            //... to do ...
                        
        ElseIf bDelete = M4_TRUE Then
            'Delete: we must decrease the number of final VE by Pay by 1
            nRegNumVE = SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.FindRegister("SCO_DT_START_DROITS_CLC",dOldDtEnd,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END_DROITS_CLC",dOldDtEnd,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)
            If nRegNumVE <> M4_ERROR Then
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.SCO_NUM_FINAL_VE = Max(SRCO_GTA_RWD_PAY_NUM_VE.SCO_NUM_FINAL_VE - 1,0)
            EndIf
        EndIf
    EndIf
	
Next 'end of: loop counters definition again

Return(M4_SUCCESS)

'SCO_FIXED_EMPLOYEE
'Calc if it is A "fixed" employee, i.e. with only fixed time slots:
' Note that the exact control is if the number of hours in fixed time slots is equal than then theoretical hours
' because an employee that work 7 hours with 7 hours of fixed time slots is fixed, don't matter if there are a lunch time slot or a forbidden time slot 

nFixedEmpl = 0
nNumVarTS = 0
nNumHoursInFixedTS = 0

SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REAL","FIXED",M4_EQUAL)
nThTSCount = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()
If nThTSCount > 0 Then
    For i=0 to nThTSCount-1
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)
        nTheorTSHours = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_STARTS_AT,SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_ENDS_AT)
        nNumHoursInFixedTS = nNumHoursInFixedTS + nTheorTSHours
    Next
    If nNumHoursInFixedTS = SCO_WORK_THEO_HRS Then nFixedEmpl = 1
EndIf

Return(nFixedEmpl)

'SCO_IS_IN_SUSPENSION

    nRegSuspToday = SRCO_GTA_INCIDENCES.FindRegister("SCO_CK_CONTR_SUSP","1",M4_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_START",dtCur,M4_SMALLER_OR_EQUAL,"SCO_DT_END",dtCur,M4_GREATER_OR_EQUAL)

'SCO_LOAD_MORE_DAYS
' This method will load the number of days by argument, after or before of the current day, only it is necessary
' Will be called, for example, by alerts and by the engine to calculate counters
'
'Arg: ARG_NUM_DAY
'Examples:
'   1.-we are calculating from 1/1/2011 to 31/1/2011 and in the day 15 this method is called with argument -1 => we want to load the day 14, but it is load so don't do anything
'   2.-we are calculating from 1/1/2011 to 31/1/2011 and in the day 3 this method is called with argument -7 => we want to load the days 27/12/2010 to 2/1/2011, so we load the days from 27/12/2010 to 31/12/2010
'   3.-if the argument is positive we load to the future: currently without use


nRet = M4_SUCCESS
nCount = Count()
If nCount>0 and ARG_NUM_DAY <> 0 Then
    If GetCurrent()<>M4_ERROR Then

        dtCur    = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CALC.SCO_DT_CUR           'current day
        dMinDate = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CALC[0].SCO_DT_CUR        'minimum date loaded
        dMaxDate = SRCO_GTA_RWD_CALC[nCount-1].SCO_DT_CUR 'maximum date loaded
        
        'we check that the days to load are not loaded
        If ARG_NUM_DAY > 0 then
            dIniToLoad = Max(dtCur+1,SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_START)
            dEntToLoad = Min(dtCur+ARG_NUM_DAY,SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_END)
            nArgNumDayPositive = ARG_NUM_DAY
        Else
            dIniToLoad = Max(dtCur+ARG_NUM_DAY,SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_START)
            dEntToLoad = Min(dtCur-1,SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_END)
            nArgNumDayPositive = -1 * ARG_NUM_DAY            
        EndIf
        dComTime = CommonTime(dMinDate,dMaxDate,dIniToLoad,dEntToLoad)        

        If dComTime <> nArgNumDayPositive Then
            'We have something to load

            If ARG_NUM_DAY > 0 then
                dIniToLoad = dIniToLoad + dComTime
            Else
                dEntToLoad = dEntToLoad - dComTime
            EndIf
            
            'we have to check if the data is in the read node or we have to load it
            nCountRead = SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.Count()
            If nCountRead > 0 Then
                dMinDateRead = SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS[0].DT_START 'minimum date loaded
                dMaxDateRead = SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS[nCountRead-1].DT_START 'maximum date loaded            
                dComTime = CommonTime(dMinDateRead,dMaxDateRead,dIniToLoad,dEntToLoad)
            EndIf
            If dComTime <> (dEntToLoad-dIniToLoad+1) or nCountRead = 0 Then
                If dIniToLoad < dMinDateRead Then
                    dEntToLoadRead = dEntToLoad - dComTime 
                    dIniToLoadRead = dIniToLoad
                Else
                    dIniToLoadRead = dIniToLoad + dComTime 
                    dEntToLoadRead = dEntToLoad
                EndIf
                SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_START_P = dIniToLoadRead 
                SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_END_P = dEntToLoadRead 
                SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.LOAD_BLK()
                SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SORT()
            EndIf

            nNumRegAdded = 0
            'we loop over the days to copy from read node to calc node
            If SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.Count()>0 Then
                For i=dIniToLoad to dEntToLoad 
                
                    'If the register exists in the Read node (i.e. this is not the first calc), we copy the register
                    nCurRegInRead = SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.FindRegister("DT_START",i,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_ID_STATUS",2,M4_EQUAL)
                    If nCurRegInRead <> M4_ERROR Then
                        AddRegister()
                        nNumRegAdded = nNumRegAdded + 1
                        CopyRegister("","SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS",nCurRegInRead,SCOPE_REGISTER+TYPE_FIELD,SCOPE_REGISTER+TYPE_PROPERTY)
                        SRCO_CALC_EMPL_DAY(i,1)
                    EndIf                       
                Next
            EndIf
                        
            'After, we sort and move to the correct register
            If nNumRegAdded>0 Then
                Sort()
                nReg = FindRegister("SCO_DT_CUR",dtCur,M4_EQUAL)
                If nReg <> M4_ERROR Then
                    MoveTo(nReg)
                EndIf                
            EndIf
            
        EndIf 'End of: we check that the days to load are not loaded
    EndIf 'End of: GetCurrent<>M4_ERROR
EndIf 'End of: nCount>0

Return(nRet)

                sIdPropertyItem = SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS_PROP.SCO_ID_PROPERTY
                'exist the property here

            sIdPropertyItem = SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS_PROP_MODIF.SCO_ID_PROPERTY
            'exist the property here
            If ExistNodeItemIndex(sTSNode,sIdPropertyItem) <> M4_ERROR Then
                sValue = SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS_PROP_MODIF.SCO_PROPERTY_VALUE
                SetValuePriority(0,sTSNode,sIdPropertyItem,-1,sValue)
            EndIf

'SCO_LOAD_THEOR_TS
'Load theoretical time slots of the day

dtCur = SCO_DT_CUR
'Only if the day have time table
If SCO_ID_TIMETABLE <> nullvalue() Then

    'Fist we load the TS of the day
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Load_prg()
    nTSCount = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()

    If nTSCount = 0 Then

        'If there are anything means that the user don't modify it, so we load the definition of the time table
        sTest = SRCO_GTA_RWD_DAY_TT.SCO_FIND_TIMETABLE(SCO_ID_DAY_TYPE,SCO_ID_TIMETABLE)
        If sTest <> nullvalue() Then
            'load of the ts of the timetable
            If SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.Count()=0 Then SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.Load_blk()

            nTSCount = SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.Count()
            nNumRegRef = 0
            nNumRegReal = 0
            For i=0 to nTSCount-1
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.MoveTo(i)
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.AddRegister()
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_STARTS_AT = SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.SCO_TIMESLOT_STARTS_AT
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_ENDS_AT = SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.SCO_TIMESLOT_ENDS_AT
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_ID_TIMESLOT_TYPE = SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.SCO_ID_TIMESLOT_TYPE       
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_REAL_OR_REFERENCE_TIMESLOT = SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.SCO_REAL_OR_REFERENCE_TIMESLOT   
                If SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.SCO_REAL_OR_REFERENCE_TIMESLOT = "REAL" Then nNumRegReal = nNumRegReal + 1
                If SRCO_GTA_RWD_TT_TS.SCO_REAL_OR_REFERENCE_TIMESLOT = "REFERENCE" Then nNumRegRef = nNumRegRef + 1            
                
                '**************************************************************************************************************************
                'Starts at in date & time format. To use it to comparations with other date & time format (for example, the clock in/out)
                'note: if the theoretical time is defined between two days (night employees) we consider the next day                               
                If i=0 Then hIni = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_STARTS_AT

'SCO_REAL_LUNCH_HRS
'Real lunch hours for clocking employees
'Note that we summ all the lunch time slots that exists in the day
' We can calculated in two ways: with the original clock info and in the effective clock info (after clocking adjustment rules)
' Argument ARG_ORIGINAL_OR_EFFECTIVE: 1 -> original, 2 -> efective

nHoursOfLunch = nullvalue()
sNumWorkedHrsString = ""
If ARG_ORIGINAL_OR_EFFECTIVE = 2 Then 
    nClockNode = "SRCO_GTA_RWD_EFECTIV_CLOCK"
Else
    nClockNode = "SRCO_GTA_RWD_CLOCK"
EndIf


nClockEf = Call(nClockNode,"Count")

    
'if there are clock info and the number of clock are even
If nClockEf > 0 and Div(nClockEf,2) = 0 Then

    SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_FILTER_REAL_OR_REF("REAL","BREAKFAST",M4_EQUAL)
    nTheorTS = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.Count()
    
    'if there are lunch theor ts and 
    If nTheorTS > 0 Then
    
        nHoursOfLunch = 0
        For i=0 to nTheorTS-1
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.MoveTo(i)
            dtTheorTSStartAt = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_STARTS_AT
            dtTheorTSEndAt = SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.SCO_DT_ENDS_AT
    
            Call(nClockNode,"Begin")
            dtClockIn = M4_MINUS_INF
            dtClockOut = M4_MINUS_INF            
            nWorkedHoursAtLunchTime = 0
            nNumWorkedTS = 0
            'we loop over the clock info
            While Call(nClockNode,"IsEOF")=M4_FALSE
    
                nClockCurRec = Call(nClockNode,"GetCurrent")
                If Div(nClockCurRec+1,2) <> 0 Then 
                    'If we are in a odd record
                    'we only take the in date and time and go to the next register
                    dtClockIn = GetValue(nClockNode,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",-1)
                    Call(nClockNode,"GONEXT")
                Else
                    'If we are in a even record
                    'we take the out date and time
                    dtClockOut = GetValue(nClockNode,"SCO_DT_DATE_AND_HOUR",-1)
                    
                    'we control if this "clock time slot" in overlaped with the lunch time slot
                    If dtClockIn < dtTheorTSEndAt and dtClockOut > dtTheorTSStartAt Then
                        dtStart = Max(dtTheorTSStartAt,dtClockIn)
                        dtEnd   = Min(dtTheorTSEndAt,dtClockOut)
                        nWorkedHrs = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtStart,dtEnd)
                        nWorkedHoursAtLunchTime = nWorkedHoursAtLunchTime + nWorkedHrs
                        nNumWorkedTS = nNumWorkedTS + 1
                    EndIf
                    Call(nClockNode,"GONEXT")
                EndIf 'end of: If we are in a even record
            WEnd 'end of: we loop over the clock info
            
            nHoursLunchTS = SCO_HOUR_TOOLS.SCO_DIF_HOUR_TO_NUMBER(dtTheorTSStartAt,dtTheorTSEndAt)
            nHoursOfLunch = nHoursOfLunch + (nHoursLunchTS  - nWorkedHoursAtLunchTime)
    
            sNumWorkedHrsString = sNumWorkedHrsString + ToString(nNumWorkedTS,0) + "@" + ToString((nHoursLunchTS  - nWorkedHoursAtLunchTime))
            sNumWorkedHrsString = sNumWorkedHrsString + "|"
        Next
    EndIf 'end of: if there are lunch theor ts 
EndIf 'end of: if there are clock info and the number of clock are even

SCO_NUM_WORKED_HRS_STRING = sNumWorkedHrsString 
Return(nHoursOfLunch)

'SCO_SET_ALERT
'Create or modify an alert, update the status of the day for blocking alerts and execute the WF asociated to the alert severity level, if needed
'Arguments:
'  ARG_ID_ALERT
'  ARG_ID_SEVERITY_LEVEL
'  ARG_ID_STATUS: 1 Set the alert, 0 Delete the alert (if exists)
'  Pairs of values for the arguments of the message in this form: 
'    ID1, Value1, ID2, Value2,...

'Variables
nNumArg = GetArgumentNumber()
sText = ""

'constants
sGTA_THEOR_ALERT = "01"
sGTA_REAL_ALERT  = "02"
sGTA_CLOCK_ALERT = "04"
sGTA_LEFTH_SEP   = "#"
sGTA_RIGTH_SEP   = "#"

'Control the variable arguments
nNumVarArg = nNumArg - 3
nNumberOfPairs = nNumVarArg/2
If Div(nNumVarArg,2)<> 0 Then
    'Error in SCO_SET_ALERT call, the variable arguments must be in pairs: ID, Value. This occurs in the alert %0:s.
    SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,517,ARG_ID_ALERT)
    Return(M4_ERROR)
EndIf

'Find the alert
nReg = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS.FindRegister("SCO_ID_ALERT",ARG_ID_ALERT,M4_EQUAL)

'--------------------------------- If we want to delete the alert ---------------------------------
If ARG_ID_STATUS = 0 Then 
    If nReg <> M4_ERROR Then
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS.MoveTo(nReg)
        If SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS.ISNEW() <> M4_TRUE Then
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS.DeleteRegister()
        Else
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS.DESTROYREGISTER()
        EndIf
    EndIf
    
'--------------------------------- If we want to set the alert ---------------------------------
Else     
    If nReg <> M4_ERROR Then
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS.MoveTo(nReg)
    Else
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS.AddRegister()
        SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS.SCO_ID_ALERT = ARG_ID_ALERT    
    EndIf
    
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS.SCO_ID_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL = ARG_ID_SEVERITY_LEVEL

    '-------------Text -------------
    'Normally we are in the good register in SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF node, but we check it
    nRegAlDef = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.GetCurrent()
    If nRegAlDef <> M4_ERROR and SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_ID_PROPERTY <> ARG_ID_ALERT Then nRegAlDef = M4_ERROR
    If nRegAlDef = M4_ERROR Then 
        nRegAlDef = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.FindRegister("SCO_ID_PROPERTY",ARG_ID_ALERT,M4_EQUAL)
    EndIf

    If nRegAlDef <> M4_ERROR Then
        sText = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_DEF.SCO_ALERT_MESSAGE

        For i=4 to nNumArg 
            If Div(i,2)= 0 Then sIDParam = sGTA_LEFTH_SEP + GetArgument(i) + sGTA_RIGTH_SEP 'if is even is a param
            If Div(i,2)<> 0 Then 'if is odd is the value
                sValueParam = GetArgument(i)

                sText = Replace(sText,sIDParam,sValueParam)
            EndIf
        Next        
    EndIf
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERTS.SCO_TEXT = sText
    
    '------------- WF -------------
    'Only the first time that we create the incidence, we launch the WF
    If nReg = M4_ERROR Then
        'Normally we are in the good register in SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL node, but we check it   
        nRegAlSevLev = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.FindRegister("SCO_ID_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL",ARG_ID_SEVERITY_LEVEL,M4_EQUAL)
        If nRegAlSevLev <> M4_ERROR Then
            SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.MoveTo(nRegAlSevLev)
            
            sIDBPC = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.ID_BPC
            
            If sIDBPC <> "" and sIDBPC <> nullvalue() Then
            
                'Fixed arguments (all the WFs for GTA alerts must have these arguments)
                sIdHr = STD_ID_HR
                nOrPer = STD_OR_HR_PERIOD
                dDtStart = SCO_DT_CUR
                sIdAlert = ARG_ID_ALERT 
                sAlertText = sText
                sIdSevLev = ARG_ID_SEVERITY_LEVEL
                sNMSevLev = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.SCO_NM_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL
                nIsBlocking = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.SCO_CHK_BLOKING
                sHTMLIcon = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.SCO_HTML_ICON
                sIdHRForNm = STD_ID_HR
                sNMBlocking = ""
                If nIsBlocking = 1 Then sNMBlocking = GetNodeItemData("SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL","SCO_CHK_BLOKING",M4_ITEM_NAME)
                
                'Other arguments
                sOtherArgs = SRCO_GTA_RWD_ALERT_SEV_LEVEL.SCO_BPC_MORE_ARGUMENTS
                sDQ = chr(M4_DOUBLE_QUOTE)
                
                sCode = "SWF_ENGINE_RT!SWF_BPO.INSTANTIATEBPO(sIDBPC,"+sDQ+"SCO_ID_HR"+sDQ+",sIdHr,"+sDQ+"SCO_OR_HR_PERIOD"+sDQ+",nOrPer,"+sDQ+"SCO_DT_START"+sDQ+",dDtStart,"+sDQ+"SCO_ID_ALERT"+sDQ
                sCode = sCode +",sIdAlert,"+sDQ+"SCO_ALERT_TEXT"+sDQ+",sAlertText,"+sDQ+"SCO_ID_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL"+sDQ+",sIdSevLev,"+sDQ+"SCO_NM_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL"+sDQ+",sNMSevLev,"+sDQ
                sCode = sCode +"SCO_CHK_BLOKING"+sDQ+",nIsBlocking,"+sDQ+"SCO_HTML_ICON"+sDQ+",sHTMLIcon,"+sDQ+"SCO_NM_HR"+sDQ+",sIdHRForNm,"+sDQ+"SCO_NM_BLOCKING"+sDQ+",sNMBlocking"
                If sOtherArgs <> nullvalue() and sOtherArgs <> "" Then
                    sCode = sCode + "," + sOtherArgs
                EndIf
                sCode = sCode + ")"
                
                nRet = clcExecuteLn4Jit(sCode,"sIDBPC",sIDBPC,"sIdHr",sIdHr,"nOrPer",nOrPer,"dDtStart",dDtStart,"sIdAlert",sIdAlert,"sAlertText",sAlertText,"sIdSevLev",sIdSevLev,"sNMSevLev",sNMSevLev,"nIsBlocking",nIsBlocking,"sHTMLIcon",sHTMLIcon,"sIdHRForNm",sIdHRForNm,"sNMBlocking",sNMBlocking)
            EndIf
        EndIf
    EndIf
EndIf

Return(M4_SUCCESS)

    'Control that this employee has GTA management this day
    If SCO_EMPL_HAS_GTA_MANAGEMENT(dtCur) = M4_TRUE Then

       'If the register is modify by GTA1, don't do anything
        nCurDayIsGtaN1 = SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.FindRegister("DT_START", dtCur, EQUAL, "SCO_ID_ORIGIN", 3, M4_EQUAL, "SCO_ID_STATUS", 2, M4_EQUAL)
        '                                                                                                  ' 3 = GTA N1                 2 = Valid
        If nCurDayIsGtaN1 = M4_ERROR and SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_TOTAL = 1 then

            '*******************************************************************************
            'New register in this node
            AddRegister()
            'If the register exists in the Read node (i.e. this is not the first calc), we copy the register
            nCurRegInRead = SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.FindRegister("DT_START",dtCur,M4_EQUAL,"SCO_ID_STATUS",2,M4_EQUAL)
            If nCurRegInRead <> M4_ERROR Then
                CopyRegister("","SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS",nCurRegInRead,SCOPE_REGISTER+TYPE_FIELD,SCOPE_REGISTER+TYPE_PROPERTY)
            EndIf
    
            If nCurRegInRead <> M4_ERROR or SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_HR_THEO <> 0 Then
                'we calculate if it is not the first calculation or if we have to recalculate all
                'but first, we clean the filters
                SRCO_GTA_RWD_THEOR_TS.CLEANFILTER()
                nRet = SRCO_CALC_EMPL_DAY(dtCur,0)
                If nRet <> M4_ERROR Then dMaxDtCalculatedNow = dtCur
            EndIf        
           
        EndIf 'End of: If the register is modify by GTA1, don't do anything
    EndIf 'End of: that this employee has GTA management this day

    dtCur = dtCur + 1 'increment of the day of the loop: we go to the next day

WEnd 'End of the loop day by day

SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_LAST_MONTH_EXEC_APPVAL = ""

SCO_AUTO_RECALC_OP_AFT_CALC_EM(dMaxDtCalculatedNow,nRet)

'Save the data
If nRet <> M4_ERROR Then 
    SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SRCO_SAVE()
    'number of employees calculated without error
    SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.NB_HR_CALC = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.NB_HR_CALC + 1
EndIf

Return(nRet)

'SRCO_CALC_EMPL_DAY
'Arg: ARG_DT_CUR, ARG_FROM_LOAD

dtCur = ARG_DT_CUR
'*******************************************************************************
'Initial data
SCO_DT_CUR = dtCur 'current day
ExecuteGroup("SCO_INIT")' initial concepts

'*******************************************************************************            
'Properties load
If ARG_FROM_LOAD = 0 Then
    nRet = SCO_LOAD_PROPERTIES_VALUE()
    If nRet = M4_ERROR Then Return(M4_ERROR)    
    SCO_CALC_START_END_HRS()
EndIf

'*******************************************************************************    
'Theoretical time calculation
If ARG_FROM_LOAD = 0 Then
    SCO_CALC_TT()
EndIf
'Theoretical time slot load
SCO_LOAD_THEOR_TS()
'Control theo. ts. into the day
nRet = SCO_CNTRL_THEO_TS_IN_DAY()
If nRet = M4_ERROR Then Return(M4_ERROR)    

'*******************************************************************************                       
If ARG_FROM_LOAD = 0 Then
    'Clocking adjustment rules
    nRet = SCO_CALL_CLOCK_ADJUST_RULES()
    If nRet = M4_ERROR Then Return(M4_ERROR)    
EndIf

'*******************************************************************************            
'Absences&Presences
If ARG_FROM_LOAD = 0 Then
    SCO_CALC_ABS_PRES()      
EndIf

'*******************************************************************************                       
'Calc real time slots
SCO_CALC_REAL_TS(ARG_FROM_LOAD)

'Calc real time
If ARG_FROM_LOAD = 0 Then
    SCO_CALC_REAL()
EndIf

'*******************************************************************************                          
'Counters
If ARG_FROM_LOAD = 0 Then
    nRet = SCO_EXEC_COUNTERS()
    If nRet = M4_ERROR Then Return(M4_ERROR)
EndIf
'*******************************************************************************                                   
'Alerts
If ARG_FROM_LOAD = 0 Then
    nRet = SCO_EXEC_ALERTS()
    If nRet = M4_ERROR Then Return(M4_ERROR)    
EndIf

'*******************************************************************************                                   
'Save
If ARG_FROM_LOAD = 0 Then
    nRet = SCO_PREPARE_FOR_SAVE()
    If nRet = M4_ERROR Then Return(M4_ERROR)    
EndIf

Return(M4_SUCCESS)
