'SCO_CHG_MAX_SEV_LEV_AFTER_HIDE
'Recalculate and change the max severity level of the day after hide alerts
' ARG_DT_START, ARG_DT_END

Begin()
dPrevDay = M4_MINUS_INF
nMaxAlertSevLevel = -1

BeginDBTransaction()

While IsEOF()=M4_FALSE

    dThisDay = DT_START
    nThisAlertSevLevel = SCO_ID_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL
    sIdHr = STD_ID_HR
    nOrPer = STD_OR_HR_PERIOD


    If dThisDay <> dPrevDay and dPrevDay >= ARG_DT_START and dPrevDay <= ARG_DT_END  Then
        
        'launch modification of max severity level of the day after hide alerts
        If nMaxAlertSevLevel = -1 Then 
            SCO_VALUE_TO_UPDATE = nullvalue()
        Else
            SCO_VALUE_TO_UPDATE = nMaxAlertSevLevel 
        EndIf                
        sUpdateSQL = "UPDATE SCO_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS SET SCO_MAX_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL = @SCO_VALUE_TO_UPDATE "
        sUpdateSQL = sUpdateSQL + " WHERE SCO_ID_STATUS=2 AND DT_START=#TO_DATE('"+ToString(dPrevDay,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)+"') "
        sUpdateSQL = sUpdateSQL + " AND STD_ID_HR='"+sIdHr+"' AND STD_OR_HR_PERIOD="+ToString(nOrPer,0) + " "
        SRCO_EXECUTE_SQL = sUpdateSQL
        SRCO_EXECUTE_SQL(0,1)
        
        'inizialice
        nMaxAlertSevLevel = -1
        
    EndIf

    If dThisDay >= ARG_DT_START and dThisDay <= ARG_DT_END Then

        If SCO_HIDE = "N" Then nMaxAlertSevLevel= Max(nThisAlertSevLevel,nMaxAlertSevLevel)
       
    EndIf
    dPrevDay = DT_START
    GoNext()
WEnd

If dPrevDay >= ARG_DT_START and dPrevDay <= ARG_DT_END  Then
    
    'launch modification of max severity level of the day, after hide alerts
    If nMaxAlertSevLevel = -1 Then 
        SCO_VALUE_TO_UPDATE = nullvalue()
    Else
        SCO_VALUE_TO_UPDATE = nMaxAlertSevLevel 
    EndIf                
    sUpdateSQL = "UPDATE SCO_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS SET SCO_MAX_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL = @SCO_VALUE_TO_UPDATE "
    sUpdateSQL = sUpdateSQL + " WHERE SCO_ID_STATUS=2 AND DT_START=#TO_DATE('"+ToString(dPrevDay,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)+"') "
    sUpdateSQL = sUpdateSQL + " AND STD_ID_HR='"+sIdHr+"' AND STD_OR_HR_PERIOD="+ToString(nOrPer,0) + " "
    SRCO_EXECUTE_SQL = sUpdateSQL
    SRCO_EXECUTE_SQL(0,1)
    
    'inizialice
    nMaxAlertSevLevel = -1
    
EndIf

EndDBTransaction(M4_COMMIT)

Begin()

'SCO_LOAD_EMPL_ALERTS

'If IsEOF() = M4_FALSE Then

    DESTROYBLOCK()
    
    sSentence = "FROM &SCO_HR_RWD_ALERTS A, SCO_X_VE_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL B "
    sSentence = sSentence + " WHERE A.STD_ID_HR=?(2,9,0) AND A.STD_OR_HR_PERIOD =?(6,2,0) "
    sSentence = sSentence + " AND A.DT_START <=?(4,0,0) AND A.DT_START >=?(4,0,0) "
    sSentence = sSentence + " AND A.SCO_ID_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL = B.SCO_ID_ALERT_SEVERITY_LEVEL(+) "
    If SCO_VIEW_HIDDEN = 0 Then 
        sSentence = sSentence + " AND A.SCO_HIDE = 'N'"
    EndIf
    If SCO_USER_TYPE = "HHRR" Then
        sSentence = sSentence + " AND B.SCO_VISIBLE_BY_HR = 1"
    ElseIf SCO_USER_TYPE = "MANAGER" Then
        sSentence = sSentence + " AND B.SCO_VISIBLE_BY_MANAGER = 1"
    ElseIf SCO_USER_TYPE = "EMPLOYEE" Then
        sSentence = sSentence + " AND B.SCO_VISIBLE_BY_EMPLOYEE = 1"
    EndIf
    
    sParam = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.STD_ID_HR + "|" + ToString(SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,0) 
    sParam = sParam + "|" + ToString(SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_END_P) +"|" + ToString(SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DT_START_P)
    
    SYS_SENTENCE = sSentence
    SYS_PARAM = sParam 
    
    Load_blk()
    
    For i=0 to Count()-1
        MoveTo(i)
        'Theoretical
        sLblNode = "SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS"
        If SCO_WORK_THEO_DAY <> nullvalue() Then
            sLblDays = GetNodeItemData("",sLblNode,"SCO_LBL_DAYS",M4_ITEM_NAME)
            sLblDay  = GetNodeItemData("",sLblNode,"SCO_LBL_DAY" ,M4_ITEM_NAME)
            SCO_WORK_THEO = SCO_WORK_THEO_DAY
            If SCO_WORK_THEO > 1 Then 
                SCO_WORK_THEO_STRING = sLblDays 
            Else
                SCO_WORK_THEO_STRING = sLblDay            
            EndIf
            SCO_ID_M4_TYPE_HRS_DAY = 6 'Number
        Else
            sLblHours = GetNodeItemData("",sLblNode,"SCO_LBL_HOURS",M4_ITEM_NAME)
            sLblHour  = GetNodeItemData("",sLblNode,"SCO_LBL_HOUR" ,M4_ITEM_NAME)        
            SCO_WORK_THEO = SCO_WORK_THEO_HRS  
            If SCO_WORK_THEO > 1 Then 
                SCO_WORK_THEO_STRING = sLblHours 
            Else
                SCO_WORK_THEO_STRING = sLblHour  
            EndIf                  
            SCO_ID_M4_TYPE_HRS_DAY = 17 'Number of hours
        EndIf
    Next
    
    CheckPointBlock()

'EndIf

'SCO_SAVE_ALERTS

For i=0 to Count()-1
    MoveTo(i)
    If ISDELETED() = M4_TRUE Then
        sDelSQL = "DELETE SCO_HR_RWD_ALERTS WHERE STD_ID_HR='"+STD_ID_HR+"' AND STD_OR_HR_PERIOD="+ToString(STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,0)
        sDelSQL = sDelSQL + " AND DT_START=#TO_DATE('"+ToString(DT_START,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)+"')  AND SCO_ORDINAL="+ToString(SCO_ORDINAL,0)
        SRCO_EXECUTE_SQL = sDelSQL 
        SRCO_EXECUTE_SQL(0,1)
    EndIf
Next
Persist_tree()

'SCO_SAVE_FROM_PRESENTATION

'First, we loop the alerts to know if we have something to save, the minimum and maximum dates to save and to check if the user can hide these alerts
nStartDateToRecalc = M4_PLUS_INF
nEndDateToRecalc = M4_MINUS_INF
nRet = M4_SUCCESS
For i=0 to Count()-1
    MoveTo(i)
    If SCO_HIDE <> SCO_HIDE..SysOldValue or SCO_COMMENT_ALERT <> SCO_COMMENT_ALERT..SysOldValue  Then
        nStartDateToRecalc = Min(DT_START,nStartDateToRecalc)
        nEndDateToRecalc   = Max(DT_START,nEndDateToRecalc)
        If SCO_HIDE = "Y" Then
            If (SCO_USER_TYPE = "HHRR" and SCO_HHRR_CAN_HIDE = 0) or (SCO_USER_TYPE = "MANAGER" and SCO_MANAGER_CAN_HIDE = 0) or (SCO_USER_TYPE = "EMPLOYEE" and SCO_EMPLOYEE_CAN_HIDE = 0) Then 
                nRet = M4_ERROR 
                'You don't have the needed rights to hide the alert %0:s of the day %1:d.
                SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,515,SCO_TEXT,ToString(DT_START,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT))
            EndIf
        EndIf
    EndIf
Next

'Then we change the maximum severity level, save the alerts and reload the alerts and the real days if needed
If nStartDateToRecalc <> M4_PLUS_INF and nEndDateToRecalc <> M4_MINUS_INF and nRet <> M4_ERROR Then
    BeginDBTransaction()

    SCO_CHG_MAX_SEV_LEV_AFTER_HIDE(nStartDateToRecalc,nEndDateToRecalc)

    nRet = Persist_tree()

    EndDBTransaction(M4_COMMIT)
    
    If SCO_VIEW_HIDDEN = 0 Then
        SCO_LOAD_EMPL_ALERTS()
    EndIf
    
    If SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.Count()>0 Then
        SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS.DESTROYBLOCK()
        SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_APPEL_HR_PERIOD_LOAD()    
    EndIf
    
EndIf

'The data was saved successfully....
If nRet <> M4_ERROR Then
    SetLog(M4_DEBUGINFOLOG,21,122,2)    
EndIf

'SCO_TRANSLATED_TIMESLOT_PER_VW
'Time slot to view in presentation

sTS = SCO_TRANSLATED_TIMESLOT_PER_1

If sTS = nullvalue() Then sTS = SCO_TRANSLATED_TIMESLOT_PER_2

Return(sTS)

M4RCH_RULES3/ID_TI/SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTER_.SOURCE_CODE:
'SCO_CALC_COUNTER_LISTS
'For some counters we need to sum the previous values to the value calculated in each moment => this will be the counters to accumulate
'Here we will calculate the list of this type of counters, in order to load their values
' The counters to accumulate will be the counters with different scope to initialize that scope to save
'With this method we control too that the counters exists in this M4O

'Variables
sWeekCounterListToCum = ""      : sCycleCounterListToCum = ""
sMonthCounterListToCum = ""     : sVEPeriodCounterListToCum = ""
sYearMonthCounterListToCum = "" : sYearWeekCounterListToCum = ""
nFirstRegisterNotDaily = nullvalue()
sM4O = GetChannelId()
sCalcNode = "SRCO_GTA_RWD_CALC"
SCO_ERROR_IN_COUNTER_DEF = M4_FALSE

'Loop over counters definition
For i=0 to Count()-1
    MoveTo(i)
    
    If SCO_ID_SCOPE <> 1 and nFirstRegisterNotDaily = nullvalue() Then nFirstRegisterNotDaily = GetCurrent()

    'Controls   
    SCO_ID_END_ACT_ITEM = SCO_CALC_ID_END_ACT_ITEM(SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT) 'property where the user (via apply value) has said if the counter is activated or not
    If ExistNodeItemIndex(sCalcNode,SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT) = M4_ERROR or ExistNodeItemIndex(sCalcNode,SCO_ID_END_ACT_ITEM) = M4_ERROR Then 'if the activation property exist
        'Error of development. You must create the item properties %0:s and %1:s for the counter %2:s in the node %3:s of the M4O %4:s.
        SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,520,SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT,SCO_ID_END_ACT_ITEM,SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT,sCalcNode,sM4O)                            
        SCO_ERROR_IN_COUNTER_DEF = M4_TRUE
    EndIf        
    
    'Counter lists
    If SCO_ID_SCOPE <> SCO_ID_SCOPE_INI Then 'if it is the same scope, we don't need to cumul

        If SCO_ID_SCOPE = 2 Then 'Week
            If sWeekCounterListToCum <> "" Then sWeekCounterListToCum = sWeekCounterListToCum + ","
            sWeekCounterListToCum = sWeekCounterListToCum + "'" + SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT + "'"

        ElseIf SCO_ID_SCOPE = 3 Then 'Cycle
            If sCycleCounterListToCum <> "" Then sCycleCounterListToCum = sCycleCounterListToCum + ","
            sCycleCounterListToCum = sCycleCounterListToCum + "'" + SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT + "'"

        ElseIf SCO_ID_SCOPE = 10 Then 'Normal month 
            If sMonthCounterListToCum <> "" Then sMonthCounterListToCum = sMonthCounterListToCum + ","
            sMonthCounterListToCum = sMonthCounterListToCum + "'" + SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT + "'"                  

        ElseIf SCO_ID_SCOPE = 11 Then 'VE period 
            If sVEPeriodCounterListToCum <> "" Then sVEPeriodCounterListToCum = sVEPeriodCounterListToCum + ","
            sVEPeriodCounterListToCum = sVEPeriodCounterListToCum + "'" + SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT + "'"        
            
        ElseIf SCO_ID_SCOPE = 12 Then 'Year: day and month
            If sYearMonthCounterListToCum <> "" Then sYearMonthCounterListToCum = sYearMonthCounterListToCum + ","
            sYearMonthCounterListToCum = sYearMonthCounterListToCum + "'" + SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT + "'"        
            
        ElseIf SCO_ID_SCOPE = 13 Then 'Year: day and week number
            If sYearWeekCounterListToCum <> "" Then sYearWeekCounterListToCum = sYearWeekCounterListToCum + ","
            sYearWeekCounterListToCum = sYearWeekCounterListToCum + "'" + SCO_ID_ENTITLEMENT + "'"        
        
        EndIf
    EndIf
Next

SCO_WEEK_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM = sWeekCounterListToCum 
SCO_CYCLE_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM = sCycleCounterListToCum 
SCO_MONTH_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM = sMonthCounterListToCum 
SCO_VE_PER_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM = sVEPeriodCounterListToCum 
SCO_YEAR_M_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM = sYearMonthCounterListToCum 
SCO_YEAR_W_COUNTER_LIST_TO_CUM = sYearWeekCounterListToCum 

SCO_FIRST_REGISTER_NOT_DAILY = nFirstRegisterNotDaily

'SCO_CALC_ID_END_ACT_ITEM
'Calc "act" item for counter: property where the user (via apply value) has said if the counter is activated or not
'ARG_ID_ENT

sActItem = Mid(ARG_ID_ENT,0,4) + "ACT_" + Mid(ARG_ID_ENT,4,length(ARG_ID_ENT)) 

Return(sActItem)

'SCO_CREATE_SENTENCE
'Create the sentence to load only the counters that we will need (theoretical, real or clock counters)
' If we are in the theoretical calculation/recalculation we need to load the theoretical counters and the rest depending in the app param SCO_CALC_REAL_COUNT_AFTER_THEO 
' If we are in the night launch the real and clock an theo
' If we are in a manual recalculation depending in the user choose
' If we are in a automatic recalculation all


'By default we load all
sLoadTheorCounters = M4_TRUE 
sLoadRealCounters  = M4_TRUE 
sLoadClockCounters  = M4_TRUE 

If SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.RECALC_HR_THEO = 1 and SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_CALC_REAL_COUNT_AFTER_THEO = 0 Then
    'If we are in the theoretical calculation/recaculation we need to load the theoretical counters and the rest depending in the app param SCO_CALC_REAL_COUNT_AFTER_THEO
    ' 0-> no => we load only theoretical
    ' 1-> yes => we load all
    ' 2-> yes, buy only for not clocking/declarative  => we load all
    sLoadRealCounters  = M4_FALSE 
    sLoadClockCounters  = M4_FALSE
    
ElseIf SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_PRES_CALC_TYPE = 4 Then
    'If we are in a manual recalculation depending in the user chooses
    sLoadTheorCounters  = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_PRES_MAN_CALC_THEO
    sLoadRealCounters   = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_PRES_MAN_CALC_REAL
    sLoadClockCounters  = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_PRES_MAN_CALC_CLOCK
    
    If sLoadRealCounters = M4_TRUE  or sLoadClockCounters = M4_TRUE  Then 
        sLoadTheorCounters = M4_TRUE 
        sLoadRealCounters  = M4_TRUE 
        sLoadClockCounters  = M4_TRUE  
    EndIf

EndIf

'If we have to load all, we don't need to enter here
sSentence = nullvalue()
If sLoadTheorCounters = M4_FALSE or sLoadRealCounters = M4_FALSE or sLoadClockCounters = M4_FALSE Then 
    sSentence = " FROM &SCO_VE_ENTITLEMENT_DEF A "

    sInString = "("
    If sLoadTheorCounters = M4_TRUE Then 
        If sInString <> "(" Then sInString = sInString + ","
        sInString = sInString + "'" + "THEORETICAL" + "'"
    EndIf
    If sLoadRealCounters = M4_TRUE Then 
        If sInString <> "(" Then sInString = sInString + ","
        sInString = sInString + "'" + "INCIDENT" + "'"
    EndIf
    If sLoadClockCounters = M4_TRUE Then 
        If sInString <> "(" Then sInString = sInString + ","
        sInString = sInString + "'" + "CLOCK" + "'"
    EndIf        
    sInString = sInString + ")"

    sSentence = sSentence + " WHERE A.SCO_CK_RECALC_AFTER_CHANGE IN " + sInString + " "

EndIf
SYS_SENTENCE = sSentence

'SCO_LOAD_COUNTER_DEF
'Load counter definition
'Arguments: ARG_DT_START,ARG_DT_END

If Count() = 0 Then
    SCO_DT_START_P = ARG_DT_START
    SCO_DT_END_P = ARG_DT_END
    Load_blk()

ElseIf SCO_DT_START_P > ARG_DT_START or SCO_DT_END_P < ARG_DT_END Then

    DestroyBlock()
    SCO_DT_START_P = ARG_DT_START
    SCO_DT_END_P = ARG_DT_END
    Load_blk()    
EndIf

M4RCH_RULES3/ID_TI/SRCO_GTA_RWD_COUNTERS.SOURCE_CODE:
'SCO_AFTER_ADDREGISTER
'After add register

STD_ID_HR = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.STD_ID_HR
STD_OR_HR_PERIOD = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.STD_OR_HR_PERIOD

'SCO_AFTER_LOAD
'After load

If GetArgumentNumber()>0 Then
    nFromFilter = GetArgument(1)
Else
    nFromFilter = 0
EndIf

sPrevClasNM = nullvalue()
For i=0 to Count()-1
    MoveTo(i)

    'Classification
    If SCO_NM_DISPLAY_DLASIFICATION = sPrevClasNM Then
        sPrevClasNM = SCO_NM_DISPLAY_DLASIFICATION
        SCO_NM_DISPLAY_DLASIFICAT_1 = nullvalue()
    Else
        SCO_NM_DISPLAY_DLASIFICATION_1 = SCO_NM_DISPLAY_DLASIFICATION   
        sPrevClasNM = SCO_NM_DISPLAY_DLASIFICATION    
    EndIf

    If nFromFilter <> 1 Then
        'Origin image 
        ' Enregistrement calculé
        If SCO_ID_ORIGIN = 1 Then SCO_IMAGE_ORIGIN = "CALC"
        ' Enregistrement modifi(ESS ou peoplnet)
        If SCO_ID_ORIGIN = 2 Then SCO_IMAGE_ORIGIN = "EDIT"
        ' Enregistrement modifi(ESS ou peoplnet)
        If SCO_ID_ORIGIN = 3 Then SCO_IMAGE_ORIGIN = "PROTTECED16_A"
    
        'Dates in text
        If SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START = SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END Then
            SCO_DATES_TEXT = GetErrorString (2,116,83,ToString(SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT))

        Else
            SCO_DATES_TEXT = GetErrorString (2,116,83,ToString(SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)) + " - " + GetErrorString (2,116,83,ToString(SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT))
        EndIf
        
    EndIf    
Next       
 If nFromFilter <> 1 Then CheckPointBlock()

'SCO_APPLY_FILTER


sCode = ""

If SCO_FILTER_DATE <> nullvalue() Then 
    sCode = sCode  + " SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START <= SCO_FILTER_DATE and SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END >= SCO_FILTER_DATE "
EndIf

If SCO_FILTER_COUNTER <> nullvalue() Then 
    If sCode <> "" Then sCode = sCode + " and "
    sCode = sCode  + " SCO_ID_VAR_ELEMENT = SCO_FILTER_COUNTER "
EndIf

'Ajout GTA V1 le 31/07/2012
'Filter on the field SCO_NM_ENTITLEMENT : "Libellé compteur"
If SCO_FILTER_NM_COUNTER <> nullvalue() Then 
    If sCode <> "" Then sCode = sCode + " and "
    sCode = sCode  + " StrIn(SCO_NM_ENTITLEMENT,SCO_FILTER_NM_COUNTER) <> M4_ERROR "
EndIf
'Filter on the field SCO_ID_SCOPE : "Périodicité de stockage"
If SCO_FILTER_SCOPE <> nullvalue() Then 
    If sCode <> "" Then sCode = sCode + " and "
    sCode = sCode  + " SCO_ID_SCOPE = SCO_FILTER_SCOPE "
EndIf
'Filter on the field SCO_ID_DISPLAY_CLASIFICATION : "Classification"
If SCO_FILTER_CLASIFICATION <> nullvalue() Then 
    If sCode <> "" Then sCode = sCode + " and "
    sCode = sCode  + " SCO_ID_DISPLAY_CLASIFICATION = SCO_FILTER_CLASIFICATION "
EndIf

'Ajout GTA V1 le 20/07/2012

If sCode <> "" Then sCode = "If " + sCode + " Then Return(1) Else Return(0)"

RemoveFilter()
If sCode <> "" Then AddFilter(sCode)
SCO_AFTER_LOAD(1)

'SCO_ERASE_FILTER

SCO_FILTER_DATE = NullValue()
SCO_FILTER_CLASIFICATION = NullValue()
SCO_FILTER_COUNTER = NullValue()
SCO_FILTER_NM_COUNTER = NullValue()
SCO_FILTER_SCOPE = NullValue()

RemoveFilter()
SCO_AFTER_LOAD(1)

'SCO_SAVE_FROM_PRESENTATION
'Save from presentation

'We loop over the counters in the screen to, in the case of change:
' put the correct Origin 
' calculate the maximum and minimun date
' calculate the tyoe of recalculation
nNumRegToSave = 0
nNumRegRecalcTheo = 0 : nNumRegRecalcInc = 0 : nNumRegRecalcClock = 0
dMinDate = M4_PLUS_INF : dMaxDate = M4_MINUS_INF 
nCurReg = GetCurrent()
For i=0 to Count()-1
    MoveTo(i)
    If IsUpdated() = M4_TRUE or IsNew() = M4_TRUE Then
        nNumRegToSave = nNumRegToSave + 1
        If SCO_FINAL_VALUE <> SCO_CALCULATED_VALUE Then
            SCO_ID_ORIGIN = 2 
            SCO_IMAGE_ORIGIN = "EDIT"
        Else
            SCO_ID_ORIGIN = 1
            SCO_IMAGE_ORIGIN = "CALC"
        EndIf
        
        sRecalcType = SCO_CK_RECALC_AFTER_CHANGE 'THEORETICAL, INCIDENT, CLOCK
        If sRecalcType = "THEORETICAL" Then
            nNumRegRecalcTheo = nNumRegRecalcTheo + 1
        ElseIf sRecalcType = "INCIDENT" Then
            nNumRegRecalcInc = nNumRegRecalcInc + 1
        ElseIf sRecalcType = "CLOCK" Then
            nNumRegRecalcClock = nNumRegRecalcClock + 1
        EndIf                            
        
        dMinDate = Min(dMinDate,SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_START)
        dMaxDate = Max(dMaxDate,SCO_VAR_ELM_DT_END)
    EndIf
Next

'Second we persist
If nNumRegToSave > 0 Then
    SCO_SAVE_FROM_PRESENTATION_2(nNumRegRecalcTheo,nNumRegRecalcInc,nNumRegRecalcClock,dMinDate,dMaxDate)
EndIf

If nCurReg <> M4_ERROR Then MoveTo(nCurReg)

Return(nNumRegToSave)

'SCO_SAVE_FROM_PRESENTATION
'Save from presentation 2: to the real save, both sinc

'Arguments
nNumRegRecalcTheo = ARG_NUM_REG_RECALC_THEO
nNumRegRecalcInc = ARG_NUM_REG_RECALC_INC
nNumRegRecalcClock = ARG_NUM_REG_RECALC_CLOCK
dMinDate = ARG_MIN_DATE
dMaxDate = ARG_MIN_DATE


nRet = Persist_tree()

'Recalculation
If nRet <> M4_ERROR and nNumRegRecalcTheo > 0 Then
    'theoretical counters
    nRet = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_CALL_AFTER_CHANGE_THEO(STD_ID_HR,STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,dMinDate,dMaxDate,SCO_EXECUTE_ALL_ALERTS_COUNTER)   
EndIf
If nRet <> M4_ERROR and ( nNumRegRecalcInc > 0 or nNumRegRecalcClock > 0 ) Then
    'incidence and clock counters
    bForceEndDayProc = M4_FALSE
    nRet = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_CALL_AFTER_CLOCK_INOUT(STD_ID_HR,STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,dMinDate,dMaxDate,SCO_EXECUTE_ALL_ALERTS_COUNTER,bForceEndDayProc)   
EndIf

'Reload
If nRet <> M4_ERROR and ( nNumRegRecalcTheo > 0 or nNumRegRecalcInc > 0 or nNumRegRecalcClock > 0)Then
    SRCO_GTA_RWD_PRES.SCO_LOAD_EMPL_COUNTERS_4_PRES()
EndIf

'The data was saved successfully....
If nRet <> M4_ERROR Then
    SetLog(M4_DEBUGINFOLOG,21,122,2)    
EndIf

M4RCH_RULES3/ID_TI/SRCO_READ_HR_REAL_WOR.SOURCE_CODE:
'Save data modified in presentation by the user: both

If IsEOF() = M4_FALSE Then

    nRet = M4_SUCCESS
    If CheckModify() = TRUE Then
    
        '*** Theoretical control system
        'Calc dates to modify
        dMinDate = M4_PLUS_INF 
        dMaxDate = M4_MINUS_INF 
        For i = 0 to Count()-1
            MoveTo(i)
            If IsUpdated()=M4_TRUE then
                dMinDate = Min(dMinDate,DT_START)
                dMaxDate = Max(dMaxDate,DT_START)
            EndIf
        Next
        
        nRet = 1 
        sMsg = ""
        THEO_CNTRL_SYSTEM!SRCO_GTA_MT_THEO_CNTRL_SYSTEM.SCO_API_CONTROL(SCO_ID_THEO_CNTRL_SYSTEM,dMinDate,dMaxDate,nRet,sMsg)
    
        If nRet = -1 Then
            'Error
            nRet = DialogBox(M4_BTN_YES_NO,GetNodeItemData(GetThisNodeId(),"SCO_LBL_THEO_CNTRL_SYSTEM",M4_ITEM_NAME),sMsg+" "+GetErrorString(18,10,557))
            If nRet = M4_NO Then Return(M4_FALSE)
        ElseIf nRet = 0 Then
            'Question
            nRet = DialogBox(M4_BTN_YES_NO,GetNodeItemData(GetThisNodeId(),"SCO_LBL_THEO_CNTRL_SYSTEM",M4_ITEM_NAME),sMsg)
            If nRet = M4_NO Then Return(M4_FALSE)
        EndIf        
        
        '*** End of:Theoretical control systems
        
        nRet = PERSIST_2()
    
    EndIf
    
    If nRet <> M4_ERROR Then
        Setlog(1,18,10,504,STD_ID_HR)  'ok
    Else
        Setlog(-1,18,10,505,STD_ID_HR)
        Return(M4_FALSE)
    EndIf
EndIf
Return(M4_TRUE)

'Save data modified in presentation by the user: both sync

'Traitement du statut et du code origin des enregistrements
SCO_MODIF_STATUS()

'Calc dates to recalculate: what the user has modified
dMinDate = M4_PLUS_INF 
dMaxDate = M4_MINUS_INF 
For i = 0 to Count()-1
    MoveTo(i)
    If IsUpdated()=M4_TRUE then
        dMinDate = Min(dMinDate,DT_START)
        dMaxDate = Max(dMaxDate,DT_START)
    EndIf
Next

'Save process
BeginTransaction()
    nRet = Persist_tree()
    If nRet <> M4_ERROR and dMinDate <> M4_PLUS_INF and dMaxDate <> M4_MINUS_INF Then
        'We have to recalculate alerts, counters,...
        nRet = SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_CALL_AFTER_CHANGE_THEO(STD_ID_HR,STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,dMinDate,dMaxDate,SCO_EXECUTE_ALL_ALERTS_COUNTER)
    EndIf
If nRet = M4_ERROR Then
    EndTransaction(M4_ROLLBACK_RESUME)
Else
    EndTransaction(M4_COMMIT)    
EndIf

'Recharger les données pour enlever les enregistrements théoriques
SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_APPEL_HR_PERIOD_LOAD()

Return(nRet)

'SCO_AFTER_CHG_DAY_TYPE
'After change day type, calendar day type or theretical number of hours

X = SCO_ID_M4_TYPE_HRS_DAY

'Control: if the day has time slot the number of hours must be the number of hours of the day (or 0 if there are holiday)
If SCO_WORK_THEO_HRS_LIST <> ToDouble(SCO_WORK_THEO) and SCO_ID_TIMETABLE <> nullvalue() Then
    
    If (SCO_ID_DAYCALEN_TYPE = nullvalue()) or (SCO_ID_DAYCALEN_TYPE <> nullvalue() and SCO_WORK_THEO <> 0)  Then
        SetLog(M4_ERRORLOG,18,10,527)
        'On this screen you cannot put a number of hours different, for a day with slots. You must click the Details button and change both, the hours of day as time slots.
        SCO_WORK_THEO = SCO_WORK_THEO_HRS_LIST
        Return(M4_FALSE)
    EndIf
EndIf

'We change the real field after change the property
sThisNode = GetThisNodeId()
If SCO_WORK_THEO_DAY <> nullvalue() Then
    sLblDays = GetNodeItemData("",sThisNode,"SCO_LBL_DAYS",M4_ITEM_NAME)
    sLblDay  = GetNodeItemData("",sThisNode,"SCO_LBL_DAY" ,M4_ITEM_NAME)
    SCO_WORK_THEO_DAY = SCO_WORK_THEO
    If SCO_WORK_THEO > 1 Then 
        SCO_WORK_THEO_STRING = sLblDays 
    Else
        SCO_WORK_THEO_STRING = sLblDay            
    EndIf
Else
    sLblHours = GetNodeItemData("",sThisNode,"SCO_LBL_HOURS",M4_ITEM_NAME)
    sLblHour  = GetNodeItemData("",sThisNode,"SCO_LBL_HOUR" ,M4_ITEM_NAME)        
    SCO_WORK_THEO_HRS = SCO_WORK_THEO
    If SCO_WORK_THEO > 1 Then 
        SCO_WORK_THEO_STRING = sLblHours 
    Else
        SCO_WORK_THEO_STRING = sLblHour  
    EndIf                  
EndIf

'We recalculate the real hours & days
SCO_RECALC_REAL_HRS()

SCO_CALC_TRAN_TIMESLOT_PER_VW()

Return(M4_TRUE)

'SCO_CALC_TRAN_TIMESLOT_PER_VW
'Calculate time slot to view in presentation

sTS = SCO_TRANSLATED_TIMESLOT_PER_1

If sTS = nullvalue() Then sTS = SCO_TRANSLATED_TIMESLOT_PER_2

SCO_TRANSLATED_TIMESLOT_PER_VW = sTS

'SCO_DELETE_ALL
'Delete all the registers modified by the user (origin = 2), and reload the originals

nNumRegOr2 = 0
dMinDate = M4_PLUS_INF 
dMaxDate = M4_MINUS_INF 
nRet = M4_SUCCESS

If CheckModify() = TRUE Then
    Setlog(1,18,10,508)
    return(M4_ERROR)
EndIf

For i = 0 to Count()-1
    MoveTo(i)
    If SCO_ID_ORIGIN = 2 and nRet <> M4_ERROR then
        nNumRegOr2 = nNumRegOr2 + 1
        dMinDate = Min(dMinDate,DT_START)
        dMaxDate = Max(dMaxDate,DT_START)

        dDtStart = DT_START
        SCO_FILL_UPDATE_STATUS(dDtStart)
        DeleteRegister()          
    EndIf
Next

If nNumRegOr2 > 0 and nRet <> M4_ERROR Then

    BeginDBTransaction()  
    nRet = delete_blk()
    nRet = SRCO_UPDATE_STATUS(0,1)
    nRet = SRCO_DELETE_RWD_THEOR_TS(0,1)
    SRCO_UPDATE_STATUS = nullvalue()
    SRCO_DELETE_RWD_THEOR_TS = nullvalue()

    'Recalculate alerts, counters,...
    SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_CALL_AFTER_CHANGE_THEO(STD_ID_HR,STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,dMinDate,dMaxDate,SCO_EXECUTE_ALL_ALERTS_COUNTER)

    EndDBTransaction(COMMIT)

    'Recharger les données valides
    DESTROYBLOCK()
    SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_APPEL_HR_PERIOD_LOAD() 
EndIf

'If nbReg > 0 Then
'    'Enregistrer les modifications en cours

'

'EndIf

'SCO_DELETE_REG
'Delete this register if is moldified by the user (origin = 2), and reload the original

nRet = M4_SUCCESS
If SCO_ID_ORIGIN = 2 then

    If IsUpdated() = TRUE Then
        Setlog(1,18,10,508)
        return(M4_ERROR)
    EndIf
    BeginDBTransaction()  
   
    dDtStart = DT_START
    deleteregister()
    nRet = delete_blk()

    If nRet<>M4_ERROR Then
        SCO_FILL_UPDATE_STATUS(dDtStart)
        nRet = SRCO_UPDATE_STATUS(0,1)
        nRet = SRCO_DELETE_RWD_THEOR_TS(0,1)
        SRCO_UPDATE_STATUS = nullvalue()
        SRCO_DELETE_RWD_THEOR_TS  = nullvalue()
    EndIf

    If nRet<>M4_ERROR Then
        'Recalculate alerts, counters,...
        SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_CALL_AFTER_CHANGE_THEO(STD_ID_HR,STD_OR_HR_PERIOD,DT_START,DT_START,SCO_EXECUTE_ALL_ALERTS_COUNTER)

        EndDBTransaction(COMMIT)

        'Recharger les données valides
        DESTROYBLOCK()
        SRCO_GTA_REAL_WORK_DAYS.SCO_APPEL_HR_PERIOD_LOAD()               
    Else
        EndDBTransaction(ROLLBACK)
    EndIf
    
EndIf
return(nRet)

If SRCO_UPDATE_STATUS = nullvalue() Then

    sIdHr = STD_ID_HR
    nOrPer = STD_OR_HR_PERIOD

    sUpdate = "UPDATE SCO_HR_REAL_WORK_DAYS A SET A.SCO_ID_STATUS = @SCO_STATUS_DEF "
    sUpdate = sUpdate + " WHERE A.STD_ID_HR='"+sIdHr+"' AND A.STD_OR_HR_PERIOD="+ToString(nOrPer,0)
    sUpdate = sUpdate + " AND A.DT_START In ( #TO_DATE('"+ToString(ARG_DT_START,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)+"')) "
    sUpdate = sUpdate + " AND A.SCO_ID_STATUS = 1 "

    SRCO_UPDATE_STATUS = sUpdate 
    
    
    sDelete = "DELETE SCO_HR_RWD_THEOR_TIME_SLOTS A WHERE A.STD_ID_HR='"+sIdHr+"' AND A.STD_OR_HR_PERIOD="+ToString(nOrPer,0)
    sDelete = sDelete + " AND A.DT_START In ( #TO_DATE('"+ToString(ARG_DT_START,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)+"')) "
    sDelete = sDelete + " AND A.SCO_ID_STATUS = 2 AND A.SCO_ID_ORIGIN = 2 "
    SRCO_DELETE_RWD_THEOR_TS = sDelete 
    
Else

    sUpdate = SRCO_UPDATE_STATUS
    sUpdate = Replace(sUpdate,"'))", "'),#TO_DATE('"+ToString(ARG_DT_START,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)+"'))")
    SRCO_UPDATE_STATUS = sUpdate 

    sDelete = SRCO_DELETE_RWD_THEOR_TS
    sDelete = Replace(sDelete,"'))", "'),#TO_DATE('"+ToString(ARG_DT_START,M4_SHORT_DATE_FORMAT)+"'))")

'SCO_FIND_WEEK
'Arguments: ARG_OR_WEEK

nReg = FindRegister("SCO_OR_WEEK",ARG_OR_WEEK,M4_EQUAL)
If nReg <> M4_ERROR Then
    MoveTo(nReg)
Else
    'Load
    SCO_OR_WEEK_P = ARG_OR_WEEK
    Load_blk()
    nReg = FindRegister("SCO_OR_WEEK",ARG_OR_WEEK,M4_EQUAL)    
    If nReg <> M4_ERROR Then
        MoveTo(nReg)   
    EndIf
EndIf

Return(nReg)

'SCO_GET_UNIT_OF_WEEK_DAY
'Arguments: ARG_OR_WEEK, ARG_DAY
'Return: number of units or M4_ERROR

nRet = SCO_FIND_WEEK(ARG_OR_WEEK)

If nRet <> M4_ERROR Then

    If ARG_DAY = 1 Then 
        nRet = SCO_WKNG_HRS_DAY_MONDAY
    ElseIf ARG_DAY = 2 Then 
        nRet = SCO_WKNG_HRS_DAY_TUESDAY
    ElseIf ARG_DAY = 3 Then 
        nRet = SCO_WKNG_HRS_DAY_WEDNESDAY
    ElseIf ARG_DAY = 4 Then 
        nRet = SCO_WKNG_HRS_DAY_THURSDAY
    ElseIf ARG_DAY = 5 Then 
        nRet = SCO_WKNG_HRS_DAY_FRIDAY
    ElseIf ARG_DAY = 6 Then 
        nRet = SCO_WKNG_HRS_DAY_SATURDAY
    ElseIf ARG_DAY = 7 Then 
        nRet = SCO_WKNG_HRS_DAY_SUNDAY
    EndIf
    
EndIf

Return(nRet)

 )

 (A.SCO_DT_START <= (SELECT #MAX( N.SCO_DT_END )

                   ) OR  
 NOT EXISTS (SELECT  N.SCO_ID_HR 
             FROM SCO_H_HR_WUNIT N
